- You have strong product instincts and build with the user in mind. You understand that a model is only as good as the problem it solves.

- You have moved past prototyping and have a deep understanding of the realities of LLMOps, data retrieval, prompt and context engineering, as well as model evaluation in production.

- You don't just call APIs, you understand the data feeding the AI system and can reason about data quality, architecture, and retrieval without needing a dedicated data engineer beside you at all times.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You are primarily interested in model research or algorithm development. This role is about shipping working AI features to production.

- You need fully defined specs and a groomed backlog to operate effectively. We expect you to discover and define the problem alongside Product and Design.

- You cannot explain AI trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. You will regularly work with Product Managers, Designers, and business leaders who need to understand what is and isn't possible.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Familiarise yourself with our codebase, tooling and roadmap.

- Partner with our Principal Engineer to define and own our approach to AI feature development.

- Contribute to shaping the roadmap for tooling and features developed by our GenAI Core team.

- Collaborate with Product and Data teams to ship a first feature to production

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills!

THE LOCATION

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work.

We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Technical screening: A 15 to 30 minute call with our Talent Partner to check your knowledge of key technical topics

3. System design interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on scoping and designing an AI feature

4. Live coding interview: A 75-minute practical session with our engineers focusing on implementing your solution.

5. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation to deep dive into your knowledge and experience.

6. Final interview: A leadership interview focusing on your behavioural, communication and collaboration skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: this is neither a research-driven nor a traditional data or software engineering role. We're looking for someone with proven experience shipping customer-facing AI products who can also confidently operate at Senior level in a SaaS organisation. This means we'll be looking for evidence that you can own fairly complex technical features from design to implementation.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo.

You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams.

This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities.

The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers, along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across:

- Customer Support

- Customer Onboarding

- Sales and Account Management

- Product and Product Operations

- Revenue Operations

- Finance

- Data and Analytics

- Program Management and Operations

You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership.

You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager, you will:

- Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth.

- Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders, positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment.

- Develop detailed customer success plans that connect the customer’s strategic goals to measurable outcomes, adoption milestones, responsibilities, and timelines.

- Lead executive business reviews and strategic customer meetings that demonstrate value, address risks, align stakeholders, and create clear next steps.

- Drive product adoption across complex customer organisations, helping customers expand usage across teams, entities, locations, use cases, and workflows.

- Create and maintain detailed stakeholder maps, identifying decision-makers, champions, influencers, operational contacts, blockers, and executive sponsors.

- Identify churn risk early using product usage, engagement, stakeholder, support, financial, organisational, and external business signals.

- Build and execute churn-prevention plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, customer commitments, and executive escalation paths.

- Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones.

- Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence.

- Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs.

- Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication.

- Act as the customer’s internal advocate, ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo.

- Navigate customer change effectively, including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities.

- Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed.

- Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations.

- Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility.

TO PUT THINGS INTO CONTEXT

In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as:

- strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers

- improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability

- increasing adoption across complex customer organisations

- creating stronger executive engagement and governance

- identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue

- improving forecast accuracy and account visibility

- coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams

- helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo

- identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption

- improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning

- helping customers navigate operational and organisational change

- turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight

You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms.

Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack.

WHAT YOU BRING

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience, managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers.

- Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role.

- Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment.

- A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers, including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation.

- Strong executive relationship-management skills, with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders.

- Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers.

- Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills, including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans.

- Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities.

- Strong commercial judgment, with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues.

- Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews.

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information.

- Strong cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority.

- A structured and proactive approach to account management, with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.

- Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly.

- The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution.

NICE TO HAVE

- Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology

- Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders

- Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers

- Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations

- Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation

- Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement

- Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions

- Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU?

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers.

- You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations.

- You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes.

- You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk.

- You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline.

- You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations.

- You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs.

- You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships.

THIS ROLE IS NOT A GOOD FIT FOR YOU IF:

- You have not directly managed enterprise or strategic customer relationships.

- You prefer transactional or high-volume customer portfolios.

- You are uncomfortable owning customer risk, retention, and renewal readiness.

- You prefer reacting to customer requests rather than building proactive engagement strategies.

- You are uncomfortable engaging executive stakeholders or leading difficult conversations.

- You do not enjoy detailed forecasting, CRM management, and account planning.

- You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination.

- You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

IN YOUR FIRST 1 MONTH AT PLEO, YOU’LL:

- Learn Pleo’s product, enterprise customer journey, value proposition, and Customer Success operating model.

- Build a detailed understanding of your customer portfolio, including revenue, renewal dates, usage, stakeholders, open issues, risks, and growth potential.

- Establish relationships with key customer stakeholders and internal account partners.

- Review and improve success plans, stakeholder maps, account plans, and risk assessments.

- Establish clear operating rhythms for customer engagement, internal coordination, and forecasting.

- Identify immediate risks, adoption gaps, and opportunities across your portfolio.

IN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS, YOU’LL:

- Lead consistent executive and operational engagement across your customer portfolio.

- Improve customer success planning, value documentation, and renewal readiness.

- Strengthen the accuracy and detail of customer health and renewal forecasts.

- Deliver measurable progress against adoption, engagement, and customer outcome goals.

- Build and execute mitigation plans for at-risk customers.

- Identify and support qualified expansion opportunities.

- Become a trusted advisor to customer stakeholders and a reliable source of account intelligence internally.

IN YOUR FIRST 5 MONTHS, YOU’LL:

- Build a healthy and well-managed portfolio of enterprise customers.

- Deliver strong retention and renewal performance.

- Improve adoption and value realisation across complex customer organisations.

- Develop trusted relationships with senior and executive customer stakeholders.

- Demonstrate strong forecast accuracy and proactive risk management.

- Contribute repeatable best practices and insight to Pleo’s broader enterprise Customer Success model.

- Be recognised as a senior individual contributor capable of managing Pleo’s most important and complex customer relationships.

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE

- Enterprise customers have clear success plans connected to measurable business outcomes.

- Executive and operational customer relationships are strong and multi-threaded.

- Customer risks are identified early and addressed through structured mitigation plans.

- Renewal forecasts are detailed, accurate, and supported by clear account evidence.

- Customers demonstrate stronger product adoption and value realisation.

- Escalations are managed with urgency, clarity, and strong customer communication.

- Internal teams are aligned around customer priorities, responsibilities, and next steps.

- Renewal and retention performance is strong across the assigned portfolio.

- Expansion opportunities are identified through customer value and business need rather than transactional selling.

- Pleo is viewed as a strategic partner rather than simply a product provider.

CANDIDATE PROFILE SUMMARY

The strongest candidate for this role is an experienced enterprise Customer Success professional who combines senior-level relationship skills with commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and disciplined account execution.

They have at least three years of direct enterprise experience and are comfortable managing complex customers with multiple stakeholders, high expectations, and significant revenue impact.

They know how to earn executive trust, demonstrate value, predict and prevent churn, maintain accurate forecasts, and mobilise cross-functional teams around customer outcomes. They are proactive, credible, highly organised, and capable of protecting and growing Pleo’s most strategic customer relationships.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Manager, IT
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Hi there!

This role sits at the center of two things that matter a lot to Zapier right now: keeping ~800 Zapiens productive and secure, and building the identity and access controls enterprise buyers scrutinize. I'm looking for someone who wants to run IT as a product, not a help desk — someone who sees AI-first operations and zero-trust architecture as the standard, not a stretch goal, and who's excited to build the team that makes that the norm.

Zapier is ~800 people, fully remote, and IT's first job is to keep the team productive and secure and to deliver a reliable, fast service, smooth onboarding and offboarding, and a great employee experience at scale. That sits on a backbone of identity (Okta), endpoint management (Jamf), and SaaS governance across 200+ apps. This internal foundation is the core of the role.

As Zapier moves upmarket, IT carries a second and growing mandate: the identity, access, and governance controls that enterprise buyers need to scrutinize. That makes a deep, capacity-backed partnership with Security central to the job and increasingly tied to how Zapier earns enterprise trust.

We're looking for a Senior Manager who's excited to lead a high performing, globally distributed team that's driven by building systems that increasingly run on Zapier's own product — energized by the shift toward enterprise-grade IT, and eager to be the gold standard for other IT teams using Zapier too.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Raise the bar on IT service — AI-first. Move IT from reactive support to a proactive, AI-first operation for ~800 Zapiens — onboarding, offboarding, and employee experience — with self-service provisioning, deflection, and proactive remediation as the operating model.

Architect identity, endpoints, and zero-trust access. Evolve Okta (SSO, SCIM, OIDC, SAML, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, lifecycle automation) and Jamf (device trust, EDR) into an enterprise-grade access layer, and own the IT side of zero-trust end to end — identity, device, and access — as a co-owner with Security.

Govern tooling as a portfolio. Treat the app portfolio as a strategic asset. Bring structure, ROI accountability, and vendor governance to 200+ tools, not just approval workflows.

Own major incidents end to end. Lead high-severity IT operational incident response and the root-cause and prevention that follow. Security incidents route to Security's Detection & Response program; IT partners on containment and remediation.

Plan IT around where Zapier is headed. Translate company direction — enterprise, AI, scale — into an IT roadmap you own and deliver, so IT is ready ahead of the need rather than catching up to it.

Influence and hold the line. Set and enforce policy on access, procurement, and security across People Ops, Finance, Legal, Product, and Engineering, moving senior stakeholders, not escalating to them. Partner with Security on security policy, operationalizing and enforcing it within IT's domain.

Build the IT org, not just the team. Turn a flat, reactive team into a tiered, globally distributed function, depth, not dependence. Expect to lead from in the mix, a player-coach who rolls up their sleeves on the hardest problems while building the team that makes that the exception, not the norm. You'll lead a team of ~6 today, evolving the structure as IT scales.

Power the enterprise motion. Make IT the internal proving ground for enterprise access controls and feed gaps to Product — as requested, be the IT reference in enterprise deals, speaking to IT personas about how we run IT on Zapier and handle access and governance at scale.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Proven IT leadership at scale. 8+ years in IT/Systems Engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers — ideally scaling IT in a high-growth, fully remote company. You build teams with real standards and accountability, develop people deliberately, and build depth rather than dependency across timezones.

AI, automation, and product mindset. You've built, championed, and implemented AI or automation into IT or security operations and treat it as core infrastructure. You're curious by nature — new products, AI, and automation are what get you excited to come to work — and you see running IT on Zapier's own product as a competitive advantage, not a nice-to-have.

Technical credibility. Deep hands-on Okta (SSO, SCIM, OIDC, SAML, MFA, RBAC/ABAC, lifecycle automation) and Jamf (device trust, EDR), plus SaaS governance at scale — you're the person your team trusts on hard calls. You've partnered with Security on zero trust, enterprise access controls, and compliance (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001), and understand the work well enough to own the controls and evidence that support them.

Strategic execution. You turn business direction into a clear IT strategy, and you follow through: plans become results, not slide decks.

Operational and financial rigor. You run to SLAs and metrics, lead major-incident response, and run SaaS spend with FinOps discipline — optimization targets and ROI.

Influence and communication. You operate across Security, Legal, Finance, and Engineering at a senior level — you win buy-in and drive people to act, not just weigh in. You frame things clearly in writing and in person, don't bury the lede, and don't soften important messages until they lose meaning. You're equally credible in customer-facing conversations, representing Zapier's IT posture to enterprise IT buyers and security teams.

NICE TO HAVE

For a role this broad, we value credentials that span identity, endpoint, security/compliance, and IT operations over deep specialization in any one — and treat all of these as signals, not requirements.

Certifications (any across these domains; we value breadth over a single track)

- Identity & access: Okta Certified (Administrator / Professional / Consultant).

- Endpoint / MDM: Jamf Certified (Admin or Pro), Apple Deployment.

- Security: CISSP, CISM, or Security+ — CCSP (cloud security) a plus.

- Compliance & audit: CISA, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor.

- Cloud: AWS certification (our stack includes AWS/IaC).

- IT service management: ITIL (service-delivery and SLA maturity).

- Program / people leadership: PMP or equivalent a plus.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Face Deduplication Collection
description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

title: Senior Product Designer (Clinical Education Platform)
description:
Headquarters: Toronto, ON / Austin, TX / Canada Remote / USA Remote

About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

Fullscript Academy is an education platform designed to support healthcare providers in delivering effective whole person care through evidence-based ingredient education and advanced diagnostic training. We deliver education through a variety of formats, including courses, webinars, articles, clinical guides, and in-app resources to support real-time clinical decision-making.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to shape the future of clinical education on Fullscript Academy. You are a strong product designer first and foremost, with deep experience in user experience design and a sharp eye for creating beautiful, intuitive interfaces that reduce complexity. You design with a high standard of craft, creating experiences that feel credible, modern, and appropriate for a clinical, professional audience.

You have experience designing products that support learning, not just usage. You understand how to design for comprehension, retention, motivation, and long-term behavior change, and you know the difference between helping a user complete a task and helping them truly understand something.

What You’ll Do:- Support seamless provider journeys across onboarding, content discovery, and course enrollment.
- Design experiences that help providers understand and retain clinical knowledge, stay motivated over time, and apply learning with confidence.
- Go beyond a single surface by creating the connective tissue between Academy and the broader Fullscript product ecosystem, ensuring context carries across experiences and learning naturally transitions into action.
- Lead nimble, iterative UX research and testing to validate ideas, experiment with interaction patterns and information architecture, and refine solutions in a fast-moving environment.
- Translate user insights, behavioral data, and product strategy into clear, thoughtful design direction.
- Partner closely with Engineering to deliver high-quality, well-documented designs, adapt to technical constraints, and collaboratively refine scope and solutions.
- Collaborate with clinicians and content leaders to shape new educational formats, deeply understand learning objectives, and design experiences that reduce complexity while preserving clinical nuance.
- Contribute to scalable patterns that maintain clarity, credibility, and consistency across Academy.

What You Bring:- Strong product design craft across user experience research, user experience design, and visual design.
- Experience designing digital products end to end, from discovery and concept development through stakeholder alignment, prototyping, and developer handoff.
- Experience working closely with engineering teams, adapting to technical constraints, refining scope collaboratively, and delivering clear, production-ready design files.
- Experience designing for learning, behavior change, or knowledge retention outcomes.
- Experience working across connected surfaces or product ecosystems.

Bonus if you have experience with:- Professional EdTech platforms
- Digital onboarding or academy-style products
- Financial education or financial literacy tools
- Knowledge or learning-enhancement platforms (e.g., AI note-taking tools)
- Healthcare experience is a plus, but not required.

What we can offer you:- Generous PTO and competitive pay
- Fullscript’s RRSP/401k  match program for financial health
- Flexible benefits package and workplace wellness program
- Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives
- Discount on Fullscript catalog of products

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $115,000 and $145,000 CAD. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only and does not include stock options, wellness stipends, or other benefits that are part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page. We’re not able to respond to individual messages about open roles on email or social channels.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at [email protected].

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future
Â
The RoleWe are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.
This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.
You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own- Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

- Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

- Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

- Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

- Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

- Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

- Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

- Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

- Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

- Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

- Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For- Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

- Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

- Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

- Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

- Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

- Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

- Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

- Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

- Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

- Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For- Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

- Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

- Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

- Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

- People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

- Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The BarWe are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.
A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.
You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

LocationThis is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.
Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
Â
LanguageEnglish is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview ProcessOur process is designed to move fast:
- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical / engineering leadership interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About the team

The Regulatory & Compliance team helps Airwallex grow responsibly as a global financial platform. We work at the intersection of law, regulation, risk, and business execution, partnering closely with teams across the company to navigate complexity, enable growth, and protect the trust our customers, partners, and regulators place in us. It’s a team for people who are thoughtful, practical, and energized by solving hard problems in a fast-moving, highly regulated environment.

What you’ll do

As Senior Manager, Regulatory Operations, APAC, you will build and run the engine that turns complex regulatory and partner obligations into real, tested, and well‑evidenced controls across our APAC‑licensed entities and products. You will sit within Regulatory Legal & Compliance and work closely with Regulatory Compliance, Regulatory Legal, Risk, Product, Operations, Finance, and external financial partners to strengthen a control environment that is practical, scalable, and regulator‑ready. This role is hands‑on and execution‑focused: you will not just interpret rules, you will design, implement, and continuously improve the controls, documentation, and reporting that demonstrate we are meeting our obligations day‑to‑day.

This role is based in Singapore and will be reporting to the .

Responsibilities:

- Identify, interpret, and operationalize regulatory and partner obligations across APAC jurisdictions, products, and licensed entities, and translate those obligations into clear governance, controls, and execution requirements.

- Manage the end‑to‑end design of key regulatory and partner controls through implementation, partnering with Product, Operations, Engineering, Risk, and Regulatory Compliance to embed controls into real workflows and systems.

- Build and maintain regulator and partner‑ready documentation for your control scope, including obligation mappings, control descriptions, RACIs, testing approaches, evidence standards, and remediation tracking.

- Engage with third parties such as regulators, auditors, and financial partners in connection with inquiries relating to controls, confidently explaining our obligations, our control architecture, and how specific controls operate in practice.

- Support regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, and related supervisory engagements in APAC by coordinating responses, curating consistent evidence packages, maintaining “exam‑ready” documentation, and partnering with Regulatory Compliance and Regulatory Legal.

- Support the governance process for material changes to controls, ensuring that relevant obligation owners and stakeholders across Product, Operations, Engineering and Compliance are notified and aligned before changes to shared controls are implemented, and that the obligations register reflects the updated control design.

- Contribute to the design and operation of regional regulatory reporting and obligations governance, ensuring that what must be reported, by whom, when, and from which systems is clearly defined and appropriately controlled.

- Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or duplication in obligations, controls, and evidence across APAC, and drive pragmatic remediation or uplift plans that balance regulatory expectations, partner requirements, and business impact.

- Use and contribute to the team's GRC tooling and compliance dashboards, maintaining accurate and current records of APAC obligations, controls, evidence and open issues within the central system, and supporting the transition towards an AI Native GRC tooling.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- 10+ years of experience in regulatory operations, regulatory compliance, internal audit, risk management, or a similar discipline within a fast‑growing tech startup and/or financial services, payments, or fintech company.

- Proven experience translating legal, regulatory, or partner requirements into operational controls, procedures, and testing or assurance activities, not just policy drafting.

- Direct involvement in supporting regulatory exams, audits, inspections, RFIs, or partner due‑diligence reviews, with clear personal ownership for planning, coordination, documentation, or remediation workstreams.

- Strong project management skills, with a track record of driving cross‑functional control or reporting initiatives to completion across Product, Operations, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

- Excellent analytical and writing skills, with the ability to turn complex regulatory concepts into clear, concise control requirements and exam‑ready materials.

- Comfort operating in a fast‑moving, high‑standards environment with evolving priorities and meaningful cross‑functional ownership, consistent with Airwallex’s broader operating model.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with payments, e‑money, card issuing or acquiring, treasury, embedded finance, or other multi‑jurisdiction fintech business models.

- Prior exposure to APAC regulators or regulatory frameworks (for example MAS, HKMA, AUSTRAC, SFC, or local central banks) and to regional bank or card scheme partners on control or reporting topics.

- Experience building or enhancing obligations registers, controls libraries, regulatory reporting operating models, or similar second‑line compliance infrastructure.

- Familiarity with GRC or similar tooling to manage obligations, controls, issues, and evidence at scale.

- Relevant professional certifications (such as CAMS, CRCM, CIA, CISA) or formal legal / compliance‑related education.

ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The GTM Partnerships team at Airwallex is focused on building and scaling partnerships that accelerate customer acquisition, deepen ecosystem reach, and unlock long-term growth. In Singapore, this role will support our SME & Growth segment by managing and activating a broad portfolio of corporate secretarial and professional services partners.

This portfolio represents a high-volume, high-potential partner base that sits alongside our priority partner accounts. Success in this role comes from creating repeatable engagement programs, strengthening partner activation, and identifying the highest-potential partners to grow within the Airwallex ecosystem.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As the GTM Partnerships Manager, SME & Growth, you will own a large portfolio of corporate secretarial and professional services partners in Singapore. This is a portfolio growth and partner engagement role focused on driving activation, maintaining partner health, and building scalable programs that help partners stay engaged with Airwallex over time.

This role is based in Singapore.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own and grow a high-volume portfolio of corporate secretarial and professional services partners through scalable engagement programs, including newsletters, product updates, webinars, in-person events, and structured check-ins

- Proactively source, cold call, and reach out to new and existing partners to drive referral and revenue pipeline, strengthen relationships, and uncover new collaboration opportunities

- Design and run partner re-engagement programs for dormant accounts, using clear outreach cadences and performance tracking to continuously improve activation outcomes

- Monitor referral activity, engagement trends, and other performance signals across the portfolio to identify partners with strong growth potential

- Build the case for high-potential partners to transition into Airwallex’s priority partner tier where appropriate

- Partner closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, legal, operations, and product to deliver relevant content, updates, and programs to partners at scale

- Maintain accurate CRM segmentation and strong data hygiene across the portfolio to support prioritisation, reporting, and program effectiveness

- Contribute ideas, market and partner insights, and operational improvements to senior GTM Partnerships stakeholders on how to strengthen partner engagement across the broader partner base

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 2–4 years of experience in channel partnerships, customer success, partner marketing, account management, or related roles

- Experience managing a high-volume portfolio of accounts or partners and building repeatable engagement programs rather than relying solely on one-to-one relationship management

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear and engaging partner-facing content and confidently lead webinars, meetings, or partner calls

- A structured, process-oriented approach to portfolio management, with strong attention to segmentation, cadence, and CRM hygiene

- Strong analytical judgment and the ability to identify patterns, prioritise opportunities, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact

- A proactive, accountable, and collaborative working style, with the ability to operate effectively across teams and levels

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience running one-to-many engagement programs such as newsletters, lifecycle campaigns, webinars, community initiatives, or similar partner programs

- Familiarity with the corporate secretarial, professional services, or adjacent B2B services ecosystem in Singapore

- Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology or fintech environment

- Proficiency in both written and spoken English and Mandarin

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

OverviewPhysical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.
Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.
The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.
We have one product: new physics, at scale.
Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.
Â
Role and Responsibilities- Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

- The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

- Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

- We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For-  A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

- Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

- You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

- A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have- Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

- Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

- Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â
How We WorkWe hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.
Â
Location and CompensationThis role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

description:
About Delinea:
Delinea is a pioneer in securing human and machine identities through intelligent, centralized authorization, empowering organizations to seamlessly govern their interactions across the modern enterprise. Leveraging AI-powered intelligence, Delineaâs leading cloud-native Identity Security Platform applies context throughout the entire identity lifecycle â across cloud and traditional infrastructure, data, SaaS applications, and AI. It is the only platform that enables you to discover all identities â including workforce, IT administrator, developers, and machines â assign appropriate access levels, detect irregularities, and respond to threats in real-time. With deployment in weeks, not months, 90% fewer resources to manage than the nearest competitor, and a 99.995% uptime, Delinea delivers robust security and operational efficiency without compromise. Learn more about Delinea on Delinea.com, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Join our passionate, global team at Delinea and help us make the world a safer and more secure place. Our success is driven by world-class product leadership, outstanding engineers, and strategic investment from TPG. We value diversity, innovation, and a culture of respect and fairness. If you're ready to push boundaries and challenge the status quo in security, we want to hear from you.
Â
Apply today to help us achieve our mission.

Job Summary

This position is on the team building StrongDM, now part of Delineaâthe universal access management platform that secures and audits access to databases, servers, Kubernetes clusters, and web applications. As a Staff Software Engineer, you will apply deep expertise across distributed systems, security, and cloud architecture to help shape the technical direction of StrongDMâs proxy and control-plane platform. You will take on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous engineering challenges, exercise independent judgment on architecture and design decisions that span multiple teams, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert on secure, high-scale distributed systems written in Go. You will report to the teamâs engineering manager.

What Youâll Do:
- Lead the architecture and technical direction of highly concurrent, distributed backend systems in Go (Golang), setting engineering standards that extend across multiple teams within StrongDM and Delinea.

- Drive design decisions for the proxy data plane (gateways and relays) and control-plane services, evaluating tradeoffs on the platformâs most complex and ambiguous technical problems.

- Partner with architects, product managers, and DevOps/SRE leadership to shape multi-quarter system roadmaps, translating broader business priorities into concrete technical strategy.

- Serve as a subject matter expert on secure network protocols and cryptographic systems (TLS/mTLS, credential brokering, key management), guiding their application across the platform.

- Lead code and design reviews across teams, holding a high bar for performance, security, and maintainability, and coach engineers on applying that bar independently.

- Investigate and resolve the most challenging technical issues in distributed, multi-cloud production environments, often requiring evaluation of ambiguous or intangible tradeoffs.

- Author and maintain architectural and technical strategy documentation that informs decisions beyond your immediate team.

- Mentor engineers across the team and may direct the work of others, building the cross-team relationships that help align engineering execution with company objectives.

What Youâll Need:
- Bachelorâs or Masterâs degree in computer science, software engineering, or related technical discipline.

- 8+ years of professional experience working as a software engineer, with deep expertise in Go (Golang), distributed systems, and backend/network service development at scale.

- Demonstrated experience architecting highly concurrent, distributed systems and exercising independent judgment on methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria, including Goâs standard networking and cryptography libraries.

- Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

- Experience with AWS (or another major cloud provider) and cloud-native deployment models at production scale.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to convey advanced technical concepts and persuade diverse stakeholders and audiences.

- Proven ability to build formal working relationships and coordinate across multiple teams and functions.

- Conceptual thinking skills sufficient to understand advanced technical issues and their broader implications for the business.

- Demonstrated track record mentoring engineers and being recognized as a subject matter expert others turn to for guidance.

Weâd Love to See:
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

- Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

- Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

- Familiarity with proxying database, SSH/RDP, Kubernetes, and HTTP traffic, and with building CLI or desktop client tooling.

- Experience shaping Zero Trust architecture strategy, just-in-time access models, and policy-as-code (e.g., Cedar) at an organizational level.

For this Job, Delinea is not considering candidates that need any type of US work authorization now or in the future.  This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J1, etc.
Why work at Delinea?
- We're passionate problem-solvers helping the world's largest organizations protect what matters most: their human and machine identities.

- We invest in people who are smart, self-motivated, and collaborative.

- What we offer in return is meaningful work, a culture of innovation and great career progression.

At Delinea, our core values are STRONG and guide our behaviors and success:
- Spirited - We bring energy and passion to everything we do

- Trust - We act with integrity and deliver on our commitments

- Respect - We listen, value different perspectives, and work as one team

- Ownership - We take initiative and follow through

- Nimble - We adapt quickly in a fast-changing environment

- Global - We embrace diverse people and ideas to drive better outcomes

We believe weaving these core values into our day-to-day actions, and our process for hiring, evaluating, and promoting employees, helps us cultivate a work environment that embraces collaboration and camaraderie.
We take care of our employees. We offer competitive salaries, a meaningful bonus program, and excellent benefits, including healthcare insurance, as well as pension/retirement matching, comprehensive life insurance, an employee assistance program, time off plans, and paid company holidays.
Delinea is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
Upon conditional offer of employment, candidates are required to complete comprehensive criminal background check, verification of education, and verification of employment, per employment policy. In addition, all publicly posted social media sites may be reviewed.

title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
description:
About Pivotal HealthPivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.
Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.
Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.
Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.
About the RoleWe're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.
This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.
What You'll Do
- Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration.  These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

- Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

- Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

- Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

- Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are
- 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

- Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

- Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

- Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

- Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

- Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

- Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have
- Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

- Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

- Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

- Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working HereWeâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.
If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.
Benefits Include:
- Competitive compensation, including equity

- Full health, dental, and vision coverage

- Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

- Flexible time off

- Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.
Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment InformationWork Authorization
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.
Reasonable Accommodations
Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

title: Maintenance Planner
description:
Job Purpose

We are seeking a Maintenance Planner to join our Engineering Stores team. In this role, you will be responsible for effectively planning, preparing, and scheduling maintenance activities to support equipment reliability, maximize plant availability, and reduce unplanned downtime. You will work closely with the Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Spare Parts teams to ensure maintenance activities are prioritized, properly resourced, and executed safely and on time.

Responsibilities:

- Plans, prepares, and schedules maintenance work orders to ensure they are completed safely, on time, and in full (OTIF).
- Reviews and prioritizes maintenance work requests based on risk, equipment criticality, and reliability.
- Prepares work orders by defining the required scope, tasks, resources, materials, and tools.
- Schedules maintenance activities considering equipment criticality, planned downtime windows, and availability of parts and services.
- Coordinates with the Spare Parts Coordinator, Storekeeper, Procurement, and Maintenance Execution teams to ensure required materials and tools are available.
- Manages maintenance task lists and ensures required materials are requested in line with inventory and supply processes.
- Ensures accurate and timely registration and management of maintenance information within the CMMS.
- Supports preventive maintenance planning and contributes to the preparation of maintenance budgets.
- Supports TPM and continuous improvement activities to improve maintenance effectiveness, reliability, and plant availability.
- Works closely with maintenance stakeholders to improve planning efficiency, reduce downtime, and support reliable execution of maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management or a related field.

Knowledge & Experience:

- 2â5 years of experience in maintenance planning, operations, supply chain, or a reliability-focused role.
- Experience in maintenance planning, preparation, and scheduling.
- Good understanding of supply and inventory management processes.
- Experience working with a CMMS and/or maintenance planning and scheduling software.
- Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to plan ahead and manage multiple priorities.
- Good reporting, data handling, and basic computer skills.
- Understanding of workflow management and maintenance work prioritization.
- Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including Maintenance, Production, Procurement, and Supply Chain.
- Experience with TPM, reliability, or continuous improvement practices is an asset.

Application Closing Date: August 28, 2026

Job Title: AI Interaction Engineer

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Sweden is a key expansion market for our Nordics region and will play a role in achieving Airwallex’s commercial success in EMEA and globally. This role is part of the commercial leadership team in Benelux and the Nordics, driving strategic decision-making and ensuring alignment with broader regional objectives. It is responsible for launching and leading an SME & Growth team on the ground in Sweden to achieve ambitious commercial aspirations, including acquiring new clients (frontbook) and managing existing clients (backbook) and driving upsells/cross-sells, and growing our presence to cement Airwallex as the market leader within the global banking and payments industry.

- Engage with customers and markets: Interface directly with customers and prospects, leading strategic deals and shaping customer-focused strategies with the global Product organisation.

- Manage performance: Oversee the commercial contribution margin, budgets, and investments, ensuring financial goals are met while aligning incentive structures with global frameworks.

- Build a high-performing team and culture: Recruit, empower, and retain top talent, foster a positive and high-performing team culture, and lead quarterly Sales Kick-Offs to align and inspire.

- Enhance brand and drive strategic collaboration: Strengthen Airwallex’s brand in Sweden and the  Nordics, represent the company at key events, and collaborate with regional and global teams to align on commercial strategies and campaigns.

- Proven experience of at least 8 years in sales, revenue growth, or go-to-market leadership, including driving cross-functional teams to achieve ambitious targets.

- Demonstrated ability to build and scale high-performing teams in dynamic, high-growth environments, with a track record of fostering team engagement and success.

- Strong analytical and data-driven approach to strategy formulation and execution, with experience in leveraging market and customer insights to optimise commercial outcomes.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across diverse teams, influence global product strategies, and represent the organisation externally.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- A strong academic background, ideally from top-tier universities, complemented by early career success in consulting or other strategic roles.
