Це роль не для дизайнера, який орієнтується лише на візуальну естетику — нам потрібна людина, яка розуміє, що рекламний креатив може виглядати просто, нестандартно або навіть навмисно «некрасиво», якщо саме це дає кращий результат.

Що будеш робити:
створювати static, video та motion-креативи для Meta Ads, зокрема з використанням AI-інструментів
працювати з готовими гіпотезами, концептами, посилами і референсами від креативного маркетолога, використовувати дані для пошуку ідей
самостійно пропонувати варіанти реалізації та покращення креативів
швидко створювати варіації успішних креативів: нові персонажі, фони, тексти, композиції, хуки і візуальні підходи
адаптувати креативи під різні аудиторії, гео, формати та рекламні задачі
шукати нові AI-інструменти та способи автоматизації, які пришвидшують виробництво креативів
підтримувати порядок у робочих файлах, шаблонах, неймінгу креативів

Наш ідеальний кандидат:
ОБОВ`ЯЗКОВО має досвід роботи дизайнером у media buying команді, performance-агенції, affiliate-команді
вміє створювати не лише статичні, але й відео-креативи
має практичний досвід роботи з AI для генерації зображень, відео, персонажів, voice-over, анімації або редагування
розуміє різницю між branding design і performance design
вміє працювати швидко, але не втрачає технічну якість, не боїться тестувати прості, нестандартні або візуально неідеальні рішення
цікавиться результатами реклами, хоче розуміти, які креативи працюють і чому
любить порядок, стандарти та зрозумілу структуру роботи, самостійно організовує свій час і тримає дедлайни

Буде перевагою, але не є обов’язковим:
досвід у Dating, Affiliate Marketing або Lead Generation
розуміння базових performance-метрик: CTR, CPC, CPA, ROI, ROAS або велике бажання поглибитись в цей напрямок
базова англійська для роботи з інструментами, референсамиі контентом

Що пропонуємо:
повністю віддалений формат роботи,Full-time
ЗП 600 -1200 $ -залежно від досвіду кандидату
роботу в performance-команді, де можна бачити реальний результат своєї роботи
чіткий backlog, мінімум мікроменеджменту, картбланш на власні ідеї та способи реалізації, можливість впливати на creative process, а не лише виконувати готові ТЗ
простір для тестування AI-інструментів і нових production-підходів
можливість професійного росту разом із Creative Factory

Як буде побудована взаємодія:
Креативний маркетолог відповідає за гіпотезу, пріоритет, концепти, посили і постановку задачі.
Дизайнер відповідає за якісне, швидке й релевантне виробництво креативів.
Media Buyers відповідають за запуск, оптимізацію та масштабування рекламних кампаній.
Після запуску дизайнер отримує фідбек по результатах, щоб сильні рішення можна було швидко масштабувати

title: Junior Product Owner
description:
Join our team as *Junior Product Owner* in the iGaming industry!

‼️This is a fully remote position but you'll be expected to work from 10:00 to 18:00 CEST/CET, regardless of your location.

🧩Who we are

*Ludicrum* is redefining iGaming, blending creativity with technology to deliver world-class gaming experiences. From marketing and product development to customer support and financial reporting, our teams are changing the game. Our *vision* is to create ultra-intuitive and engaging platforms to fuel growth through strategic partnerships and market expansion.

Our success is driven by core values deeply embedded in our culture. We believe in *transparency* , always being clear, open, and honest. We are *goal-focused* , relentlessly pursuing our targets. *Adaptability* is key: we embrace change and use it to excel. *Kaizen* guides us, as we continuously improve, test, and refine.

With a dynamic and collaborative culture and fast career growth, our 250+ global team thrives!

🥜 In a nutshell

As our *Junior Product Owner* , you'll play a key role in turning product ideas into impactful solutions. You'll own the execution of product initiatives by transforming business needs into clear, actionable development work while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the product. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Design, and business stakeholders, you'll ensure every feature delivers meaningful value for both our players and the business.

🎯 The responsibilities & the impact YOU will have: *Drive Product Execution*

*

Own and continuously refine the product backlog, ensuring work items are clear, prioritised, and ready for development.

*

Translate business needs into well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria that enable efficient delivery.

*

Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities to keep delivery on track and maximise product value.

*Solve Problems & Improve the Product*

*

Investigate business requests, analyse player behaviour and product performance, and identify opportunities to improve the user experience.

*

Validate requirements, challenge assumptions, and recommend the best solutions before development begins.

*

Independently investigate product issues, evaluate trade-offs, and propose informed recommendations.

*Collaborate Across Teams*

*

Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering, QA, Design, and business stakeholders to align on priorities and deliver impactful features.

*

Gather and clarify requirements to reduce ambiguity and ensure smooth execution throughout the product lifecycle.

*

Work with QA teams to ensure delivered features meet business requirements and maintain high quality standards.

⚡ All you need is…

*

*2+ years of experience* in *Product roles* within *iGaming* industry

*

Solid experience working with *Agile development teams*.

*

You're naturally curious and enjoy digging into problems to understand the why , not just the what.

*

You know how to turn ideas and business needs into *clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets* that engineers can actually work from.

*

You're a confident communicator who enjoys talking to people, asking questions, and challenging assumptions. You'll spend a lot of time working across teams, so being proactive and comfortable starting conversations is essential.

*

You take ownership, don't wait to be told what to do, and aren't afraid to suggest better ways of solving a problem.

*

You've worked with tools like *Jira, Confluence, or similar* to manage product delivery.

Nice to have

*

Experience with FullStory, BI dashboards, or other product analytics tools to understand user behaviour and product performance.

*

Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation, using data to validate product decisions.

*

A basic understanding of software development processes and how engineering teams work.

*

A Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), SAFe Product Owner, or similar Agile certification.

*🌟 Why You’ll love working here:*

*

*Flexible and Remote Working:* Work from anywhere, supporting your work-life balance.

*

*Equipment provided:* We’ll set you up with a laptop, headphones, and mouse so you’re ready to work comfortably.

*

*Career Growth:* We’re committed to your development, offering training and advancement opportunities.

*

*Performance Recognition:* Earn raises and career progression opportunities based on a quarterly performance review and a constructive feedback cycle.

*

*Health and Fitness Benefits* : Receive fitness reimbursements from day one, and after one year of employment, gain access to a health budget to support your well-being.

*

*Self Development Budget* : Invest in your growth through online courses and professional learning opportunities.

*

*Extra Paid Annual Leave:* Enjoy 22 days of vacation, with an additional day added for each year of employment, up to a maximum of 26 days.

*

*Special Birthday Perk* : Take your birthday off after a year of employment to celebrate!

*Apply today! Submit your resume in English and join us in creating unforgettable experiences.*

We can’t wait to hear from you!
-------------------------------

All CVs are reviewed by our human recruitment team.

title: Product Owner Junior - Sustentabilidade
Junior Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten)
description:
*Headquarters:* Remote, Berlin

What to expect

Caspar Health ist führend in der digitalen Reha-Nachsorge. Wir entwickeln Lösungen, die eine moderne, datengestützte Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen und die Brücke zwischen Klinik und Zuhause schlagen. Unsere App bietet Patient*innen die Freiheit, ihre Nachsorge zeitlich flexibel und ortsunabhängig zu gestalten – individuell begleitet durch unser therapeutisches Team.

Als Product Manager*in (alle Identitäten) gestaltest du die digitale Transformation im deutschen Gesundheitswesen aktiv mit. Deine Arbeit hat unmittelbaren Impact, denn jedes Feature, das du entwickelst, zahlt direkt auf den Genesungsweg von Menschen ein. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Engineering und Data durchläufst du alle Facetten eines modernen Produktzyklus – von der ersten Hypothese bis zum Release. Du arbeitest hands-on mit Prototypen, nutzt Experimente zum Lernen und stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Nutzer*innen. So erlebst du unmittelbar, welchen wertvollen Unterschied deine Arbeit für das Leben von Patient:innen und die Zukunftsfähigkeit unseres Gesundheitssystems macht.

Diese Rolle ist perfekt für dich, wenn...

*

...du den direkten Kontakt liebst: Wöchentliche Nutzerinterviews sind für dich kein Pflichttermin, sondern deine wichtigste Inspirationsquelle

*

...du Geschwindigkeit schätzt: Schnelles Prototyping und Shipping motivieren dich mehr als monatelange Konzeptionsphasen

*

...du mutig entscheidest: Du fühlst dich wohl dabei, auch bei unvollständiger Datenlage die Richtung vorzugeben und durch Iteration zu lernen

Your Challenges

*

Werde zur Stimme unserer Nutzer*innen: Du führst eigenständig Interviews mit Patient*innen und sprichst regelmäßig mit Ärzt*innen und Kliniken. Du tauchst tief in ihre Lebensrealität ein, analysierst ihre Herausforderungen und übersetzt echte Gespräche in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, die den Genesungsweg spürbar verbessern

*

Gestalte die Therapie von morgen: Du formulierst Hypothesen, testest sie mit Experimenten und Prototypen – und baust gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering echte Lösungen, die in unserer App live gehen. Du begleitest Features vom ersten Problemverständnis bis zum Release und darüber hinaus

*

Wachse in die Verantwortung für deinen Squad: Gemeinsam mit Design, Tech und Medizin moderierst du den Weg von der ersten Idee bis zum Release. Du lernst, wie man Klarheit schafft und Hindernisse aus dem Weg räumt, damit ihr am Ende gemeinsam den Erfolg eurer Arbeit feiern könnt

*

Sorge für Transparenz und Vertrauen: Du kommunizierst Fortschritte und Hürden offen. Dein Ziel ist es, alle Beteiligten mitzunehmen und eine Basis zu schaffen, auf der wir unsere Produktvision Schritt für Schritt gemeinsam in die Realität umsetzen

*

Arbeite datengetrieben und zeige Impact: Du definierst Erfolgskriterien, analysierst Metriken und ziehst klare Schlüsse aus Nutzer- und Produktdaten. Deine Insights fließen direkt in Entscheidungen ein und helfen uns, Impact messbar zu machen – für Patient:innen, Kliniken und das Unternehmen

*

Präge unsere Roadmap aktiv mit: Mit deinen Nutzer-Insights und datenbasierten Lösungen beeinflusst du Prioritäten und Produktentscheidungen direkt. Du bringst Themen proaktiv ein und gestaltest gemeinsam mit dem Team, woran wir als Nächstes arbeiten

*

Übernehme Ownership für Engagement, Verständlichkeit und Fortschritt im Patient:innen-Erlebnis: Du identifizierst zentrale Paint Points, priorisiert datenbasiert und setzt gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering konkrete Verbesserungen um - mit dem Ziel einer stabilen, klaren und motivierenden App-Experience

*

Messbarer Impact:In den ersten 3-6 Monaten baust du ein tiefes Verständnis für unsere Patient:innen auf, definierst klare Erfolgskriterien und bringst erste Features oder Optimierungen live, die spürbare Verbesserungen Nutzungsverhalten zeigen

Your profile

*

Erste PM-Erfahrung: Du hast bereits in agilen Teams gearbeitet und dabei geholfen, nutzerzentrierte digitale Produkte zum Erfolg zu führen

*

Leidenschaft fürs Bauen & neue Technologien: Du liebst es, Dinge einfach auszuprobieren – ob durch Prototyping, Experimente oder „Vibe Coding“. Dabei nutzt du KI-Tools und Automatisierung ganz natürlich als Hebel, um schneller zu validieren und smarte Lösungen zu bauen

*

Analytisches Köpfchen: Du hast Spaß daran, Daten zu interpretieren und als Kompass für deine Entscheidungen zu nutzen

*

Pragmatismus & Problemlösung: Komplexe Situationen schrecken dich nicht ab. Du strukturierst das Chaos und findest Lösungen, die im echten Alltag (Klinik/Patient) funktionieren

*

Hands-on-Mentalität: Du lernst am liebsten durch Machen. Schnell etwas veröffentlichen, Feedback einsammeln und iterieren ist genau dein Rhythmus

*

Kommunikationsstark: Du bewegst dich sicher in einem internationalen Team und sprichst fließend Deutsch sowie sehr gutes Englisch

Why Caspar Health?

*

Remote-first mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – Office optional in Berlin Mitte oder 90 Tage im Jahr außerhalb Deutschlands

*

Passend dazu, unterstützen wir Dich mit einer monatlichen Homeoffice Pauschale und einem Essenszuschuss on Top

*

Genug Zeit zum erholen – mit 30 Tagen Urlaub im Jahr

*

Budget für Weiterbildung, Konferenzen & Coaching, passend zu deinen Potentialen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

*

Hohe Eigenverantwortung & Entscheidungsfreiheit: kein Mikromanagement – wir stellen Expert*innen ein, die wissen was sie tun #MakeAnImpact!

*

Echte Zusammenarbeit: keine Silos, keine Eitelkeiten – wir haben schließlich alle die gleiche Vision vor Augen #ValueFocus!

*

Zugang zu allen Caspar-Angeboten im Bereich mentale & physische Gesundheit #HealthyTogether!

*

Und ja – Alle Snack-Wünsche die das Herz begehrt, gemeinsame Sport-Sessions, ein nie endender Getränke Kühlschrank & eine gute Portion Humor gibt’s auch

-------------------------
Was uns als Team ausmacht
-------------------------

*

Wir leben Vielfalt – Diversität ist bei uns kein Aushängeschild, sondern Alltag

*

Feedback ist kein Tool, sondern Teil unserer Kultur

*

Wir glauben daran, dass Technologie nur dann sinnvoll ist, wenn sie Menschen hilft

*

Unser Antrieb ist Purpose – aber unser Anspruch ist Professionalität

Lust, Gesundheit neu zu denken?
-------------------------------

Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil von Caspar Health. Gemeinsam machen wir den Unterschied.

Your contact

Elisabeth Hegele; Talent Acquisition Specialist

Außerdem sind wir an deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin und deinen Gehaltsvorstellungen interessiert. Solltest du weitere Fragen haben, wende dich bitte an talent@caspar-health.com. Wir werden uns so schnell wie möglich mit dir in Verbindung setzen.

Unser Produkt CASPAR Health wird im Umfeld von medizinischen Einrichtungen, Patient*innen, Ärzt*innen und Therapeut*innen eingesetzt. Zu unserem beruflichen Alltag gehört es, mit (sensiblen) personenbezogenen Daten (z.B. Gesundheitsdaten) zu arbeiten. Daher fordern wir von unseren Mitarbeiter*innen ein hohes Commitment zum Schutz personenbezogener Daten ein, um die Rechte der Betroffenen bestmöglich zu schützen.

Diversität und Inklusion:

title: Senior Product Designer (UX).
description:
*Who we are*

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

*About the role:*

As a Senior Product Designer, you will be responsible for executing high-quality designs for our financial products, ensuring they are intuitive, accessible, and effective. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior designers, and champion user-centred design within the organisation. This role requires a strategic mindset, deep UX/UI expertise, and the ability to translate complex financial concepts into seamless user experiences.

*What you’ll do*

* Define and execute design strategies that align with business objectives and user needs.
* Lead the end-to-end design process, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and final UI execution.
* Conduct advanced user research, usability testing, and A/B experiments to validate and refine design solutions.
* Partner closely with product managers and engineers to ensure seamless implementation of designs.
* Design scalable UI components and contribute to our evolving design system.
* Advocate for accessibility (A11y) and inclusive design principles, ensuring our products serve a diverse user base.
* Create and refine micro-interactions and motion elements to improve user engagement and usability.
* Use data-driven insights to continuously improve the user experience and optimise for business impact.
* Mentor and guide junior designers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.
* Stay ahead of fintech trends and best practices to drive product innovation.

*What you need to succeed*

* 3+ years in a senior product design role, with a strong focus on UX and a demonstrated ability to lead impactful projects
* Mastery of visual design, typography, grids, layout, and colour theory.
* Expertise in interaction design, information architecture, and user flows.
* Deep understanding of designing for both mobile and web platforms, ensuring responsive and adaptive experiences.
* Strong knowledge of behavioural psychology and how it influences user decision-making.
* Extensive experience conducting usability testing, user interviews, and heuristic evaluations.
* Ability to synthesise qualitative and quantitative insights into impactful design decisions.
* Familiarity with UX analytics tools (Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Hotjar, etc.).
* Proficiency in atomic design principles and building scalable UI frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of motion design tools (Lottie, After Effects, Principle) to create dynamic user experiences.
* Experience mentoring and guiding junior designers.
* Ability to articulate design rationale and influence stakeholders across teams.
* Comfortable working in agile, fast-paced product teams.
* Figma mastery - deep experience with auto layout, design tokens, component variants, interactive prototypes, and scalable design libraries.
* Proven experience in fintech and/or SaaS environments, with a strong understanding of industry challenges and user behaviours.

*What you’ll get*

* A leadership role in shaping the future of fintech - your work will impact millions of users.
* Career growth opportunities.
* A culture of experimentation - we encourage innovative thinking and rapid iteration.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Remote-friendly work culture, with access to learning resources.

*What to expect in the hiring process*

* Application & portfolio review: we look for strong UX case studies that showcase process, research, impact, and leadership.
* Preliminary phone call with the recruiter: a brief conversation to discuss your background, interests, and expectations.
* Interview with a design team member: a discussion about your experience, approach to design, alignment with our mission, and a portfolio walkthrough.
* Design Challenge: an advanced exercise to assess problem-solving, UX/UI craft, and strategic thinking.
* Final executive conversation: a discussion with senior leadership about your ability to think strategically, collaborate across teams, and drive business and user impact through design.

*How to apply:*

Submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your best work - preferably with fintech or SaaS-related projects. Your portfolio should clearly demonstrate impact, including measurable improvements in user experience, business metrics, or engagement. We want to see end-to-end product thinking, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and final execution.

title: Senior UX/UI Designer
description:
rtCamp is seeking a Senior UX/UI Designer to join our growing design team. This is a role for a seasoned, self-directed designer who brings both craft and strategic thinking to their work. You'll own the design process end-to-end across complex client projects and digital products. This includes leading research, shaping design systems, facilitating stakeholder conversations, and mentoring the designers around you. You won't just execute; you'll anticipate problems, define direction, and raise the bar for design quality across every project you touch.

At this level, you'll be a trusted voice in client relationships, comfortable navigating both the technical and consultative sides of a conversation solo. You'll contribute to how rtCamp's design practice evolves by setting component standards, driving research strategy for product areas, and actively growing the capabilities of junior and mid-level teammates. Whether you're running a user research study, leading a design review, or navigating a nuanced client conversation, you bring ownership, rigor, and strategic awareness to the work.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Own design quality and drive outcomes for assigned projects from discovery through delivery, taking full accountability for the user experience on your product surface.
* Identify UX risks across your own work and your teammates' surfacing issues early and addressing them with sound design judgment before they affect delivery or client outcomes.
* Independently plan, facilitate, and synthesize user research studies, translating findings into clear, actionable design direction; own the research strategy for your product area.
* Design scalable UX solutions across full product surfaces and, at a senior level, across multiple products simultaneously balancing depth of craft with breadth of systems thinking.
* Own specific design-system components end-to-end, including creation, documentation, and governance; contribute to setting component standards that the broader team relies on across multiple projects.
* Lead design reviews and enforce design best practices, maintaining high standards for the work that ships under your name and your team's.
* Estimate your own design tasks with accuracy, and collaborate with teammates and project leads on project-level scoping, providing well-informed input on effort and timelines.
* Handle client conversations independently facilitating both technical and consultative discussions with existing clients, and helping prepare for and lead conversations with prospective clients.
* Mentor junior and mid-level designers through structured feedback, design critique, and active investment in the growth and quality of those around you.
* Serve as a Design Lead on projects when needed delegating tasks across designer levels within a project, ensuring continuity, and maintaining overall design quality.
* Proactively identify value-focused opportunities and assign them appropriately, looking for ways to improve both the design process and the business offering for clients.
* Align every design decision with client and business goals, demonstrating a clear understanding of how design output affects project success and client satisfaction.

Must Haves
----------

* 5+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating complex, production-level work across varied product surfaces and client contexts.
* Proven ability to independently plan and conduct user research including interviews, usability testing, and synthesis, and translate insights into clear design strategy and direction.
* Deep proficiency in Figma and the broader design toolchain, including prototyping, handoff documentation, and design specifications for engineering.
* Strong systems thinking with hands-on experience contributing to or building design systems, including component governance, documentation practices, and cross-project standards.
* The communication skills to facilitate both technical and consultative client conversations independently—presenting clearly, explaining rationale, and adapting to your audience.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring designers and contributing to the growth and quality of a design team, including through critique, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
* A clear understanding of business goals and the ability to connect design decisions to project and client outcomes, framing design work in terms of value and impact.
* Ability to estimate your own work accurately and collaborate on project-level scoping with an informed intuition for effort and complexity.

Good to Have
------------

* Experience working in a digital agency or client-services environment, managing design work across multiple simultaneous engagements.
* Familiarity with WordPress, open-source ecosystems, or headless CMS architectures commonly used in enterprise web projects.
* Prior experience in a Design Lead or project-level team lead capacity on multi-designer engagements, including task delegation and quality oversight.
* Background in design operations, design strategy, or research-led product strategy at a practice or organizational level.
* Experience collaborating with distributed or remote-first engineering and product teams across time zones.

title: Senior/ Lead Security Researcher
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior/ Lead Security Researcher based in India.*

This is an opportunity to join a Product Security team focused on cutting-edge mobile cybersecurity research and advanced threat defense. You will investigate sophisticated threats across Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS Next, helping develop innovative protections for mobile applications and devices. The role combines reverse engineering, vulnerability research, penetration testing, exploitation, and mitigation techniques. You will contribute to security architecture spanning mobile devices, applications, and connected systems. As a senior contributor, you will take ownership of research projects while mentoring junior researchers and influencing technical direction. The environment is fast-moving, highly technical, collaborative, and designed for researchers who enjoy solving complex security problems.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Research emerging threats affecting mobile operating systems and applications, including rooting/jailbreaking, app tampering, runtime tampering, and techniques used to conceal malicious modifications.
* Conduct reverse engineering, vulnerability research, exploitation, and mitigation work to develop effective mobile security protections.
* Perform penetration testing and security assessments of mobile products and applications, identifying vulnerabilities and recommending practical defenses.
* Develop scripts, tooling, and attack/defense techniques for mobile devices and applications to accelerate security research and testing.
* Create customer-facing security demonstrations that clearly communicate attack scenarios, vulnerabilities, and corresponding defensive mechanisms.
* Contribute to security solution architectures spanning mobile devices, applications, and networked components, including authentication technologies such as OAuth2 and FIDO2.
* Research and assess cryptographic protocols and algorithms when required as part of broader security architecture and product development.
* Take ownership of selected research and development projects, driving them from investigation through implementation and delivery.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior security researchers, while contributing to a culture of quality, creativity, and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate closely with the wider Product Security team to develop innovative approaches to emerging mobile security challenges.

Requirements:
-------------

* 5+ years of relevant experience in security research, application security, mobile security, vulnerability research, penetration testing, or a closely related field.
* Strong understanding of operating system internals across one or more platforms such as Android, iOS, HarmonyOS Next, Linux, or comparable systems.
* Solid knowledge of mobile application development and security, with practical familiarity with rooting/jailbreaking, runtime tampering, app tampering, and related evasion techniques.
* Hands-on experience with security research and reverse-engineering tools such as Frida, Theos, Ghidra, and IDA Pro.
* Familiarity with web application security and VAPT tools such as Burp Suite.
* Ability to understand how security tools and methodologies work internally and use that knowledge to develop creative, customized approaches rather than relying solely on standard workflows.
* Strong understanding of threat modeling and familiarity with at least one established threat-modeling framework.
* Experience with scripting or building custom tools to support security research, testing, attack simulation, or defensive development.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking abilities, with a systematic and methodical approach to research and testing.
* Demonstrated ownership of technical projects, with the ability to work independently and make progress with minimal supervision.
* Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to quality, security, and technical rigor.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively and mentor less-experienced researchers.
* A proactive, adaptable, and highly driven mindset suited to a dynamic and rapidly evolving technical environment.
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline is preferred, particularly with relevant cryptography coursework.
* Information security, ethical hacking, or security architecture certifications are a plus.

Benefits:
---------

* Fully remote position based in India.
* Full-time opportunity within a specialized Product Security team.
* Opportunity to work on advanced mobile cybersecurity research across Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS Next.
* Exposure to reverse engineering, vulnerability research, exploitation, penetration testing, cryptography, and security architecture.
* High level of technical ownership and the opportunity to lead selected research initiatives.
* Opportunity to mentor junior researchers and contribute to the evolution of security practices.
* Fast-paced, innovative environment with opportunities to develop new security tools, techniques, and solutions.
* Opportunity to work on security technologies protecting large-scale digital ecosystems and users globally.

title: Junior Business Analyst (Full Remote - Europe)
description:
*********************
Our Vision & Products
*********************

*🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship*

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At *EverAI* , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With *50 million users and counting* , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the *world’s largest AI companionship platform* , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is *safe, ethical, and human-first*.

And we’re only just getting started!

********
Our Team
********

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

*Alexis Soulopoulos* [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

*Michael Monin* [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

*Thomas Lacroix* [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

*Maruša Fasano* [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

*********
Your Role
*********

Most Business Analyst roles are built around decks — you analyze, you recommend, someone else decides, someone else executes.

*This role is built differently: we're hiring an Analyst who does more than produce the recommendation. You'll frame the problem, build the model, pressure-test your own conclusions, and take the result directly to the people who'll act on it* — with as few layers as possible.

*You'll work directly with our founders and Executive team on a product already used by more than 50 million people.* At this scale, a single sharp insight — a pricing lever, a churn pattern, a broken funnel — can move numbers that would take a much larger company months to shift.

If your instinct was always to wonder what happened after the deck was presented, this is your chance to find out.

---------------------
Your Responsibilities
---------------------

*This is a hybrid role: part analyst, part operator.*

Some weeks you'll be modeling a pricing decision; others you'll be in the day-to-day of the business — unblocking processes, coordinating across teams, and making sure things actually get done.

Here's what it actually looks like:

*

*Own analyses end-to-end:* frame the problem, gather and model the data, pressure-test your own conclusions, and present recommendations directly to leadership

*

*Turn ambiguity into action:* when the question is broad and undefined — a new market, a new product bet, a process that's quietly broken — structure it yourself, decide what data would prove or disprove your hypothesis, and drive the analysis without waiting to be handed a scoped brief

*

*Build the tools that inform real decisions:* business cases, financial models, forecasts, and KPI dashboards that our founders and execs actually use to decide what happens next

*

*Improve how the business runs:* spot the operational bottleneck nobody's named yet, design the better process, and help drive it into place across teams

*

*Run special projects that matter:* coordinate stakeholders, keep initiatives moving from kickoff to delivery, and prepare the strategy documents, performance reviews, and investment memos that shape where the company goes next

*

*Communicate like it counts:* distill your analysis into the one slide that changes someone's mind — lead with the answer, back it with evidence

*********************
*Your Qualifications*
*********************

*

title: AI Research Fellowship, (Summer and Fall 2026)
description:
----------------
*About the Team*
----------------

The DoorDash Research Fellowship is a 3-month program (extendable to 6 months) looking for Summer and Fall 2026 cohorts, for researchers and engineers who want to work on the hardest applied ML and AI problems in local commerce. Fellows are given the resources, autonomy, and access to real-world operational data needed to pursue ambitious research directions — with the goal of producing work that influences both the field and how DoorDash operates at scale.

This program is modeled on the best external research fellowships: fellows are treated as independent researchers, not as junior employees on a product team. You pick the problem (within a set of priority areas), you own the direction, and you publish or ship the outcome.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
*You’re excited about this opportunity because you will receive…*
-----------------------------------------------------------------

* *Dedicated compute allocation* sized to the research agenda — GPU clusters for training and inference budgets for experimentation
* *Full access to DoorDash's research infrastructure* — our internal RL stack, training and evaluation pipelines, RL environments built on real operational systems, agent evaluation harnesses, and the tooling our own research teams use day-to-day. Fellows are first-class users, not sandboxed visitors.
* *Access to DoorDash operational data* — real-world datasets spanning logistics, merchant operations, consumer behavior, and marketplace dynamics, under appropriate data governance
* *Research mentorship* from senior researchers and engineering leaders at DoorDash, plus a named research sponsor for each fellow who meets with you weekly and is accountable for unblocking your work
* *Speaker series* featuring leading researchers and practitioners from academia and industry — faculty from top ML programs, research leads from frontier AI labs, and senior operators from across tech. Fellows get dedicated 1:1 time with speakers when possible.
* *A cohort of fellows* working alongside you — a small, tight-knit group of researchers tackling different problems but sharing ideas, drafts, and reading groups. The community extends to DoorDash research alumni and the broader fellowship network.
* *Publication support* — fellows are encouraged to publish at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, etc.) and DoorDash will support the legal and review process
* *Relocation support, housing stipend, and competitive pay*

*Structure*
-----------

* Kickoff (2 weeks, in-person in SF): Onboarding, scoping the research agenda with your sponsor, meeting teams across Research, ML Platform, and relevant product orgs
* Core research period (~10 weeks, hybrid from SF DoorDash office): Focused research work with regular check-ins, internal talks, and working sessions. Extension to 6 months decided at the midpoint based on research progress and mutual fit.
* Closeout: Final write-up, internal presentation, and publication or productionization path

*Priority Research Areas*
-------------------------

Fellows are welcome to propose their own direction, but we are particularly interested in work across:

* *Reinforcement learning environments for real-world operations* — building high-fidelity simulators and training environments from operational data, including the tradeoffs between real-data fidelity and synthetic generalization
* *Agentic systems for logistics and local commerce* — long-horizon planning, tool use, and evaluation methodologies for agents operating in physical-world marketplaces
* *Foundation models for marketplace dynamics* — forecasting, pricing, matching, and personalization at marketplace scale
* *Evaluation and measurement* — new benchmarks and evaluation methods for ML systems deployed in messy, real-world operational settings
* *Multimodal understanding* — vision, speech, and language applied to merchant catalogs, operations, and consumer interfaces

----------------------------------
*We’re excited about you because…*
----------------------------------

* You’re a researcher with a strong track record — PhD candidates (rising 4th year or beyond), recent PhDs, or independent researchers with published work at top ML venues or equivalent demonstrated output
* You’re an engineer with deep research instincts who have shipped ambitious ML or systems work and want dedicated time to pursue a research direction
* You can operate independently — set a research agenda, scope it, and execute without heavy supervision
* You have strong written and verbal communication; comfort presenting work to mixed research and engineering audiences

We are not looking for specific years of experience or specific degrees. Exceptional candidates from non-traditional backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.

**************
*Compensation*
**************

The fellowship is 12 weeks long with potential opportunity for extension. The fellow’s starting pay will fall within the monthly pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including education, work location, and market conditions.

Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future. In addition to base pay, fellows are eligible for both a housing stipend and relocation stipend. DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. *That’s why we offer our fellows a wellness reimbursement benefit, access to an employee assistance program, in-office lunch credits and more!*

Base Pay (Monthly)
$8,500 — $16,000 USD

--------------
About DoorDash
--------------

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

-----------------------------------------
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
-----------------------------------------

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Statement of Non-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on “protected categories,” we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. title: Technical Resource Contact Center Analyst - Senior
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Resource Contact Center Analyst - Senior based in the United States.*

This senior-level role is central to delivering advanced technical support and exceptional customer experiences across complex IT infrastructure environments.
You will troubleshoot sophisticated hardware and software issues spanning compute, virtualization, networking, and storage technologies.
As a technical escalation point, you will guide junior analysts while helping teams resolve challenging customer issues efficiently.
The position combines hands-on problem solving with knowledge management, root cause analysis, training, and continuous service improvement.
You will collaborate with customers, engineering teams, product stakeholders, and internal support functions to drive both immediate and long-term resolutions.
Your expertise will help strengthen technical documentation, self-service capabilities, operational metrics, and overall support quality.
This is a fully remote opportunity suited to a customer-focused technical professional who thrives in a fast-paced, global environment.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Provide advanced technical support for complex customer issues across multiple products, platforms, and technologies.
* Diagnose and resolve sophisticated hardware and software problems involving operating systems, virtualization, compute, networking, and storage environments.
* Serve as a senior escalation point for junior analysts, providing technical guidance, troubleshooting expertise, and mentoring.
* Conduct in-depth troubleshooting and root cause analysis to identify effective and sustainable solutions.
* Document technical resolutions, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge articles to strengthen internal efficiency and customer self-service.
* Identify recurring technical issues and recommend preventative actions, collaborating with product development and engineering teams on long-term solutions.
* Support the design and delivery of training programs for new and existing contact center analysts.
* Monitor and analyze contact center performance metrics, identifying opportunities to improve service quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of contact center processes, tools, workflows, and technical documentation.
* Maintain strong knowledge of supported products, technologies, industry developments, and emerging technical trends.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, internal teams, and cross-functional stakeholders throughout the resolution process.
* Work independently on complex cases while collaborating effectively with broader technical and customer support teams.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–7 years of experience in technical support within a contact center or comparable environment, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Proven ability to troubleshoot complex, end-to-end hardware and software environments.
* Strong technical knowledge across operating systems, virtualization, compute, networking, and storage technologies.
* Experience with virtualization and container technologies such as VMware, OpenShift, and containers.
* Understanding of Ethernet and Fibre Channel networking, as well as block, file, and object storage.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured and methodical approach to complex technical challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach, and guide junior technical professionals.
* Experience using CRM and service management platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, along with knowledge management systems.
* Strong customer-service orientation and commitment to delivering high-quality technical support.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Relevant technical certifications such as VCP, RHCSA, RHCE, or CCNA are considered a plus.

--------
Benefits
--------

* *Remote work* within the United States.
* Expected base salary of *$100,000–$120,000* annually.
* Expected on-target earnings of *$110,000–$138,000*.
* Eligibility for applicable bonus, variable, or commission compensation programs.
* Industry-leading benefits and services designed to support employees’ health and overall well-being.
* Flexible work arrangements, depending on role and location.
* A collaborative and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and innovation.
* Opportunities to develop technical expertise through knowledge sharing and exposure to complex technologies.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career development within a global technology environment.
* Strong emphasis on autonomy, ownership, work-life balance, and employee well-being.

title: Junior Functional and Automation Tester
description:
*Type of Requisition:*

Pipeline

*Clearance Level Must Currently Possess:*

None

*Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:*

None

MBI (T2)

Professional Engineering

*Skills:*

Application Lifecycle Management (ALM), Automated Testing, System Testing

*Certifications:*

None

*Experience:*

1 + years of related experience

*US Citizenship Required:*

No

*Job Description:*

The *Junior Functional and Automation Tester* supports the planning, execution, and documentation of functional and automated testing for modern applications. This role works with product, development, Development, Security, and Operations (DevSecOps), and) team members to help ensure solutions meet business requirements and quality expectations. The tester contributes to test case development, test automation, defect reporting, and continuous improvement while learning established testing standards, security practices, and delivery processes.

*MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT* :

* Participate in sprint/release planning by helping identify testing scope, test data needs, and required environments under the guidance of senior team members.
* Review business and technical requirements and assist in creating test cases, test scripts, and test data to validate workflows, edge cases, and error handling.
* Execute hands-on functional testing (manual and exploratory) and document results clearly, including reproduction steps and supporting evidence.
* Build and maintain automated tests (such as unit, application programming interface (API), integration, and user interface tests) following team frameworks and coding standards.
* Support testing of event- and message-based workflows, including applications that use Apache Kafka or similar messaging technologies, by validating expected outcomes and end-to-end processing behavior.
* Assist with testing API-centric and cloud-friendly designs (microservices and serverless applications), including basic backward compatibility and integration checks.
* Log, track, and re-test defects; participate in defect triage discussions and learn to support root-cause analysis by providing clear observations and test evidence.
* Follow secure testing and data handling procedures; escalate potential security or privacy concerns to appropriate team members.
* Contribute to continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) testing by running automated suites, reviewing results, and helping keep tests reliable and maintainable.
* Help maintain testing documentation (test plans, test evidence, dashboards, and runbooks) so releases are auditable and operationally ready.
* Learn and apply observability basics (logs, metrics, alerts) to support troubleshooting and improve test coverage over time.
* Use approved AI-assisted development and testing tools to help accelerate test creation and analysis, while following team guidance for quality and security.
* Perform other job-related tasks as assigned to support delivery and quality goals.

*WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED*
Bring your expertise and drive for innovation to GDIT.

*Education:*

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field from an accredited College/University
* Alternative Path: If the candidate does not possess a relevant four-year degree, an additional four years of relevant work experience will be required.

*Required Experience:*

* Minimum 1 year of experience in software testing, quality assurance, test automation, or related software development roles (including internships, co-ops, or equivalent project work).
* Foundational knowledge of software testing concepts, including functional testing, regression testing, and defect lifecycle.
* Some experience creating or maintaining automated tests using common tools/frameworks (academic projects, internships, or entry-level professional experience acceptable).
* Basic understanding of APIs and how to test them (for example: request/response validation, status codes, authentication basics).
* Familiarity with at least one scripting or programming language used for automation or validation (for example: Java, JavaScript, and/or SQL).
* Familiarity with Git and standard team workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
* Exposure to CI/CD concepts and willingness to learn pipeline-based testing (for example: using Jenkins or GitLab).
* Understanding of secure handling of data in test activities (least privilege awareness, not exposing sensitive data, safe logging practices).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document test results and defects clearly.
* Strong collaboration skills and willingness to learn from feedback and follow team standards.

*Preferred Skills and Experience:*

* Exposure to Agile delivery practices and Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) concepts.
* Familiarity with change/configuration management tools (for example: VersionOne, ServiceNow) and/or Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) practices.
* Introductory familiarity with cloud and messaging concepts (for example: Google Cloud Platform (GCP) basics, Pub/Sub, Kafka) and interest in learning distributed systems testing.
* Exposure to container concepts (for example: Docker fundamentals) and modern application architectures (microservices/serverless).
* Familiarity with approved AI-assisted tools (for example: OpenCode, Claude Code, Gemini Vertex AI) to support test creation and analysis.

*Security Clearance Level* :

* This role will require you to obtain and maintain a *Public Trust* and will require you to provide onsite *fingerprinting* at a designated facility. This investigation may review personal and criminal behavior, financial conduct, foreign influence, as well as other adjudications.
* *This position has a U.S. residency requirement. The USPS security clearance process requires the selected candidate to have resided in the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for the last five years as follows: U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 6 months consecutively in the last 3 years (unless they meet certain exceptions). Non-U.S. Citizens cannot have left the U.S. (including U.S. Territories) for longer than 90 days consecutively in the last 3 years.*

*Location:*

* Remote

*GDIT IS YOUR PLACE*

At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.

* Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
* Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
* Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, competitive pay and paid time off
* Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

40

*Travel Required:*

Less than 10%

Remote

*Work Location:*

Any Location / Remote

*Additional Work Locations:*

*Total Rewards at GDIT:*

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

About the Role
--------------

We are looking for a *Junior Software Engineer* who is comfortable working across the full product development stack, including frontend, backend, and AI-powered features.

In this role, you will build internal tools, automation platforms, data-driven products, and AI-enabled workflows. You will work on user-facing interfaces, backend services, APIs, data integrations, and LLM-powered capabilities. We are looking for someone who can move fast, learn quickly, and use AI tools effectively to deliver end-to-end product features.

This is not a pure frontend or pure backend role. We value engineers who can take ownership of a feature from requirement understanding to UI implementation, backend logic, AI integration, testing, and iteration.

Responsibilities
----------------

*

Build and maintain end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, and AI/LLM components.

*

Develop user interfaces for internal tools, dashboards, AI assistants, automation workflows, and productivity platforms.

*

Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, task workflows, and integrations with internal or external systems.

*

Integrate LLM/AI capabilities into real product scenarios, such as intelligent assistants, RAG workflows, AI agents, automation tools, classification, summarization, and issue analysis.

*

Use AI coding tools to improve development speed, code quality, testing, and debugging.

*

Work with product, operations, support, engineering, security, and infrastructure teams to understand user needs and deliver practical solutions.

*

Participate in product iteration based on user feedback, usage data, and business impact.

*

Write clean, maintainable code and contribute to documentation, testing, and engineering best practices.

Requirements
------------

*

Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.

*

Solid programming foundation and ability to learn new technologies quickly.

*

Hands-on experience with at least one frontend framework, such as React, Vue, Angular, or similar.

*

Hands-on experience with at least one backend language or framework, such as Python, Go, Java, Node.js, FastAPI, Spring Boot, Express, or similar.

*

Basic understanding of frontend engineering, including component design, state management, API integration, UI debugging, and browser fundamentals.

*

Basic understanding of backend engineering, including API design, databases, authentication, async jobs, logging, monitoring, and service reliability.

*

Real experience with LLM/AI applications, such as: LLM API integration/ Prompt engineering/ RAG/AI agents/ Tool/function calling/ Workflow automation/ Text classification / summarization / extraction/ LLM output evaluation

*

Comfortable using AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cline, OpenCode, or similar tools in daily development.

*

Strong ownership, good communication skills, and willingness to work on ambiguous problems.

*

Ability to deliver practical solutions with both engineering quality and user experience in mind.

Nice to Have
------------

*

Experience building AI-powered products, internal tools, dashboards, workflow automation systems, or data-driven applications.

*

Experience with LLM/Agent/RAG frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Dify, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, Hugging Face, or similar.

*

Experience with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, knowledge bases, or retrieval systems.

*

Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, incident analysis, DevOps, SRE, or workflow automation.

*

Experience with UI/UX design thinking or building usable internal tools from scratch.

*

Experience using AI tools to build full-stack features faster, including frontend generation, backend scaffolding, tests, and documentation.

*

Personal AI projects, hackathon projects, open-source contributions, or production AI application experience.

*

Good technical writing and knowledge sharing habits.

What We Value
-------------

*

Are comfortable working end to end across frontend, backend, and AI features.

*

Are AI-native and actively use AI tools to improve their own productivity.

*

Have built real AI/LLM applications, not just used ChatGPT.

*

Care about user experience and practical business value.

*

Can quickly turn ambiguous requirements into working product features.

*

Are curious, hands-on, and fast-learning.

*

Think about reliability, maintainability, security, and AI output quality.

*

Communicate clearly and collaborate well with cross-functional partners.

Example Work You May Do
-----------------------

*

Build a dashboard or internal tool that helps users understand operational data and AI-generated insights.

*

Develop a user interface for an AI assistant or agent workflow.

*

Build backend APIs and data pipelines for AI-powered automation.

*

Integrate LLMs into product workflows for classification, summarization, recommendation, or issue analysis.

*

Build a RAG-based knowledge assistant for domain-specific Q&A.

*

Develop an agent workflow that can call tools, retrieve data, and complete multi-step tasks.

*

Use AI coding tools to accelerate frontend, backend, testing, and documentation work.

*

Improve product experience based on user feedback and usage data.

title: Junior Field Sales Representative
description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated recent graduate or early-career professional who is passionate about the equine industry and interested in building a career in sales and business development.

The Role

As one of the first members of the US team, you'll spend most of your time visiting horse farms, breeding operations, training facilities, and farrier businesses across the Bluegrass region. You'll build relationships with equine professionals, introduce them to our products, and help grow our presence in the Kentucky horse community.

You'll be introducing two products:

* A farrier management platform (scheduling, horse records, invoicing) already successfully operating internationally.
* A horse owner and multi-stakeholder platform launching in September 2026.

What You'll Do

* Manage day-to-day outreach to existing app users/new prospects to build relationships and keep them engaged.

* Monitor account health remotely: track how customers are using the platform, flag any drop-off or issues, and follow up before problems become churn.
* Conduct structured customer check-in calls to understand how customers are using the product day-to-day.
* Surface customer pain points and feedback to share with the product and international teams.
* Support onboarding and adoption remotely to help new or inactive users get set up and comfortable with the platform via phone, without requiring an in-person visit.
* Prioritize and segment accounts for the field phase to identify top accounts and high-potential customers worth prioritizing once in-person farm visits begin.

* Build relationships with horse owners, breeding farms, training facilities, and farriers throughout the Lexington and Bluegrass region.
* Visit equine businesses and demonstrate our software solutions.
* Introduce new customers to our platforms and support them during onboarding.
* Attend industry events, trade shows, sales, clinics, and conferences across Kentucky.
* Gather customer feedback and market insights to help improve our products and customer experience.
* Work closely with the international team to support the company's US expansion.

What We're Looking For

* Bachelor's degree in Equine Science, Equine Management, Animal Science, Agriculture, Business, Marketing, or a related field.
* Recent graduates or candidates with up to 2 years of professional experience are encouraged to apply.
* Internships, student leadership, customer service, retail, sales, ambassador programs, or other customer-facing experience are highly valued.
* A genuine passion for the equine industry and enthusiasm for meeting and working with horse professionals.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable learning and demonstrating mobile applications and software products.
* Self-motivated, organized, and eager to learn in a growing business.
* Valid driver's license and willingness to travel throughout the assigned territory.

What's on Offer

* Opportunity to join an exciting international company during its US expansion.
* Training, mentorship, and ongoing support from an experienced global team.
* Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
* Career growth opportunities as the business expands.
* Lexington-based role with a mix of field work and home office.
* Health, dental, 401(k), expense account, and vehicle allowance.

The Junior Analyst provides financial, programmatic, research, and technical-writing support to the Defense Health Agency Facilities Enterprise. The position supports Military Health System financial analysis, DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution activities, policy research, data consolidation, and the preparation of clear, decision-ready products for DHA leadership.

*Requirements*

*Benefits*

* Internal training programs and knowledge-sharing events.
* Unlimited, free use of AirHelp’s services.
* Pre-paid virtual card.
* Office commute subsidy.
* Access to mindfulness and well-being platform (Mindgram).

Why AirHelp?

At AirHelp, we're on a mission to make the world of travel better. Since our foundation in 2013, we've assisted over 3 million passengers in receiving their rightful compensation, and we've protected over 12 million travelers through our membership program, AirHelp+. With a global team of over 400 AirHelpers speaking 19 languages, we aim to provide a stress-free travel experience for all. And there’s more! AirHelp isn’t just a great company, but a truly lovable place to work. That's why we're so proud to have been named a Most Loved Workplace, also for LGBTQ+, women and young professionals.

Our offices are fully accessible, and we customize interviews to accommodate special needs, including those of neurodiverse candidates. Refugees and displaced individuals are encouraged to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Junior Backend Engineer
description:
----------
About Wolt
----------

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

------------
*Who We Are*
------------

Global Marts builds the technology behind DoorDash's own grocery and retail operations across DashMart, Wolt Market, and Deliveroo Hop. Our systems decide what products our stores stock, how much inventory to purchase, which vendors to source from, how warehouses execute orders, and what prices customers see.

We build everything from forecasting and replenishment systems to vendor management, warehouse execution, labor scheduling, space optimization, and pricing. Our in-house forecasting platform has replaced third-party solutions and now powers production globally. This isn't a traditional CRUD backend environment. You'll have the opportunity to work on real operational problems and learn how backend systems support a global retail organization.

----------------
*What You'll Do*
----------------

As a Backend Engineer, you'll work primarily with Go or Kotlin alongside experienced engineers to build and improve production systems. You'll:

* Build and improve backend services that support inventory, purchasing, warehouse operations, pricing, and fulfillment.
* Write reliable, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering practices.
* Work with experienced engineers to understand technical problems and contribute to their solutions.
* Learn how we design, deploy, monitor, and operate backend services in production.
* Collaborate with engineers, product managers, data scientists, and operations teams.
* Take increasing ownership of features and services as you grow in the role.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and the team's operational responsibilities.
* Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate learning and development, while applying sound engineering judgment to validate and understand the solutions you build.

-------------
*How We Work*
-------------

* *Learning & Ownership:* You'll be supported by experienced engineers while gradually taking more ownership of the systems you work on.
* *Collaboration:* We solve problems together and value asking questions, sharing ideas, and learning from each other.
* *Scalability & Simplicity:* We value pragmatic solutions and focus on building reliable systems without unnecessary complexity.

----------------
*Our Tech Stack*
----------------

Our primary backend languages are Go and Kotlin. We also use Kafka, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Snowflake, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, gRPC, GitHub Actions, and modern cloud infrastructure.

You don't need experience with all of these technologies. We're looking for strong engineering fundamentals and an eagerness to learn.

-------------------------
*Our Humble Expectations*
-------------------------

We're looking for engineers who have:

* A good foundation in software engineering and backend development.
* Experience with Go, Kotlin, or another modern programming language through professional work, internships, studies, or personal projects.
* An understanding of fundamental concepts such as APIs, databases, testing, and writing maintainable code.
* An interest in learning how production systems are built, deployed, monitored, and operated.
* A willingness to learn new technologies and work on problems that may initially be unfamiliar.
* Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.
* Are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of your everyday engineering workflow to learn, explore, debug, and ship effectively, while being able to understand, validate, and take ownership of the code you produce.

*Nice to Have*

Experience or exposure to any of the following is a plus, but not required:

* Databases, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Kafka, Snowflake, or other data and streaming technologies.
* Forecasting, optimization, scheduling, or data-heavy applications.
* Grocery, retail, logistics, supply chain, or warehouse technology.

--------------
*Why Join Us?*
--------------

You'll have the opportunity to develop your backend engineering skills while working on technology that powers DoorDash's global grocery and retail business.

You'll learn from experienced engineers and contribute to systems that influence inventory, fulfillment, pricing, and supply chain decisions across multiple markets.

📍 This role is based in one of our tech hubs in *Helsinki*. We work in distributed teams, but may not be able to support fully remote work or relocation.

------------
*Next Steps*
------------

We're reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so don't wait to apply. We'll get back to you as soon as possible.

You can read more about our recruitment process here.

-----------------------------------------
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
-----------------------------------------

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Legal Associate (Junior Legal Manager)
description:
*About Us:*
Founded in 2018, headquartered in Johannesburg, and backed by leading investors including Pantera Capital, Coinbase Ventures and Fidelity’s F-Prime Capital, VALR is a global crypto exchange offering a comprehensive suite of products—including Spot Trading, Spot Margin, Perpetual Futures, Staking, Lending, Borrowing, OTC services, VALR Invest, Crypto Bundles, and VALR Pay. Benefits

* Engage with the latest blockchain technologies and tools in a rapidly evolving industry.
* Work from anywhere with secure, stable internet connectivity, allowing you to create your ideal workspace.

* Career Development

* Benefit from an annual professional development allowance alongside scheduled company training sessions to keep you at the forefront of the crypto industry.

* Competitive Compensation

* Competitive salaries that align with industry standards.
* When you contribute to our success, you’ll be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, recognising your impact on VALR’s growth.
* Receive preferential Tier 5 trading fees on VALR, with no monthly trading volume required.

* A commitment to fostering a diverse workforce with initiatives that promote equity and belonging.

* Employees are encouraged to strive for coherent and wholesome lives, fulfilling their work, personal, social, physical and spiritual goals to the best of their abilities.
* Compliance with statutory leave required by individual countries, in addition to flexible leave options.
* Enjoy lunch on us when working from our Johannesburg Head Office, one of the ways we support wellbeing and connection in the workplace.

title: Sales Development Representative, Annuities
description:
*About Ethos*
-------------

Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

*About the role*

The Annuity SDR is the first point of contact for prospective customers exploring annuity products with Ethos. This is a junior, licensed role focused on *qualifying* leads and setting appointments for our full-time Annuity Sales Representatives - not closing business. Because you're licensed, you'll be able to speak knowledgeably about annuity basics and Ethos' offerings during the qualification conversation, without getting into full product recommendations or sales.

This role is also a growth path: strong performers who want to move into a full-time, commission-eligible Annuity Sales Rep seat will have the opportunity to advance, using this role to build product knowledge, phone skills, and a track record.

*Duties and Responsibilities:*

* Engage inbound and outbound leads via calls, email, and SMS to qualify interest and fit for annuity products
* Conduct discovery to understand a prospect's financial situation, goals, and timeline
* Provide light, licensed-appropriate education on annuities and how Ethos' products work - enough to qualify and build trust, not to close
* Set qualified appointments for licensed Annuity Sales Representatives and hand off with clean, complete context
* Manage and prioritize a pipeline of leads through Salesforce (or equivalent CRM), including consistent follow-up
* Maintain accurate records of licensing status, disclosures, and required compliance touchpoints on every call
* Partner with the Annuity Sales team to refine qualification criteria and improve appointment show/close rates
* Hit monthly/quarterly targets for qualified appointments set
* Build toward eligibility for promotion into a full-time Annuity Sales Representative role

*Qualifications and Skills:*

* *Active state life insurance license required at time of hire* — candidates must already be licensed; unlicensed candidates will not be considered
* 1 year of sales or telesales experience — this is an entry-level/junior role; prior insurance experience is a plus but not required
* Strong verbal communication skills; comfortable discussing financial products with a wide range of customers
* Coachable and eager to grow into a closing sales role
* Comfortable with high call volume and a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment
* Working knowledge of CRM tools (Salesforce or similar) preferred
* Strong organizational skills; able to manage a multi-stage pipeline
* Based in the US (state-specific licensing requirement)
