title: Junior-/Senior-IT-Security-Administrator (m/w/d)
description:
Am Universitätsklinikum Jena treffen hochspezialisierte Medizin, Forschung auf Spitzenniveau sowie eine der anspruchsvollsten IT-Landschaften im Gesundheitswesen aufeinander. Klinische Anwendungen, Forschungsplattformen, Medizintechnik und tausende vernetzte Systeme müssen nicht nur zuverlässig funktionieren, sondern dauerhaft gegen eine Bedrohungslage geschützt werden, die sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt.

Für Sie bedeutet das: keine standardisierte Corporate-IT, sondern eine digitale Infrastruktur, in der technische Tiefe, kritische Infrastruktur und medizinische Versorgung unmittelbar zusammenwirken. IT-Security beginnt hier nicht erst im Incident-Management, sondern bereits bei der sicheren Planung, Bewertung und Absicherung neuer Systeme, Anwendungen und Medizingeräte.

**Nicht jede IT-Umgebung fordert Security-Expertinnen und -Experten gleichermaßen heraus. Wenn Sie Komplexität motiviert und Sie Freude daran haben, Sicherheit dort zu gestalten, wo Medizin, Forschung und kritische Infrastruktur zusammenkommen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.**

### Ihr Beitrag im Bereich IT-Security umfasst insbesondere:

* Planung, Konzeption und Betrieb zentraler Komponenten der IT-Sicherheitsarchitektur am Universitätsklinikum Jena mit Fokus auf Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit und Wirksamkeit
* Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung und Einführung zentraler Security-Lösungen sowie Begleitung von Projekten zur Etablierung neuer Sicherheitsstandards im klinischen und wissenschaftlichen Umfeld
* Enge Zusammenarbeit im Security-Team als operative Schnittstelle zum SOC-Partner inklusive Bewertung von Security Alerts, Risikopriorisierung und Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen
* Bewertung sicherheitsrelevanter Fragestellungen im Analystenteam sowie Beratung interner und externer Projektpartner:innen bei der sicheren Einführung von Applikationen und Medizingeräten
* Betrieb eines strukturierten Schwachstellenmanagements sowie Durchführung proaktiver Threat-Hunting-Analysen zur kontinuierlichen Überprüfung der Sicherheitsarchitektur
* Unterstützung von IT-Support und Infrastrukturteams bei der Analyse und Lösung komplexer Störungen im Netzwerk- und Clientumfeld mit Security-Fokus
* Mitwirkung bei IT-Sicherheitsaudits und Prüfungen sowie Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen
* Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung sicherheitstechnischer Dokumentationen zur nachhaltigen Verankerung von Security-Wissen in Systemen und Prozessen

### Darauf kommt es uns an:

* abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium der Technischen Informatik bzw. vergleichbares Studium oder entsprechende Berufserfahrung
* Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse zur Kommunikation mit Kolleg:innen und Dienstleistern (C1-Niveau)
* Zertifizierungen in den Bereichen Netzwerk/Security (z. B. CISSP/CCNP) sind von Vorteil
* Erfahrungen im Threat Hunting, mit Sicherheitsprotokollen und Verschlüsselungstechniken
* Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrungen in Netzwerktechnik und Betriebssystemen wie Linux und Windows, sowie Automatisierungsplattformen wie z. B. Ansible
* Erfahrung in der Planung und Installation von IT-Systemen und Erfahrung bei der Durchführung von IT-Projekten mit einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise
* Gute Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich BSI Grundschutz, ISO 27.001 und IT-Risikomanagement
* Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten mit einer hohen Problemlösungskompetenz in Kombination mit eigenverantwortlicher Arbeitsweise und hoher Lernbereitschaft
* Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie tiefgreifende Kundenorientierung mit hohem Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie detail- und lösungsorientierter Arbeitsweise
* Idealerweise Erfahrungen im Bereich Krankenhaus-IT oder einem Unternehmen mit KRITIS-Relevanz (BSI-Grundschutz)

### Wir bieten noch mehr:

* Teamvielfalt mit gemeinsamer Haltung: Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichsten Berufsgruppen und Charakteren – vereint durch Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Pragmatismus und ein großes Herz für den öffentlichen Auftrag des UKJ.
* Begegnung & Austausch im Alltag: Mehrere Cafeterien als soziale Treffpunkte für kurze Pausen, Austausch über Berufsgrenzen hinweg und kleine Auszeiten im Arbeitsalltag.
* Stabilität mit Sinn: Öffentlicher Arbeitgeber mit langfristiger Perspektive, klaren Strukturen und dem guten Gefühl, Teil von etwas gesellschaftlich Relevantem zu sein.
* Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement, Präventions- und Sportangebote sowie regelmäßige Team Events

Kennziffer: 185/2026

*Unabhängig von Herkunft, Alter, Geschlecht oder* [*Behinderung*](https://www.uniklinikum-jena.de/Beruf+_+Karriere/Bewerberguide+_+Hinweise/Schwerbehinderte+Bewerbende.html) *– bei uns am Universitätsklinikum Jena sind Sie willkommen.*

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
*About Us*

Ennoble Care is a mobile primary care, palliative care, and hospice service provider with patients in New York, New Jersey, Maryland, DC, Virginia, Oklahoma, Kansas, Pennsylvania, Texas, Florida, and Georgia. Ennoble Care’s clinicians go to the home of the patient, providing continuum of care for those with chronic conditions and limited mobility. Ennoble Care offers a variety of programs including, remote patient monitoring, behavioral health management, and chronic care management, to ensure that our patients receive the highest quality of care by a team they know and trust. We seek individuals who are driven to make a difference and embody our motto, “To Care is an Honor.” Join Ennoble Care today!

*About the Role:*

We build and run the software that our clinicians, coordinators, and back-office teams use every day in a rapidly growing organization that is dominating its marketplace. The system is primarily a .NET web platform with a SQL Server back-end and Kendo front-end, along with a legacy WPF client we're migrating away from.

We're looking for an engineer who has internalized AI-assisted development (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and uses it to ship great software at pace. More than “I've tried Copilot", we’re looking for someone who can execute against multiple DevOps tickets at once, guide the AI coder towards the best design, and spot bad output before it becomes a bug or performance-slayer in production.

Equally important is an ability to work with a business owner who may only half-know what they want. You’ll need to come to understand our business quickly, be able to ask the right questions, and help improve the initial DevOps ticket into something that is ready to feed to the AI to code. You excel when you can deliver the thing that the business owner actually needed, not just a rote implementation of the first idea they had.

*What you'll do*

* Work directly with business owners and clinical operations leads to understand a problem, push back where their original DevOps ticket is fuzzy or self-contradictory, and help improve the ticket that makes the work buildable.
* Build features across the stack: C# / .NET, SQL Server (stored procs, schema changes, query tuning), Kendo/Telerik UI, JavaScript.
* Use AI coding tools as your primary leverage — running several small tasks in parallel, or a large feature with satellite work cooking alongside it.
* Review AI output with real skepticism: catch the invented column name, the reinvented helper, the plausible-looking method that quietly breaks an invariant three processes away.
* Test relentlessly. Unit tests, integration tests, and hands-on-the-app testing of your own work and your teammates' work before it reaches users.
* Occasional WPF work — bug fixes in the legacy client and migrating functionality out of it into the web platform.
* Own your changes through deployment and into production support.

*What we're looking for*

*Required*

* 1 year of relevant experience
* C# / .NET and SQL Server experience — enough that you can read a query plan, design a schema, and tell when generated SQL is wrong rather than merely ugly.
* Demonstrated fluency with an agentic AI coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) in real production work. Be ready to talk specifics: how you scope prompts, how you verify output, where these tools fail you.
* The engineering judgment to know when the AI is confidently wrong. This is the single most important thing on this list.
* Excellent requirements skills — comfortable in the room with non-technical stakeholders, good at surfacing the unstated assumption before it becomes rework.
* A testing instinct that borders on adversarial. You look for the edge case, the null, the concurrent user, the bad data already sitting in the table.
* Comfort in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities and short feedback loops.

*Nice to have*

* Kendo / Telerik UI for ASP.NET.
* WPF or another desktop XAML stack.
* Healthcare, EMR/EHR, or other regulated-domain experience.
* Azure (Functions, Service Bus / RabbitMQ-style messaging, App Service).
* Experience working with LLM-backed features in a product, not just as a dev tool.

*How we work — read this part carefully*

*We move fast and we finish things. That means:*

* Rework is part of the job. Sometimes the business owner sees it and realizes it's not right. We redo it without drama.
* There are occasional long days and occasional weekends. Not as a lifestyle, but they happen — around releases, production issues, and hard deadlines. If that's a dealbreaker, we'd rather know now, and there's no hard feelings.
* You'll test other people's code. Quality is a team output, not an individual one.
* You'll be trusted with a lot. Small team, direct access to decisionmakers, very little ceremony between you and shipping.
* The people who thrive here love building software — the craft of it, not just the paycheck — and would rather own an outcome than a ticket queue.

*Salary Range:* $120,000- $140,000 + 10% Bonus Target

*Location:* Fully remote

*Travel:* Up to 10% annual domestic travel

*Full-time employees qualify for the following benefits:*

* Medical, Dental, Vision and supplementary benefits such as Life Insurance, Short Term and Long Term Disability, Flexible Spending Accounts for Medical and Dependent Care, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity.
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Office Holidays

*All employees qualify for these benefits:*

* Paid Sick Time
* 401(k) with up to 3% company match
* Referral Program
* Payactiv: pay-on-demand. Cash out earned money when and where you need it!

*Candidates must disclose any current or future need for employment-based immigration sponsorship (including, but not limited to, OPT, STEM OPT, or visa sponsorship) before an offer of employment is extended.*

title: Junior Conference Manager
description:
**Reports to:** CEO (interim)

**Location:** Remote in the US

**Job Type:** Full-time, exempt, salary

**Summary of Position:**

The Junior Conference Manager provides support of events from conception through to completion. Conferences include technical conferences, trade shows, board meetings, and social events. The role of Junior Conference Manager is hands-on and often involves working as part of a team and varies highly depending on the specific client and type of conference. Junior Conference Managers are principally responsible for managing multiple conferences throughout the year.

**Performance Evaluation:**

Formal evaluations will be conducted in six-month intervals by your assigned Pod Leader to assess job performance.

**Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Meet weekly with Director, Conference Management Operations and Pod leader to provide status updates, discuss time-sensitive items that require completion, address quality control checks, and discuss improvements that should be made.
* Attend weekly Unit meetings and actively participate in discussions on items of importance and process/systems improvement.
* Attend weekly Pod meetings and actively participate in discussions on items of importance and process/systems improvement.
* Attend and actively participate actively in Unit Workshops.
* Attend and actively participate actively in All-Company meetings.
* Maintain accurate time records according to company policy, to track support requirements for each client.
* Demonstrate proficiency of Company applications: Gmail, ClickUp, Slack, Google Calendar, Zoom, GoToMeeting, Cvent, Dropbox, Doodle, MailChimp, Last Pass, Skype, Survey Monkey, ShareX, and others.
* Demonstrate proficiency in the ability to seamlessly navigate the company’s internal file structure.
* Demonstrate knowledge proficiency of the basic structure of IEEE, keeping current on all policies and keeping updated contact lists.
* Manage ClickUp boards for each conference, keeping tasks dated and up-to- date. Ensure boards and tasks contain complete information, checklists, etc. so anyone is able to seamlessly step in and help with tasks as required.
* Develop and foster relationships with Conference leadership: General Chairs, Technical Program Chairs, Organizing Committee, becoming an invaluable resource.
* Liaise with clients to ascertain their precise conference requirements.
* Configure and manage online paper submission process.
* Compile and produce conference proceedings content.
* Produce detailed RFP for conferences (e.g. timelines, venues, suppliers, legal obligations, staffing and budgets).
* Communicate and maintain timelines and priorities on every project.
* Develop and actively manage event budgets.
* Manage all project elements within time limits and on budget.
* Ensure excellent customer service and quality delivery.
* Travel onsite to perform advance site inspection, as necessary.
* Research markets to identify opportunities for conference attendance growth and increased paper submissions.
* Coordinate with venue management, caterers, exhibit designers, contractors and other vendors, as necessary.
* Plan room layouts for conference sessions, workshops, demonstrations, and social events.
* Plan menus and order food & beverage for conference functions.
* Coordinate volunteer staff requirements and volunteer staff briefings.
* Sell sponsorship/stand/exhibition space to potential exhibitors/partners.
* Configure online registration sites and manage conference registration processing.
* Prepare delegate packs, name badges and collateral.
* Liaise with marketing and PR colleagues to promote the conference.
* Liaise with clients and internal design staff to create a brand for the event and organize the production of tickets, posters, catalogues and sales brochures, plus social media coverage.
* Coordinate suppliers, handle client queries and troubleshoot on the day of the conference to ensure that all runs smoothly.
* Oversee onsite set up of registration area, exhibit area, and meeting rooms.
* Demonstrate proactive approach to handling issues and troubleshooting any emerging problems throughout the entire conference planning cycle.
* Carry out post- conference evaluation (including data entry and analysis and producing reports for conference sponsors).
* Organize and clearly express information in concise written and verbal form and work with diverse contacts from around the world.
* Schedule and facilitate conference calls with Conference committees, taking detailed minutes. Facilitate action item completion.
* Manage conference websites, ensuring the websites always include the most current content and are user-friendly.
* Develop and maintain Conference social media platforms, drafting and posting content regularly.
* Demonstrate knowledge proficiency of the Conference Operating Manual for each conference you are responsible for managing.
* Adhere to Conference Catalysts Operating guidelines. (Appendix A)
* Adhere to the Company Mission, Vision, and Core Values (Appendix B), always maintaining a positive attitude and professionalism.
* Familiarize yourself with the Company Handbook. (Appendix C)
* Familiarize yourself with the Review Evaluation Form. (Appendix D) This will be used at the Status Review in June of each year, as a touchstone for progress; and will be used in the Performance Review at the end of each year, to determine salary and advancement opportunities within the Company.

**Required Experience, Skills, and Education:**

* Bachelor's degree in event management, business administration, management, communications, or related field. Or relevant combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of two years of experience in full-scope event mangement or planning work.
* Strong communication, organization, and client-facing skills.
* Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Demonstrated problem-solving ability and resourcefulness.
* Familiarity with professional associations or nonprofit organizations.

**Travel Requirements:**

* Travel for this position will be around 7-8 times per year, for a length of 5-8 days each time.

* Estimated travel between 10 - 18%
* Domestic and international travel is required. Must have, or have the ability to acquire, a passport.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
* Must be capable of traveling on long-haul flights.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

* Compensation is commensurate with skills, education, and experience starting at $54,700/year.
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance (Full employee premiums covered by Conference Catalysts).
* Health Flexible Spending Account (FSA) for eligible health & wellness expenses.
* 401(k) Retirement Plan following the 90-day onboarding period (Conference Catalysts matches dollar for dollar, up to 5% of employee deferrals).
* Uncapped flex time off following the 90-day onboarding period.
* 14 paid company holidays.
* Voluntary Life and AD&D insurance.
* Individual professional development budget.
* Annual office discretionary budget.
* Annual swag store budget.
* Monthly gym membership reimbursement.

title: Junior Sales Representative
description:
About Global Charter Services, Inc.

Global Charter Services, Inc. (GCS) is the holding company for BusBank, Buster, CorporateShuttle.com and FestDrive. With over 20 years of experience chartering buses and the highest retention rate in the business, we are the most reliable partner in bus charter services. All of our brands are focused on making chartering buses easy for our customers.

GCS is headquartered in Chicago and has offices in New York City, and staff based in many states in the USA. We are financially backed by a group that includes the executives that have led Lancer Insurance and Booking.com.

GCS is an equal opportunity employer.

About You

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys connecting with people, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is eager to grow in the transportation and charter services industry. The primary responsibility of this position is to answer inbound calls, identify customer needs, generate leads, and convert those opportunities into quotes and ultimately booked trips.

About the Opportunity

This is a junior sales representative position, and you will report directly to the Director of Customer Success. You will work hands on with the Director of Sales, Sales Team and Customer Success Team. This role is a great entry point for anyone looking to build a career in sales and customer service within a growing and mission-driven company. As a Sales Representative at Global Charter Services, you will be the first point of contact for many of our customers—playing a key part in shaping their experience with us. You’ll learn how to identify customer needs, generate quotes, and close sales while working alongside a supportive team committed to your growth.

GCS Inc. views itself as a start-up with an “all hands on deck” mentality. There are no lines drawn between positions or teams.

-----------------------
*Key Responsibilities:*
-----------------------

* Inbound Call Management:
Answer incoming calls promptly and professionally, providing excellent customer service while gathering essential trip details.
* Lead Generation & Qualification:
Identify potential sales opportunities from inbound inquiries and input accurate information into Zoho CRM and the Buster platform.
* Quoting & Sales Conversion:
Prepare and deliver accurate quotes for sales opportunities, follow up with customers, and convert quotes into confirmed bookings.
* Customer Relationship Building:
Maintain friendly, clear, and helpful communication with customers to build trust and ensure a positive experience.
* CRM & Technology Use:
Utilize Zoho CRM and other company technology platforms to manage leads, track communication, update records, and ensure smooth sales processes and accurate data collection.
* Work closely with the Sales Team and Customer Success Team to provide clear details, support customer needs, and ensure successful trip management.
* Meet or exceed individual sales goals, response-time expectations, and lead conversion benchmarks, and follow the CRM process.
* Work with National Account Executives to assist them in quote to close process
* Work with the Customer Success Team to assist when needed in the quality control process

Your Experience

● 1+ years in a positive Customer Service / Sales or related field – transportation / travel / hospitality

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
***********

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

*A day in the life:*

As a Junior Software Engineer, you'll build and maintain features across our AI-centric web applications — turning designs into working UI, wiring up API integrations, and keeping the codebase clean and well-tested.

You'll work closely with senior engineers who review your code, help unblock you when you're stuck, and push you to level up fast. Expect a mix of hands-on and AI-assisted coding, debugging, and daily collaboration through stand-ups and code reviews, with English as your everyday working language across a global, cross-timezone team.

*Key Responsibilities:*

* Build and maintain web application features across the frontend and backend, writing clean, well-documented code and implementing user interfaces to design spec

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

* Familiarity with Git and standard version control workflows
* Strong written and verbal English skills for daily use — documentation, code comments, and communication with global teams and clients
* Comfort giving and receiving feedback in code review, and asking for help when blocked
* Eagerness to learn, take direction, and grow technical skills quickly

*Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)*

* 80%+ of assigned sprint tickets completed on time each cycle
* Pull requests pass code review with 2 or fewer rounds of revision on average
* Zero critical bugs shipped to production per release
* Unit/integration test coverage maintained on all new code shipped
* Code review comments and stand-up follow-ups addressed within 1 business day

*Most Important Things (MITs)*

* Shipping clean, tested, well-documented code on the tasks you're assigned
* Growing your technical skills fast — asking questions, taking feedback, and applying it
* Being a reliable teammate: showing up to stand-ups, flagging blockers early, and meeting commitments
* Following team standards — git workflow, security practices, and code review process — without being reminded
* Using AI tools to work faster and smarter, not just to get by

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

*About Pixel Systems*
Pixel Systems is a small, remote software agency. We do not build flashy consumer apps or chase the latest industry trends just for the sake of it. Instead, we focus on the practical systems that teams use every day to keep their businesses running: admin panels, CRM integrations, and database management tools. Our clients come to us when their existing spreadsheets have become too complex or when their software tools refuse to communicate with each other. We provide fixed-price quotes, perform weekly demos, and hand over every piece of code and documentation when we finish a project. We value stable, well-tested technologies like Node, React, and Postgres because they produce reliable software that is easy to maintain over the long term.

*The Role*
As a Junior Prompt Engineer, you will be working with our development team to refine how our applications interact with AI models. This is not about creative writing or generating marketing copy. Your focus will be on getting these models to produce structured, predictable data that our software can use. You will spend your time testing different ways to phrase instructions, checking the accuracy of the information returned, and finding ways to reduce errors. This is a paid position, and the compensation is competitive for a junior-level role in the current market. You will work from home, collaborating with a senior team that prefers clear communication and working code over long meetings and complex plans.

*What you will be doing*

* Testing various instructions to see which ones generate the most reliable results from language models.
* Running repetitive tests to ensure that the AI outputs remain consistent over time.
* Documenting the specific phrases and logic that lead to successful data extraction.
* Helping the developers format AI responses so they can be stored directly in a Postgres database.
* Reviewing model outputs for accuracy and identifying where the logic might be failing.
* Working with the team to identify which business tasks are good candidates for AI and which ones are not.
* Comparing different versions of models to see which one provides the best value for specific client needs.

*What we are looking for*

* A logical and methodical approach to solving problems and testing ideas.
* Clear writing skills in English, with the ability to explain complex tasks simply.
* An interest in how software systems process and organize information.
* Basic knowledge of how data is structured in formats like JSON or simple tables.
* The ability to stay organized while managing multiple versions of different prompts and tests.
* A preference for straightforward, functional work over flashy or experimental projects.
* Comfort working in a remote setting where you manage your own daily schedule.

*Helpful background*

* Experience using public AI interfaces for research, coding help, or personal projects.
* Basic familiarity with GitHub or other version control tools.
* Some exposure to web technologies like Node or React, even if only through short courses.
* Experience in a role that required high attention to detail, such as data entry or quality testing.
* A general understanding of how APIs work to move data between different pieces of software.

*Working at Pixel Systems*
Working here means focusing on the work itself. We are a small team with no management layers, which means you will have direct access to the senior engineers building the core of our projects. We value clarity and honesty, especially when something is not working as expected. Our culture is built around remote work: we communicate mostly through text and short video walkthroughs, and we respect everyone's time by avoiding unnecessary meetings. We build tools that help real people, like warehouse managers and operations teams, do their jobs with less frustration. If you enjoy solving practical problems and shipping software that actually gets used, you will find a good home at Pixel Systems.
We believe that building a reliable system is more important than being the first to use a new technology. We look for people who are curious, who ask questions when they are stuck, and who take pride in creating documentation that others can actually understand. As a junior member of the team, you will have the chance to see how professional software is built from the ground up, all while working in a stable, no-drama environment.

title: UX/UI Designer, Design Systems Consultant (AI-Fluent)
description:
Please note, this posting is to highlight joining Right Side Up's talent collective specifically and is not representing an internal full-time role, or a current opportunity with a client.

Right Side Up is a collective of premium marketing talent, with all of the marketing chops, and none of the agency fluff. We're trusted by the most respected early-stage ventures, the fastest-growing tech companies, and well-established Fortune 500 teams to do one thing better: growth. We have over 1,400+ clients including Stitch Fix, Sephora, Yelp, Sun Basket, Crunchbase, DoorDash, Calm, and more.

About the Role
--------------

We're seeking freelance UX/UI Designers who specialize in design systems to help our clients modernize their systems for a world where humans and AI tools build side by side. Some companies call this a Design Engineer or Systems Designer; we're using UX/UI Designer, Design Systems here because it's the clearer, more searchable term for what this role actually is: a design role, not a software engineering one. This role sits at the intersection of design systems craft and AI fluency: someone who's equally comfortable untangling a token architecture in Figma and configuring the AI-tooling connections (MCP and similar) that let coding assistants read and respect that system instead of guessing at it. Contract projects typically range from ten to forty hours per week, depending on client needs and project scope, and often run as focused, timeboxed engagements rather than open-ended retainers.

Responsibilities
----------------

*

Audit existing design systems for structural gaps: tokens versus variables, component architecture, and missing or outdated documentation.

*

Resolve foundational issues (naming, token structure, variable setup) so a design system translates cleanly into documentation and code, without introducing breaking changes for engineering.

*

Build and maintain design system documentation, covering components, patterns, usage guidelines, and variant rules, in a structured format built for AI-fluent workflows and legible to both humans and AI tools.

*

Configure and maintain AI-tooling connections between design platforms (Figma, documentation platforms) and AI coding or design assistants (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Figma Make, GitHub Copilot, and similar), often via MCP-style integrations.

*

Extract undocumented institutional knowledge from designers and engineers and turn it into clear, actionable documentation.

*

Establish or refine governance models, contribution workflows, and success metrics so a design system stays healthy after the engagement ends.

*

Collaborate closely with design and engineering stakeholders, translating between the two without needing to write production code.

*

Stay current on evolving AI-assisted design and design-to-code workflows as the tooling landscape shifts.

Requirements
------------

*

Strong experience in design systems, UX/UI design, or design engineering, with real depth at the foundational level (tokens, variables, component architecture), not just visual component work.

*

Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted design or coding tools, and enough technical comfort to configure AI-tooling connections rather than just use them.

*

Strong written communication skills. A lot of this work is turning tribal knowledge into documentation other people (and AI tools) can actually rely on.

*

Comfortable working independently on defined, timeboxed engagements with light day-to-day oversight.

*

Adaptable to different company environments, including regulated or compliance-sensitive ones where design-to-production handoffs stay manual by design.

Tools & Platforms
-----------------

*

Figma, including Dev Mode, variables, and component architecture.

*

Design system documentation platforms: zeroheight preferred, with Supernova, Backlight, Frontify, or similar also valued.

*

AI-assisted design and coding tools: Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Figma Make, GitHub Copilot, and other MCP-compatible platforms.

*

Familiarity with how design tokens map into code (CSS variables, JSON tokens, Style Dictionary-style pipelines) is a plus.

Why Right Side Up
-----------------

Join a team that values expertise, flexibility, and meaningful work with some of the most innovative brands in the world.

Exciting opportunities are available now, apply today to join our network of experts!

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
Company Overview
----------------

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE CANADA WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.

We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview
-----------------

We’re looking for a UX/UI Designer to design thoughtful, high-quality digital experiences across a range of client engagements. This role is ideal for a curious, collaborative designer who enjoys solving real problems and bringing ideas to life — from early concepts through polished delivery.

In this role, you will partner closely with client product teams and our internal team to turn complex ideas into clear, intuitive, and engaging experiences. You’ll be joining real, in-flight work where quality and delivery speed matter, collaborating with experienced designers and growing the instincts that come from shipping things that matter.

Why This Role Matters
---------------------

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

What You’ll Do
--------------

Craft & Delivery
----------------

* Design end-to-end UX/UI deliverables from early exploration and concepting through high-fidelity execution
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and polished interface designs that balance usability, business goals, and technical constraints
* Build, evolve, and maintain design systems that support consistency, scalability, and flexibility across products
* Conduct UX research activities including usability testing and user interviews to inform design decisions
* Use Figma confidently for design, prototyping, documentation, and collaboration
* Bring an AI-forward mindset to your design work, using tools like Figma AI and Claude to improve efficiency, creativity, and design quality

Collaboration & Communication
-----------------------------

* Partner closely with client product teams to understand problems, shape solutions, and deliver meaningful outcomes
* Collaborate with engineers, strategists, and delivery leads to bring designs to life effectively and efficiently
* Participate in agile workflows and balance multiple projects, clients, and industries while maintaining a high bar for craft

Leadership & Influence
----------------------

* Take ownership of design work end-to-end and follow through with craft and consistency
* Contribute to internal initiatives such as marketing, pitches, and the evolution of the design practice
* Stay curious and keep growing — bring new ideas, experiment often, and embrace continuous improvement

What You’ll Bring
-----------------

* 2+ years of professional experience as a UX/UI Designer working on digital products or platforms
* Strong hands-on design skills with deep proficiency in Figma
* Experience building and maintaining design systems in real-world product environments
* Working knowledge of UX research methods including usability testing and user interviews
* Experience working directly with clients or cross-functional product teams
* A collaborative mindset with comfort giving and receiving design feedback
* Ability to adapt to design approaches across different industries, users, and problem spaces
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI-assisted design tools and workflows (e.g., Figma AI, Claude)
* Experience with motion design, advanced prototyping tools, front-end concepts, or workshop facilitation is a plus

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are
------------------------------

* *A doer.* You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
* *A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.* The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
* *Direct in a way that makes the work better.* You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
* *Obsessed with craft.* You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
* *Built for ownership.* You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
* *All in.* You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
* *Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.* Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
* *Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.* Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design lifecycle, from translating business requirements into intuitive user experiences and interactive prototypes to developing responsive front-end interfaces, conducting usability testing, and supporting applications throughout their operational lifespan. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in user experience design, visual design, information architecture, and front-end development, combined with strong hands-on experience building responsive, accessible, and component-driven web applications using modern web technologies. You will work closely with product managers, business analysts, software engineers, QA teams, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to deliver high-quality digital products that enhance customer satisfaction and support strategic business objectives.

*Required Qualifications*

* Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, Digital Media, or a closely related discipline.
* Five or more years of professional experience designing and developing production-grade web or mobile applications with a strong emphasis on user experience and interface design.
* Strong, demonstrable understanding of user-centered design methodologies, information architecture, interaction design, accessibility standards, responsive design principles, and end-to-end product design processes.
* Advanced working knowledge of Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, Photoshop, Illustrator, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern front-end frameworks such as React.
* Hands-on production experience creating responsive user interfaces, interactive prototypes, reusable design systems, component libraries, and scalable front-end architectures.
* Proven experience developing front-end applications using React, with working familiarity in Angular or Vue considered a strong plus.
* Strong knowledge of responsive web design, CSS frameworks, browser compatibility, accessibility (WCAG), front-end optimization techniques, and UI performance best practices.
* Solid experience with Git-based version control workflows, Agile development methodologies, design collaboration tools, developer handoff processes, and release management practices.
* Hands-on experience integrating front-end applications with RESTful APIs, cloud-hosted applications, authentication systems, and modern deployment environments.
* Strong analytical thinking, usability evaluation, debugging, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to solve complex user experience challenges through research-driven design decisions.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience designing enterprise applications involving dashboards, workflow management systems, data visualization, real-time collaboration features, or complex business applications.
* Familiarity with Storybook, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, SASS, animation libraries, Progressive Web Applications (PWAs), and modern front-end performance optimization techniques.
* Exposure to DesignOps, design thinking methodologies, accessibility auditing, service design, behavioral analytics, customer journey optimization, and enterprise design systems.
* Experience conducting usability testing, A/B experimentation, accessibility validation, design quality assurance, and contributing to user-centered design practices within Agile software development environments.

title: Lead UX/UI Designer (m/w/d)
description:
Sorge gemeinsam mit uns für die digitale Zukunftsfähigkeit der Bundeswehr.

Lead UX/UI Designer (m/w/d)

ab sofort und in Vollzeit bundesweit an einem unserer BWI Standorte.

Als primärer Digitalisierungspartner der Bundeswehr erbringen wir stabile, sichere und effiziente IT-Services im In- und Ausland, vom Grundbetrieb bis in den einsatznahen Bereich und tragen so zur kontinuierlichen Erhöhung der Führungs- und Einsatzfähigkeit der Bundeswehr bei. Mit über 8.000 Kolleg*innen betreiben und modernisieren wir eine der größten und komplexesten IT-Infrastrukturen in Deutschland. Wir suchen verantwortungsvolle IT-Spezialist*innen, die die Bundeswehr-IT aus Überzeugung in herausfordernden Digitalisierungsvorhaben weiterentwickeln und so einen Beitrag zur Sicherheit Deutschlands leisten wollen.

​Die Customer Solution Unit „Ausbildungssysteme“ ist verantwortlich für die Projekte und Vorhaben zur Digitalisierung der Ausbildungssysteme in Schulen und Ausbildungseinrichtungen der Bundeswehr und im Geschäftsbereich BMVg. Somit trägt sie zur kontinuierlichen Erhöhung der Führungs- und Einsatzfähigkeit sowie der Kampfkraft der Streitkräfte bei. Die Einheit hat als interner Auftragnehmer die Durchführungsverantwortung für die Verträge und Aufträge im Umfeld der Digitalisierung der Ausbildungssysteme für > 300.000 Nutzer.

Hört sich spannend an?
Dann gib uns einen ersten Eindruck Deiner Skills und füge Deiner Bewerbung Dein aussagekräftiges UX/UI - Portfolio oder Case Studies als PDF bei.

Dein Profil:

-

Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Medien- und Kommunikationsdesign, Medieninformatik/HCI bzw. Psychologie / Soziologie

-

Mindestens 6 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Senior UX/UI Designer (m/w/d), inkl. fundiertes Verständnis von UX-Prinzipien und Design Thinking

-

Langjärhige Erfahrung in der Gestaltung digitaler Benutzeroberflächen unter Berücksichtigung von Usability und Barrierefreiheit (BITV/WCAG)

-

Routine im Umgang mit Tools wie Figma, Sketch oder Adobe XD

-

Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Workshops sowie in der Erstellung von Prototypen und Usability-Tests

-

Idealerweise Erfahrung im Lernökosystem

-

Schnelle Auffassungsgabe insb. von Prozessen und technischen Anforderungen, ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Moderationsstärke und einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch

-

Reisebereitschaft zu Nutzerstandorten innerhalb Deutschlands

-

Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse sowie sehr gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Deine Aufgaben:

* Durchführung von User Research über User Storys, User Flows- und Journeys
* Gestaltung intuitiver und nutzerzentrierter Interfaces für digitale Produkte von Wireframes bis zum fertigen UI-Design und High Fidelity-Prototypen
* Durchführung von Usability Tests sowie Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Pflege des Design-Systems
* Durchführung von Workshops und Interviews
* Anforderungsanalyse und -priorisierung sowie Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Anforderungen
* Prozessanalyse und Modellierung
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und internen Auftragnehmern, Projektteams und externen Dienstleistern sowie vermitteln von fachlichen Anforderungen, Nutzerbedürfnissen und technischen Möglichkeiten
* Beratung von Nutzervertreter und Auftraggeber zum Thema UX/UI

* Durch abwechslungsreiche und gesellschaftlich relevante Aufgaben gewährleisten wir den reibungslosen IT-Betrieb und die Digitalisierung der Bundeswehr

title: Staff UX/UI Designer
description:
*Company Overview*

APPLICATIONS FROM OUTSIDE COLOMBIA AND ARGENTINA WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED FOR THIS ROLE

Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.

We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

*Position Overview*

We’re looking for a Staff UX/UI Designer to define design strategy and lead quality across major client engagements. This role is ideal for an experienced designer who can own end-to-end design for complex, multi-platform products, lead UX research strategy, and partner with leadership and clients to shape product direction.

In this role, you will work as a key design leader on a cross-functional team, owning design system architecture, driving research strategy, and mentoring designers at multiple levels. You’ll champion AI-powered design workflows, contribute to design operations, and help shape how the Experience team grows and works.

*Why This Role Matters*

At Robots & Pencils, we design AI systems for a human world. Our name says it all. Robots and pencils means engineering paired with creativity, because every agent we ship has to work for real people in real workflows. That balance is baked into how we operate.

Every role here contributes directly to that mission. Here, you shape how AI systems integrate into enterprise operations, how teams move at real velocity, and how products create measurable impact for clients and the people they serve. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days. That pace demands people who take ownership, lead with craft, and care deeply about what they put their name on.

*What You’ll Do*

*Craft & Delivery*

* Define design strategy and direction for major engagements, leading end-to-end design across complex, multi-platform products
* Own design system architecture and governance, ensuring consistency, scalability, and flexibility across products and teams
* Lead UX research strategy — selecting methodologies, embedding research into the delivery process, and ensuring insights influence product direction
* Champion AI-powered design workflows and lead their adoption on engagements, driving efficiency and creative quality (e.g., Figma AI, Claude)
* Drive design operations and process improvements that improve how the Experience team delivers and collaborates
* Lead internal initiatives including marketing, business development, and the evolution of the design practice

*Collaboration & Communication*

* Partner with leadership and clients on design direction, serving as a senior design voice at the engagement level
* Collaborate closely with engineers, strategists, and delivery leads to align design decisions with technical and business realities
* Lead workshops, design sprints, and collaborative sessions with clients and cross-functional teams

*Leadership & Influence*

* Mentor junior and mid-level designers, helping them grow their craft, confidence, and professional practice
* Establish design quality standards and critique culture that lift the team’s collective craft
* Make design decisions with thoughtful consideration of tradeoffs across usability, business goals, and technical constraints

*What You’ll Bring*

* 6+ years of professional UX/UI design experience with a strong product background
* Expert Figma proficiency with design system architecture experience
* Deep experience leading design systems at scale, including architecture, governance, and cross-team adoption
* Deep UX research experience including research strategy, methodology selection, and translating insights into product direction
* Experience defining design strategy for complex products or engagements
* Experience presenting and influencing at the leadership and client level
* Track record of mentoring designers and lifting team craft
* Strong experience with AI-assisted design tools and leading their adoption within a team (e.g., Figma AI, Claude)
* Experience facilitating workshops, design sprints, and collaborative sessions with clients and cross-functional teams
* Service design experience, design ops leadership, or multi-platform design depth is a plus

*You’ll Do Well Here if You Are*

* *A doer.* You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
* *A fast learner who knows you don't know everything.* The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
* *Direct in a way that makes the work better.* You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
* *Obsessed with craft.* You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
* *Built for ownership.* You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
* *All in.* You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
* *Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight.* Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
* *Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do.* Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission. We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

-------------------------------------------

* Create lovable products, the perfect blend of something useful and delightful that forges meaningful connections with users.

ArcTouch is a specialty studio that is part of the award-winning AKQA Group.

If you're passionate about building lovable products, we want you to join us!

----------------------

----------------------

As a Product Designer at ArcTouch, you'll be able to design great user experiences and engaging interfaces for various platforms (iOS and Android apps, web projects, and many others!). Explore every form of interaction from touchscreens to voice command, chatbots, VR and AR. All of this for international digital products that are used by millions of users every day.

Working with us, you’ll get the chance to collaborate with a skilled, fast-paced and innovative team on various projects. You will contribute to different phases of the design process, from discovery to delivery, sharing your knowledge with others and boosting your understanding of various types of business.

We encourage collaboration through creativity, so we value good communication skills and teamwork, from defining requirements with product managers to working close to developers to ensure pixel-perfect execution of design deliverables.

* Lead and/or participate in group ideation and collaborative design sessions, providing design critiques and support to your colleagues.
* Plan research for new projects, and collect and interpret data for design audits.
* Create mockups, concepts, and prototypes for client testing and approval.
* Articulate design rationale effectively to both internal and external audiences.
* Keep up to date with the latest design and technology trends for various platforms.
* Create the right documentation for handoff, ranging from a sketch on a whiteboard to an annotated mockup (or detailed UI specifications and assets) for developers to implement.
* Learn and share knowledge with your peers during our internal team meetings and ceremonies.
* Communicate the design rationales clearly and actively in English, being able to adapt the communication to internal or external stakeholders. Conduct presentations and answer questions from various audiences.

* Work cooperatively, and communicate early and often to handle multiple projects with flexibility to change focus quickly.
* Engage actively with hardware and software advancements, getting “out of the box” and suggesting new applications to our business and clients.
* Proactively reach out to share knowledge and contribute with teammates, collaborating to evangelize design within ArcTouch.

*REMOTE:* This position is remote-friendly within Brazil.

*CONTRACTOR:* This is a short-term contractor position.

title: Founding Designer (UI/UX) - Contract
description:
Contract role with potential to become permanent

*About Bolter*

Bolter is an AI agent platform built to help people get real work done, without needing to stitch together multiple tools or spend weeks setting things up.

You describe what you need in plain language and Bolter creates and runs agents that can carry out the work end to end. They retain context, remember how you work and can also create real, shareable apps such as trackers and dashboards.

Bolter is funded and currently at the validation-sprint stage, working with a small group of high-impact operators. We are now looking to hire a founding designer to shape the product from the ground up.

*About the role*

This is a genuine zero-to-one design role.

You will define how people create, understand and work with AI agents inside Bolter. That includes the agent-building experience, the workspace where people can steer their agents, and the applications those agents generate.

There is no established design system or interaction model to inherit. You will create both from the ground up, defining the components, patterns and behaviours that shape the product as it develops.

The design problem goes beyond making AI easier to use. It is working out what it should feel like to collaborate with agents that retain context, carry out work and create software themselves.

You will work directly with the GM in a lean team, with specialised AI agents supporting implementation. Your early design decisions will form the foundation that the rest of the product builds on.

*What you’ll do*

*

Build and own Bolter’s design system from the ground up

*

Define the interaction patterns for creating, understanding and steering AI agents

*

Shape the experience across the workspace and agent-generated applications

*

Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed, clarity and craft

*

Move quickly from ideas to working designs and strengthen what proves useful

*

Help shape the early design and product team as Bolter grows

*What we’re looking for*

*

You’ve designed and shipped AI products and understand the interaction problems that come with them

*

You think in systems and interaction patterns, not individual screens

*

You have strong product and design judgement

*

You care about craft, but know when speed and pragmatism matter more than polish

*

You’re comfortable designing while the product itself is still being defined, rather than working from a settled brief

*

You can form clear opinions and adapt them when the evidence changes

Bolter is still early enough that the core design decisions are open. You will have meaningful ownership from the beginning and the opportunity to help define what working with AI agents should actually feel like.

If you want to define an AI product rather than inherit one, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Designer de Produto UI/UX  - Senior
AI-Native UI/UX Designer
description:
*About* AmorServ

AmorServ delivers technology services, IT support, and digital solutions to enterprise clients. We work across multiple product lines and client engagements, which means our designers shape experiences for both internal platforms and external customer-facing products. Speed, polish, and craft all matter — and AI is now a core part of how we get there.

The Opportunity
---------------

We're hiring a UI/UX Designer who has fully embraced AI-assisted design tooling — Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Galileo, Magic Patterns, Midjourney, and the rapidly evolving stack around them. This isn't a role for someone who occasionally uses AI for inspiration. We want a designer who treats AI tools as a first-class part of their workflow: generating, iterating, prototyping, and shipping at a pace that wasn't possible two years ago.

You'll own the design output across multiple AmorServ initiatives, partnering closely with engineering to move from idea prototype production-ready UI in days, not weeks.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Lead end-to-end UI/UX design for AmorServ web and mobile products — from discovery and wireframes through high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.

* Use AI design tools (Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Magic Patterns, Galileo, Uizard, etc.) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate ideation, generate variations, and produce production-grade UI faster.

* Translate business requirements and user research into clean, accessible, conversion-focused interfaces.

* Build and maintain design systems — components, tokens, patterns — that scale across multiple AmorServ products.

* Prototype real, clickable experiences that engineers can build directly from, with handoff specs that leave no ambiguity.

* Use generative AI for visual assets, icon systems, illustrations, and marketing creative when appropriate, while maintaining brand consistency.

* Run lightweight user testing and incorporate feedback rapidly.

* Stay ahead of the AI design tooling landscape and bring new workflows into the team.

What We're Looking For
----------------------

Required:
---------

* Demonstrable fluency with AI design tools. You should be able to walk us through projects where AI tools materially shaped the output, not just decorated it.

* Strong portfolio showing shipped product work — web, mobile, or both — with clear visual craft.

* Expert-level Figma skills (auto-layout, components, variants, variables, prototyping).

* Solid grasp of design systems, accessibility (WCAG basics), and responsive design.

* Ability to write clear copy for UI — microcopy, empty states, error messages, onboarding.

* Comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and direct feedback.

* Clear written and visual communication. You can explain why a design works, not just that it does.

Nice to have:
-------------

* Experience designing for B2B / enterprise software, IT services, or technical products.

* Front-end fluency — enough HTML/CSS/Tailwind/React to read code, tweak prototypes, or hand off cleanly to engineers.

* Experience with prompt engineering and getting consistent, on-brand output from generative tools.

* Motion design (Framer, Rive, After Effects, or Lottie).

* Background designing AI-powered product features (chat interfaces, agent UIs, generative experiences).

How You Work
------------

* You ship. You'd rather get a v1 in front of users this week than a v3 in a month.

* You think in systems, not screens. Every component you make is one someone else can reuse.

* You treat AI tools as leverage, not a crutch. You know when to generate and when to draw.

* You sweat the details — spacing, type rhythm, color, motion — because they compound.

* You're opinionated but not precious. You defend good ideas and let go of bad ones quickly.

What We Offer
-------------

* Compensation matched to experience — we're open from mid-level through lead/principal.

* A modern AI tooling stack, fully paid for. If a new tool ships and it's worth using, you get it.

* Real ownership over what you design and how it ships.

* A small, fast team where your work is visible and your judgment matters.

* Remote-friendly with flexible hours.

How to Apply
------------

Attach the following as one document:
-------------------------------------

* Your portfolio (link or PDF). We care about depth on 2–3 projects more than breadth.

* A short note (no cover letter required) covering: which AI design tools you use weekly, and one example of a project where AI tooling changed how you'd normally approach the work.

* Your résumé.

We review every application. If your portfolio shows the craft and the AI fluency, you'll hear back.

AmorServ is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and craft

You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built.
AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality.

* Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences.
* Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience.

title: Staff Visual Designer - Design Systems
location: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States
description:
In 1954, architect Eero Saarinen designed a radically modern bank branch for Irwin Union in Columbus, Indiana. With glass walls, no private offices, and a floor plan that invited openness, it embodied a new kind of transparency in finance. The building was surrounded by trees, furnished by Herman Miller, and featured rustic brick flooring. Today, that space is a conference center, and that spirit of design-forward thinking in banking feels all but extinct.

Mercury believes that level of care and craft in design has been lost in modern finance and we’re building a brand that brings it back. We're a financial technology company building products that feel extraordinary to use. We help people and businesses accomplish more with their money by turning banking* from a frustration into a catalyst for their ambitions.

Our Design Systems team sets the visual foundation that every product designer, every UI surface, and every expressive product moment builds on, from the foundations like type and color, to highly expressive brand-in-product moments that make Mercury feel considered.

We’re looking for a Staff Visual Designer to raise the ceiling on craft across Mercury’s design system and product experience. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can see the whole UI system and knows how to evolve it at scale.

Design Foundations is a brand-new team at Mercury, responsible for design systems, brand in product, and AI tools to help anyone build. This means this role has real agency to define it: supporting a highly collaborative team that’s hungry to grow its craft, and a clean slate for setting the vision forward.

*In this role, you’ll:*
-----------------------

* Redefine and ship large, foundational improvements to Mercury’s design language (things like type, color, and iconography) that scale beautifully across every product surface.
* Partner with Brand and other craft leaders to bring expressive moments into the product and set direction for how brand and product visual language work together.
* Set the craft bar for the design org: define what excellent looks like, and build the systems, guidelines, and references that make it repeatable.
* Actively coach product designers on their craft, giving direct feedback that raises the quality bar across both individual work and the design system itself.
* Partner with design systems designers and engineers to make sure visual decisions translate cleanly into scalable, maintainable components.
* Represent design systems and visual craft in conversations with Brand, Engineering, and design leadership.

*What you’ll bring:*
--------------------

* 10+ years of experience in visual design, with deep expertise in typography, color systems, and iconography at a product or brand scale.
* A portfolio that shows range: foundational systems work as well as high-craft, expressive visual design.
* Not just taste, but conviction and language to articulate what makes something successful.
* A track record of coaching or mentoring other designers, with a clear point of view on what strong craft looks like and how to teach it.
* Systems thinking, you’re comfortable balancing expressive visual design with the pragmatic needs of a scalable design system for a data rich product.
* Strong stakeholder management, comfortable winning buy-in from executives and cross-functional leaders on high-visibility work, backed by conviction.
* Strong communication and presence: able to set direction, build alignment, and defend opinionated design decisions with both designers and engineers.
* Proficient in design tools and front-end prototyping with React; comfortable working closely with engineers on how visual systems get built and maintained in code. Affinity for AI-assisted prototyping. Motion design skills are a plus.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

We’re looking for a Senior Designer with strong visual instincts, sharp craft, and most importantly, deep AI fluency and prototyping momentum: someone who uses AI to think faster, make more, and close the gap between concept and build.

This role is for someone who cares deeply about typography, layout, interaction, motion, and the details that make work feel clear, expressive, and culturally aware. You’re excited to build brands that scale from foundational identity systems to campaign concepts and into real, shippable product experiences and you’re genuinely obsessed with emerging AI tools, building custom workflows, and using them to expand exploration, speed iteration, and raise the fidelity of what you hand to engineering.

*WHAT YOU'LL DO*

* Design across brand identity systems, campaigns, and digital product experiences (web, mobile, platforms)
* Create scalable visual languages and design systems that work across marketing and product environments
* Translate strategy into clear concepts, flows, UI frameworks, and high-craft executions
* Prototype early and often from interaction/motion studies to clickable and high-fidelity prototypes that reduce ambiguity and accelerate delivery
* Use AI as a core design tool, not an add-on: build and refine workflows for ideation, iteration, production support, and rapid prototyping
* Partner with strategists, writers, producers, and engineers to bring work to life end-to-end, with an emphasis on feasibility and build-ready detail
* Present work clearly, incorporate feedback thoughtfully, and contribute to client conversations when needed
* Balance conceptual exploration with strong day-to-day design production across multiple workstreams
* Deliver high-fidelity concepts that developers can build from ensuring what ships looks and behaves like what was intended (handoff, QA, iteration)
* Manage workload and project timelines to keep design work prioritized, scoped appropriately, and delivered on schedule

*WHAT YOU'LL NEED*

* High AI fluency and curiosity: you’re not just familiar with tools you’re actively experimenting, developing opinions, and evolving your workflow
* Prototyping strength: you can turn ideas into tangible, testable experiences quickly, and you use prototypes to drive alignment and decisions
* Strong communication skills, collaborative mindset, and ability to own pieces of work independently
* A portfolio showing strong craft across identity, campaign, and product/UI work (systems + execution)

We pride ourselves on not only solving consumer and business problems, but also helping to establish new capabilities for our clients. With a global client roster of Fortune 100s and start-ups alike, we crave the hardest problems to solve. Striving never to be pigeonholed, we work across every major category: from tech to CPG, financial services to travel & hospitality, government and education to media and publishing. We value the collaboration with our client partners, including but not limited to Adidas, Amazon, Con Edison, Diageo, EY, J.P. Morgan Chase, Lenovo, Marriott, Mars, Microsoft, Thomson Reuters, and TikTok.

The Code and Theory network is comprised of nearly 2,000 people with 50% engineers and 50% creative talent. We’re always on the lookout for smart, driven, and forward-thinking people to join our team.

The compensation range for this role is $90,000 – $115,000 and spans multiple levels. We're open to hiring at the level that best matches the right candidate's experience. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, budget, and location.

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

*What We Do*

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

*About the Role*

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
* Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
* Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
* Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
* Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

*How to get started*

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

*Project time expectations*

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

*Compensation*

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$50 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.
