description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a UX Designer – Retail & Operational Systems based in Canada.*

This role offers the opportunity to shape intuitive, efficient digital experiences for frontline retail and financial operations. You will design transactional systems used in fast-paced, compliance-driven environments where usability, accuracy, and speed are critical. Your work will simplify complex workflows while helping users complete high-frequency tasks with fewer errors and less training. You’ll collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and legal stakeholders to turn business and regulatory requirements into clear user experiences. The position combines research, workflow architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and design-system development. It is an ideal opportunity for a UX professional who enjoys solving complex operational problems and using emerging AI-assisted design tools to accelerate iteration.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Observe frontline workflows to identify friction points, workarounds, training gaps, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
* Lead UX design for high-frequency, compliance-sensitive retail and financial transactions, balancing user needs with business, regulatory, and technical constraints.
* Architect intuitive workflows covering areas such as item intake, pricing, customer profiles, loyalty enrollment, inventory, loan processing, payments, and fraud prevention.
* Design interfaces that prioritize data accuracy, keyboard-first and mobile navigation, conditional logic, validation, error prevention, and efficient task completion.
* Partner with product, engineering, operations, risk, compliance, and legal teams to translate business rules and regulatory requirements into usable interfaces and workflows.
* Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, annotated specifications, and pixel-perfect production-ready UI designs.
* Validate concepts through usability testing, workshops, design reviews, and iterative feedback cycles.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary keystrokes, shorten learning curves, streamline workflows, and minimize operational errors.
* Contribute to and evolve design systems and component libraries optimized for high-volume operational environments.
* Apply AI-assisted design and prototyping tools to accelerate exploration and iteration while maintaining strong standards for usability and visual quality.

------------
Requirements
------------

* 4+ years of professional UX/UI design experience, particularly with operational workflows, internal tools, transaction-processing platforms, or similarly complex systems.
* Strong expertise in information architecture, form design, workflow optimization, conditional logic, and task-oriented interaction design.
* Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, and evolving design systems and reusable component libraries.
* Advanced visual design skills with a strong eye for typography, color, spacing, hierarchy, consistency, and interaction details.
* Demonstrated ability to translate regulatory, compliance, and business requirements into clear and intuitive user experiences.
* Advanced proficiency with *Figma* , including *Figma AI* and *Figma Make*.
* Strong ability to communicate design rationale and collaborate effectively with engineering, product, operations, compliance, and leadership teams.
* Curiosity and adaptability toward emerging design technologies and AI-assisted workflows.
* Bilingual proficiency in *English and Spanish*.
* Experience with item valuation, customer onboarding, identity verification, loyalty programs, payments, or similar transactional systems is an asset.
* Experience designing task-oriented interfaces for non-desk users in high-volume retail or operational environments is an asset.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted prototyping tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Figma AI is a plus.
* Understanding of stateful prototyping, including focus states, transitions, loading states, and complex interaction sequences.
* Knowledge of prompt engineering, conversational or multimodal interfaces, computer-vision experiences, and AI-assisted features with appropriate trust, transparency, and user-override mechanisms is valued.
* A portfolio demonstrating strong UX/UI work, workflow optimization, and AI-assisted design iterations is preferred.

--------
Benefits
--------

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*About Creative Fabrica*

Creative Fabrica is a subscription platform serving millions of creators, designers, and crafters worldwide. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time-consuming production.

Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication-ready designs in minutes instead of hours.

Our content library contains 15+ million commercially-licensed fonts, graphics, SVGs, and templates, giving you professional-quality building blocks without the expense or time of creating assets from scratch.

*About the role:*

Creative Fabrica is building a new generation of AI products, and we want our visual identity and creative output to be as ambitious as the products themselves. We're building an in-house creative team that supports product launches, educational content, social channels, campaigns, partnerships and our overall brand - and a major part of that is producing a large volume of strong creative: quickly, consistently and across many different formats.

As our Graphic Designer, you will be one of the key people shaping how Creative Fabrica AI looks across every marketing touchpoint. You'll work closely with our Motion Designers, Video Editor, Educational Content Producer, Product Marketing and channel owners to create visual assets for launches, campaigns, social content, partnerships and ongoing brand communication.

This is a high-output creative role. We're not looking for someone who wants to spend several days refining every individual asset - we want strong design judgment combined with the ability to move quickly, explore multiple directions and turn successful ideas into repeatable creative systems. AI should be a natural part of how you work: you'll be encouraged to experiment with new models and creative tools, build AI-assisted workflows and find ways to increase both the quality and speed of our creative production.

This is a full-time, in-office role at our Amsterdam HQ, with an annual allowance of 30 work-from-anywhere days.

*What you will do:*

* *Create assets across every marketing touchpoint* - design for product launches, social channels, educational content, campaigns, partnerships and landing pages, from thumbnails and social assets to launch graphics, product visuals and presentation decks
* *Turn ideas into compelling concepts* - translate product capabilities, messages and campaign ideas into clear, visually compelling creative directions
* *Produce a high volume of quality creative* - balance strong craft with the speed a fast-moving growth team requires, developing multiple directions and variations rather than defaulting to a single execution
* *Make AI part of your process* - use generative AI throughout ideation, image generation, exploration, iteration and production, and experiment with new models and tools that can improve our design workflows
* *Design for the channels that matter* - work with channel owners to create and iterate assets specifically for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X and other platforms
* *Keep static, motion and video consistent* - work closely with our Motion Designers and Video Editor to develop concepts that hold up across every medium
* *Shape our visual identity* - help develop and evolve Creative Fabrica AI's brand and translate it into practical guidelines
* *Build creative systems that scale* - create reusable templates, components and design systems, and turn successful concepts into formats that quickly generate new variations
* *Iterate on what works* - use performance data and feedback from channel owners to understand which creative approaches land, and stay current with visual culture, design trends and generative AI

*What you will need:*

* *2+ years of design experience* - in graphic design, visual design, brand design or a similar role, with a strong portfolio demonstrating excellent digital design and visual craft
* *Strong tool proficiency* - Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud, or equivalent professional design tools
* *Hands-on generative AI experience* - AI tools for visual creation are already part of your creative workflow, and you're genuinely excited about how AI is changing the creative process
* *Excellent design fundamentals* - a strong grasp of typography, composition, colour, hierarchy and visual storytelling, plus experience designing for digital and social channels across multiple formats and aspect ratios
* *Brand consistency skills* - experience working with brand identities and maintaining visual consistency across different types of assets
* *High creative velocity* - you enjoy making, testing and iterating rather than endlessly perfecting a single direction, and you know when work needs exceptional polish versus when speed matters more
* *Proactivity and ownership* - you can take a loose objective and independently develop strong creative directions, without waiting for a pixel-perfect brief. Good written and spoken English

*Nice to have:*

* *Advanced AI workflows* - deep experience with generative AI image tools, or building repeatable and automated AI-assisted creative workflows
* *Performance creative experience* - creating high-performing organic social or paid advertising creative, or an understanding of creative testing and performance marketing
* *Adjacent creative skills* - motion design, basic video editing, or landing-page and web design
* *High-output environments* - experience in a startup, growth team, agency or similar, ideally designing for AI, SaaS, technology or consumer products

*We would also like to offer you:*

* *Lunch:* On days you work in the office a warm fresh lunch will be provided for you.
* 30 days *Work From Anywhere Benefit* per year.
* *24* days of paid vacation per year + public holidays.
* *Travel Allowance* , if you live more than 10 KM from the office (in the form of an NS card).
* Company *pension plan*.
* Company *events* and *overseas trips* !

*Is this you?*
--------------

Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.

You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.

Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

*Unique Company Culture and Mission*

*Our Mission*

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one dog destination in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokanes love of Rescue Dogs.

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

*Our Company Culture*

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we dont take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where its normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dogs birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isnt being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

title: Graphic Designer, Social Media, Sales and Community Manager(Full-Time)
description:
Herbal Goodness is a US-based manufacturer of pure, organic superfoods, premium herbal extracts, and empowering people to live healthier lives. Founded on principles of quality, sustainability, and social impact, we donate 10% of our profits to educate young girls in Africa.

Role
We are seeking an experienced, purpose-driven Graphic Designer, Social Media, Sales & Community Manager to join our team full-time and help elevate our brand across e-commerce, digital marketing, and retail packaging across US markets, and anchor our expansion into the Nigerian/African market.

Position Overview

We are looking for a creative, highly detail-oriented Graphic Designer with a strong background in direct-response design, e-commerce graphics, and consumer packaged goods (CPG). In this role, you will own the visual identity of Herbal Goodness across our Shopify site, Amazon storefronts, paid ad creative (Meta/Google), and retail packaging (such as GNC banners and product labels).

Key Responsibilities

* Digital Advertising Creative: Design high-converting Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and Google display ad creatives, including static banners, video thumbnails, flat-lay composites, and callout graphics.
* Packaging & Retail Collateral: Develop and update compliant product labels, box packaging, print inserts, and retail marketing assets (e.g., GNC display banners, sales sheets).
* E-Commerce & Amazon Visuals: Create engaging Amazon A+ content, main product gallery images, banner ads, and Shopify landing page graphics.
* Brand Consistency: Maintain and evolve the Herbal Goodness brand identity, ensuring visual harmony, clean typography, and premium aesthetics across all consumer touchpoints.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with our marketing, PPC media buying, and executive leadership teams to rapidly iterate on ad performance data and launch new product campaigns.

* Social Media Management: Oversee and execute the daily strategy across TikTok, Facebook, and Instagram, crafting engaging organic posts, short-form video content, and stories that grow brand awareness and engagement.
* Content Planning & Strategy: Lead the master content calendar and creative direction tailored specifically to both our US and Nigerian target markets, balancing cultural relevance, brand messaging, and product promotion.
* Influencer & Creator Programs: Identify, recruit, and manage relationships with micro- and macro-influencers on TikTok and Instagram to drive UGC (user-generated content), brand advocacy, and affiliate sales.
* Community & Facebook Group Management: Actively engage with our audience, respond to comments and messages, and build/moderate vibrant Facebook Groups around wellness, organic living, and women's empowerment.
* Sales & Revenue Growth: Leverage social channels as direct sales drivers by introducing TikTok Shop, Instagram Shopping, strategic giveaways, and conversion-focused community campaigns to measurably grow revenue.
* Performance Tracking & Reporting: Monitor key growth metrics—including engagement rates, follower acquisition, influencer ROI, and social-driven sales—to continuously refine and optimize content strategy.
*

Qualifications & Requirements

* Experience: 3+ years of serious AI use, professional graphic design and social media management experience (agency or in-house CPG/supplement brand preferred).
* Software Proficiency: Expert knowledge of AI tools for graphics and video production, Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign). Experience with basic video editing/motion design (Premiere/After Effects) is a strong plus.
* E-Commerce Focus: Proven experience designing high-converting assets for Meta ads, Amazon storefronts, and direct-to-consumer websites.
* CPG Packaging: Familiarity with print-ready file preparation, typography, color management, and dietary supplement label requirements.
* Portfolio Required: An active online portfolio demonstrating strong layout, typography, photo manipulation, and commercial product marketing visuals.
* Mindset: Self-motivated, comfortable in a fast-paced environment, and deeply aligned with our purpose-driven, non-GMO, organic wellness mission.

Why Join Us?

* Purpose-Driven Work: Be part of a mission-led brand dedicated to health, sustainability, and supporting girls' education in Africa.
* Competitive Compensation: Salary commensurate with experience.
* Growth & Impact: High-visibility role where your creative work directly drives campaign performance and business growth.

Herbal Goodness is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Marketing Content & Graphic Designer
description:
The *Content & Graphic Designer* will be responsible for creating engaging marketing and sales content for SAG Intelligence by combining strong *content writing, visual communication, and graphic design skills*.

This is a hands-on role that goes beyond social media graphics. The candidate will be expected to understand SAG Intelligence's products and services, identify the value they provide to customers, and translate complex product and technology information into clear, compelling written and visual content.

A key part of the role is supporting the *Sales/BDR team with customized content and collateral for inbound enquiries*. This may include tailored presentations, one-pagers, product explainers, solution briefs, case-study-style content, email content, and other materials based on a prospect's specific requirements.

The role will work across *Marketing and Sales* , serving as a bridge between Product, Marketing, and Sales by turning business requirements and product information into polished, professional content and visual assets.

Content Creation
----------------

* Create engaging, informative, and persuasive content around SAG Intelligence's products, solutions, and services.
* Develop content for different stages of the customer journey, from awareness and education to consideration and conversion.
* Create website content, product descriptions, blogs/articles, LinkedIn posts, social media content, email campaigns, product announcements, solution briefs, one-pagers, case studies, sales collateral, FAQs, and presentation content.
* Translate complex product and technology concepts into simple, engaging, and easy-to-understand content for business audiences.
* Develop messaging focused on customer problems, benefits, use cases, and business outcomes.

Graphic Design
--------------

* Design marketing and sales materials aligned with SAG Intelligence's brand.
* Create social media creatives, infographics, product graphics, presentation decks, sales one-pagers, brochures, product/solution sheets, case-study designs, email graphics, website visuals, and digital advertisements.
* Maintain consistency in branding, typography, layouts, imagery, and overall visual identity.
* Transform written concepts and product information into compelling visual stories.
* Create graphics that communicate complex information quickly and effectively.

Customized Content for Inbound Enquiries
----------------------------------------

* Work with the *Sales/BDR team* to understand prospect requirements and create customized content to support sales conversations.
* Create customized product presentations, prospect-specific one-pagers, solution summaries, product/service overviews, industry-specific collateral, use-case presentations, proposal visuals, product comparison documents, customized email content, and follow-up materials.
* Develop customized case-study or ROI-style content and visual explanations of how products or services can address a prospect's specific problem.
* Take a prospect requirement and turn it into concise, professional, and visually appealing content that explains how SAG Intelligence's solution can address the requirement.

Sales Enablement
----------------

* Work closely with BDR and Sales teams to understand common prospect questions, objections, and requirements.
* Create reusable sales collateral that helps the sales team communicate products effectively.
* Develop content for different industries, personas, and use cases.
* Quickly adapt existing content for specific prospects or opportunities.
* Maintain a library of updated marketing and sales collateral.
* Help the sales team present complex products and solutions simply and compellingly.

Product & Industry Research
---------------------------

* Develop a strong understanding of SAG Intelligence's products, services, and target customers.
* Research relevant industry trends and customer pain points.
* Understand target audiences and create content that resonates with their business challenges.
* Stay up to date with trends in *Healthcare, Legal, Finance, Technology, AI, and related B2B industries* , as relevant to the company's offerings.
* Translate product updates and new features into customer-friendly messaging.

Social Media & Digital Content
------------------------------

* Develop engaging content for LinkedIn and other relevant digital channels.
* Create educational, thought-leadership, product-focused, customer pain-point, industry insight, infographic, and short-form visual content.
* Work with the Marketing team to maintain a consistent content calendar.
* Repurpose long-form content into multiple social and visual formats.

Performance & Quality
---------------------

* Maintain quality and consistency across written and visual content.
* Ensure brand consistency across marketing materials.
* Deliver customized sales requests within the required turnaround time.
* Continuously improve content based on audience and sales feedback.
* Support the Sales/BDR team with relevant and effective content.

*Requirements*

* *2–5+ years of experience* in content creation, graphic design, marketing communications, or a similar role.

* Strong combination of *content writing and graphic design skills*.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Ability to write professional B2B content with a clear and persuasive tone.
* Strong visual communication and design sense.
* Ability to understand technical/product information and simplify it for a non-technical audience.
* Strong understanding of business audiences and decision-makers.
* Ability to create customized content quickly based on sales or customer requirements.
* Experience creating content for *B2B companies, SaaS, technology, healthcare, professional services, or similar industries* is preferred.

Design Tools
------------

Strong proficiency in one or more of the following:

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Canva
* Figma
* PowerPoint / Google Slides

Experience with *Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, or similar video/motion-graphics tools* is an advantage.

Content & AI Tools
------------------

Experience with modern content and AI tools is highly desirable, including:

* ChatGPT or similar AI writing tools
* AI-assisted design tools
* Grammarly or similar editing tools
* Content management systems
* SEO/content research tools

The candidate should understand how to use AI to *accelerate content creation while maintaining originality, accuracy, brand voice, and quality*.

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience working with B2B SaaS or technology companies.
* Experience creating content for senior decision-makers.
* Experience supporting sales teams with customized collateral.
* Understanding of Healthcare, Legal, Finance, or other professional-services industries.
* Portfolio demonstrating both *content writing and graphic design*.
* Experience creating presentations and sales enablement materials.
* Basic understanding of B2B marketing funnels and lead generation.

*Benefits*

*Join Our Dynamic Team:* Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.

*Embrace the Opportunities:* Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.

*Limitless Career Growth:* Unlock a world of possibilities and resources to propel your career forward.

*Fast-Paced Thrills:* Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.

*Flexibility, Your Way:* Embrace the freedom to work from home or any location of your choice. Create your ideal work environment.

*Work-Life Balance at Its Best:* Say goodbye to stressful commutes and hello to quality time with loved ones. Achieve a healthy work-life integration to perform at your best.

title: Graphic Designer
description:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

*Compensation*

For this Graphic Designer, with 5+ years of experience, the compensation range is $2,500 - $3,333 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. This range is designed to accommodate early-career professionals and reflects the foundational skills and potential for growth within the role.

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a talented and motivated *Graphic Designer* who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ to join our dynamic team . This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

In this role, you will be instrumental in crafting visually compelling designs that resonate with our brand’s ethos and captivate our target audience. As a Graphic Designer at Sezzle, you will work closely with the marketing, product and even sales teams to produce high-quality visuals that drive engagement and elevate our brand presence across different digital platforms.

*What You'll Do:*

* *Visual Branding:* Follow brand guidelines to develop and maintain consistent visual branding across all channels, including websites, email, print, and sales decks.
* *Creative Design:* Conceptualize and design graphics for various marketing efforts, including in-app banners, emails, landing pages, sales decks, and display ads.
* *Collaboration:* Work closely with the creative, marketing, and product teams to ensure goals and timelines are being met.
* *Innovation:* Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and technologies to continuously push the creative boundaries and bring fresh ideas to the table.
* *Project Management:* Manage multiple design projects from concept through completion, ensuring high-quality output within deadlines.
* *Brand Storytelling:* Translate complex ideas into simple, elegant visuals that tell a compelling story and enhance our brand identity.

*What We Look For:*

* *Experience:* 5+ years of experience in graphic design, preferably within the tech or fintech industry.
* *Skills:* Proficient in Figma, AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, etc), Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), and other design tools. Jira experience preferred but not required.
* *Portfolio:* Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design projects, with a focus on digital campaign design.
* *Creativity:* A keen eye for aesthetics, typography, and composition, with a passion for creating engaging and visually striking designs.
* *Collaboration:* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to take constructive feedback and iterate quickly.
* *Detail-Oriented:* Strong attention to detail, with a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
* *Adaptability:* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple projects, and adapt to changing priorities.
* *Education:* A degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

*Why Sezzle?*

* *Innovative Environment:* Join a forward-thinking company that values creativity and embraces new ideas.
* *Growth Opportunities:* Be part of a growing company with opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* *Inclusive Culture:* Work in an inclusive environment that fosters diversity, equity, and belonging.
* *Impactful Work:* Contribute to a company that is making a positive impact on the financial future of millions.

*About You:*

* *You have relentlessly high standards* - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* *You’re not bound by convention* - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* *You need action* - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* *You earn trust* - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* *You have backbone; disagree, then commit* - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* *You deliver results* - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

*What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:*

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented *Graphic Designer* to join us and help shape the visual identity of our three products: WP Rocket, Imagify, and RocketCDN. 🚀

Become Our New Graphic Designer !

As our *Graphic Designer* , you'll bring our marketing campaigns to life through engaging, high-quality visuals across all touchpoints. From *ad creatives and campaign banners to landing pages, website visuals, and social media assets,* you'll help shape how our products look. You'll also contribute to evolving our brand identities, bringing fresh ideas while ensuring consistency across channels. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and be an integral part of our Marketing team.

This role is fully remote, but to keep collaboration smooth and our working hours nicely aligned, we’re looking for someone based in Europe.

You’ll be officially employed in your country of residence through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner, so you can enjoy the flexibility of remote work while being fully employed locally.

What You Will Be Doing

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

*

Own the visual execution of campaigns - defining creative angles and developing full asset sets based on briefs from the marketing team

*

Design a wide variety of ad creatives and formats - display banners across standard sizes and paid social - enabling testing and iteration to improve performance

*

Design and adjust website visuals to support conversion and campaign goals

*

Create brand assets across channels - social media graphics, email banners, infographics, illustrations, ebooks, and print materials

*

Contribute ideas to help evolve and refine brand guidelines and visual identity over time

Stay informed on design trends, competitor work, and best practices to bring fresh creative ideas to the team

What Do You Need To Excel at This Job

*

Proven professional experience as a Graphic Designer within a SaaS, tech, software, or digital product environment

*

Proven experience designing display advertising and paid social ad creative — banner sets adapted across standard formats and sizes (300x250, 728x90, 160x600, etc.), including multiple variations for performance testing

*

Proven experience designing landing pages, website visuals, and other web assets built to convert

*

Comfortable designing across other marketing formats too — email, infographics, and organic social, with knowledge of platform-specific best practices

*

Experience working with and evolving an existing brand identity, with a strong sense of visual consistency

*

Ability to translate a campaign angle or brief into compelling, on-brand visual assets

*

Strong proficiency with Figma and relevant Adobe Creative Suite tools such as Photoshop and Illustrator

*

Currently based in Europe and able to work within European working hours — you'll be part of the core marketing team, collaborating daily on calls and Slack

*

Ability to collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and other stakeholders to translate briefs and feedback into strong visual execution

*

Strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple design requests and deadlines simultaneously

Do you want to know other things we appreciate about our candidates?

*

*Thrives in a fast-paced environment*

You are a doer, adaptable, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can evolve quickly.

*

*Previous* *remote job experience*.
Slack will be your virtual office, where all the life of the company takes place.

*

*Think beyond "making things pretty"*

You understand that great marketing design has a purpose. Whether you're creating an ad, banner, landing page, or campaign visual, you think about the audience, the message, the brand, and the goal behind the design.

About us
--------

Founded in 2014 in the beautiful Lyon, France, *WP Media* is an equal opportunity employer with a distributed team of +45 teammates living around the world.
WP Media is the French company behind successful WordPress plugins like WP Rocket and Imagify. WP Rocket is the premium caching plugin for WordPress used by +5,000,000 websites worldwide. Our plugin makes sites go at the speed of light in just a few clicks. Imagify is our free image optimization service, including a free WordPress plugin: we have already optimized more than 19,000,000,000 images! 😲

You will join our remote, global Marketing team and collaborate with talented teammates across multiple countries and time zones. We have flexible working hours & a remote work culture. We value clear communication and encourage everyone to participate actively. We are eager to find out which new country will be added to our distributed team map! 🌍

WP Media is part of , a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting and digital marketing services.

** is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.

Do We Share the Same Values?

*Mutual respect, collaboration, and inclusivity.*

These are the fundamental values that support our life as a team.

*Healthy balance between work and private life.*

We encourage our employees to enjoy their family and hobbies with flexible working hours and minimum vacation policy. There are no time cards to stamp, only customers to make happy and friendly teammates to work with! We care about the work you do, not about the hours you sit at your desk.

*We like to see each other in person whenever possible.*

Every year, we organize a trip with the whole team and spend a week of coworking and fun activities together.

To give you an idea, so far we have traveled to Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Greece and Serbia.

We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here—what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

Now that we've told you so much about us, it's your turn.

We can’t wait to receive your application! 🌟

You work fast across the Creative and Production phases, taking a brief from concept to on-brand, platform-native execution at a volume that would be impossible by hand. You produce for named enterprise accounts, hold the line on brand, and feed every learning back into the system so each cycle starts sharper than the last.

*About the Flywheel Platform:* Flywheel is our proprietary platform that runs the content supply chain end to end. Our production team operates it, and you design inside it every day. It ingests a brand from a URL or brand book into a structured, prompt-ready profile (palette, tone, audience, visual direction), then lets you brief and generate across multiple models from one workspace. You organize, compare, and approve output in Collections, run an automated brand-fit and brand-safety check with Persona Lens, repair AI artifacts with Pixel Fix, and upscale to final delivery resolution. A production calendar keeps every asset and deadline on track, and one-click export ships shareable review links.

Design across formats: social, motion, static campaign, brand systems, and presentation

Use AI image and video tools to generate, iterate, and atomize concepts at high throughput inside Flywheel

Take generated output the last mile in Adobe: retouching, compositing, type, layout, and finishing to brand standard

Build and maintain prompt libraries, style references, and templates that raise first-pass yield across the team

Hold the line on brand across hundreds of executions for accounts like Nature Fresh Farms and Samsung

Keep work on-brand and platform-native, never generic AI output

Partner with the Creative Director and brand and production leads inside production pods

Feed learnings back into Flywheel so each cycle starts sharper and the system gets smarter

What You Bring

A strong portfolio across digital, social, and brand design

Daily, hands-on command of AI design tools across image, video, and upscaling; you adopt new models fast (our stack includes Luma, Higgsfield, Open Art AI, Superscale, and Topaz)

Deep Adobe Creative Cloud skills: Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and After Effects

A finishing eye that tells a good generation from a finished asset and closes the gap

Comfort with high throughput; you produce volume without dropping quality

Brand discipline to carry a client's visual identity across large execution counts

4+ years of graphic design experience in agency, in-house, or studio settings

Figma fluency

Motion and short-form video editing (After Effects, Premiere, Runway)

Experience building or maintaining design systems and template libraries

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*ABOUT US*

Stio® is an omni-channel mountain brand that designs, develops and sells beautiful, functional, and innovative apparel, footwear and other accessories infused with the soul of the mountain lifestyle. With headquarters in Jackson, Wyoming, Stio draws inspiration from the surrounding Teton Range and offers product via Stio.com, catalog, B2B and its Mountain Studio® retail locations.

We live and love mountain life, and as such see ourselves as caretakers of the resources that provide it. We are proud partners of Protect Our Winters and the Conservation Alliance among many other organizations. We have a strong preferred materials platform, use Bluesign® approved textiles wherever possible, audit our supply chains for best practices, and operate our workplaces responsibly.

We think that outside is the best side and that you can’t improve on nature. It’s good for mind, body and soul, and it’s our responsibility to help enable access for all people, regardless of race, gender, beliefs, background or ability. We strive for inclusion at Stio and in our local and national communities.

*YOUR ROLE*

At Stio, we're on a mission to bring the soul of mountain life into everything we make. We're looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our Creative team and help bring that spirit to life across every touchpoint, from catalog and direct mail to digital campaigns, retail environments, and beyond. In this role, you'll balance high-volume, detail-oriented production with real opportunities for creative exploration, working within Stio's established brand direction while helping shape how it shows up at every turn.

Our ideal candidate thrives on collaboration, brings a sharp eye for detail to every project, and is confident sharing ideas and standing behind their work. They move comfortably between print and digital, handling a catalog layout, a retail display, and an email campaign with equal ease, and bring real energy and curiosity to the process, not just clean execution. This is a role for someone who loves the craft of design as much as the outdoors that inspire it.

*YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES*

* Execute and adapt creative assets across all channels, including digital, retail, print, social, and email
* Dream up and produce standout visuals for seasonal brand and product campaigns, bringing energy and fresh ideas within Stio's established creative direction
* Get hands-on with catalog design and production, building real fluency and shared contribution in the craft
* Elevate retail and wholesale spaces, including displays, signage, and point-of-sale materials, with design that makes Stio's mountain spirit tangible in the real world
* Craft digital campaign assets, from email to social, that feel just as inspired as anything on the printed page
* Hunt down and curate authentic mountain athlete and lifestyle imagery with a discerning eye, making sure every asset feels true to who Stio is
* Champion brand guidelines while still finding room to experiment and push ideas forward
* Maintain rigorous attention to detail and consistent production quality across every deliverable, preparing production-ready artwork that meets technical specs across digital, print, retail, and other workflows
* Build genuine fluency in the "how it's made" side of print design, including prepress and production, growing that competence over time
* Keep multiple projects moving in Asana, staying organized ahead of deadlines
* Team up across Brand, Art, and E-Commerce to bring campaigns to life
* Partner with the Senior Copywriter and Brand marketing to make sure every message and visual feels unified

*YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE*

* 3+ years of relevant experience in graphic design or a related role, preferably at a lifestyle, outdoor, fashion, or sports brand (experience in print or catalog production is a plus)
* Proficient and comfortable in both Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign) and Figma; both are required for this role
* Prepress competence: a solid understanding of print production fundamentals like color management and bleed, along with the technical fluency to get files production-ready across formats
* Proven experience managing work through Asana or comparable project management tools; this is a highly weighted skill for this role
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to multitask across a high volume of concurrent deadlines
* Exceptional attention to detail: in print design, precision is not optional, and accuracy and polish are required at every stage
* A keen eye for curating authentic mountain athlete and lifestyle imagery; strong understanding of apparel product marketing and how visual storytelling supports product sell-through
* Comfortable presenting concepts and defending creative decisions in front of stakeholders, someone who can stand behind their creative choices, not just execute them
* Welcomes feedback and critique with openness and positivity, recognizing that collective input is what makes the work best
* A collaborative, positive, and proactive spirit, someone who brings ideas and energy to the table, not just polished output
* A builder at heart, someone driven to strengthen the team's processes, workflows, and creative approach over time

*THE FINE PRINT*

* Medical, Dental, Vision plans
* Company-paid Long Term Disability
* Employee Assistance Program
* 401k with Match
* Generous paid time off policies
* Company Culture Committee
* Gear test, perks, and more

We provide competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives and benefits. The base salary range for this role is $65,000-$75,000. It would not be typical for someone to be hired at the top end of the range for the role, as actual pay will be determined based on several factors including experience, skills, and qualifications.

This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, we reserve the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed. Stio is an equal opportunity employer of all qualified individuals, including minorities, BIPOC, LGBTQ+, veterans & individuals with disabilities.

This can be spent on self-purchase of health insurance or on doctor’s fees for yourself and close relatives (spouse, children);

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Design Verification
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Engineer - Design Verification based in India.*

This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on verifying next-generation high-speed interconnect IPs and SoCs for demanding AI and HPC systems.
You will define verification strategies and architectures for complex protocols including PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and UCIe.
The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, covering UVM environments, coverage closure, assertions, debugging, and sign-off.
You will work closely with architecture, design, and validation teams across sophisticated silicon development programs.
The position also offers the opportunity to influence reusable verification frameworks and advance verification methodologies.
As a senior contributor, you will mentor engineers while helping establish rigorous engineering standards across projects.
The environment is fast-moving, technically ambitious, and focused on delivering production silicon for the rapidly expanding AI infrastructure market.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Define and execute scalable, comprehensive verification strategies and plans for high-speed PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, and related IP and SoC subsystems.
* Architect and develop reusable, layered UVM testbenches, verification environments, agents, and components for complex protocol verification.
* Apply deep protocol expertise to verify PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL 3.x, Ethernet 200G/400G, and UCIe PHY and Adapter layers against demanding functionality and compliance requirements.
* Drive coverage-driven verification, including functional coverage, assertion-based verification, metrics analysis, coverage closure, and verification sign-off.
* Lead complex debug and root-cause analysis across simulation, emulation, prototyping, and silicon bring-up environments.
* Collaborate closely with design, architecture, validation, and other engineering teams to identify issues early and deliver robust, high-quality IP and SoC solutions.
* Establish verification best practices, methodologies, and reusable frameworks that can support multiple projects and tape-outs.
* Mentor junior and mid-level verification engineers, providing technical guidance and promoting strong verification discipline.
* Explore opportunities to incorporate AI/ML capabilities into verification workflows and improve engineering productivity.
* Contribute to performance, power-aware, hybrid, and other advanced verification initiatives as required.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
* 12+ years of professional experience in design verification, with substantial exposure to complex SoC and IP verification.
* Proven experience defining and implementing verification architectures for high-speed interconnect protocols and sophisticated semiconductor designs.
* Strong hands-on expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, coverage-driven verification, and SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA).
* Deep practical knowledge of PCIe Gen5/Gen6, CXL 3.x, Ethernet 200G/400G, or comparable high-speed protocols.
* Experience verifying UCIe PHY and Adapter layers is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of SoC architecture, IP integration, high-speed interfaces, and verification methodologies.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex debugging and problem-solving activities across simulation and hardware environments.
* Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to influence engineering decisions and establish effective verification practices.
* Excellent communication and mentoring capabilities, with a collaborative and low-ego approach to working with cross-functional teams.
* Experience with emulation, prototyping, or hybrid verification platforms is a plus.
* Exposure to performance verification, power-aware verification, and AI/ML applications within verification workflows is advantageous.
* Experience developing verification frameworks that have been reused across multiple tape-outs is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with additional industry-standard protocols such as DDR, Ethernet, PCIe, CXL, and UCIe is beneficial.

--------
Benefits
--------

* *Remote work:* Remote position available for candidates based in India.
* *Location:* Opportunity to work as part of a growing engineering organization in Bengaluru.
* *Technical impact:* Work on critical chiplet infrastructure and high-speed interconnect technology supporting AI and HPC systems.
* *Ownership:* Significant autonomy to shape verification strategies, methodologies, and technical roadmaps.
* *Innovation:* Opportunity to work on advanced semiconductor challenges at the intersection of chiplets, AI infrastructure, interconnects, and high-speed silicon.
* *Global collaboration:* Work with a distributed, international engineering team.
* *Technical growth:* Exposure to cutting-edge protocols, verification technologies, and emerging AI-assisted engineering workflows.

title: Brand & Marketing Designer
description:
*About RenewCO2*

RenewCO2 makes carbon-negative chemicals and fuels. Our electrocatalytic CO2 utilization technology runs on electricity, water, and waste CO2, and the product drops straight into existing industrial supply chains. Because the process is energy-efficient, our cost structure competes with fossil-derived incumbents rather than relying on a green premium.

We are venture-backed, and we have won grant funding from the U.S. Department of Energy, the National Science Foundation, DARPA, the New Jersey Commission on Science, Innovation and Technology, and Breakthrough Energy, among others. The technology is demonstrated at pilot scale with customers, and we are now building toward commercial scale.

The company started in the United States, where most of our R&D is executed, while product development and manufacturing happen in India.

Our customers are chemical, fuel, and materials producers across Asia, Europe, and North and Latin America. Your work has to hold up for a procurement team in Rotterdam, a process engineer in Houston, and a plant manager in Gujarat, not just one of them.

This role is based in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, at Ohmium International, which builds green hydrogen electrolyzers at a gigafactory there. RenewCO2 has a joint development agreement with Ohmium: working beside a partner that already makes electrochemical stacks at volume shortens our path to manufacturing at scale.

*The role*

You will be the only designer at the company. Everything RenewCO2 puts in front of a customer, a partner, an investor, or a government reviewer passes through you: investor and capability decks, product one-pagers and spec sheets, the website, booths and signage, social assets, technical diagrams, report layouts, and the brand system holding it all together.

The hard part is not production. It is turning engineering reality into something a non-specialist understands and a specialist cannot pick apart. You will take a rough sketch, a CAD screenshot, or an Excel chart from an engineer and produce a figure that is accurate first and beautiful second.

You will also art-direct outside help. We are not building an in-house studio, so you will brief and manage illustrators, 3D artists, videographers, exhibit fabricators, and printers, and hold their work to our standard.

*What you will do*

*Decks and sales collateral*

• Design investor, partner, and capability decks end to end, including the dense technical slides. Those are the hard ones and they matter most.

• Build PowerPoint and Google Slides template systems with working masters, layouts, and theme colors that non-designers cannot easily break.

• Produce one-pagers, spec sheets, technical FAQs, and leave-behinds that fit real content into a fixed page.

*Technical illustration and data visualization*

• Draw process flow diagrams, system schematics, equipment cutaways, and plant layouts from engineering source material, checking accuracy with our technical team.

• Build charts from raw data: cost curves, comparison bars, mass and energy flow diagrams, with correct axes, correct units, and honest scales.

• Prepare figures for conference posters, technical papers, and government reports to the conventions those audiences expect.

*Website*

• Design and build pages in our CMS, and own the updates, with turnaround measured in hours.

• Hold the line on responsive layout, page performance, on-page SEO hygiene, and accessibility to WCAG 2.1 AA including color contrast.

*Brand system*

• Keep and evolve the RenewCO2 brand system: logo use, typography, color, icons, diagram and chart styles, photography direction, document templates.

• Maintain a component and template library, and an asset library organized well enough that other people find things in it.

*Social, campaigns, and events*

• Produce social and campaign assets, mostly for LinkedIn: statics, carousels, short motion pieces, event promotion.

• Design booths, banners, signage, and large-format graphics, and take them through print production and installation by our fabrication vendors.

*Vendor art direction*

• Write the brief, pick the vendor, and manage illustrators, 3D and CGI artists, video crews, exhibit fabricators, and print shops to schedule, budget, and quality.

• Review proofs, renders, and cuts, and give feedback specific enough to act on.

*What we need to see in your portfolio*

We read portfolios closely, and we care more about problem-solving than polish. Include these, and note what you personally did:

• A deck you designed end to end, not a template you filled. Show us the densest technical slide in it.

• A technical illustration you built from an engineer's rough sketch, a CAD screenshot, or a photograph: a process flow diagram, a system schematic, or an equipment cutaway.

• Charts you built yourself from raw data, with a note on where the data came from.

• A one-pager or spec sheet where real technical content, including a table, had to fit a fixed page.

• A website you designed and shipped, with a live link.

• A brand or template system you maintained that other people used correctly without you in the room.

*Required qualifications*

• Four to seven years designing in-house or at an agency, with real work for B2B, industrial, engineering, energy, or scientific clients. Consumer-only and social-only portfolios will not fit.

• Figma at an expert level: components, variants, auto-layout, and shared libraries other people build from.

• Illustrator for vector and technical illustration, InDesign for multi-page and print-ready layout, Photoshop for image work.

• Real mastery of PowerPoint and Google Slides. A large share of what we send out is a deck, and engineers will edit it after you hand it over.

• You can design and build in Webflow, WordPress, or something comparable, and you understand responsive layout, basic HTML and CSS, image optimization, on-page SEO, and WCAG 2.1 AA.

• Print production beyond exporting a PDF: CMYK against RGB, Pantone matching, bleed and safe areas, resolution for large-format booth graphics, packaging files for a printer, and checking a physical proof.

• You have art-directed outside vendors. You wrote the brief, picked the partner, held the schedule and budget, and gave feedback that improved the work.

• You can work with engineers and scientists. You ask the clarifying question, you respect what the data says, and you never make a diagram prettier at the cost of making it wrong.

• Disciplined file management: naming conventions, versioning, one source of truth. Sound handling of unpublished technical material under NDA.

• Strong typography and layout judgment, plus the ability to explain a decision in plain language to people who do not speak design.

• Fluent written and spoken English. Kannada or Hindi helps with local print and fabrication vendors.

*Strongly preferred*

• 3D visualization for equipment, skid, and plant renders in Blender, KeyShot, or SolidWorks Visualize.

• Motion design for short explainers and animated diagrams in After Effects or Rive.

• Familiarity with scientific figure conventions, and experience preparing figures for journals, conference posters, or government technical reports.

• Photography and video on site, in the lab and on the factory floor, including basic lighting and editing.

• Illustration range wide enough to define a visual language rather than borrow one.

• Front-end comfort past HTML and CSS, or experience with design tokens in a code base.

• Time at an early-stage company where you set the standard instead of inheriting it.

*What success looks like in six months*

• A deck and document template system in active use, with fewer off-brand files circulating each month.

• A refreshed website you can update yourself, quickly, without outside help.

• A library of accurate, reusable diagrams and charts that the commercial and technical teams pull from instead of rebuilding.

• A short vendor bench for print, illustration, 3D, and video, with known costs and lead times.

*Location, working pattern, and compensation*

Hybrid: two days a week on site in Chikkaballapur, the rest wherever you work best. A company shuttle runs from Bengaluru, so you do not have to relocate or drive the corridor yourself.

Compensation: ₹12–15 lakh fixed CTC, plus equity and benefits. No travel, though an extra on-site day sometimes comes up around a booth build or a print review.

*What to submit*

• A portfolio link or a PDF under 20 MB covering the six items above. Password-protected is fine, and include the password.

• Annotation on every piece: what you designed, built, or art-directed, and what a team, an agency, or a vendor did. If it is unannotated we will assume the least.

• For two projects, a few lines on the brief, the real constraint you worked against, and one decision you would make differently now.

• A live link to a website you designed, with a note on what you designed against what you built.

• Willingness to open a native file later in the process, whether a Figma library, an Illustrator diagram, an InDesign document, or a PowerPoint template, and walk us through how it is put together. Construction matters as much as output.

Do not send confidential or NDA-covered client work. Redact it or describe it. We will not ask you for unpaid spec work, and any exercise later in the process gets scoped and paid.

*How to apply*

Apply below through our careers page at

https://www.renewco2.com/caree...The application platform collects your CV, work samples, and a few short questions.

RenewCO2 is an equal opportunity employer. We judge candidates on what they have done and what they can do, and we welcome applicants of every background. If you need an accommodation at any stage, tell us and we will arrange it.

title: Senior Staff Engineer - Physical Design
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Engineer - Physical Design based in India.*

This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on end-to-end physical implementation for advanced semiconductor and AI/HPC designs.
You will lead complex block- and full-chip implementation activities from floorplanning through physical signoff and tape-out.
The role has a strong emphasis on achieving demanding power, performance, area, timing, and reliability targets.
You will collaborate closely with RTL, STA, DFT, package, and CAD teams to solve challenging implementation and signoff issues.
The position also offers the opportunity to shape physical design methodologies, automation, and engineering best practices.
You’ll work in a fast-moving, low-bureaucracy environment where deep technical expertise, ownership, and execution are highly valued.
Based in Bengaluru with a remote-friendly setup, this role is suited to an experienced engineer who wants to make a direct impact on next-generation AI infrastructure.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* *Lead physical design implementation:* Own full-chip or block-level physical implementation from floorplanning and power planning through placement, CTS, routing, optimization, physical verification, and GDS signoff.
* *Drive PPA and reliability optimization:* Analyze and optimize timing, congestion, power, IR drop, electromigration, and signal integrity across advanced technology nodes.
* *Manage signoff closure:* Identify and resolve implementation issues and ensure high-quality closure across timing, power, area, and reliability requirements.
* *Collaborate cross-functionally:* Partner with RTL, DFT, STA, package, and CAD teams to address complex implementation, integration, and signoff challenges.
* *Improve physical design methodologies:* Develop and enhance implementation flows, automation scripts, tools, and methodologies to improve engineering efficiency and design quality.
* *Support tape-out:* Contribute to tape-out planning and execution while ensuring implementation milestones and signoff deliverables are completed with minimal schedule impact.
* *Provide technical leadership:* Participate in technical reviews, establish best practices, and proactively identify implementation bottlenecks and risks.
* *Mentor engineers:* Guide junior team members, share technical expertise, and contribute to the development of a strong physical design engineering culture.

title: Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Design Quality Engineer based in India.*

This role provides senior technical leadership in design quality for the development and commercialization of medical devices.
You will apply expertise in design controls, risk management, verification and validation, and quality engineering to support safe and effective products.
The position spans the full product lifecycle, from early concept and design reviews through testing, commercialization, sustaining activities, and design changes.
You will work closely with R&D, Operations, Regulatory, Supplier Quality, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams to solve complex product and quality challenges.
Your expertise will directly influence product safety, regulatory compliance, manufacturing readiness, and customer outcomes.
The role also offers significant opportunities to lead strategic initiatives, mentor quality engineers, and serve as a recognized subject matter expert.
This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced medical-device quality professional who combines technical depth with strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Provide technical leadership for Design Quality Engineering activities throughout the medical device product lifecycle, from concept and development through commercialization and sustaining operations.
* Represent the Quality function on product and process development teams, ensuring quality requirements are integrated effectively into development activities.
* Ensure design control requirements are appropriately implemented, including design verification, validation, specifications, procedures, risk management, design reviews, design changes, and Design History File activities.
* Serve as an independent reviewer during design reviews and conduct Design History File audits when required.
* Own or approve one or more processes within the Design Quality Engineering scope and promote consistent application of quality methodologies.
* Lead or support supplier quality activities, including supplier selection, specification reviews, new tooling qualification, inspection planning, and PPAP review or leadership.
* Work with engineering teams to define quality characteristics and inspection plans for components, subassemblies, and finished medical devices.
* Lead investigations into complex product problems, identify root causes, and manage corrective actions arising from investigations.
* Evaluate and disposition nonconforming materials and products used in pilot and clinical builds.
* Conduct or support health risk assessments related to Health Hazard Evaluations, reporting, and potential product recalls.
* Participate in design reviews and provide quality input on alternative design solutions, product architecture, and manufacturability.
* Contribute hands-on during early product development activities, including physician interactions, product engineering, competitive product testing, and prototype testing.
* Review and provide input to material specifications, drawings, inspection procedures, manufacturing procedures, and other design and manufacturing documentation.
* Approve deviations and design changes, conduct impact assessments, and define or approve appropriate implementation plans.
* Develop and support master test plans covering design verification, design validation, process validation, traceability, and related quality activities.
* Create, evaluate, and validate product and process test methods and review test protocols and reports to ensure regulatory and quality objectives are met.
* Define and maintain risk-management strategies throughout the product lifecycle, including Risk Management Plans, Risk Management Files, and benefit-risk evaluations.
* Lead risk-management activities using FMEA, Hazard Analysis, and other appropriate tools, ensuring risks are effectively identified, controlled, monitored, and incorporated into design improvements.
* Lead strategic quality initiatives and, where appropriate, manage cross-functional teams responsible for delivering improvement plans.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement across Quality, Engineering, Manufacturing, and other functions, strengthening design controls, risk management, and quality practices.
* Maintain knowledge of applicable FDA and international regulatory requirements and support implementation of updated standards and procedures.
* Represent the Quality function during regulatory, notified-body, internal, and other audits as required.
* Serve as a technical mentor to Quality Engineers and other team members, providing guidance on complex quality engineering topics and methodologies.
* Act as a recognized subject matter expert in one or more Design Quality Engineering domains across the organization.
* Apply statistical knowledge to analyze technical data, evaluate results, and provide evidence-based recommendations.
* Perform other quality engineering and technical responsibilities as assigned.

-------------
Requirements:
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline with *10+ years of Quality Engineering experience in the medical device industry* , or a Master’s degree with *8+ years of relevant experience*.
* Experience in related engineering areas such as R&D or Manufacturing may be considered when responsibilities include substantial medical device quality engineering work.
* Extensive hands-on experience with medical device product development from concept through commercialization and/or leading design changes, product improvements, remediation, or sustaining initiatives.
* Advanced working knowledge of FDA QMS requirements, including *21 CFR Part 820* , as well as *ISO 13485* and *EU MDR*.
* Strong knowledge of medical device design controls, verification and validation principles, and risk management requirements under *ISO 14971*.
* Demonstrated experience using risk-management tools such as FMEA and Hazard Analysis and integrating risk activities throughout product realization.
* Proven experience with Change Control, Non-conformance, Deviations, Complaints, Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs), CAPAs, and related quality processes.
* Strong understanding of quality engineering methodologies, statistical analysis, data interpretation, and evidence-based decision-making.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams in a medical device product development environment.
* Strong ability to influence and negotiate without direct authority across Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Clinical, Supplier Quality, and senior leadership teams.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation, verbal communication, organizational, and project management skills.
* Ability to read, interpret, and communicate highly technical material effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, combined with exceptional attention to detail.
* Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint; advanced proficiency is preferred.
* Strong self-motivation, accountability, teamwork, and ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional environment.
* Knowledge of *IEC 62304* is preferred.
* Familiarity with one or more of *ISO 10993, IEC 62366, ISO 11607, ISO 11137, or ISO 11135* is preferred.
* Experience in women’s health, fertility, or related medical device applications is a plus.
* Ability to interface confidently with senior leadership, external stakeholders, regulatory bodies, and other key partners.

---------
Benefits:
---------

* *Remote work:* Remote position based in India, with the role associated with the Gurgaon, Haryana location.
* *Senior technical ownership:* Opportunity to serve as a recognized Design Quality Engineering subject matter expert.
* *Professional growth:* Significant exposure to advanced medical device quality, regulatory, risk management, verification, validation, and design-control practices.
* *Leadership opportunities:* Ability to mentor Quality Engineers and lead cross-functional teams and strategic quality initiatives.
* *Cross-functional exposure:* Collaborate with R&D, Operations, Regulatory, Clinical, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, and senior leadership teams.
* *Product lifecycle exposure:* Work across concept development, product testing, commercialization, sustaining engineering, remediation, and design changes.
* *Meaningful impact:* Direct influence on the safety, effectiveness, quality, and regulatory compliance of medical devices.
* *Continuous improvement:* Opportunities to shape quality methodologies, strengthen design controls, and improve product-development processes.
* *Technical environment:* Exposure to internationally recognized medical device standards, regulatory frameworks, risk-management methodologies, and advanced quality tools.
* *Full-time schedule:* Full-time, day-shift position.
