title: Staff Product Designer, Growth
description:
About the Team

At Miro, design is intrinsic in everything we do. As a business we are on a mission to redefine how great work is done, and as a design team we aim to make that as easy and delightful as possible.

We operate in a fast-paced environment and get to have a direct impact on the millions of users who rely on Miro to collaborate and create the next big thing. As a part of our Product Design team, you will contribute to our design process, culture, and experience principles and set new standards for design quality.

About the Role

Miro is looking for a visionary Staff Product Designer to support the design of Miro's Growth team, including adoption and onboarding experiences. This isn't just about refining workflows; it's about defining the future of how millions of people bring their ideas to life.

As a key leader within the Growth stream, you will lead the design evolution of these experiences, you will help Miro users reach value quickly through experiments you can ship and measure. We are looking for an AI Native designer - someone who doesn't just see AI as a feature but as a fundamental shift in the product development process and ultimately, a massive opportunity.

You will be tasked with shaping not just where Miro's offering should be, but where it is going - ensuring we aren't just keeping pace with the market, but setting it.

What you’ll do

- Own design across activation, feature discovery, engagement, habit formation, and expansion — not just onboarding.

- Identify where in that journey the biggest opportunity sits, and you make the case for pursuing it.

- Be a tireless innovator in the AI space. You will explore how generative AI can collapse the gap between a user's first visit and a genuine "aha" moment, personalizing activation and engagement at scale.

- Approach the product with an entrepreneurial spirit and sense of ownership. You'll navigate ambiguity, build lean experiments, and treat the growth experience as your own startup within Miro.

- Leverage your deep understanding of the competitive landscape to create a best-in-class experience that rivals any competitor while maintaining Miro's ease of use across the platform.

- Partner with Product and Engineering across the org to solve complex technical- and design challenges around AI quality, discoverability, and the seamless journey from a user's first sign-up to deep, habitual engagement with the infinite canvas.

- Set the bar for design excellence at Miro, mentoring other designers and contributing to the evolution of our design systems and internal tooling.

What you’ll need

- 10+ years of product design experience, ideally in B2B SaaS or AI-focused roles.

- At least 2-3 years operating at a Staff / Principal level, with proven ownership of complex initiatives.

- A strong portfolio showcasing your ability to create clear, user-focused products and strategies. Demonstrating both the impact on user experience and business goals.

- A deep understanding of AI and AI design tooling and the ability to show you're leading the charge.

- Proven experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, UX design, and engineering, to deliver seamless growth solutions.

- Deep understanding of UX practices, information architecture, and user-centred design methodologies.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate the value of design and collaborate effectively across diverse teams.

- A proactive and flexible approach, comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment and managing multiple priorities.

- Experience working on growth, lifecycle, or onboarding-focused design tools and experimentation platforms is a massive plus.

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board. https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVG8Fi8Yc=/?moveToWidget=3458764661021134968&cot=10

title: Senior Solution Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake are looking for a Senior Solution Engineer for the UK market who can solve our customer’s most complex problems. In this role you will work directly with the account sales team and channel partners to understand the needs of our customers, strategize on how to best support them in their evaluation and ultimately help our customers choose Snowflake as their solution.

As a Snowflake Solution Engineer you share our passion for solving complex data challenges and helping organizations to get the most out of their data assets. Our technical landscape is ever evolving and you are keen to learn new skills and put them into practice on real world challenges. You are able to translate features and functions into solutions that solve business problems, in conversations with technical or business teams, with end users or executives.

IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL GET TO:

- Present Snowflake’s technology and vision to executives and technical contributors at prospects and customers

- Work hands-on with prospects and customers to demonstrate and communicate the value of Snowflake technology throughout the sales cycle, from demo to proof of concept to design and implementation

- Create and develop technical champions in your accounts to drive deals and achieve a technical win

- Be at the cutting edge of Snowflake technology and confidently present Snowflake roadmap features and functionality to customers and/or prospects

- Immerse and enable yourself in the ever-evolving industry, maintaining a deep understanding of competitive and complementary technologies and vendors and how to position Snowflake in relation to them

- Work closely with other sales engineers to make each other the best and constantly learn from wins and losses

- Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to continuously improve Snowflake’s products and marketing

- Represent Snowflake at industry or customer events

- Work with our ecosystem and implementation partners to build joint architectures or collaborate on account strategies and initiatives to help our customers be successful

- Proactively contribute and help co-develop Account & territory plans and execute while engaging with the broader internal/external ecosystem.

ON DAY ONE YOU WE WILL EXPECT YOU TO HAVE:

- Solution engineering/solution architect experience in a Saas environment or relevant industry experience (analytics, data science, data engineering etc)

- Outstanding presentation skills to both technical and executive audiences, whether impromptu on a whiteboard or using presentations and demos

- Understanding of and experience with data architecture, data analytics and cloud technology

- Hands on experience with SQL

- Ability to solve customer specific business problems and apply Snowflake’s solutions

- Customer-facing skills to effectively communicate our vision to a wide variety of technical and executive audiences both written and verbal

PREFERRED (BUT NOT REQUIRED) TO HAVE:

- Experience in FSI

- Hands on experience with Python

- Experience working with modern data technology (e.g. dbt, spark, containers, devops tooling, orchestration tools, git, etc.)

- Experience with AI, data science and machine learning technologies

People want to buy from people who understand them. Our Solution Engineers build connections, relationships and trust with our customers that last. We love to learn, are open to giving and receiving feedback and are passionate about making our customers and each other successful.

Think you have what it takes but not sure that you tick every box above? Apply anyways! We value the broad range of experience our teams bring to the table and believe our customers are more successful because of it.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION

Lead the strategy, development, and execution of key product initiatives that drive customer value and support business objectives. Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver impactful product solutions, ensuring alignment with market needs and company goals.

KEY ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

- Develop and execute product strategies and roadmaps for assigned product lines or platforms.

- Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and go-to-market teams to define and launch new features or products.

- Engage with customers, sales, and customer success teams to gather feedback, validate concepts, and ensure value delivery.

- Analyze market trends, competitive landscape, and usage data to inform prioritization and product evolution.

- Lead cross-functional initiatives, managing dependencies, risks, and communication across teams.

- Mentor other product managers and contribute to organizational frameworks, tools, and practices.

- Define success metrics and ensure product outcomes are measurable and aligned to strategic objectives.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 8–10 years of experience in product management, including ownership of major product lines or features

- Strong background in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise technology products

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred

- Proven success in developing and scaling products in cross-functional environments

- Strong analytical, leadership, and communication skills

- Experience with Agile methodologies, product lifecycle tools, and data-driven decision-making

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Opportunity to work with some of the smartest minds to solve complex challenges at scale.

- Impactful role in shaping and securing a global, cloud-native & AI driven platform.

- Innovative, collaborative, and fast-paced culture.

ABOUT TEKION

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform. It includes Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises, and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform, using cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to bring together OEMs, retailers, dealers, and customers. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia, and Europe.

About the Role

We're hiring a Lead Product Manager to own our Computer Vision and Video platform within Service Products. You'll set the product strategy for how vision and video capabilities get built into the Service experience, manage a small team, and coordinate with engineering across time zones.

We're looking for someone with strong product fundamentals who has shipped AI-native product before: you owned what the AI should do, not just where to bolt it onto someone else's roadmap. We also want someone who's actually managed people, with reviews, growth plans, and accountability for what their team delivers.

What You'll Own

* The Computer Vision and Video platform roadmap: what ships, in what order, and why

* AI-native product decisions within that scope, including when a model should inform a decision, act on its own, or route to a human

* A team of at least 2 direct reports

* Coordination across time zones between US-based product and distributed engineering teams

Duties & Responsibilities

Own Product Strategy & Outcomes

Set the vision for computer vision and video capabilities inside Service Products, and stay accountable for the outcomes, not just the launch dates.

Drive Business Impact

Tie your roadmap to numbers that matter: adoption, accuracy, time saved, revenue impact.

Customer-Centric Product Development

Get in front of the people using this product. Video and computer vision features get tested by service bay lighting and technicians in a hurry, and that's where you'll learn what actually works.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Work daily with engineering on model architecture tradeoffs, with design on how vision output gets surfaced to a technician mid-repair, and with data science on what accuracy threshold is actually good enough for this use case.

Platform & Scale Thinking

Design so other teams can build on top of what you ship. This role is about a platform that scales across dealership sizes and use cases, not a single feature.

Mentorship & Product Excellence

Manage your direct reports with the seriousness the job deserves, and set the standard for how AI-native product gets built on your team.

Execution With Velocity

Ship and iterate quickly. Platform ambition is not an excuse to move slowly.

Qualifications

* 8+ years of Product Management experience owning customer-facing SaaS products, with strong command of the fundamentals: discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, post-launch iteration

* Experience shipping AI-native product where you owned the decision of what the AI does and why

* Direct experience in Computer Vision and Video platform product work. Tell us what you shipped, what the model did, and what happened when it was wrong

* 2+ years managing a team of at least 2 direct reports, including performance management and growth planning

* Experience coordinating work across time zones with distributed or offshore engineering teams

* Strong systems design and product architecture skills, with the ability to design scalable, extensible technical solutions

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence engineering, design, and data science without formal authority over them

* Experience building systems and processes that scale, beyond individual feature delivery

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in automotive retail, dealership operations, or Fixed Ops/Service workflows

* Experience with model deployment, MLOps, or production monitoring for vision/video models

* Familiarity with responsible AI principles, model explainability, and failure-mode design for computer vision systems

* Advanced degree (MBA or Engineering) from a top-tier institution

A quick note: if you've read this carefully, mention the phrase "JiraHunters" in your interview. It's our team's internal name, and it's how we know you actually read the job description.

title: Account Executive, Mid Market
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

ABOUT ZAPIER

We’re on a mission to make automation work for everyone.

As the leader in easy automation, Zapier empowers businesses to automate workflows and move data across 7,000+ apps. We work with what you work with, across your apps and tech stack, so you can make magic happen.

We’re at an interesting inflection point at Zapier. Automation and AI are reshaping how businesses operate, and we’re right in the middle of it. We’re looking for someone who wants to help drive that innovation, not just someone who wants to hit a number.

The role: you’ll be selling Zapier’s AI Orchestration platform to companies with up to 1,000 employees, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close.

Most of your pipeline will come from you. Cold outreach, turning a warm signal into a real conversation, finding the deal before it finds you, that's the job, and we need people who are built for that part, not just willing to do it.

Zapier's Mid-Market motion is early. We need architects, not order-takers. You won't inherit a playbook. You'll help write it

There's more than one path to this role

Likely you’ve been a top performer in SaaS sales (or consistently exceeding in mid-market, and you’re ready to step up) and can run a deal end-to-end, including prospecting. However, if you have a track record of tackling hard problems, hands-on experience with AI tools (not just familiarity), put customers first, and have a drive to make things happen you may also be a great fit for our team.

Either way, what separates a good candidate from a great one is proactive ownership, the ability to navigate ambiguity, strong stakeholder communication, cross-functional collaboration, and a genuine hunger to learn fast.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- You have 2-5 years of demonstrated success in selling horizontal SaaS solutions to multi-stakeholder or technical organizations across the mid-market levels, with a strong focus on automation, integrations, and enhancing tech stack efficiency.

- Proven track record of success in closing software deals over and meeting or exceeding your sales quota

- Strong understanding of APIs, integrations, and tools like Zapier, with the ability to explain their importance in modern tech ecosystems.

- Demonstrated ability to discuss IT concerns, including security, scalability, compliance, and performance, in a credible and knowledgeable manner.

- Excellent communication skills both with customers and within an organization

- Ability to develop and navigate senior-level relationships quickly and effectively

- You thrive in a state of ambiguity and are motivated by strong personal drive

- You use AI in your work today, not occasionally, but as part of how you operate at a high level. You can point to workflows you’ve built, how your approach has evolved through iteration, and the impact on quality, efficiency, and experience while intentionally  applying AI for the right outcomes, setting a high bar for outputs, and taking ownership of what ships.

AI Fluency Assessment https://ai-fluency-hub.vercel.app/

- Take our 10 minute AI Fluency Assessment by clicking the link above. See how your skills stack up against our sales bar, get a personalized tier, and walk away with actionable next steps to level up your AI skills.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own mid-market accounts end-to-end: prospecting, discovery, negotiation, close, and expansion

- Sell Zapier’s AI-powered automation platform to enterprises moving from manual workflows to orchestrated, AI-first operations

- Show up in the field: build relationships at events, conferences, and executive briefings that go deeper than a LinkedIn connection

- Build relationships across the org from the people doing the work up to the C-suite

- Lead conversations that help customers think through the real business impact of automation, not just the product features

- Quarterback complex deals across Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Product. You’re accountable for the outcome, not just your piece

- Help shape how we go to market at the mid-market level; the team is small, fast, and building the motion from scratch

WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY

This section exists to save everyone time.

- You’re coming from a large enterprise org and need a defined territory, established SDR/BDR support, and fully built enablement to be successful

- You measure success by activity volume over deal quality

- You want to avoid ambiguity and prefer a structured, repeatable process handed to you

- You can demo a product’s features, but can’t frame the ROI or build a business case from a customer’s pain

- AI is something you’ll “get around to” rather than something you’re already using

WHY JOIN NOW

Zapier is profitable, has been around long enough to know what we’re doing, and is growing into a bigger opportunity in AI and automation. You’ll do real work where your contributions are visible and your impact is measurable. Our team is deeply curious and always looking for innovative ways to meet and exceed our customers' needs.

If breaking into AI is something you’re thinking about, there are very few companies where you’ll build with it the way you will here. We’ll take you from capable to transformative—and that’s increasingly a career-defining skill set.

We are a remote-first company. We believe the people who win in AI and automation aren’t just product experts; they synthesize information, build business cases, and move faster than the competition.

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Manager, GTM Analytics
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job Posted: 08/26

Location: Americas (North, Central and South America)

Hi there!

Zapier is hiring a Manager, Analytics & Strategy to lead our newly formed GTM Analytics team. This team is the central analytics home for Marketing, Sales, RevOps, and Customer Ops, with a mandate to deliver trusted GTM insights, improve the quality and speed of decision-making, and turn repeated questions into durable self-service analytics assets.

You will manage a team of embedded analysts supporting Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops. Your team will own the day-to-day analytics interface for GTM leaders: funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales and support analytics, forecasting inputs, recurring business reviews, dashboarding, metric definitions, and urgent executive questions.

This is a hands-on analytics leadership role. we're looking for someone who has deep analytics judgment, strong SQL skills, and real GTM domain expertise. You might come from a sales analytics, marketing analytics, revenue analytics, finance, or investment banking environment. The common thread is that you know how to operate with urgency, precision, and a high quality bar, and you are energized by analytics work: scoping ambiguous business questions, pressure-testing numbers, coaching people through complex GTM data questions, and delivering clear recommendations under time pressure.

This is not a pure people-management role. You should be able to lean into advanced analytics, understand core statistical concepts, and guide work on experimentation, forecasting, or segmentation when the work calls for it, but the center of gravity is analytics leadership: trusted reporting, business partnership, analytical QA, stakeholder management, and building a faster, more consistent operating model for GTM data. You should also be AI-native in how you work and excited to make this team a proving ground for self-service analytics, analyst automation, and governed AI-assisted data workflows.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on analytics manager. You have 6+ years of experience in analytics, finance, revenue operations, marketing analytics, sales analytics, business operations, investment banking, or a related field. You have managed analysts or analytics-adjacent teams for at least 1 year, but you are still comfortable rolling up your sleeves to review SQL, inspect a dashboard, pressure-test assumptions, and help frame the answer.

You have strong GTM analytics expertise. You understand how marketing, sales, customer operations, and revenue motions fit together. You have worked with funnels, pipeline, bookings or ARR, campaign performance, sales productivity, support performance, forecasting, attribution, segmentation, or lifecycle analytics. You know how to translate GTM questions into metrics, cuts, cohorts, and recommendations that leaders can act on.

You are excellent with SQL and analytical reasoning. You read and write SQL, reason about grain and joins, identify data quality issues, and coach analysts toward cleaner, more reliable methods. You are comfortable with statistics and advanced analytics concepts such as confidence intervals, incrementality, cohorting, regression, forecasting, and experiment readouts, and you know when to partner with Data Science for heavier modeling work.

You bring finance-grade rigor and urgency. You can operate in a fast-twitch environment where leaders need clear answers quickly. You know how to separate what must be directionally right today from what needs a deeper follow-up, and you keep quality high even when timelines are short. Experience in investment banking, finance, FP&A, revenue analytics, or another high-intensity analytical environment is a strong plus.

You set a high bar for quality, trust, and communication. You know that GTM analytics only works when stakeholders trust the numbers. You build review mechanisms, documentation habits, and QA standards that make dashboards and analyses easier to trust. You can explain caveats without hiding behind them, and you help teams align on source-of-truth metrics across Data, Finance, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Ops.

You are an excellent manager and coach. You raise the performance of analysts through clear expectations, thoughtful feedback, technical coaching, and strong prioritization. You know how to help analysts grow and coach them through ambiguous requests and work that should be automated or moved into self-service.

You are AI-native and automation-minded. You actively use modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, QA SQL, summarize stakeholder context, produce documentation, and prototype workflows. You are excited to make AI central to the team's operating model, and to turn repeated analyst workflows into governed self-service assets, AI primitives, reusable dashboards, or model improvements.

You can manage across analysts and data engineers. You understand the difference between stakeholder-facing analytics and data foundation work, and you help both groups work together effectively.

THINGS YOU'LL DO

- Lead the Analytics & Strategy team, managing analysts embedded with Marketing, Sales, and Support/Customer Ops.

- Build a fast, trusted operating model for intake, prioritization, QA, stakeholder communication, and recurring business reviews.

- Coach analysts to deliver high-quality work across funnel reporting, campaign performance, sales analytics, support analytics, forecasting, segmentation, attribution, and executive readouts.

- Partner with GTM leaders to clarify ambiguous questions, identify the decisions at stake, and make sure the team's work leads to concrete business action.

- Review SQL, dashboards, metric definitions, data caveats, and analytical narratives so the team can move quickly without lowering the quality bar.

- Make the team the intake point for self-service and AI automation opportunities: recognize duplicate asks, separate one-off requests from repeatable workflows, and turn recurring patterns into AI primitives, governed dashboards, metric documentation, and model improvement requests that build the robot over time.

- Bring advanced analytics judgment to experimentation, incrementality, cohort analysis, forecasting, segmentation, and statistical readouts, while partnering with Data Science for deeper modeling needs.

- Leverage AI tools in your own workflow and your team's workflows, helping the team move faster while maintaining accuracy, documentation, and governance.

- Develop analysts through clear expectations, direct feedback, growth paths, and a strong peer learning culture.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

title: Course Writer and Editor: UX, UI, and AI
description:
Headquarters: Denmark

URL: https://ixdf.org/about/careers

You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it. You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand.

Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world.

A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman, as well as Design Leads at Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education
IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us take online education to new heights and make a meaningful impact on humankind.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team
We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

-
Our Course Writers and Editors: lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective. This is the role described here.

-
Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI: lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.

-
Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI: lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our Education Designers.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

You, the Course Writer and Editor, own how our courses and Master Classes read: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish. Our Education Designers hand you the structure and the exercises, and they'll often hand you draft headings and hooks along with them. The final wording is yours. You'll work closely with our Co-Founder, your Team Lead, the Education Designers, and the Course Directors, and you'll have a real say in what we make. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

Your Role at IxDF

-
Be a core part of our Editorial Team. You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create educational content for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with skills in timeless, human-centered design and AI.

-
Make an impact as you decide how every course sounds. The title people want to click, the first paragraph that hooks them, the on-screen words that make our learners remember and apply what our experts teach. Our Education Designers create the structure and draft the headings, hooks, and quizzes. You finalize the scripts, hooks, headings, quiz wording, and editorial voice across everything we publish, and you give proactive feedback on the structure.

-
You don't need a design background. Most of our writers and editors start without one, and that can be an advantage because you're coming to design the way many of our learners do. In your first year you'll learn it from the inside, working through it sentence by sentence with the people who teach it, until you know what a course participant needs.

-
Write for a diverse, global audience. Some of our courses and Master Classes serve experienced designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields, and many are not reading in their first language. Often, you'll write for all of them at the same time. Getting that balance right without watering anything down is a rewarding editorial challenge.

-
Be the voice of IxDF. Our reputation lives in every sentence we publish, and many of those sentences will be yours. Represent a global movement dedicated to design education, and take pride in it. It's a big responsibility, and a rewarding one.

-
Set and raise the standard for our assessments, so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests. Our Education Designers decide what a question has to test. You write the wording that does both.

-
Balance the big picture with the smaller details. Expect to focus on one large course creation project per month, alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published. You'll also write and edit articles, course descriptions, and supporting material, and help our Growth team and our two founders get the voice right in campaigns and social copy.

-
Turn expert material into lessons. Once you've built an understanding of design, you'll take a one-hour Master Class transcript and the learning goals for what the lesson must teach, then turn the strongest sections into a finished lesson. We produce 3 Master Classes per month, so new expert material arrives continuously.

-
Our courses combine written and video lessons. You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from.

-
Find room for improvement by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios learners produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Small, incremental edits are why our material surpasses even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do.

-
We’re committed to excellence, and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role is not for the average. Ahead of you is a highly rewarding and enriching journey.

-
Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

-
You won't do this alone. You'll work with our Education Designers, Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the material: you'll add what's missing, delete what's redundant, and suggest how to improve the structure. You'll be working with people who have anything from 4 to 40 years of design experience, ready to share their knowledge. We'll also help you upskill so you can grow a designer's eye alongside your editor's ear. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll develop personally and professionally.

-
We're proud to have assembled a remarkable team of unicorns who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

Do You Share IxDF's Vision?
People don't just buy our courses; they invest in a better version of themselves and a career they truly love. That's why every course we create and every sentence we write must do more than just inform. It must reflect the high-quality research and hands-on skills we teach.

-
Show the dream outcome: Help people imagine a future of creative, meaningful work, fulfillment, and impact through a career in design and AI.

-
Strengthen belief in success: Build confidence through real stories, practical case studies, and hands-on templates.

-
Overcome barriers: Write in a way that's crystal clear, human, and motivating. Connect and lead the way.

You'll educate, inspire, energize, and support. Whether you write a course article or give editorial feedback on a video, you'll help designers thrive in the age of AI.

About You

-
You have at least 4 years of professional writing or editing experience.

-
What matters far more than the number is the quality of the work you can show us: a course, an article series, a set of scripts, documentation, a newsletter. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you wrote it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

-
You're a master communicator with a sharp eye for detail and strong skills in language, tone, and flow.

-
You can take a complex idea and write it so a beginner gets it on the first read.

-
You know how to hook someone with a title and a first line, and you know the difference between a hook that's earned and a hook that's cheap.

-
You collaborate with AI in everything you do. You use AI to write, research, and create faster, and you know how to take human leadership, so the outcome is 100% yours and better than you could have created without AI.

-
You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

-
You can write for a career changer and for an experienced designer without losing either one.

-
You have an exceptional talent for creating structure, and you take pride in organizing processes and tasks in a way that's efficient and clear.

-
You're genuinely curious about UX and UI design, and you're motivated to learn how great design shapes experiences and solves problems.

-
You're genuinely curious about how AI is changing design work and design education, and you look for new ways to use it in your own work.

-
You're kind, and you have the social intelligence and empathy to engage well with very different kinds of people.

-
You're fluent in written and spoken English, your grammar is exact, and you understand the power of tone, brevity, and microcopy.

-
You take full ownership of your work and see it through. You move comfortably across ad hoc projects of varying complexity, and you stay consistent when the work turns repetitive.

-
You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills.

-
You spot problems before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

-
You value teamwork, prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals and harmony in the workplace.

-
You work well with great responsibility and freedom inside a well-documented, structured system. Accuracy and attention to detail are key on an online learning platform, where every tag must be correct and every piece of text formatted to our upload system. It's in your nature to meticulously double-check that everything is in order.

-
You're self-motivated, and you love creative freedom, independent judgment, and the responsibility that comes with both.

-
You’re driven by the desire to make a positive impact in the world and to improve the lives of others.

-
You're located in a time zone between UTC+0 (London) and UTC+4 (Dubai), which covers Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Bonus Points
None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

-
You've taught in classrooms or workshops, or you've created educational material.

-
You have your own blog or social media page where you create and share original content.

-
You’ve collaborated with video production teams.

-
You've written quiz or assessment questions.

-
You've worked with an LMS or an online learning platform.

-
You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in communications, journalism, literature, or a similar field.

What We Can Offer

-
A highly valued role: You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

-
Reach and impact that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. Your words will be read year after year, by hundreds of thousands of people who build better careers and design a better world for all of us. An education you can't buy: free access to every IxDF course and Master Class, and a job that requires you to study the work of the best designers alive in order to edit it. Most people pay for this. You'll be paid for it.

-
Access: the designers whose books you'd normally buy are the people whose words you'll be shaping, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with.

-
Studio shoots: once you know our courses well, usually after your first year, you'll be a real asset on a studio production, and you'll be welcome to join us when we meet our experts in professional studios around the world. Some of us love that part and go every time; others keep travel to a minimum. Both work for us. On average we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.

-
Autonomy: Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses read.

-
A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotely alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by a common mission to create the best possible design and AI education in the world and make it accessible for everyone.

-
Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

-
A full-time position within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or a studio production.

-
Bi-weekly knowledge-sharing sessions and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

-
A work culture with no fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama. Your colleagues value your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

-
A daily mission to help impact, empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people by creating affordable high-end design education for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

-
A company where the distance between idea and execution is minimal. We're a highly agile organization with zero bureaucracy or corporate politics – and with exceptional order and efficiency.

-
A company culture where passion meets high performance and excellence. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process, you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline.

-
We thrive because we have a hands-on attitude and a bias towards action as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll need crisp execution skills yourself and the ability to impress your colleagues with concrete results, just like they'll impress you.

-
If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, you’re in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then you’ll find virtually limitless opportunities with us.

-
We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at the forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it. You'll help set a direction that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

How to Learn More and Apply

To submit your application as well as learn more about our Work Culture and Values, please visit https://ixdf.org/about/careers

Please apply as soon as you can. We’re firm believers in “the sooner, the better” and we look forward to working with you!

title: Product Design Intern
description:
*About Sezzle:*

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a talented and motivated *Product Design Intern* who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ and. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. Also someone who’s excited to learn, experiment, and help shape the future of Sezzle’s web and mobile experiences. If you love crafting intuitive interfaces, have an eye for motion and micro-interactions, and are curious about where AI meets design, you’ll fit right in. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to ship thoughtful, user-centric work that makes people’s lives easier.

*What You'll Do:*

* Partner with product managers and engineers to design user-friendly features across Sezzle’s platforms
* Create wireframes, visual designs, prototypes, and interaction flows that balance clarity, aesthetics, and usability
* Contribute to our design system by building and documenting reusable components in Figma
* Ensure consistency of design & UI patterns, language, and branding elements across all product components
* Participate in user research and testing to inform and refine your work
* Present design work and rationale to design team and stakeholders while gathering feedback to iterate and polish your solutions
* Explore illustration, motion design, and micro-interactions to elevate the experience

*What We Look For:*

* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, or a related field
* Some hands-on experience in UI/UX or product design for digital products (through internships, coursework, freelance, or personal projects)
* Strong communication skills in English
* Proficiency in Figma for interface design and prototyping
* Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
* Familiarity with modern product design trends and basic design principles

* *Experience:* Some prior exposure to designing for web or mobile (internships, freelance, coursework, or personal projects count)
* *Craft & Tools:* Strong Figma skills for interface design and prototyping; curiosity about testing and validating with users
* *User Focus:* Passion for building accessible, inclusive experiences
* *Design Systems:* Understanding of scalable UI systems, from color and typography tokens to components
* *Component Management:* Experience creating and updating UI components in Figma
* *Adaptability:* Comfortable juggling multiple projects and deadline while maintaining quality
* *Collaboration:* Clear communicator and team player who’s open to feedback
* Technical Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS/React is a plus, not a requirement

* *Portfolio Requirements:*

* Please include a link to an online portfolio or PDF that showcases:

* 3-4 of your best digital design projects
* Clear explanation of problem and project requirements
* Your design process

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with animation or motion tools (After Effects, Lottie, Rive)
* Interest in designing interactive components and motion-enhanced micro-interactions
* Curiosity about how AI can support and accelerate the design process

*About You:*

* *You have relentlessly high standards* - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* *You’re not bound by convention* - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* *You need action* - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* *You earn trust* - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* *You have backbone; disagree, then commit* - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* *You deliver results* - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

*What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:*

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

*Compensation* : The salary for the *Product Design* Intern is $800 USD monthly gross.

title: Junior Software Quality Assurance Engineer (QA + Bug Fixes) USD
description:
Job Description

*Junior Software Quality Assurance Engineer (QA + Bug Fixes)*
*Full-Time | $7 USD/hour*

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Software Quality Assurance Engineer whose primary responsibility is to find bugs before our customers do. You will spend most of your time testing new features, attempting to break workflows, identifying edge cases, documenting issues, and validating fixes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys investigating problems, thinking critically, and improving software quality. While the majority of the role is quality assurance, candidates with basic development skills will have opportunities to implement minor fixes and grow into a larger engineering role over time.

Responsibilities

*Quality Assurance (80–90%)*

* Test new software releases and existing features.
* Intentionally attempt to break workflows and uncover bugs.
* Perform regression testing before releases.
* Create detailed bug reports with reproduction steps, screenshots, and videos.
* Verify that reported bugs have been fixed correctly.
* Test software across different devices, browsers, and user scenarios.
* Identify usability issues and recommend improvements.
* Investigate customer-reported issues and reproduce them.

*Development Support (10–20%)*

* Implement minor frontend and backend bug fixes.
* Update UI elements, validation rules, and small workflows.
* Assist developers with testing and deployment verification.
* Help maintain testing documentation and quality standards.

Requirements

* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written English communication skills.
* Ability to think through edge cases and unusual user behavior.
* Basic understanding of web applications and SaaS products.
* Familiarity with browser developer tools.
* Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Git.
* Ability to work independently during overnight U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior QA or software testing experience.
* Experience writing bug reports.
* Familiarity with React, Node.js, or TypeScript.
* Experience using project management tools such as Jira, Trello, or ClickUp.

What Success Looks Like

* Bugs are identified before customers encounter them.
* Bug reports are clear, actionable, and reproducible.
* Releases are thoroughly tested and stable.
* Customer-reported issues are quickly reproduced and verified.
* Product quality continuously improves over time.

title: Junior Growth Manager
description:
--------------
About the role
--------------

The Junior Growth Manager role will report directly to a Growth Manager. This is a role that works closely with our clients, as well as our internal team — giving this individual real ownership over the day-to-day running of client accounts and relationships.

On a day-to-day basis, you'd be responsible for keeping accounts organized and on track: coordinating across teams, managing deadlines, communicating with clients, and building the systems and processes that make everyone around you more effective.

We're a small, growing team. As Pearmill scales — winning more sophisticated clients, expanding our tools, and taking on more ambitious work — our Growth Managers need a strong operational partner to run alongside them. That's this role. Your responsibilities will grow with the company, and you'll have a real impact on the business from day one.

💡 *A note on AI at Pearmill*

AI isn't bolted onto our work or sold as a shortcut — it's embedded in how we think, test, and build. We use agentic workflows to handle repeatable work across media, creative, and reporting. The right person for this role doesn't just use AI tools — they're genuinely excited by them, curious enough to tinker, and confident enough to build with them.

--------------------------------
3 awesome things about this role
--------------------------------

*

*The freedom to make the role your own!* There's no rigid playbook here. You'll have real latitude to build systems, automate the repetitive stuff, and shape what great client operations look like at an AI-native agency.

*

*Working across a variety of accounts with interesting people* — both the clients and our colleagues. Every account is different, and you'll get exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and ways of thinking about growth.

*

*Having real responsibility for the success of the account!* This isn't a shadow-and-support role. You'll own key parts of how we show up for clients — and when things run smoothly, it's because of you.

------------------------
Primary responsibilities
------------------------

*

You will be a *key point of contact for day-to-day client communication* — scheduling meetings, sending agendas ahead of every call, and delivering polished post-meeting recaps that document decisions and next steps clearly.

*

You are the *most organized member on the team* — you know everything that's happening on your accounts, communicate details to all the stakeholders, and are able to be in the details. Deadlines don't sneak up on you.

*

You will *track all deliverable deadlines* across accounts and work directly with channel managers and creatives to ensure nothing gets missed. You're the first line of accountability when timelines are at risk.

*

You will *maintain creative trackers* across all active accounts — keeping statuses accurate, approvals logged, and visibility high so Growth Managers always know where things stand.

*

You will *build and document internal processes and automations* alongside the Growth team. We're actively investing in making Pearmill faster and smarter — you'll be executing on that work while GMs provide strategic direction.

*

You will *manage ongoing vendor and platform relationships* with Google, Meta, and other partners — owning routine correspondence, rep follow-ups, and keeping those relationships warm and proactive.

*

You will *align the team on messaging and logistics for weekly client meetings* , and support Growth Managers in orchestrating how we approach our relationships with clients.

*

You will *actively use AI tools to get more done* — writing better emails faster, summarizing meetings, drafting recaps, researching vendors, and finding smarter ways to handle the work that used to take hours.

---------
About you
---------

*

You have *1–2 years of experience in a client-facing, agency, or marketing coordination role* — or you've done something equivalent that gave you real accountability over multiple moving pieces.

*

You're *excited about creating processes, systems, and templates* — you see a broken workflow and immediately start thinking about how to fix it.

*

You're an *excellent communicator and collaborator* , and you think deeply about oxford commas. Your written communication is clear, warm, and polished — clients feel taken care of, not just managed.

*

You're *genuinely curious about performance marketing*. You don't need to know paid media cold, but you want to learn — you ask good questions and connect dots quickly.

*

You're *comfortable working across tools* like Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and project management platforms. You pick up new software quickly and don't need hand-holding to get productive.

*

*You live in AI tools.* ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity — you're in them every day, not just for drafting emails, but because you're genuinely curious about what they can do. You've probably already tried to build something with one. You're not afraid to break things.

*

*You think in systems and automations.* When you see a repetitive task, your instinct is to ask: can AI handle this? You're excited about agentic workflows, prompt engineering, and the idea that the best version of this job is one you've partially automated yourself.

*

*You understand that AI handles the repetition — you handle the nuance.* You don't expect AI to do your job. You expect it to make you dramatically better at it. That distinction matters to us.

*

You're *ownership-oriented*. You don't wait to be told something is going sideways — you see it, flag it, and often already have a fix in mind.

*

You're a *good hang*. We work closely and care about each other. Being great at your job and being a kind, low-ego teammate aren't in tension here — we expect both.

-----------------------
Flourishing at Pearmill
-----------------------

We get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction out of making the things around us better at their jobs. Clients who arrived wanting a channel fixed and left with a system. People who joined to run ad accounts and left able to build a team that runs global strategy. And most recently, our little AI agents running around our Notion docs and giving us super powers.

We're a fast growing, diverse group of goofy yet dedicated marketers, creatives, engineers, and analysts, running over $500M in ad spend across 15+ platforms. Join us!

title: Junior Scrum Master
description:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
*Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!*
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

------------------------
*Why this role matters:*
------------------------

We are seeking a dynamic and pragmatic Scrum Master to join our diverse global team. As a Scrum Master, you will play a crucial role in supporting our Agile transformation. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is passionate about Agile and eager to take the first step in their career supported by an experienced Agile team.

Vonage is entering an exciting new chapter, focused on consolidating and aligning a business that has grown and diversified through acquisition. This role will be part of the Lean Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) at Vonage. The LACE are implementing the Scaled Agile framework (SAFe) across the business to help align our teams and maximize the value they deliver. This role is a chance to get real experience of driving SAFe implementation you won’t get from training or certification.

----------------------------
*Your key responsibilities:*
----------------------------

With the support of the LACE team you will help to drive the Agile transformation across Vonage. Your role will focus specifically on introducing a strong Agile culture within one or more teams, and you will also have the opportunity to assist the Release Train Engineers with running of SAFe events.

* Train, mentor, and support teams to introduce and follow agile values, principles, and practices.
* Use a data driven approach to help teams monitor their performance and drive a culture of continuous improvement.
* Encourage open communication and active participation within and between teams.
* Identify and address impediments that could hinder the team's progress or productivity. Collaborate to find solutions and eliminate obstacles.
* Foster effective communication between team members and stakeholders. Ensure information flows smoothly and that everyone is aligned with the team’s goals and priorities.
* Support the Release Train Engineers with planning for and running SAFe events such as PI planning.

-------------------
*What you'll bring*
-------------------

Some experience as a Scrum Master with an awareness of one or more Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban or XP will be useful to succeed in this role. Transferable experience from different career paths is welcomed.

• Lead user testing sessions and conduct thorough analysis to inform design improvements.

• Proven track record of delivering scalable and reliable software solutions.
• A portfolio demonstrating expertise in UI/UX design and relevant projects, including experience with Information Architecture deliverables and the organization of complex enterprise applications or digital products.
• Proven experience in designing dynamic forms with a strong emphasis on intuitive user experience and efficient design.
• Extensive experience in creating CSS cards and drag & drop functionality.

Communication and Organizational
• Excellent presentation and communication (oral and written) skills.
