title: Education Designer UX UI and AI
description:
You're a designer who has facilitated workshops or built online courses, and you noticed that *Â you loved it and that you were unusually good at it*.

You know how to make complex skills easy to learn, and how to guide people in applying their new skills. As one of our Education Designers, you'll structure and create the courses and Master Classes you lead.

You've taught design or AI to hundreds of people. Now you get the opportunity toÂ *teach it to hundreds of thousandsÂ* of learners around the world.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes includeÂ *Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman* , as well as Design Leads atÂ *Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe*. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

Youâll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you toÂ *take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow*. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. Youâll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

--------------------------------------------------------
Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education
--------------------------------------------------------

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help usÂ *take online education to new heights* Â andÂ *make a meaningful impact on humankind*.

At IxDF, weâre not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

------------------------------------------------
We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team
------------------------------------------------

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

*

*Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:Â* lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there.Â *This is the role described here.*

*

*Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:Â* lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with ourÂ *Education Designers*.

*

*Our Course Writers and Editors:Â* lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the userâs perspective.

Weâre a flexible team, and youâll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

*You, the Education Designer,Â* establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with ourÂ *Co-Founder* , yourÂ *Team Lead* , and theÂ *Course Directors* , who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, ourÂ *Course Writers and Editors* Â take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

-----------------
Your Role at IxDF
-----------------

*

*Be a core part of our Editorial Team.* Â You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

*

*Design for a diverse, global audience.Â* Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

*

*Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.* Â You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

*

Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments thatÂ *turn passive watching into active designing*. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

*

*Set and raise the standard for our assessments,Â* so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

*

*Make expert knowledge understandable.* Â You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

*

*You help produce Master Classes.Â* We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session.Â *Timelines vary enormously* : with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

*

YouÂ *plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leaders* Â in design and thenÂ *fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world*. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average *Â we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.*

*

*Our courses combine written and video lessons.Â* You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

*

*Balance the big picture with the smaller details.Â* Expect to focus onÂ *one large course creation project per quarter* , alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

*

*Find room for improvementÂ* by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

*

*Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentationÂ* so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

*

*You won't do this alone.Â* You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

*

*Weâre committed toâ¯excellence,* Â and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role isâ¯not for the average. Ahead of you is aâ¯highly rewarding and enriching journey.

*

We're proud to have assembled aÂ *remarkable team of unicorns* Â who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

---------
About You
---------

*

You have at leastÂ *5 years of hands-on design experience*.

*

You'veÂ *facilitated workshops* Â repeatedly, run a beginner course, mentored designers, or built curricula for online courses.

*

You canÂ *show us something you built* : a course, a workshop series, live Master Classes, an AI teaching app, or a mentoring program. Weâre excited to hear what it was, why you built it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

*

You can take aÂ *broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence* Â thatâll make a beginner feel and act confident.

*

You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

*

You're a *Â practical idealist*. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

*

YouÂ *collaborate with AI in everything you do*. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to take *Â human leadership* , so theÂ *outcome is 100% yoursÂ* and better than you could have created without AI.

*

You know the difference betweenÂ *timeless human-centered design skills and skills in tools that change*. Youâre passionate about the first, because theyâre the most interesting to you and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon. Youâre eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know theyâre more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

*

You canÂ *teach a career changer* Â the powerful skills of great design, and you canÂ *guide an experienced designer* Â in upskilling to a more senior role.

*

You're genuinelyÂ *curious* Â about how AI is changing design work and design education.

*

You're kind, and you have theÂ *social intelligence and empathy* Â to engage well with very different kinds of people.

*

You'reÂ *fluent in written and spoken English* Â and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

*

Youâre enthusiastic about learning by doing and areÂ *committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills*.

*

YouÂ *spot problems* Â before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

*

YouÂ *value teamwork* , prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals. You give constructive feedback that others can act on, and you take it the same way. When someone shows you how your idea could be better, you're interested rather than defensive.

*

You'reÂ *self-motivated* , and you loveÂ *creative freedom* ,Â *independent judgment* , and theÂ *responsibility* Â that comes with both.

*

Youâre driven by the desire toÂ *make a positive impact in the world* Â and to improve the lives of others.

*

Most of the work happens from yourÂ *home office,Â* but you'reÂ *willing to travel a few times a year* Â to shoot courses. You're located in aÂ *time zone* Â between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

------------
Bonus Points
------------

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

*

You'veÂ *publishedÂ* educational material under your own name orÂ *spoken* Â at design conferences.

*

You've worked with anÂ *LMS or an online learning platform*.

*

You'veÂ *built AI-supported learning* : tutors, adaptive paths, automated feedback. Or youâve used AI to build products.

*

You hold aÂ *bachelor's or master's* Â in UX, UI, AI, or a similar field.

*

You have yourÂ *own blog or social media page* Â where you create and share original content.

*

You haveÂ *collaborated with video production teams*.

-----------------
What We Can Offer
-----------------

*

*A highly valued role:* Â You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

*

*Reach and impact* Â that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. A workshop facilitator might teach one hundred designers a year. Your design decisions will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

title: Education Designer: UX, UI, and AI
description:
*Headquarters:* Denmark
*URL:*

You're a designer who has facilitated workshops or built online courses, and you noticed that *you loved it and that you were unusually good at it*.

You know how to make complex skills easy to learn, and how to guide people in applying their new skills. As one of our Education Designers, you'll structure and create the courses and Master Classes you lead.

You've taught design or AI to hundreds of people. Now you get the opportunity to *teach it to hundreds of thousands* of learners around the world.

You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world.

The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include *Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman* , as well as Design Leads at *Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe*. Don Norman also chairs our executive board.

You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to *take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow*. Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between idea and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast.

--------------------------------------------------------
Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education
--------------------------------------------------------

IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. Help us *take online education to new heights* and *make a meaningful impact on humankind*.

At IxDF, we’re not just a company but a movement dedicated to making high-quality design and AI education accessible to everyone, everywhere.

We've pioneered online design education since 2002. We have over 1,150,000 enrollments and 1,583 company members, with more than 40 courses, 160 Master Classes, and thousands of open-source design resources, created by our team in collaboration with 240 industry leaders.

With learners from over 100 countries, your work will empower people worldwide.

------------------------------------------------
We're Hiring Three People for Our Editorial Team
------------------------------------------------

We're growing, and three roles are open at the same time to build the next generation of our core educational product. Here's what each role leads on:

*

*Our Education Designers, UX, UI, and AI:* lead how design and AI are taught. You plan, structure, and create the core content, and you decide what a course participant should be able to do by the end and how they get there. *This is the role described here.*

*

*Our Course Directors, UX, UI, and AI:* lead what we teach and who teaches our courses and Master Classes. You reach out to industry leaders and create the invitation they say yes to. You bring your judgment to a planned course outline: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether the structure is solid. You plan and shoot courses with our *Education Designers*.

*

*Our Course Writers and Editors:* lead how our courses and articles read. You make each title engaging, ensure each sentence flows, and edit the written course experience from the user’s perspective.

We’re a flexible team, and you’ll be able to do what you excel in. Everyone on our team creates courses, and everyone works across these roles. If you're torn between two roles, apply for the one you'd be best at, and tell us in your application which other one you considered and why.

*You, the Education Designer,* establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course. You create the sequences, exercises, templates, and assessments. You'll work closely with our *Co-Founder* , your *Team Lead* , and the *Course Directors* , who lead on what we teach and who teaches it, and you'll have a real say in both. We all reach out to and collaborate with industry leaders in these processes. Once your course is ready, our *Course Writers and Editors* take it the last mile: the scripts, hooks, headings, on-screen text in videos, quiz wording, and editorial voice. You'll also work closely with the video team and our growth team.

-----------------
Your Role at IxDF
-----------------

*

*Be a core part of our Editorial Team.* You'll collaborate with IxDF editors, video editors, and UX and UI designers as well as external industry leaders to create courses and Master Classes for people worldwide. You'll help them succeed in the age of AI with new skills in AI and in timeless human-centered design.

*

*Design for a diverse, global audience.* Some of our courses and Master Classes serve working designers who want to grow into more senior work. Others serve people moving into design from other fields. Often, you'll teach both in the same lesson. Getting both right without watering either down is a rewarding design challenge.

*

*Make an impact as you decide how the courses you lead come together.* You establish what a course participant should be able to do by the end of a course, then you plan, structure, and create the core content that gets them there. What comes first, what builds on what, and how people level up step by step with ease and joy from confused to competent. You'll work across UX design, human-computer interaction, design thinking, UI design, psychology, and AI.

*

Design the exercises, portfolio activities, design templates, and assessments that *turn passive watching into active designing*. You write the exercises that make a course participant apply an idea to their own portfolio project, the templates that scaffold that work, and the assessments that reveal whether they understood and can apply it, or whether they just watched. You write the headings and hooks your structure calls for, and our Course Writers and Editors own the final wording. Every course should leave a participant with a portfolio case study they can show a hiring manager.

*

*Set and raise the standard for our assessments,* so a correct answer proves understanding, not just recognition, and a good question teaches as well as tests.

*

*Make expert knowledge understandable.* You take raw expert video material, course and Master Class transcripts and footage featuring global industry leaders, and turn it into educational material that teaches timeless human-centered design and AI.

*

*You help produce Master Classes.* We produce 3 per month. Over email, you reach out to designers whose work you admire, invite them to create one with us, plan the content, and produce the live session. *Timelines vary enormously* : with Don Norman or Vitaly Friedman it can be two weeks from first email to publication, because we work with them often. With a new expert, it can be half a year. Once the session is recorded, you get the footage and the transcript, and you decide with the Course Directors and Team Lead which existing course benefits from which snippets, and where they go.

*

You *plan the course content in collaboration with the global industry leaders* in design and then *fly out to meet them in professional studios across the world*. You'll shoot the course content there with some of your colleagues. Expect this a few times a year at minimum. Some of us love that part and join every studio production; others keep it to those few trips. Both work for us. On average *we shoot 4-6 new courses per year.*

*

*Our courses combine written and video lessons.* You'll work closely with the video team, giving constructive feedback on on-screen text, b-roll, graphics, and animation, and telling them which takeaways need a visual, so each video is more engaging to learn from and accurate from a design perspective. You'll also work closely with our growth team.

*

*Balance the big picture with the smaller details.* Expect to focus on *one large course creation project per quarter* , alongside small, continuous improvements to what's already published.

*

*Find room for improvement* by looking at completion rates, learner feedback, and the portfolios course participants produce, then go back and fix what isn't excellent yet. Use the power of incremental, modular design as you help push the quality of our educational materials to new heights, surpassing even the very best in industry and academia. We're always learning, always improving, always raising the bar in everything we do and ship.

*

*Maintain and improve our crystal-clear documentation* so our knowledge resources stay up-to-date, easy to find, and provide instant value to our internal teams. Clarity is key. Any line of documentation should be self-explanatory.

*

*You won't do this alone.* You'll work with our Course Directors, your Team Lead, and our Co-Founder to pressure-test the structure: what's missing, what doesn't belong, and whether it holds together. That kind of judgment takes twenty years to build, and this type of collaboration is one of the fastest ways to grow your own design skills. You'll work in a diverse, highly organized, result-driven environment where you'll grow personally and professionally.

*

*We’re committed to excellence,* and we seek a like-minded enthusiast to join us. This role is not for the average. Ahead of you is a highly rewarding and enriching journey.

*

We're proud to have assembled a *remarkable team of unicorns* who uplift, motivate, and push each other to excel daily. There's a seat open for someone who shares our passion for excellence. Could that be you?

---------
About You
---------

*

You have at least *5 years of hands-on design experience*.

*

You've *facilitated workshops* repeatedly, run a beginner course, mentored designers, or built curricula for online courses.

*

You can *show us something you built* : a course, a workshop series, live Master Classes, an AI teaching app, or a mentoring program. We’re excited to hear what it was, why you built it the way you did, and how long it took you to create.

*

You can take a *broad, complex design practice and turn it into a step-by-step learning sequence* that’ll make a beginner feel and act confident.

*

You can teach the same idea in different formats: a 60-minute workshop, a written lesson, a 90-second video. You know what a medium does well and what it can't carry, and you know what to cut when the format gets shorter.

*

You're a *practical idealist*. You know how to create great results through incremental quick wins and MVPs, and you know when to go all in and make something perfect.

*

You *collaborate with AI in everything you do*. You use AI to research, structure, write, and create faster, and you know how to take *human leadership* , so the *outcome is 100% yours* and better than you could have created without AI.

*

You know the difference between *timeless human-centered design skills and skills in tools that change*. You’re passionate about the first, because they’re the most interesting to you and you know that AI will take over much of the tool-based design work soon. You’re eager to help people build UX and UI skills because you know they’re more relevant than ever in the age of AI.

*

You can *teach a career changer* the powerful skills of great design, and you can *guide an experienced designer* in upskilling to a more senior role.

*

You're genuinely *curious* about how AI is changing design work and design education.

*

You're kind, and you have the *social intelligence and empathy* to engage well with very different kinds of people.

*

You're *fluent in written and spoken English* and you can explain complex ideas clearly.

*

You’re enthusiastic about learning by doing and are *committed to putting in the effort to continuously improve your skills*.

*

You *spot problems* before anyone else notices them, and when something goes off track you come back with a solution rather than a report.

*

You *value teamwork* , prioritize collaboration, and focus on collective goals. You give constructive feedback that others can act on, and you take it the same way. When someone shows you how your idea could be better, you're interested rather than defensive.

*

You're *self-motivated* , and you love *creative freedom* , *independent judgment* , and the *responsibility* that comes with both.

*

You’re driven by the desire to *make a positive impact in the world* and to improve the lives of others.

*

Most of the work happens from your *home office,* but you're *willing to travel a few times a year* to shoot courses. You're located in a *time zone* between UTC-6 (Austin, Chicago) and UTC+8 (Singapore, Perth), which includes all of Europe.

------------
Bonus Points
------------

None of these are required, but each of them would make us even happier.

*

You've *published* educational material under your own name or *spoken* at design conferences.

*

You've worked with an *LMS or an online learning platform*.

*

You've *built AI-supported learning* : tutors, adaptive paths, automated feedback. Or you’ve used AI to build products.

*

You hold a *bachelor's or master's* in UX, UI, AI, or a similar field.

*

You have your *own blog or social media page* where you create and share original content.

*

You have *collaborated with video production teams*.

-----------------
What We Can Offer
-----------------

*

*A highly valued role:* You'll shape our core product, our courses and Master Classes.

*

*Reach and impact* that are difficult to find anywhere else in this field. A workshop facilitator might teach one hundred designers a year. Your design decisions will reach hundreds of thousands. They'll build better careers and design a better world for all of us.

*

*Access:* ** The experts you'd normally cite in a workshop are the people whose material you'll be shaping, whose Master Classes you'll produce, and in some cases the people you'll be in a studio with. Our name opens doors. An email from IxDF gets read, so the reach you have now is the floor, not the ceiling.

*

*Autonomy:* Nobody will ever hand you a template and tell you to fill it in. You decide how our courses teach.

*

*A global, purpose-driven team: Work remotely* alongside passionate professionals from all over the world, united by a *common mission* to create the best possible design and AI education in the world, and make it accessible for everyone.

*

*Our co-founder and co-CEO, Rikke, will work closely with you*. She and our other co-founder, Mads, built IxDF from nothing, with no investment capital, so we would stay free to make world-class design education affordable to everyone. She was the sole editor and video editor for many of our early years, so she's shaped our course planning, expert interviews, video shoots, and content editing from the inside. She's still hands-on in everything we do, and she still films educational videos herself, in places like the US, the North Pole, and Nepal.

*

A *full-time position* within a fully remote organization. Video-based collaboration with your colleagues from elsewhere on the planet, and we get together in person each year, on a team trip or for a studio production.

*

Bi-weekly *knowledge-sharing sessions* and 4 meeting-free days weekly for focused work.

*

A work culture with no *fluffy titles, political agendas, or corporate drama*. Your colleagues value *your warm character, your strong work ethic, and the results you deliver*. If you embody old-school virtues of always striving to deliver results, learn and become better every day, you'll thrive at IxDF.

*

A daily mission to help impact, *empower, and enrich the lives of millions of people* by creating *affordable high-end design education* for everyone across the planet. It'll be yours too.

*

*Colleagues with four to forty years of experience* , and a culture where we follow the best idea, not the longest résumé.

*

A company *where the distance between idea and execution is minimal.* We're a highly agile organization with *zero bureaucracy or corporate politics* – and with *exceptional order and efficiency*.

*

A company culture where *passion meets high performance and excellence*. To help us improve the world, and yourself in the process, *you'll need grit, strong work ethic, long-term thinking, and self-discipline*.

*

We thrive because we have a *hands-on attitude and a bias towards action* as opposed to fluff-filled, unrealistic strategies. You'll need *crisp execution skills yourself* and the ability to *impress your colleagues with concrete results* , just like they'll impress you.

*

If you want even more opportunities to show the world what you can do, you’re in luck! When you're willing to do the hard work of learning and growing, then you’ll find virtually *limitless opportunities with us.*

*

We built online design education before people believed in it. AI is now changing what designers do, and they carry a bigger responsibility than ever. You'll be at the *forefront of teaching designers to work with AI and to design responsibly for it*. You'll help *set a direction* that shapes both the designers we teach and the people who use what they build. Together, we'll design a better world.

---------------------------
How to Learn More and Apply
---------------------------

To submit your application as well as learn more about our Work Culture and Values, please visit https://ixdf.org/about/careers

Please apply as soon as you can. We’re firm believers in “the sooner, the better” and we look forward to working with you!

Unknown Worlds is looking for a Technical UI Designer to help build the next game in the Subnautica franchise. ****************

title: Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Front-End UI/UX Engineer based in Canada.*

This role is an opportunity to shape intuitive, accessible, and high-quality digital experiences for complex enterprise applications.
You will combine strong front-end engineering expertise with a deep understanding of UI/UX and accessibility principles.
Working primarily within an ASP.NET MVC 5 environment, you will translate business and user needs into polished, maintainable interfaces.
Your work will help ensure applications are usable, inclusive, responsive, and compliant with modern accessibility standards.
You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA specialists, and technology teams.
The position offers a hands-on engineering environment where you can influence both technical implementation and the overall user experience.
You will also contribute to technical specifications, testing, documentation, and the delivery of reliable production-ready solutions.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain accessible, user-centered interfaces for complex enterprise applications built on ASP.NET MVC 5.
* Translate business requirements, user needs, and design concepts into clean, intuitive, maintainable, and production-ready front-end experiences.
* Apply UI/UX principles including information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and responsive design to real-world applications.
* Implement and validate web accessibility in accordance with WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 requirements.
* Apply semantic HTML, ARIA roles and attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, and other accessibility best practices.
* Test interfaces using assistive technologies and screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, and VoiceOver, as appropriate.
* Develop and support full-stack .NET applications using C#, ASP.NET MVC 5, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies in a Windows environment.
* Build and integrate front-end experiences with RESTful APIs and internal or external systems.
* Work with Microsoft SQL Server, including data models, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views required to support application functionality.
* Prepare technical design specifications, technical documentation, and clear design documentation.
* Write and maintain unit tests while supporting QA, usability testing, accessibility validation, and release activities.
* Analyze requirements, troubleshoot complex UI and cross-browser issues, and deliver stable, polished solutions within established timelines.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, customers, designers, and cross-functional technology teams to validate solutions and resolve issues.
* Contribute to design reviews, accessibility audits, usability initiatives, and continuous improvements to the application's user experience.
* Work independently within established enterprise codebases while identifying opportunities to modernize and improve legacy front-end components.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Design, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8+ years of professional software development experience, with significant hands-on experience in front-end and UI development.
* Strong proficiency in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and jQuery, with a focus on clean, semantic, maintainable markup.
* Demonstrated ability to apply UI/UX principles such as information architecture, interaction design, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design.
* Hands-on experience implementing and testing accessible web experiences against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards.
* Practical knowledge of ARIA, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus management, and accessibility testing with assistive technologies.
* Strong proficiency in C# and ASP.NET MVC 5, with experience developing and supporting full-stack .NET applications in Windows environments.
* Solid Microsoft SQL Server experience, including database design, data modeling, T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and views.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, core computer science principles, and software engineering best practices.
* Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and integrating front-end applications with internal and external systems.
* Experience with unit testing, QA collaboration, usability testing, release processes, and the broader software development lifecycle.
* Ability to analyze complex requirements, troubleshoot cross-browser and UI issues, and deliver reliable, high-quality solutions with minimal supervision.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and advocate for users and accessibility.
* Experience with DevExpress UI components and reporting tools is preferred.
* Formal training or certification in UX, accessibility, human-centered design, or credentials such as IAAP CPACC/WAS is an advantage.
* Experience supporting usability testing, accessibility audits, design reviews, or design-to-development workflows is a plus.
* Familiarity with Figma, Adobe XD, or similar design and prototyping tools is beneficial.
* Experience with financial aid, student information systems, higher-education data, or related enterprise applications is desirable.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and legacy .NET modernization is advantageous.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Opportunity to work on complex enterprise applications with a strong focus on user experience and accessibility.
* Hands-on exposure to front-end engineering, UI/UX design, accessibility, and full-stack .NET development.
* Opportunity to influence the usability and inclusivity of business-critical digital products.
* Collaborative environment involving business stakeholders, customers, designers, QA, and technology professionals.
* Opportunity to work with established enterprise technologies including ASP.NET MVC 5, C#, SQL Server, and DevExpress.
* Scope to contribute to modernization initiatives and improve legacy application front-end experiences.
* Professional growth through exposure to accessibility standards, UX practices, enterprise engineering, and cross-functional delivery.
* Opportunity to work on solutions where engineering quality, accessibility, usability, and user needs are treated as core priorities.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
*Opis projektu*

Szukamy *Senior UX Researchera* , który będzie odpowiedzialny za prowadzenie badań użytkowników wspierających rozwój produktów cyfrowych w globalnym środowisku.

W tej roli będziesz łączyć *user research, podejście human-centered design oraz strategię produktową* , dostarczając zespołom produktowym i projektowym wiedzy, która przekłada się na konkretne usprawnienia doświadczeń użytkowników.
Poszukujemy osoby samodzielnej i doświadczonej, która potrafi prowadzić proces badawczy od zdefiniowania problemu, przez dobór i realizację metod badawczych, aż po analizę wyników i przedstawienie rekomendacji. Będziesz ściśle współpracować z Product Managerami, UX/UI Designerami oraz zespołami technicznymi, wspierając proces discovery i podejmowanie decyzji produktowych.

* *3–5 lat doświadczenia* w prowadzeniu badań UX, user research, usability testing lub product design research dla produktów cyfrowych.

title: Lead AI Experience Designer
description:
**********
*About Us*
**********

We are a technology services company dedicated to helping organizations build and deploy cutting-edge AI solutions. From generative AI and custom LLM integrations to predictive analytics and intelligent automation, we work across industries to bring real-world AI applications to life. Our projects combine deep technical expertise with hands-on client collaboration to solve high-impact problems.

***********
Job Summary
***********

We are seeking a Lead AI Experience Designer to serve as the founding design hire. You will establish UX/UI practices for Eliza’s client AI solutions — turning powerful AI capabilities into polished, intuitive, client-ready products. This is a strategic, hands-on role for a designer who can move from ambiguous business problems and user research to sharp product direction, tested prototypes, and polished interfaces.

As Eliza’s first dedicated designer, you will shape not only individual products but also how we approach design as a company: our standards, patterns, tools, and approaches. You will partner directly with AI Product Managers, Forward Deployed Engineers, and client stakeholders — advising across multiple engagements while embedding deeply in the highest-priority, experience-intensive work.

Your primary focus will be elevating the end-user experience and interface quality of Eliza’s AI solutions, from early workflows and prototypes through production-ready UI. The right person is AI-native in their practice — using modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, testing, and production — while bringing strong judgment about where human craft and rigor matter most.

********************
Key Responsibilities
********************

--------------------------
1. Define Design Standards
--------------------------

*

Establish the principles, standards, and operating rhythm for AI product design at Eliza.

*

Establish reusable design systems and interaction patterns that enable FDEs to build consistent, production-ready AI experiences across client engagements.

*

Create practical design playbooks, templates, and review practices that help delivery teams move from discovery to validated, high-quality interfaces faster.

*

Bring a clear point of view on what great AI product experiences require — and make that point of view practical for product, engineering, and client teams.

-------------------------------------
2. User Discovery & Product Direction
-------------------------------------

*

Lead user discovery, workflow research, concept testing, and usability testing with client stakeholders and end users, using AI-native research tools to accelerate synthesis and insight generation.

*

Synthesize insights into clear user needs, opportunity areas, journey maps, and product recommendations.

*

Turn ambiguous business and technical problems into focused product and UX direction.

*

Help teams distinguish between an impressive AI demo and a useful, trustworthy product experience.

--------------------------------
3. Experience & Interface Design
--------------------------------

*

Design end-to-end user experiences for AI-enabled products, from early concepts and workflows to high-fidelity interface design.

*

Create clear, intuitive interaction patterns for AI products, including moments where users need transparency, control, feedback, or confidence in the system’s output.

*

Produce the artifacts that move delivery forward: flows, wireframes, prototypes, visual systems, and implementation-ready specifications.

*

Raise the quality bar for visual and interaction design across priority client engagements.

*

Set a new bar for what enterprise AI products can feel like: elegant, trustworthy, and unmistakably designed for the people who rely on them.

-----------------------
4. Delivery Partnership
-----------------------

*

Partner closely with AI Product Managers and Forward Deployed Engineers to keep product, technical, and experience decisions connected throughout delivery.

*

Partner with FDEs to translate complex AI-system capabilities and constraints into flexible, SDK-informed interface standards that make multimodal, streaming, and real-time experiences predictable and production-ready.

*

Participate in client-facing working sessions, presenting design rationale and guiding stakeholders through decisions and tradeoffs.

*

Support iterative development by testing prototypes and in-progress builds, identifying usability issues early, and helping teams make practical improvements.

*

Balance advisory work across multiple engagements with deep ownership on the projects where design is most critical.

----------------------------
5. AI-Native Design Practice
----------------------------

*

Use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, prototyping, testing, and production without compromising design judgment or quality.

*

Bring current AI product patterns and experience-design practices into client work, adapting them thoughtfully to each use case and audience.

***************************
How We’ll Know It’s Working
***************************

*

Client products feel clearer, more intuitive, and more differentiated.

*

User research and testing meaningfully shape product direction before engineering investment is locked in.

*

AI PMs and FDEs have a trusted design partner who strengthens both discovery and design delivery.

*

Priority engagements show stronger stakeholder confidence, usability, and end-user satisfaction.

*

Eliza has a consistent, reusable standard for AI product experience across its portfolio.

**************
Qualifications
**************

--------
Required
--------

*

5+ years of experience in product design, UX design, service design, or a closely related discipline.

*

Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end product design—from research and problem framing through prototyping, testing, and polished UI delivery.

*

Strong user-research capability, including interviews, concept validation, and usability testing.

*

Excellent product judgment: able to make clear recommendations in ambiguous environments and explain the reasoning behind them.

*

A portfolio showing thoughtful interaction design, visual craft, and the ability to simplify complex workflows.

*

Experience working closely with product managers and engineers to ship real products.

*

Strong client-facing communication skills, including the ability to facilitate working sessions and present to senior stakeholders.

*

Comfort managing several concurrent workstreams without compromising quality.

*

An AI-native working style and a practical understanding of how modern AI systems shape product experiences.

---------
Preferred
---------

*

Experience designing AI-enabled, data-heavy, enterprise, or workflow products.

*

Familiarity with the practical constraints of LLMs, agents, automation, and human-in-the-loop systems.

*

Experience in consulting, professional services, or other client-delivery environments.

*

Experience designing for complex or regulated industries.

*

Experience building or contributing to design systems, reusable interaction patterns, or product-design playbooks.

*************
What We Offer
*************

*

A founding opportunity to define Eliza’s design practice and influence the company’s product standard.

*

Competitive compensation (base salary + performance incentives tied to client outcomes).

*

Equity options in a growing AI services company.

*

Exposure to a wide range of industries and high-impact AI problems.

*

Travel opportunities for on-site client engagements (if desired).

*

A collaborative, mission-driven team passionate about the real-world impact of AI.

title: UX Design Lead
description:
--------
Overview
--------

LMI is seeking a *UX / Design Engineer* to join the IronSled Platform-as-a-Service team. This role will own the design of the processes, workflows, and user experiences that determine how customers interact with and consume the platform.

This is not a traditional UI design role focused primarily on visual polish. The Staff UX / Product Designer will work across product, engineering, cybersecurity, and platform operations to simplify complex technical processes such as identity and access management, onboarding, application provisioning, environment access, and CMMC-related workflows. *This position requires the ability to obtain a security clearance. U.S. citizenship is required.*

The ideal candidate understands that the user interface is often the final expression of a larger process. They will identify friction in the underlying workflow, work with stakeholders and engineers to determine what can be simplified or automated, and translate the resulting process into an intuitive user experience.

As an early member of a small, cross-functional team, this person will have significant influence over how IronSled evolves as a product and how users experience the platform.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

--------------
What You’ll Do
--------------

* Own the end-to-end user experience for IronSled, from initial access and onboarding through application deployment and ongoing platform use.
* Analyze existing technical and operational processes to identify unnecessary steps, manual dependencies, user friction, and opportunities for automation.
* Design workflows around complex platform capabilities including IAM, access control, RBAC, provisioning, application onboarding, environment selection, and CMMC requirements.
* Partner directly with platform engineers, security personnel, Product Management, and technical leadership to ensure proposed experiences are technically viable and aligned with backend constraints.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and drive alignment when improving processes requires changes across organizational or technical boundaries.
* Translate complex technical requirements into understandable user journeys, process flows, wireframes, prototypes, and implementation-ready specifications.
* Establish and maintain consistent UX patterns, reusable components, design standards, and documentation across the IronSled portal.
* Conduct user research and usability testing with internal and external tenants to validate assumptions and continuously improve platform workflows.
* Provide front-end engineers with clear specifications and assets that reduce ambiguity and allow implementation to move quickly.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate research, validate workflows, stress-test designs, develop technical requirements, and create narrowly scoped implementation assets where appropriate.
* Contribute limited front-end artifacts when they materially accelerate implementation, such as design tokens, CSS variables, component specifications, or other low-risk assets.
* Ensure user experiences meet accessibility requirements and applicable Section 508 standards.
* Advocate for user needs while balancing security, compliance, technical feasibility, platform maintainability, and mission requirements.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

----------------------
What We’re Looking For
----------------------

* 7+ years of experience in UX design, product design, service design, or a related discipline, with experience leading complex end-to-end design efforts.
* Demonstrated experience improving workflows where the primary challenge involved business processes, technical constraints, organizational behaviors, or system architecture rather than visual design alone.
* Experience designing complex enterprise, SaaS, PaaS, developer, cybersecurity, or other technically sophisticated products.
* Strong ability to create user flows, journey maps, process diagrams, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs.
* Experience partnering directly with software engineers and technical stakeholders to translate designs into implementation-ready requirements.
* Working understanding of modern web technologies including HTML, CSS, responsive design, APIs, and component-based front-end development.
* Experience developing or maintaining design systems, reusable components, design tokens, or similar standards.
* Experience conducting user research, usability testing, and stakeholder interviews.
* Ability to communicate design decisions and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently identify ambiguity, investigate underlying causes, and drive decisions.
* U.S. citizenship required.
* Ability to obtain and maintain the clearance or access required to support Department of War customers.

Target salary range: $123,000 - $170,000

*Disclaimer:*

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

title: Digital Designer
description:
******************
*Digital Designer*
******************

--------------
About the Role
--------------

We’re looking for a *Digital Designer* to join our creative team and bring our brand to life across digital touchpoints. This is a hands-on role for a strong visual designer who understands how to create beautiful, brand-forward work while designing for performance and conversion.

You’ll work across *e-commerce, landing pages, email, campaigns, presentations, and other digital brand experiences* , partnering closely with creative, marketing, and cross-functional teams.

We’re looking for someone who has strong craft, excellent digital instincts, and the ability to take a brief and independently turn it into polished, thoughtful work.

What You’ll Do

* Design digital assets across our website, landing pages, email, campaigns, presentations, and other marketing channels.
* Create compelling, conversion-minded landing pages and e-commerce experiences.
* Design campaign and lifecycle emails that balance strong visual storytelling with usability and performance.
* Translate creative briefs into polished concepts and final executions.
* Develop strong visual concepts through typography, imagery, composition, art direction, and storytelling.
* Work confidently with photography and intimate imagery, including image selection, compositing, retouching, and layout.
* Maintain a high level of craft and consistency across typography, spacing, alignment, and established grid systems.
* Build organized, scalable Figma files using Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, and shared styles.
* Contribute to and evolve reusable design systems, templates, and components across digital channels.
* Design web and email experiences with real-world implementation and responsive behavior in mind.
* Explore and incorporate AI-assisted creative tools into the design process where they improve ideation or execution.
* Collaborate with marketing, copy, development, and other stakeholders to bring projects from concept through launch.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities while communicating proactively and flagging blockers early.
* Take ownership of your work and operate with a strong level of autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

----------------------
What We’re Looking For
----------------------

* Strong experience in digital, visual, marketing, or brand design.
* A portfolio demonstrating high-quality digital work and strong visual craft.
* Experience designing for *DTC, e-commerce, or consumer-facing brands*.
* Strong understanding of art direction, brand identity, typography, composition, and visual storytelling.
* Deep proficiency in *Figma* , including Auto Layout, components, variants, variables, shared styles, and organized file structures.
* Experience designing *landing pages, websites, email, and digital campaigns*.
* Strong understanding of how digital designs translate into buildable web and email experiences.
* Ability to work within an established brand while still bringing fresh creative thinking.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency across a high volume of creative.
* Comfortable receiving feedback, presenting design rationale, and collaborating cross-functionally.
* Able to work independently, manage priorities, and take projects from brief to final delivery.
* Comfortable working with imagery and creative related to intimate wellness and sexuality.

------------
Nice to Have
------------

* Experience with *Klaviyo* or other email marketing platforms.
* Motion design, animation, or interaction design experience.
* Familiarity with HTML/CSS or front-end design constraints.
* Experience with analytics, A/B testing, CRO, or performance-driven creative.
* Experience using generative AI or AI-assisted image tools as part of a professional creative workflow.

----------------------
Portfolio Requirements
----------------------

As part of the application process, please include a portfolio along with a selection of work that demonstrates:

* A website, landing page, or other digital experience that has been launched.
* An example demonstrating strong art direction, image compositing, or retouching.
* 1–2 examples of campaign or marketing emails.
* An example of a reusable template, component system, or scalable design system.
* An example of AI-assisted creative work, including how AI contributed to the final execution.

This is a remote opportunity to shape mission-critical digital products supporting complex federal investigative and data-driven operations.
You’ll combine deep UX expertise with strong visual design skills to turn sophisticated workflows and large volumes of data into intuitive experiences.
The role is highly client-facing, with direct collaboration across government stakeholders, product managers, engineers, and delivery teams.
You’ll contribute across the full design lifecycle, from research and discovery through prototyping, testing, implementation, and iteration.
Your work will help simplify complex processes, improve information discovery, and strengthen operational decision-making in secure enterprise environments.
You’ll operate as a hands-on design leader and trusted advisor within a collaborative consulting and Agile delivery environment.
This role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact on federal modernization while working on challenging, high-visibility digital transformation initiatives.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Lead end-to-end product design activities for mission-critical federal digital products, from discovery and research through delivery and continuous improvement.
* Create wireframes, journey maps, workflows, prototypes, and high-fidelity visual designs that address complex user and business needs.
* Translate sophisticated requirements, investigative workflows, and data-intensive use cases into intuitive, accessible, and effective user experiences.
* Conduct stakeholder interviews, user research, usability testing, and other discovery activities to validate assumptions and inform design decisions.
* Simplify complex workflows and data-rich environments through thoughtful interaction design, information architecture, navigation, and visual hierarchy.
* Develop and maintain reusable design patterns, standards, and design-system components to ensure consistency across products and experiences.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, business analysts, and other delivery team members throughout the product lifecycle.
* Present design concepts, recommendations, prototypes, and design rationale clearly to government and client stakeholders.
* Incorporate feedback and usability findings into iterative design improvements while supporting Agile delivery teams.
* Ensure digital experiences align with accessibility best practices, security requirements, enterprise standards, and established user-centered design principles.
* Serve as a trusted design partner in client engagements, helping stakeholders navigate complex product and user experience challenges.

-------------
Requirements:
-------------

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional experience in UX, UI, product design, or a closely related discipline.
* Previous consulting experience in a client-facing environment, with confidence working directly with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated experience designing digital solutions for U.S. Federal Government agencies.
* Strong portfolio showcasing both user experience and visual design capabilities across complex digital products.
* Advanced proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools, particularly *Figma* and *Adobe Creative Suite*.
* Hands-on experience with user research, stakeholder interviews, prototyping, usability testing, interaction design, and iterative product development.
* Strong understanding of human-centered and user-centered design methodologies, information architecture, and accessibility best practices.
* Ability to transform complex requirements and data-heavy workflows into clear, intuitive, and visually compelling experiences.
* Excellent presentation, communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively with product managers, engineers, analysts, government stakeholders, and multidisciplinary Agile teams.
* Active *Secret Clearance* or the ability to obtain and maintain the required clearance.
* Must reside in the United States; candidates residing in *New York, California, or Colorado are not eligible* for this position.

---------
Benefits:
---------

* *Remote work:* Fully remote position for eligible candidates residing in the United States.
* *Competitive compensation:* Compensation aligned with experience, qualifications, and the responsibilities of the role.
* *Comprehensive benefits:* Access to a competitive benefits package designed to support employee health, well-being, and financial security.
* *Professional development:* Extensive opportunities for learning, skills development, and career growth.
* *Collaborative environment:* Work alongside multidisciplinary professionals combining consulting, digital design, product engineering, and Agile expertise.
* *Meaningful work:* Contribute to digital transformation initiatives with tangible impact on federal operations and user experiences.
* *Inclusive culture:* Commitment to diversity, equal opportunity, and a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.
* *Innovation-focused environment:* Participate in challenging projects involving intelligent automation, platform technologies, digital transformation, and modern product development practices.

title: Graphic Designer — AI Training Project (Remote, Flexible, Up to $25/hr)
description:
-------------------
*About HumanSignal*
-------------------

Real-world data is the competitive edge in AI.

HumanSignal is a human data partner for companies building AI models and products. Our customers ship better AI, faster, because we partner with their researchers from real-world data creation to annotation to delivery.

We design and create datasets from scratch, recruit and manage the domain experts who evaluate model output, and run everything through our own platform, Label Studio, the open-source standard for data labeling and evaluation, used by over 1 million practitioners worldwide.

We specialize in the operationally complex: real-world data collection, multimodal pipelines, and multi-step workflows. Advanced ML and AI teams use our enterprise platform to run their own data factories, and our services team to extend their reach where in-house capacity runs out.

If you want to do work that materially shapes how the next generation of AI products gets built, we'd love to talk.

---------------------------------------
Put your design eye to work training AI
---------------------------------------

We're teaching AI models to understand what makes design work — and we need experienced graphic designers to show them. You'll evaluate professionally designed layouts, identify where the design falls short, and use your craft to bring it up to standard. Your design judgment becomes training data that helps AI learn to evaluate visual quality the way a designer does.

This is flexible, fully remote work you can fit around your schedule — ideal for freelancers, career-changers, or designers between projects who want steady paid hours over the next several weeks.

--------------
What you'll do
--------------

* Evaluate professional designs across the dimensions that matter: typography, visual hierarchy, color, layout, and overall polish
* Spot design issues — some as subtle as a font choice, others calling for more substantial rework
* Apply your design skills in a browser-based editor to bring the work up to a cohesive, professional standard
* Work through a steady volume of designs while keeping your quality and judgment consistent
* Flag edge cases and unclear examples to help us sharpen our guidelines

--------------
What you bring
--------------

* Formal design training (degree, certificate, or bootcamp) *or* 3+ years of professional graphic design experience
* Strong command of design fundamentals: composition, color theory, typography, visual hierarchy
* Fluency with browser-based design tools — you can execute quickly and cleanly
* A calibrated, objective eye: you evaluate against design principles, not personal taste
* Sharp attention to detail and the ability to stay consistent through repetitive tasks
* Availability of 10+ hours per week for the next 2–6 weeks

------------
Nice to have
------------

* Experience reviewing or critiquing others' work (art direction, design QA, teaching, or mentorship)
* Prior AI/data annotation work

--------
Why join
--------

You'll get paid, flexible, fully remote design work with a fast onboarding and training process — and you'll be contributing to cutting-edge AI that's learning how to see design. Contributors who deliver consistently high-quality work get first access to extended hours and future paid projects.

title: Graphic Designer - Board Games & Tabletop
description:
About Goliath
-------------

Goliath is an international manufacturer and distributor of toys and games, operating in 15 countries and reaching more than 100 countries worldwide. At the heart of our business is a belief in great products and the magic of innovation. Our mission is to bring fun to every household through teamwork, creativity, and collaboration.

We are looking for a *Graphic Designer with experience in board games, tabletop games, toys, or related consumer products* to join our creative team. This role will work across the full game experience, from packaging and game boards to cards, components, instructions, and supporting materials.

Position Summary
----------------

The Graphic Designer is responsible for developing creative, high-quality artwork for Goliath's games and products. This includes packaging, game components, instruction manuals, retail displays, and other supporting graphics.

This position works closely with the Art Director, Brand Management, Project Management, Product Development, and other cross-functional teams to take projects from initial concept through final production.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

Graphic Design & Creative Development
-------------------------------------

* Design artwork for game packaging, game boards, cards, components, instruction manuals, retail displays, and supporting materials.
* Develop creative concepts based on game themes, target audiences, and brand direction.
* Create layouts with strong typography, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
* Create and modify packaging dielines using existing templates and custom specifications.
* Develop logos, icons, patterns, and other supporting graphics as needed.
* Stay current on trends in board games, toys, packaging, entertainment, retail, and pop culture.

Production & Artwork Management
-------------------------------

* Prepare accurate, production-ready artwork for manufacturing.
* Preflight, package, and organize artwork files for production.
* Verify imagery, product descriptions, logos, legal copy, component details, and other required elements before artwork is released.
* Ensure artwork meets packaging dielines and manufacturing specifications.
* Maintain organized files and version control throughout the design process.
* Assist with photo editing and image preparation as needed.

Collaboration & Project Management
----------------------------------

* Work closely with the Art Director, Project Managers, Brand Management, Product Development, and other teams throughout the development process.
* Manage multiple projects at different stages while balancing changing priorities and deadlines.
* Incorporate creative and production feedback efficiently while maintaining design quality.
* Adapt to changing project requirements and timelines.

*Requirements*

* 5+ years of professional graphic design and production experience in an agency, studio, or in-house creative environment.
* *Experience designing for board games, tabletop games, toys, game packaging, or a closely related physical consumer product category.*
* Portfolio demonstrating strong packaging and product-focused graphic design. *Board game or tabletop work is strongly preferred.*
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, InDesign, and Photoshop.
* Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, and print production.
* Experience preparing production-ready files and prepress artwork.
* Consumer packaging and dieline experience.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Comfortable working on a Mac platform.
* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design or equivalent professional experience preferred.

Additional experience with game boards, cards, components, rulebooks, licensed brands, illustration, logo design, 3D rendering, large-format graphics, or photo editing is a plus.

*Benefits*

* 401(k) with company matching
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Flexible spending and health savings accounts
* Paid time off
* The opportunity to work in a creative, collaborative toy and game environment

*Please include a portfolio with your application. Candidates with board game, tabletop game, toy, or game packaging experience are strongly encouraged to highlight that work in their portfolio.*

title: Graphic Designer - Remote

Curious and solutions -oriented mindset, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach to design challenges.

A portfolio that demonstrates :

Strong design and understanding of how to elevate a brand

Strong visual storytelling

Integrated visual brand storytelling across channels

*Growth Skills*

We’re proud that a diversity of small business owners, crowdfunding campaigns, and global brands trust Easyship as their gateway to the world. To learn more about us click here.

*Job Title:* Senior Product Manager (Fraud and Risk)

*Reports to: Head of Product*

*Location* : Bengaluru, India.

*Key Relationships:* Business Development, Customer Success, Product and Engineering teams

*Job Purpose:

* Easyship is a shipping technology platform connecting sellers and marketplaces to couriers—and powering customized, end-to-end logistics solutions. We’re seeking an experienced Product Manager with strong fraud prevention exposure ideally with exposure to transactional or high-volume business models to own initiatives across checkout, account creation, and post-purchase flows. You’ll define problem statements and solutions, align with our product vision, and coordinate with design/engineering to ship features that reduce fraud loss, prevent product abuse, and build trust—ultimately driving confidence and profitability for our merchants.

*What you’ll do:*

* Own the roadmap for Account Management, covering authentication, login security (MFA, reCAPTCHA, OAuth2, enterprise login), authorization (roles, subscriptions, limits), security, fraud prevention, and KYC/KYB.
* Own subscription management, including tiering, entitlements, usage limits, features access, and upgrade/downgrade flows to ensure seamless user experience and revenue accuracy.
* Drive partnerships and enterprise logins, integrating with identity providers (SSO, SAML, OAuth2) and platform ecosystems to enable secure, scalable access for business customers.
* Define and prioritize initiatives to balance user experience, conversion, fraud risk, and compliance needs.
* Deep-dive into user journeys (onboarding, login, account recovery, subscription upgrades, white labelling, Gray labelling) to reduce friction while ensuring strong protection against fraud and abuse.
* Shape and execute the roadmap across payment security (checkout, optimising the fraud rules, 3-D Secure/SCA).
* Prioritize using ROI frameworks; balance conversion, fraud loss, and operational cost to maximize business impact, being responsible for the entire P&L (profit and loss) of the Frauds and Security team
* Lead delivery from discovery → release → post-release, setting clear success metrics such as fraud rate, chargeback ratio, dispute win rate, false-positive rate, manual review time, and related support tickets.
* Partner with the engineering, data, finance, risk ops, support, and logistics teams to deliver resilient, compliant flows
* Stay current on market/PSP capabilities, risk signals, SCA/PCI/AML trends, and competitor tactics; convert insights into backlog items and experiments.

*Who you are:*

* 6+ years in Fraud and Risk with hands-on ownership of fraud prevention for transactional or high-volume products.
* Strong grasp of fraud fundamentals: account takeovers, synthetic/friendly fraud, triangulation, chargebacks and disputes, device/behavioural signals, rules, ML models, and evidence workflows.
* Deep understanding of authentication & authorization fundamentals: MFA, SSO, OAuth2, enterprise identity integrations, role-based access control.
* Data-first operator comfortable with funnels, experimentation, KPIs, and trade-off modelling (conversion vs fraud loss vs ops cost).
* Proven prioritization and crisp problem framing; able to influence across distributed global teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; highly organised, resourceful, entrepreneurial.

title: Senior Product Manager (R14206)
description:
*ABOUT OPORTUN
*
--------------

Oportun (Nasdaq: OPRT) is a mission-driven financial services company that puts its members' financial goals within reach. With intelligent borrowing, savings, and budgeting capabilities, Oportun empowers members with the confidence to build a better financial future. Since inception, Oportun has provided more than $21.3 billion in responsible and affordable credit, saved its members more than $2.5 billion in interest and fees, and helped its members set aside an average of more than $1,800 annually.

*WORKING AT OPORTUN*
--------------------

Working at Oportun means enjoying a differentiated experience of being part of a team that fosters a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where we all feel a sense of belonging and are encouraged to share our perspectives. This inclusive culture is directly connected to our organization's performance and ability to fulfill our mission of delivering affordable credit to those left out of the financial mainstream. We celebrate and nurture our inclusive culture through our employee resource groups.

*POSITION OVERVIEW*
-------------------

Oportun is seeking a talented, customer-focused, and analytical Senior Product Manager to join the Servicing & Payments team.

You will help create a trusted post-disbursement experience that strengthens members’ confidence in Oportun, supports their financial health, and encourages continued engagement and repeat member behavior. You are responsible for making repayment easy, intelligent, successful, and accurately reflected for lending members

In this role, you will define product strategy, set measurable objectives and key results, create outcome-oriented roadmaps, and partner with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, and other teams to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about building products that make repayment simpler and help members build a stronger relationship with Oportun, join us.

*WHAT YOU’LL DO*
----------------

* Define and execute product strategy and roadmaps that improve repayment outcomes, member trust, and repeat engagement.
* Own initiatives end to end—from discovery and requirements through delivery, measurement, and iteration.
* Create simple, transparent, and reliable servicing and payment experiences across self-service and assisted channels.
* Use member insights, data, and experimentation to improve payer rate, payment success, DQ prevention, and lending-member NPS.
* Lead cross-functional delivery with engineering, design, data, operations, risk, compliance, legal, and finance.
* Communicate product strategy, trade-offs, progress, and measurable business impact to senior stakeholders.

*WHO YOU ARE / WHAT YOU BRING*
------------------------------

* *Strong track record* : 5+ years of product management experience in high-growth environments.
* *Experience* working with business executives from many disciplines (compliance, risk, operations, fraud, technology, business intelligence, finance, training, legal, cybersecurity, etc.) to understand the need, define features, and prioritize and manage scope to operate in an iterative agile delivery framework.
* *Customer-centric:* You are passionate about improving the financial health of Oportun’s members.
* *Analytical problem solver* : You have experience working and delivering on complex problems. You excel in making data-informed decisions (testing and experimentation, defining metrics, data analysis).
* *Collaborative* : You have a track record of shipping and iterating on impactful products that required partnering with and building consensus across a wide group of cross-functional partners.
* *Excellent communicator* : You are a clear and concise communicator, and you have superb documentation skills.
* *Execution* : You’re scrappy, solution-oriented, and able to help the team push through obstacles and blockers to deliver value for our members.
