title: Senior Recruiter | GTM Expansion
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Ramp, people are the single biggest lever on our trajectory, and the bar for who joins this team gets higher every quarter, not lower. We are hiring our first dedicated Recruiter for GTM Expansion, based in London: someone who can map a market, identify the operators who will outperform their peers and run a full-cycle process that wins them.

The UK is the immediate mandate. You will partner with local and US-based leaders to turn an ambitious growth plan into a real commercial team, from first conversation through offer close. You will also help us build the recruiting approach, market knowledge and candidate networks that support Ramp's expansion into new GTM markets over time.

The recruiters who do this best combine craft on the front end, research, identification and calibration, with execution on the back end, closing, candidate experience and pipeline discipline. We are looking for both.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own full-cycle recruiting for priority GTM Expansion hiring, starting with UK roles across Sales, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships and Customer Success.

• Build a sharp point of view on the UK market and future expansion markets: the companies producing strong talent, the people who outperform their peers and the communities that matter.

• Use research, data and AI as part of your everyday craft to identify and qualify exceptional candidates. We expect a written market point of view, not just a slate of profiles.

• Run thoughtful, personalised outreach grounded in the candidate's actual background, commercial motion or recent work. We care more about quality, replies and conversion than send volume.

• Partner with GTM leaders to turn ambitious hiring plans into a clear profile, credible process and realistic compensation strategy. Surface hard market truth early and push back constructively when needed.

• Own the candidate experience from first conversation through offer close: fast follow-up, clear communication, strong process discipline and a tailored closing plan for the candidates we most want.

• Build real presence for Ramp in London through the right relationships, referrals and targeted community activity. The point is pipeline and credibility, not events for their own sake.

• Work tightly with the wider GTM Recruiting team on calibration, sourcing support, insight and operating rhythm, while bringing strong local judgment.

• Help improve how Ramp recruits for expansion by capturing what works in the UK and applying it thoughtfully as we enter new markets.

WHAT YOU NEED

• 5+ years of full-cycle GTM or Sales recruiting experience, ideally in a high-growth technology company where quality and pace both mattered.

• Strong knowledge of the UK technology talent market and a credible local network, or clear evidence that you can build one quickly.

• A track record of finding and closing exceptional people, not simply running inherited processes. You can point to candidates you identified who became strong hires.

• Excellent sourcing and research instincts. You can explain why someone is genuinely differentiated, not only that they have the right title at the right company.

• Experience hiring across several GTM functions, such as AEs, Sales Leadership, Solutions Consulting, Partnerships, Customer Success or RevOps.

• Strong candidate-closing judgment. You listen closely, understand what each candidate is weighing and can build conviction against serious alternatives.

• The confidence to influence senior leaders, challenge a mis-scoped search and make a hiring process better without creating unnecessary friction.

• Comfort using data to understand funnel health, diagnose problems and hold an honest conversation about what needs to change.

• High ownership. You book the next step while you have the candidate, chase what is stuck and do not wait for a detailed brief to get useful work moving.

• Specific, sharp written communication. Your outreach and candidate updates should never feel template-driven.

NICE TO HAVE

• Experience recruiting for a fintech, SaaS, infrastructure or similarly complex B2B product.

• Experience joining a company as the first recruiter in a new geography, or helping to scale an international business.

• Experience building an AI-augmented recruiting research workflow.

WHY THIS ROLE

You will have unusual ownership over one of Ramp's most important growth priorities, with the support of an established Talent team rather than the isolation of a one-person recruiting function. The work is practical and high impact: build the UK commercial team, help leaders make better hiring decisions and raise the bar for how Ramp recruits as it enters new markets.

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

- Relocation expense coverage to NYC or SF (if needed)

CANADA

- Group medical, dental, and vision coverage through Sun Life

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

- Fertility drug coverage (up to $4,000 lifetime)

- Group Retirement Plan with employer match (RRSP + DPSP)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay, with additional time available at reduced pay

- Employee Assistance Program and virtual care through Lumino Health

UNITED KINGDOM

- Private medical insurance through Freedom Elite

- Virtual GP and at-home care via eMed x Livi

- Workplace pension through Penfold, with salary sacrifice option

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay with additional time available at reduced pay

REFERRAL INSTRUCTIONS

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

OTHER NOTICES

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. ABOUT THE TEAM

The CEO Office Strategy & Operations team partners directly with Airwallex's executive leadership on the company's most important priorities.

We work across regions and functions to turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear decisions and executable plans. Our work spans market expansion, new business and product initiatives, operating model design, and other strategic priorities that require coordination across multiple parts of Airwallex.

The team combines rigorous problem-solving with hands-on execution. We don’t stop at making recommendations—we work with Product, Engineering, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Finance, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams to turn strategy into reality.

It is a high-visibility, fast-moving environment for people who enjoy solving difficult problems, working across disciplines, and building things where the playbook does not yet exist.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Senior Associate, Global Expansion Strategy & Operations, you will help take new Airwallex markets from strategy to launch across the Americas.

You will work alongside senior members of the CEO Office and leaders across the company to answer some of the hardest questions involved in entering a new financial market: Where should we enter? How should we enter? What do we need to build? What could prevent us from launching? And how do we make each subsequent expansion faster and more scalable?

This role goes beyond traditional program management. You will be expected to understand the substance behind the workstreams you support, form hypotheses, identify what is actually blocking progress, and help move complex issues toward decisions.

Over time, you will develop a broad understanding of how a global financial platform is built – from regulatory strategy and product infrastructure to operations and commercial launch.

This role is based in San Francisco.

- Build market-entry strategies. Assess market attractiveness, customer opportunity, competitive dynamics, regulatory feasibility, and Airwallex’s right to win. Help develop recommendations on where we should expand and what capabilities we need to succeed.

- Design the market-entry model. Evaluate licensing pathways, entity structures, partnerships, and operating models. Work with Legal, Compliance, Finance, Treasury, and other teams to translate regulatory constraints into practical business and operating decisions.

- Translate strategy into product requirements. Partner with Product and Engineering to convert market-entry and regulatory requirements into concrete product scope, sequencing, and launch dependencies. Help ensure the roadmap reflects what is actually required to operate and scale locally.

- Drive cross-functional launch readiness. Own defined workstreams within market launches and work across functions to identify critical-path dependencies, surface blockers early, establish clear ownership, and drive issues toward resolution. Support go/no-go decisions across product, regulatory, operational, risk, and commercial dimensions.

- Enable executive decision-making. Synthesize complex and sometimes conflicting perspectives into clear choices and recommendations. Prepare concise materials for CEO Office and executive leadership on market prioritization, investment decisions, key trade-offs, risks, and launch readiness.

- Build the Global Expansion operating system. Develop reusable frameworks, dashboards, templates, and lightweight AI-enabled tools that make expansion more systematic. Automate areas such as regulatory research, licence mapping, competitive intelligence, status reporting, risk tracking, and dependency management where doing so improves speed and quality.

- Take on broader CEO Office priorities. Flex onto high-priority initiatives beyond core market expansion, including strategic reviews, restructuring or migration programs, crisis-response workstreams, and cross-market operating or structuring questions.

- 2–4 years of experience in top-tier strategy consulting (MBB or equivalent), or in a strategy, operations, expansion, product strategy, or regulatory role within fintech, payments, banking, or financial infrastructure.

- Strong structured problem-solving skills. You can take an ambiguous problem, break it down, identify what matters most, and develop a point of view without waiting for perfect information.

- Experience driving at least one complex cross-functional initiative involving product, regulatory, operational, or commercial stakeholders, with clear personal ownership for moving the work forward.

- Excellent communication and synthesis. You can go deep enough to understand a complex issue and then explain it clearly and concisely to different audiences, including senior stakeholders.

- High ownership and operating discipline. You move quickly, manage dependencies and follow-through reliably, seek feedback early, and are willing to roll up your sleeves when needed.

- Comfort using AI tools. You use AI for research, analysis, drafting, synthesis, or workflow improvement and exercise sound judgment around verification, source quality, and when human expertise is required.

Snowflake is seeking a seasoned Financial Services Industry Architect with deep, hands-on experience designing and delivering transformation initiatives powered by data, analytics, and AI. The ideal candidate has worked directly with banks, financial services organizations to modernize core systems, unify transactional and risk data, and translate business priorities into scalable technical architectures and measurable business outcomes.

- Partner with customers on strategic opportunities: You will drive customer engagement in strategic deals where your industry expertise can help drive Snowflake adoption. You'll build trusted relationships with executives, chief data officers, chief risk officers, and enterprise data architects at banks and finance organizations, acting as a trusted advisor who blends business and technical context to advance opportunities.

description:

title: English Teacher
description:

English at Pembroke is taught by a large, dynamic team across Years 7 to 12, spanning both SACE and the International Baccalaureate. Our Middle School curriculum has been recently redesigned around conceptual threads and a portfolio-based approach to assessment that prioritises the process of learning, not just its products. Our teachers enjoy considerable freedom in text selection, within a framework of high academic expectations, and our faculty culture is one of collegiality, intellectual curiosity and serious engagement with pedagogy. Our staff contribute to curriculum design, and are supported to grow as practitioners at every career stage.

About the Role
Successful applicants will teach across the secondary years, with allocations shaped by experience and strengths. Depending on the appointment, this may include Middle School classes, senior SACE English subjects, or IB Diploma Language A courses.

Key Responsibilities include:
- Delivering engaging, rigorous and innovative English lessons that foster a love of learning
- Supporting students to develop strong literacy, analytical and communication skills
- Providing purposeful assessment and feedback that supports every students' growth
- Contributing to a positive and collaborative culture across the Middle and Senior Schools
- Actively participating in the life of the School through co-curricular and pastoral care contributions.

About You
You are an effective teacher first and foremost, with demonstrated impact on student learning and a command of your subject that lets you teach with both rigour and imagination.

You will bring:
- Strong subject knowledge and a love of literature and language that students can feel
- Evidence-informed, responsive pedagogy and high expectations of every learner
- Capacity or willingness to teach across SACE and IB pathways (IB experience is valued but not required; training and support are provided)
- Strong communication with students, families and colleagues
- A collaborative disposition and a genuine interest in contributing to faculty and school life

Applications at All Career Stages
We welcome applications from experienced practitioners and from graduate and early-career teachers alike. Early-career appointees are supported through structured mentoring and induction as part of a faculty that takes professional growth seriously.

Required for Employment (Prior to Commencement)

- Current Plink RRHAN-EC training: Masterclass and Fundamentals, including Protective Practices

Find Your Place At Pembroke

Whether in the classroom, on the sporting field, or behind the scenes, every role contributes to shaping the rich and inclusive culture of the School. With opportunities for professional growth, a strong sense of belonging, and a genuine appreciation for staff, Pembroke is a place where your work is seen, valued, and celebrated.

Read more in The Heart of Pembroke - Celebrating our Staff.

Pembroke School is a co-educational, non-denominational, day and boarding School from Early Learning Centre to Year 12. Renowned for academic excellence and a broad, inclusive program, Pembroke offers the South Australian Certificate of Education (SACE) and is also an International Baccalaureate World School, offering the IB Diploma Programme (IBDP) and Primary Years Programme (PYP).

Pembroke is a vibrant and exciting School catering for a diverse community of students. With over 1,700 students, the School offers a broad-ranging curriculum and an outstanding choice of co-curricular opportunities. The School employs over 300 permanent and fixed-term staff, plus more than 150 casual employees.

Pembroke seeks to engage outstanding, diverse and well-qualified staff to work in our welcoming and open School. All staff work together to provide an environment that facilitates each studentâs exploration of their potential, academic progress and personal welfare. Staff are encouraged to maintain a collaborative approach, a broad outlook within their respective field and a commitment to ongoing professional development and continuous improvement. Pembroke is a lively and fulfilling place to work.

Applications for this position close on Sunday, 6 September 2026, at 11:59 pm.

Работа у нас — это: официальное оплачиваемое трудоустройство;период буткемпа — до 12 месяцев;классная адаптация, профессиональные наставники и погружение в задачи с первого дня;обучающие встречи: воркшопы, лекции и обмен опытом внутри дизайн-комьюнити Авито;техника для продуктивной работы и компенсация питания;доступ к корпоративным онлайн-библиотекам «МИФ» и «Альпина»;забота о здоровье: в офисе принимают терапевт и массажист, есть два тренажёрных зала с душевыми, функциональные тренировки с тренером;замечательный офис в двух минутах от метро «Белорусская»: панорамный вид на центр города, места для уединённой работы и зоны отдыха.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Remote) - UK
description:
*The role:*

We are looking for highly talented and driven software engineers who take pride in their work, to expand our Engineering team in London. Successful candidates will join a cross functional team including product managers and designers working closely with the rest of our business to deliver working code that solves real problems for both internal and external customers. You will take ownership of the services managed by your team, ensuring that their development aligns with the higher level AlphaSights Engineering strategy, while mentoring more junior Engineers. If you have a strong passion for solving problems with code, and want to work with exceptional colleagues in a high achievement environment, this role is a good fit for you.

*What you’ll do:*

* *Design solutions:* Define the best technical solutions to business problems, contributing to an architectural vision that will scale up to be the world's leading research platform.
* *Ship working code:* We primarily work with React on the frontend and Kotlin microservices with Postgres on the backend, with some older services written in Ruby on Rails. We’ve always got an eye open to assess new technologies that might improve our stack.
* *Deploy and iterate:* We release frequently to our customers, using CIrcleCI and Spinnaker for CI/CD, and quickly gather feedback in order to inform our next iteration.
* *Build your competency:* You will learn quickly by building market-leading technology with experienced colleagues in a high performance environment. Engineers can also use our L&D budget to fast-track development of specific technical competencies.
* *Maintenance and troubleshooting:* Carefully monitor our services, catching errors before users notice them, diagnosing the root cause and deploying fixes.

*Who you are:*

* You probably have *a degree in a STEM subject* , but we’re happy to work with people who perfected their craft via a different route.
* *Experience working at a similar level in a mature Engineering team for 5+ years* , and looking to take your career to the next level. We’re looking for people who have incredible potential.
* *Technical expertise* with at least one programming language (we use Kotlin and a bit of Ruby), and ideally experience with relational databases.
* *Proven track record –* You’ve made a demonstrable impact in your previous roles, standing out from your peers. **
* *Highly driven and proactive –* you relentlessly and independently push through hurdles and drive towards excellent outcomes.
* *Meticulous* – you hold high standards and have an obsessive attention to detail.

Learn more about our tech organization here!

Don't worry if your experience or background doesn't match all of these areas, we believe a broad spectrum of experience provides great perspective on solving problems in new and innovative ways and we’d love to hear from you.

Please note that unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor visas for this position. AlphaSights is an equal opportunity employer.

**THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION EXCLUSIVELY FOR CURRENT UK RESIDENTS.*

title: Jr. Quality Assurance Specialist - Evening Shift
description:
Schedule:

* All applicants must be available to work Mondays -Fridays 10am - 7pm EST with rotating weekends. (required shift)

What do we do?

ACD Connect. is an innovative, virtual company that thrives on brokering solutions for our non-profit clients. ACD’s heartbeat and competitive edge is powered by our people. Our company has grown from providing routine call center services to providing high-level, full-scale donor support resources and products. Our proprietary scripting engine, web forms and custom-built reporting enable clients to successfully conduct large-scale fundraising campaigns with accuracy and creativity.

What will you do?

The Junior Quality Assurance Specialist – P supports the daily Call Review and Quality Monitoring program by evaluating entry-to-mid-level customer interactions, checking adherence to service standards, verifying compliance with standard operating procedures (SOPs), and documenting evaluation metrics. Working closely with Team Leads and partnering with the Account Manager, this position assists in identifying quality trends and baseline coaching opportunities and provides designated operational support to Team Leads, including attendance tracking and the facilitation and tracking of 1:1s and documented coaching. The role does not independently manage employees; people-management support is performed under Team Lead oversight and Account Manager review, as applicable, to maintain high operational standards and client compliance across remote operations.

Training

The schedule for training will be in the afternoon 9am -5pm EST Monday-Friday for 1 month. Once the month of training ends permanent schedule will be 10am - 7pm EST.

Responsibilities

* Evaluate customer service calls, chats, and tickets for standard accuracy, policy compliance, and service quality.
* Audit routine evaluations for scoring consistency, objectivity, and adherence to company rubrics.
* Identify individual and team-level quality trends, common coaching opportunities, and workflow gaps.
* Support Tier 1 and Tier 2 Support Specialists by providing objective evaluation data for employee development.
* Maintain familiarity with Call Review policies, standard evaluation forms, and routine QA scoring criteria.
* Log daily evaluation data and assist in updating QA trackers, SOP summaries, and training audit materials.
* Participate in regularly scheduled quality review and calibration sessions with Team Leads and QA Specialists.
* Prepare preliminary routine QA summaries and report recurring compliance findings to leadership.
* Investigate low Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores and assist in identifying root causes or process improvement areas.
* Assist the Support Specialist team with follow-ups, standard research, and operational reporting.
* Assist Team Leads with designated team-management support activities, including coordinating, facilitating, documenting, and tracking employee 1:1s and documented coaching under Team Lead oversight and with Account Manager review, as applicable.
* Participate, as assigned, in Team Leads’ monthly 1:1 calibration and coaching sessions for new hires and Support Specialists identified as needing additional coaching, development, or goal support. The Junior QA Specialist may assist the Team Lead with relevant QA findings, facilitation support, and documenting and tracking coaching goals, action items, and follow-up progress. Participation is limited to these designated developmental coaching sessions; the Team Lead retains responsibility for the 1:1, employee coaching, and people-management decisions, with Account Manager review as applicable.
* Assist Team Leads and the Account Manager with attendance and schedule-adherence tracking, including reviewing available records, verifying discrepancies, completing appropriate follow-up, and maintaining supporting documentation. Escalate identified concerns to the Team Lead or Account Manager for determination and action.
* Exercise moderate operational authority within assigned QA and Team Lead support responsibilities while recognizing that final people-management, performance-management, disciplinary, scheduling, and other supervisory decisions remain with the Team Lead and/or Account Manager.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, special auditing tasks, and documentation reviews.
* Assist the Team Lead with client-facing interactions and may participate directly in designated client communications, meetings, or account-related tasks as determined and approved by the Account Manager. Client-facing involvement is limited to assigned, AM-approved scope.
* Perform other duties and operational projects as assigned.

What does it take?

* 1 year management experience.
* 2+ years’ experience working in a virtual contact center.
* Knowledgeable in Microsoft Office products, general virtual and telephony platforms.
* Time management and customer service skills.

• USB Headset

• Webcam - All training is 100% on camera
• Laptop or PC (No tablets/Chromebooks/Macs)

Our systems are not compatible with MacBooks, Apple devices, Chromebooks, or tablets. This position requires the use of a personal desktop or laptop running a Windows operating system, Microsoft Office Products with compatibility for HP platforms and software.

All applicants applying from these states or internationally unfortunately cannot be considered.

title: Junior Account Manager
description:
*POSITION SUMMARY:*

The Junior Account Manager supports the successful day-to-day management and delivery of assigned client accounts and programs. Working closely with Account Managers, Client Services leadership, Staffing, and project delivery teams, this role helps coordinate client requests, staffing & event requirements, program documentation, reporting, and operational deliverables.

The Junior Account Manager serves as a supporting point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders, helping ensure communication is timely, information is accurate, and programs are executed in accordance with client expectations and Elevate's operational standards.

This role is designed for an individual developing their account management and client services expertise. The Junior Account Manager will gain increasing responsibility for client communication and account operations while learning to independently manage client relationships and programs.

*ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES:*

*1. Client & Account Support*

* Support Account Managers in the day-to-day management of assigned client accounts and programs.

* Take the lead on smaller-scale projects and activations, managing client communication, internal coordination, timelines, and delivery from brief through to completion, with appropriate Account Manager oversight.

* Serve as a supporting point of contact for clients on routine program updates, requests, and operational matters.

* Assist with client communications and ensure requests, decisions, and action items are accurately documented and communicated to appropriate internal teams.

* Participate in client calls, status meetings, briefings, and program reviews.

* Prepare meeting agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up communications as needed.

* Maintain professional, responsive, and client-focused communication.

* Escalate significant client concerns, changes in scope, or service issues to the Account Manager or appropriate Client Services leader.

*2. Program & Operational Coordination*

* Support the planning and execution of staffing programs, activations, and client initiatives.

* Assist in translating client requirements into clear operational and staffing needs.

* Coordinate with Staffing, Project Management, HR, Payroll, and other internal teams to support successful program delivery.

* Track schedules, staffing requirements, program milestones, deadlines, and outstanding deliverables.

* Help ensure internal teams have accurate and current information regarding client requirements and program expectations.

* Monitor program readiness and proactively identify potential gaps, delays, or operational concerns.

* Support on-site and live event operations as required, acting as a key point of contact between Elevate, the client, and Brand Ambassadors. Responsibilities may include managing staff check-ins and check-outs, monitoring attendance and punctuality, coordinating breaks and shift coverage, responding to staffing issues, communicating client updates to the team, supporting Brand Ambassadors throughout the event, and escalating any operational or client concerns appropriately.

* Escalate operational issues appropriately and assist with resolution and follow-through.

*3. Staffing & Talent Coordination*

* Partner with Staffing and project delivery teams to support fulfillment of client staffing requirements.

* Assist with communicating program requirements, scheduling information, and client expectations to appropriate internal teams.

* Track staffing progress and identify potential fulfillment concerns.

* Monitor feedback regarding field staff performance and communicate relevant concerns to Account Managers, Staffing, or HR as appropriate.

* Help maintain alignment between client expectations, staffing plans, and program execution.

*4. Documentation & Reporting*

* Maintain accurate and current client files, program documentation, briefs, schedules, and account records.

* Support the preparation of client-facing documents, presentations, status updates, and program materials.

* Assist with post-activation reporting, program recaps, and client-facing summaries.

* Track assigned account and program KPIs and compile information for Account Manager review.

* Maintain accurate information within CRM, staffing, project management, and other company systems.

* Ensure assigned reports, documents, and administrative deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

*5. Client Service & Continuous Improvement*

* Support consistent delivery of a high-quality client experience throughout the program lifecycle.

* Gather feedback from clients and internal teams and communicate opportunities for improvement.

* Identify recurring operational issues and recommend potential process improvements.

* Support Account Managers in implementing solutions that improve efficiency, communication, and service delivery.

* Develop knowledge of Elevate's services, staffing capabilities, operational processes, and client portfolio.

* Take on increasing account responsibility as experience and proficiency develop.

*EDUCATION*

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, Event Management, or a related field preferred.

* Equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.

*EXPERIENCE*

* 1–3 years of experience in account coordination, client services, project coordination, experiential marketing, staffing, events, hospitality, or a related environment preferred.

* Experience working in a client-facing or customer-facing environment preferred.

* Experience within staffing, experiential marketing, event management, or an agency environment is a plus.

*KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES*

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Excellent organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.

* Ability to build positive working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to recognize when issues require escalation.

* Ability to work effectively across multiple departments and functions.

* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and ability to learn staffing, scheduling, and project management systems.

* Strong administrative and documentation skills.

* Professional judgment and discretion when handling client and employee information.

* Client-service mindset with a willingness to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

* Ability and willingness to learn account management, staffing operations, and experiential program delivery.

*TRAVEL*

* Travel may be required to attend client meetings, activations, events, and other business operations.

* Travel requirements will vary based on assigned accounts and programs.

*PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS*

* Ability to work at a computer for extended periods.

* Ability to travel by automobile and commercial airline when required.

* Ability to lift up to 20 pounds on occasion.

* Ability to attend client meetings and on-site events.

* jest otwarta na naukę, feedback i długofalowy rozwój.

Nie wymagamy wcześniejszego doświadczenia technicznego - nauczymy Cię, jak rozumieć role IT i prowadzić skuteczne procesy rekrutacyjne.

* Vom Konzept bis zum Release: du treibst den gesamten Design-Prozess voran.
* Neue Ideen setzt du schnell in klickbare Prototypen um (z. B. in Figma) und entwickelst sie iterativ weiter.
* Du übersetzt deine UI/UX-Konzepte direkt in sauberen Frontend-Code.
* Als Bindeglied zum Entwicklerteam arbeitest du eng und auf Augenhöhe mit ihnen zusammen.

## Das bringst du mit

### Fachlich

* Du lernst gern und nie aus.
* Kreativität ist deine Berufung.
* Erfahrung im UI/UX-Design (Figma)
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; gutes Englisch
* Du denkst logisch, arbeitest strukturiert und bringst einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch mit.
* Grundlegendes BWL-Verständnis

### Sozial

* Du bist ein Energiegeber.
* Du bist empathisch und kommunikationsstark.
* Du arbeitest gerne proaktiv im Team mit.

### Persönlich

* Du bist initiativ und hast Schaffensfreude.
* Du willst Dinge voranbringen, eine gesunde Unzufriedenheit treibt dich an.
* Du bist effektiv und hartnäckig, wenn es darauf ankommt.

## Wir bieten

* 100% Remote – echtes ortsunabhängiges Arbeiten
* Flexible Arbeitszeiten – damit Arbeiten in deinen Alltag passt
* Teilzeit – Umfang nach Vereinbarung (mind. 20 Std./Woche)
* Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
* Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Aufstiegs- und Weiterentwicklungschancen in einem dynamischen Umfeld.
* Eintritt ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

* User personas
* Journey maps
* User flows
* Information architecture
* Product requirements

* Ensure usability across browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

* Comfortable balancing user needs with business objectives.

* Data-driven approach to design decisions.

* Experience creating:

* User flows
* Wireframes
* Interactive prototypes
* Design systems

* Strong understanding of:

* UX principles

* Familiarity with:

* Mixpanel
* Amplitude

*Tools & Technologies*
----------------------

* Figma
* Adobe XD
* Sketch
* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Zeplin

* Collaboration & Project Management Tools

*What a Typical Day Looks Like*
-------------------------------

* Conduct user research and analyze product insights.
* Design wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces.
* Build and refine scalable design systems.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineers on new features.
* Run usability tests and improve user journeys.
* Deliver developer-ready assets and documentation.
* Iterate designs using customer feedback and analytics.

*In short:* You’ll design intuitive, scalable product experiences that improve usability, engagement, and customer satisfaction while helping shape the future of the product.

*Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)*
--------------------------------

* Improved usability and customer satisfaction.
* Increased user engagement and feature adoption.
* Higher product retention.
* Reduced UX friction across key workflows.
* Consistent implementation of scalable design systems.

-------------------

title: Web Designer
description:
===

Process: https://hexhq.notion.site/Hex-s-Web-Designer-Interview-Process-2ee45d6bfe7c8057ba69fcf715b02812

TeamPage: https://hexhq.notion.site/Design-Hex-21a4d4a08e23457faad1378455e18ac0

===

Members of the Brand Design team bring the Hex brand to life across every customer and employee touchpoint. As our Web Designer, you will lead the Web pillar within Brand Design — owning the strategy, UX/UI, art direction, and execution across our website, documentation surfaces, and other web surfaces.

You’ll operate as both a player/coach and eventually hire + mentor a small web design team as we scale.

----------------
*About the role*
----------------

Own and execute the design and experience of Hex’s web surfaces, including our website, documentation site, product launches, and future digital experiences.

This is first and foremost a highly hands-on design role. You’ll own work from concept through final execution, setting an exceptional bar for visual design, UX, typography, interaction, and craft.

You’ll also play a major role in how Hex tells its product story. Working closely with Product Marketing, Content, and Product, you’ll help determine how our product is represented across marketing surfaces: what we show, what we simplify, what deserves interaction or motion, and how design can make complex ideas feel clear and compelling.

While broader web and content strategy is shared across Marketing, this role will own the design and UX strategy of our web experiences, bringing a strong point of view on how structure, interaction, visual hierarchy, and product storytelling come together.

What you’ll do
--------------

*Design and web experience*

* Own and execute the design and UX of Hex’s website, documentation site, campaign experiences, and future web surfaces.
* Create exceptional, highly crafted digital experiences from early concept through shipped execution.
* Establish and maintain visual quality, patterns, interaction principles, and consistency across Hex’s web ecosystem.
* Continually evolve core surfaces rather than treating the website as a collection of one-off redesign projects.
* Partner with Marketing on broader web priorities while owning the design perspective on hierarchy, UX, interaction, and how users experience the Hex story.
* Balance strong systems thinking with the ability to create bespoke moments when the story calls for something more distinctive.

*Product launches and storytelling*

* Own and execute the design expression of major product launches alongside Brand and Product Marketing.
* Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling, and memorable visual stories.
* Participate early in launch and content planning, bringing a design perspective to how a story should unfold rather than simply executing against a finished brief.
* Develop a strong point of view on how Hex’s product should be depicted across marketing, from product UI and screenshots to demos, diagrams, illustration, conceptual visuals, and interactive experiences.
* Help determine what needs to be shown, what can be simplified, and which ideas benefit from demonstration rather than explanation.
* Create repeatable storytelling patterns that allow our product to feel coherent across the homepage, product pages, launches, campaigns, events, and content.
* Ensure major product moments feel visually clear, differentiated, and unmistakably Hex.

*Motion and interaction*

* Use motion and interaction intentionally to clarify ideas, demonstrate product behavior, and make Hex feel alive.
* Create lightweight motion, product animations, micro-interactions, transitions, and interactive storytelling moments.
* Establish a strong point of view on where motion adds meaning versus decoration.
* Explore new ways to make product stories more dynamic and experiential across the web.
* Partner with motion specialists or external collaborators when an idea requires deeper production support.

*Design and UX strategy*

* Bring a strong point of view on how UX, visual hierarchy, interaction, and narrative work together.
* Help define how different audiences encounter and understand Hex across our marketing surfaces.
* Partner with Brand, Content, Product Marketing, and Product on content planning, identifying where design can make a story clearer or more compelling.
* Help determine how information should be structured and sequenced, what deserves emphasis, and what format is best suited to telling a particular product story.
* Influence how Hex represents an increasingly broad product platform without losing clarity or personality.
* Identify opportunities to evolve Hex’s digital design language and how we show up in the world.
* Use research, performance signals, experimentation, and design intuition to continually improve the experience.

*Hands-on development*

* Take your own designs all the way into production using HTML, CSS, React/Next.js.
* Prototype and ship interactive experiences where working directly in the browser produces a better result.
* Use AI-assisted design and development tools to prototype, explore, and ship high-quality experiences faster.
* Experiment with emerging AI tools and workflows, with strong judgment about where they improve the work and where craft still needs a human hand.
* Collaborate closely with engineering partners on larger or more technically complex work.
* Care deeply about implementation details and ensure the shipped experience reflects the intent of the design.
* Help establish front-end patterns and workflows that make high-quality execution faster and more repeatable.
* Balance creative ambition with performance, accessibility, maintainability, and speed.

*Team and creative influence*

* Influence the processes, standards, critique rituals, and creative culture of the Design team.
* Help establish stronger ways of working across Brand, Product Marketing, Product Design, Content, and Engineering.
* Bring external inspiration and new thinking into how Hex approaches digital design and product storytelling.
* Identify where additional design, motion, or engineering support could have the greatest impact.

---------
About you
---------

You might be a great fit if you:

* Have 8+ years of experience across web, visual, UI, or digital product design.
* Have exceptional hands-on craft across UX, typography, interaction, and visual systems.
* Are a strong product storyteller, particularly for technical, B2B, developer, data, or product-led companies.
* Think strategically about design and UX and can connect creative decisions to audience, narrative, product, and business goals.
* Have a strong eye for motion and interaction.
* Can ship production-quality work in HTML, CSS, and React/Next.js.
* Are curious and capable with AI-assisted design and development workflows.
* Operate autonomously and are comfortable owning work from concept through launch.

In addition to our unique culture, Hex proudly offers a competitive total rewards package, including but not limited to, market-benched salary & equity, comprehensive health benefits, and flexible paid time off.

The salary range for this role is: $170,00 - $240,000

The salary range shown may be a reflection of additional factors such as geographical location and skill ranges/levels we’re open to. Placement in the salary range will be decided upon completion of the interview process, taking into account factors like leaving room for growth, internal fairness & parity, your demonstrated skills, and the depth of your experience. Our Recruiting team will be able to provide more details during the interview process.

By submitting an application the candidate consents to the use of their personal information in accordance with the Hex Privacy policy: .

Hex Technologies uses AI-assisted tools as part of our application review process, including for resume screening and fraud detection. These tools help our *team* evaluate applications and verify applicant information. All AI-generated recommendations are reviewed by a member of our recruiting team before any hiring decision is made. No application is automatically rejected based solely on an AI tool's output.

title: UX Engineer
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes for patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We are hiring a UX Engineer to own and evolve our design system and shared UI patterns, enabling faster, more consistent product development across teams.

This role sits within Engineering and operates as a bridge between Design, Product, and Frontend Engineering. The UX Engineer ensures that design intent translates cleanly into production by building and maintaining high-quality, reusable UI primitives, components, and interaction patterns.

A core focus of the role is enabling designers and product teams to leverage reliable, production-aligned building blocks rather than creating bespoke solutions.

*As a UX Engineer, you will:*

* Own and evolve the design system as a product, including components, patterns, and usage standards.
* Build and maintain reusable UI primitives and interaction patterns that scale across teams.
* Proactively manage frontend UX-related technical debt, resolving quality gaps and inconsistencies that slow development.
* Conduct coded prototyping for complex workflows using synthetic or mock data, especially for data-dense or AI-enabled experiences.
* Improve experience quality and consistency across motion, responsive behavior, and mobile contexts.
* Partner closely with Design and Product during discovery to validate feasibility and reduce downstream rework.
* Act as the interface between design intent and frontend implementation, resolving ambiguity and aligning on constraints.
* Contribute production-quality code and collaborate with engineering on system-level frontend decisions.

*You should get in touch if:*

* You have Advanced frontend engineering expertise (React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Storybook), and experience shipping production UI.
* You have Experience working with design systems and component libraries at scale.
* You have High design fluency, with attention to interaction detail, usability, accessibility, and visual quality.
* You have Experience working in AI-enabled development environments or leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate workflows.

*Benefits Overview* :

* *Financial Well-Being* : Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
* *Physical Well-Being* : We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
* *Mental Well-Being* : We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
* *Professional Development* : Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

* Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
* Reimbursement for office setup expenses
* Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
* Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
* Paid parental leave for all new parents
* And much more!

*About Counterpart Health:* In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

#LI-REMOTE

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

$157,000 — $205,000 USD

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
BCom is a fast-growing, digital-first marketing agency that amplifies purpose-driven ideas. We partner with campaigns, causes, and brands to do work that matters. From online fundraising to media, advertising, and creative, our team has raised millions of dollars, built coalitions, and won tough fights. We’re building something special and looking for top talent to help take it to the next level. As we work toward ambitious growth goals, we want driven, strategic thinkers who are committed to doing great work and building something meaningful together.

We are hiring a *Senior Web Designer* to lead the quality, consistency, and execution of digital experiences across campaigns, brands, and client engagements. This is a hands-on role focused on designing and building high-performance websites that bring creative vision to life through thoughtful UI and UX execution. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of website development, from site mapping and wireframing in Figma to final build and launch in WordPress using a page builder, translating high-level creative direction into polished, interactive digital experiences. Partnering closely with the Art Director - Design and Creative Director while owning execution, you will ensure all websites are visually strong, intuitive to navigate, mobile responsive, accessible, and optimized for performance and conversion, collaborating with strategists, copywriters, designers, and account teams to deliver high-impact web solutions that align with client goals and drive results.

At BCom, we take pride in delivering top-tier work while showing up for each other. With our mission at the forefront, we center honesty, collaboration, and meaningful relationships in everything we do. If you’re looking to grow with a team rooted in purpose and committed to impact, we would like to meet you!

*Key Areas of Responsibility*
-----------------------------

UI/UX Design & Prototyping
--------------------------

* Translate abstract client goals and brand guidelines into intuitive sitemaps, wireframes, and user flows.
* Design high-fidelity website mockups and interactive prototypes in Figma, establishing the visual language for digital projects.
* Apply modern UI/UX principles to ensure websites are user-friendly, accessible (WCAG standards), and responsive across all screen sizes.
* Create web design systems, including button styles, typography hierarchies, page sections, and component libraries, to ensure consistency across pages.
* Present design concepts to internal teams and clients, articulating the rationale behind layout and usability decisions.

CMS Implementation & Build
--------------------------

* Take approved designs and build them pixel-perfectly within WordPress using the Elementor page builder (or similar frameworks).
* Manage the technical setup of pages, including installing necessary plugins, configuring forms, and integrating third-party tools (CRMs, donation platforms).
* Collaborate with back-end developers on complex functionality, providing them with clear design assets and specifications.
* Conduct thorough Quality Assurance (QA) testing across browsers and devices to ensure the site functions flawlessly before launch.

*Site Maintenance & Optimization*

* *Execute ongoing website updates, landing page creation, and content refreshes for existing clients.*
* *Troubleshoot visual bugs, broken links, or layout shifts that occur after browser or plugin updates.*
* *Optimize images and assets for web performance to ensure fast load times and strong Core Web Vitals scores.*
* *Monitor live sites for design consistency and recommend visual improvements or modernizations as trends and client needs evolve.*

**Required Skills**
-------------------

*Hard Skills*
-------------

* *Mastery of Figma for web design, prototyping, and developer handoff.*
* *Expertise in WordPress and page builders (specifically Elementor) for custom site construction.*
* *Strong working knowledge of HTML and CSS to customize themes and troubleshoot layout issues beyond the limitations of a page builder.*
* *Understanding of SEO best practices (structure, hierarchy, speed) and digital accessibility standards.*
* *Experience integrating marketing tools (forms, tracking pixels, CRMs) into web pages.*

*Soft Skills*
-------------

* *Ability to balance aesthetic beauty with the functional realities of site performance and loading speed.*
* *Determination to figure out why a layout is breaking or a plugin is conflicting without needing immediate developer intervention.*
* *Comfortable speaking the languages of both "Art" (Designers) and "Code" (Developers).*
* *Highly collaborative and comfortable working across teams, roles, and functions.*
* *Comfortable presenting work to clients and internal partners in a confident, compelling way.*
* *Creative problem solver with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.*
* *Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality.*
* *Receptive to feedback and committed to iterative improvement.*
* *Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.*

*The purpose-driven work that our clients rely on us for every day is challenging and edgy. It can be stressful at times. We rely on a shared set of company values that serve as the ultimate guide for team, client and company growth. All successful applicants must align with BCom’s company values which include:*

**One boat, one mission.* We row in the same direction to serve the mission of our company. Do good for our clients and for each other. Collaborate in a way that eases the workload and burden for everyone. Our collective effort is greater than the sum of its parts.*

**Win the tough fights.* Outcomes matter. We keep our clients and their success and goals at the front of everything we do. Purpose-driven work is edgy, fast-paced and challenging. We fight to win every day.*

**Be present.* To win, you have to compete. To compete, you have to show up. We show up for our teammates, for our clients, and for our communities.*

**Relationships matter.* We forge meaningful connections with our clients, our teammates, and the communities we serve — from our founding in rural America to the halls of the nation's capital.*

**Be honest.* We tell the truth with our clients and with each other. We’re honest about our work and the way we do it. Honesty is easy – and convenient – when things are working. It’s hard – but required – when things are tough.*

**Benefits**
------------

* *100% coverage for employee medical, dental and vision plans*
* *401(k) Plan*
* *Paid time off*
* *Paid company holidays*
* *Unlimited sick leave*
* *Flexible remote work options*
* *12 weeks paid parental leave*

*The salary range for this position is $77,300 - $100,500*

*BCom Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is BCom’s policy to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, length of time spent unemployed, as well as other classifications protected by applicable laws. People of color, women, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ individuals, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply.*

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.

Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.

Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world’s most innovative lenders do business.

We're looking for a driven Product Designer who brings their own curiosity and initiative to the work. You thrive in ambiguity, are energized by complex user problems, and naturally gravitate toward finding the design opportunity in every conversation. You move fast—using AI-powered prototyping tools to explore ideas and generate feedback quickly—then translate that thinking into polished, engineer-ready Figma deliverables. You build close partnerships with Product Management and UX Research, and you're as comfortable shaping what gets worked on as you are executing it.

*Responsibilities*

* Define the user experience for our digital product, including the creation of process artifacts such as User Journeys, Interaction patterns, task-flows, sketches, wireframes, and Visual Design
* Take ownership of translating vague or qualitative customer feedback into actionable design hypotheses and workflow improvements
* Proactively seek out friction in the product experience; bring forward design problems before they are assigned to you
* Leverage AI-powered prototyping tools (including Claude, Replit, Figma Make, and similar) to rapidly generate interactive prototypes for fast feedback loops with stakeholders and customers
* Translate AI-assisted prototypes into high-fidelity, developer-ready designs in Figma, ensuring engineers can pick up and implement designs with minimal ambiguity
* Ask the right questions of stakeholders and customers upfront—surface the design inputs that matter and cut through noise to prioritize effectively
* Partner with Product Management and UX Research to identify areas of friction in the mortgage lender workflow and drive design reviews in those areas
* Look for opportunities to solve problems in unique and innovative ways and help maintain visual and brand consistency between all products and platforms
* Build functional prototypes to validate and test your designs

*Requirements*

* 3–5 years of product design experience, with a portfolio that shows real ownership—not just execution of someone else's vision
* *Figma proficiency is required* — candidates without strong Figma experience will not be considered; must be able to produce polished, component-consistent, developer-handoff-ready designs
* Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Figma Make, Replit, or similar) for rapid prototyping; comfortable moving quickly from concept to testable artifact
* A self-starter mentality: you identify problems on your own, form a point of view, and drive toward solutions
* Demonstrated ability to independently interpret ambiguous customer or stakeholder feedback and translate it into structured, actionable UX improvements
* Genuine curiosity about the product and users—you ask questions others don't think to ask and aren't satisfied with surface-level answers
* Strong communication skills—ability to present design decisions confidently, ask sharp questions in stakeholder reviews, and build alignment without being directive
* Solid grounding in UX design and design thinking principles; able to manage your own workflow and deadlines with an emphasis on quality and timely delivery
* A portfolio that demonstrates real problem-solving—not just polish—across digital product experiences
* Familiarity with mortgage lending workflows, underwriting processes, or fintech products is a plus, but hunger to learn the domain matters more
* Comfort with JIRA and Agile environments

*Extra Credits*

* Experience in financial services or mortgage technology products
* Comfort working directly with engineering teams in sprint-based delivery environments
* Exposure to design systems creation or governance
* Curious and inquisitive; patient problem solver; positive and adaptable

*Life at Ocrolus*

We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.

*Our culture is grounded in four core values:* *

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a *Lead Learning Experience Designer* to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors.

In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey.

This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.

Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference.

*Responsibilities*

* Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.
* Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.
* Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance.
* Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.
* Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools.
* Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement.
* Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.

*Qualifications*

*Required*

* Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.
* Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.
* Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.
* Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
* Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.

*Preferred*

* Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations.
* Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones.
* Experience creating learning in modern digital environments using tools such as Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, video editing tools, AI content generation platforms, or similar technologies.
* Experience partnering with product teams or using product design approaches, such as user research, experimentation, prototyping and iteration.
* Knowledge of experimentation methods, A/B testing, learning analytics, product analytics, and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with Wikimedia projects, the Wikimedia movement, or open-source communities.

*You'll Thrive in This Role If You...*

* Think like a designer and builder, comfortable moving from identifying challenges to creating, testing and improving solutions.
* Are curious about how people learn, what motivates participation, and how to leverage modern methods and technology to create memorable learning experiences.
* Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy figuring out what needs to be built rather than waiting for a predefined assignment.
* Excel at collaborating with people from different backgrounds, languages, and areas of expertise.
* Balance creativity with evidence and structure, using data, research, and feedback to guide decisions.
* Care deeply about accessibility, inclusion, and creating learning that supports equitable participation.
* Are inspired by Wikimedia's mission to make knowledge freely available to everyone.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

*As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.*

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries ***. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$117,437 to US$177,624 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

**Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:*

title: Senior Recruiter | G&A
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is hiring a Senior Recruiter to lead critical searches across our G&A functions.

These teams shape how Ramp grows, protects the business, and maintains a high bar as we scale. You will own searches from initial scoping through close, partnering directly with leaders across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions. You will be expected to develop real fluency in each area you support, translate ambiguous business needs into clear hiring strategies, and bring an independent point of view on talent.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally strong at research, assessment, stakeholder partnership, and closing. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating sensitive searches, and creating structure without slowing the business down.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own full-cycle recruiting across Recruiting, Risk, and other G&A functions, from intake and market mapping through offer and close.

- Develop real fluency in the functions you support so you can identify the signals that distinguish exceptional talent beyond title, company, and tenure.

- Partner with hiring leaders to define the hiring thesis, calibrate the bar, and translate ambiguous needs into clear search strategies and interview plans.

- Build proactive pipelines through market research, targeted sourcing, referrals, and thoughtful engagement with passive candidates.

- Advise leaders using market intelligence, recruiting data, and candidate feedback to challenge assumptions and improve hiring decisions.

- Run disciplined, high-velocity processes while delivering a personal candidate experience and leading thoughtful closing strategies for competitive hires.

WHAT YOU NEED

- 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant ownership of G&A, corporate, or specialized business-function searches.

title: Design Engineering Intern
description:
*Location:* Remote (United States)

*Work Model:* Remote

*Industry:* AI recruiting and talent marketplace (B2B SaaS)

*Compensation:* $35–$50 per hour

About the Company
-----------------

TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. We work with dozens of venture-backed startups across AI, developer tools, fintech, and healthcare. The team is small and founder-led, and interns work on live problems rather than practice ones.

The Opportunity
---------------

This is a design engineering internship, which means the same person decides how something should work and then builds it. You will take ideas that arrive as a sentence or a rough sketch and turn them into interfaces people actually use, owning the visual and interaction decisions along the way rather than waiting for a spec.

We care about craft here in a way that is easy to claim and harder to do: spacing, hierarchy, typography, and the small interaction details that make a product feel considered. Because the team is small and the surface is still being shaped, your judgment about how something should feel carries real weight, and you will see the result in front of users quickly.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Design and build product surfaces end to end, from low-fidelity idea to shipped interface.
* Own layout, typography, hierarchy, and interaction detail across the surfaces you build.
* Implement in React, Next.js, and TypeScript, working with the backend services behind each surface.
* Build and extend shared components so the product stays visually consistent as it grows.
* Make interfaces work well across screen sizes and states, including the empty and error ones.

Requirements
------------

* Strong taste for product design, interaction design, and visual detail.
* Experience building with React, Next.js, TypeScript, or similar frontend tools.
* Comfort working from low-fidelity ideas and turning them into usable interfaces.
* Strong understanding of layout, typography, hierarchy, and responsive design.
* Has shipped design or frontend projects, whether independently, in class, or through prior work.
* Clear communicator who can work independently in a remote environment.
