--------------------
ABOUT PLAYPOWER LABS
--------------------

PlayPower Labs builds software for leading EdTech companies that serve millions of learners. We help our clients solve hard product and engineering problems so they can deliver better learner experiences through advanced technology, thoughtful design, and reliable execution.

We've been fully remote since before COVID and plan to stay remote. We are US-based, with a development center in Gandhinagar, India.

---------------
WHAT WE BELIEVE
---------------

*

We believe technology is a force multiplier for education.

*

Great software can make learning more engaging, effective, personalized, and accessible for millions of learners worldwide. The future of education will be shaped by advanced online learning, AI, and education data, and we want to help build that future.

*

Education data combined with AI is opening up new ways to create adaptive, personalized learning experiences. We're here to turn those opportunities into real products that learners, educators, and EdTech companies can actually use.

--------
THE ROLE
--------

We're looking for a high-energy product designer who wants to ship real experiences, not just push pixels in a file.

You'll design intuitive, engaging, AI-powered learning products used by students and educators around the world. You'll take problems from ambiguous to shipped: framing the problem, mapping the flow, designing the screens and states, and building clickable prototypes that prove the experience works. This role is for someone who can design a feature, prototype it fast, hand it off clean, and keep the user in control, especially when AI is doing the heavy lifting.

If you like moving fast, experimenting hard, and using AI as a real design multiplier, you'll fit right in.

You can find details on the interview process here

--------------
WHAT YOU'LL DO
--------------

*

Design UI/UX for AI-based experiences across EdTech web and mobile apps used by students and educators.

*

Own work end to end: problem framing, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and clickable prototypes.

*

Design user-facing AI/LLM features that reduce effort while keeping the user in control, with review, edit, and undo built in.

*

Apply vibe coding and modern AI design tools (Claude Design, Lovable, Figma) to go from idea to working prototype fast.

*

Build and maintain reusable components, variants, and design tokens so the product stays consistent as it scales.

*

Design for accessibility by default: clear labels, keyboard use, focus, contrast, useful errors, and status beyond color (WCAG 2.2 AA).

*

Design mobile-first, responsive interfaces that hold up on a phone and adapt cleanly to desktop.

*

Produce engineering-ready handoffs a developer can start building tomorrow: flows, states, validation rules, and component specs.

*

Collaborate in fast iteration loops with designers, engineers, product, and learning experts to sharpen user flows.

*

Bring energy, ideas, and momentum to a small team building real product.

----------------------
WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
----------------------

*

A strong portfolio of shipped product design across web and mobile, with clear thinking behind the pixels.

*

Strong skills in Figma, and craft in visual and interaction design: hierarchy, spacing, typography, and states.

*

A genuine sense of product: you interrogate the brief, make assumptions explicit, and prioritize what matters.

*

Interest in designing for AI-enhanced, personalized user journeys, and keeping people in control of the AI.

*

Fluent with modern AI design and prototyping tools, and willing to keep experimenting as the tooling evolves.

*

Systems thinking: you design with reusable components, variants, and tokens, not one-off screens.

*

Accessibility-minded, with real care for how the product feels for every user.

*

Product-minded and comfortable moving without perfect instructions.

*

Startup energy: ownership, speed, curiosity, and no "that's not my job" attitude.

------------
BONUS POINTS
------------

*

You've designed for EdTech, or for students, teachers, or classrooms specifically.

*

You've built and maintained a design system, or shipped a real component library.

*

You can prototype in code (HTML/CSS, React, or tools like Lovable) to make handoffs sharper and iterations faster.

*

You've designed AI-powered product features and thought hard about failure states, guardrails, and human review.

-------------
WHAT WE OFFER
-------------

Remote work, competitive pay, real ownership, space to experiment, and a small team that cares about building good products without corporate theater.

title: Product Owner – Mobile Application
description:
*About the Role*

For our client, we are looking for an experienced Product Owner to take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of a customer-facing mobile application.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, UX/UI designers, developers, QA engineers, and other product and technology teams to translate business and customer needs into clear product priorities and deliver high-quality mobile experiences.

The ideal candidate combines a strong product mindset, understanding of mobile application development, excellent stakeholder management skills, and the ability to turn complex requirements into actionable work for an Agile development team.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Own and continuously prioritize the mobile application product backlog.
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and priorities for the development team.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into clear product requirements.
* Work closely with developers, QA engineers, UX/UI designers, architects, and other stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
* Participate in product discovery and help identify opportunities to improve the mobile customer experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, priorities, and expected outcomes.
* Plan and prioritize new features, improvements, technical initiatives, and bug fixes.
* Lead backlog refinement and actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ensure development teams have clear requirements and understand the business value behind each initiative.
* Coordinate dependencies with other products, systems, APIs, and internal teams.
* Gather and analyze feedback from customers, business stakeholders, and development teams.
* Use product data, customer insights, and business requirements to support prioritization decisions.
* Monitor delivered functionality and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support mobile application releases and coordinate readiness across relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure product requirements consider security, privacy, regulatory, and technical requirements where applicable.
* Maintain clear product documentation and communicate progress, priorities, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.

*Requirements*

* Proven experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar product role.
* Hands-on experience working with mobile applications (iOS and/or Android).
* Good understanding of the mobile application development lifecycle.
* Experience managing and prioritizing a product backlog.
* Strong knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.
* Experience creating user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
* Ability to translate business requirements into clear tasks and priorities for technical teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience collaborating with software developers, QA engineers, UX/UI designers, and business teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, technical constraints, and delivery timelines.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Professional working proficiency in English.

*Nice to Have*

* Experience with large-scale or high-traffic consumer mobile applications.
* Understanding of REST APIs, backend integrations, authentication, and mobile application architecture.
* Experience working with analytics and product performance metrics.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, Figma, or similar platforms.
* Experience with mobile application release processes through the Apple App Store and Google Play.
* Understanding of mobile UX/UI principles and accessibility.
* Experience working in regulated or security-sensitive industries.
* Experience collaborating with distributed or international development teams.

*What We Value*

We are looking for someone who takes ownership rather than simply managing a backlog. You should be comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions, making prioritization decisions, and bringing business and technical teams together around common goals.

You should have a strong customer mindset and be interested in understanding not only what needs to be built, but also why it matters and how its success should be measured.

*What You Can Expect*

* Ownership of an important customer-facing mobile product.
* Close collaboration with experienced technology and business professionals.
* Opportunity to influence product priorities and customer experience.
* An Agile environment focused on continuous improvement and high-quality delivery.
* Work on meaningful mobile features used by real customers.
* Opportunities to contribute to both short-term delivery and longer-term product development.

If you have experience building and improving mobile products and enjoy connecting customer needs, business objectives, and technology, we would be happy to hear from you.

****

*What We Offer*

* Project / Industry: Banking
* Location: Remote – open to candidates based in the Baltic States or Poland
* Contract Type: B2B
* Compensation: €4,500–€5,500 per month, depending on experience and qualifications
* Start Date: ASAP
* Work Model: Fully remote
* Opportunity to work on a customer-facing mobile application within the banking sector
* Collaboration with experienced product, technology, and business teams

*Recruitment Process:*

* *CV Screening:* Applications are reviewed within 24 hours.
* *Pre-Screening Interview:* A brief Q/A session ( *Automated or with a Recruiter* ) designed to learn more about your experience related to the required job position. * *Automated Session (Recommended)* – You can complete this session on your own at a time that is convenient for you. The questions and follow-ups are well-structured and designed to highlight your experience and provide detailed insights into your background. This option is recommended because it's usually more detailed and allows us to provide feedback from the hiring manager faster.﻿
* Session with a Recruiter – You can also have the session with a recruiter. The questions are the same, but the discussion may be a bit less detailed, and feedback might take a little longer.﻿

* *Shortlisting:* Qualified candidates are presented to the hiring manager for review.
* *Formal Interviews:* On-site discussions with the hiring manager or project team, with feedback provided within 1-2 weeks.
* *Offer and Onboarding:* Successful candidates receive a formal offer and begin a structured onboarding process.

Information about the processing of your personal data is provided in our Privacy Policy, which is available online at Privacy Policy.﻿

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a versatile, highly skilled Graphic Designer to join the Tendem project (**) andcreate high-quality visual assets for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, layout design, and branding to transform ideas into professional, polished creative assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, layout design, and creating diverse marketing materials.

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Graphic Designer, your focus will be on layouts, infographics, social media templates, and overall visual polish. * Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma to handle a wide spectrum of visual tasks.
* Format Versatility: Seamlessly switch between designing impactful one-pagers and highly engaging digital templates, adapting to the constraints of each medium.

*Additional requirements*

* An adaptable, fast-paced, and detail-oriented mindset.
* Strong dedication to delivering visually polished, professional-grade assets.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to manage diverse visual tasks simultaneously.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$50 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

In this role, you'll apply your expertise in UI/web design, layout, and visual communication to transform briefs and concepts into clean, on-brand, and implementation-ready web designs. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in UI/web design, marketing pages, and digital visual communications.

----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. We need a core specialist dedicated to owning the look and feel of all web-based materials, ensuring they feel consistent, polished, and perfectly aligned with the broader brand ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Design high-converting one-pagers, pitch-style landing pages, and simple marketing sites based on textual copy, outlines, or existing drafts.
* Translate brand assets and social media visuals into responsive web layouts, structured components, and sections that can be easily implemented by developers or no-code tools. • Prepare and securely package production-ready files (organizing Figma frames, exporting assets, and detailing specs) for seamless handoff.
* Ensure absolute visual consistency between interactive web pages, static PDFs, and social materials.
* Enforce layout quality standards through systematic verification of responsiveness, proper spacing, clarity, and adherence to modern web trends prior to delivery.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in web design, UI design, digital marketing design, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related creative/technical fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on landing pages, marketing websites, and product or startup one-pagers demonstrating clear hierarchy and strong typography. We are looking for specialists who are confident working from rough prompts, AI-generated drafts, or existing brand systems to convert them into structured, implementation-ready web designs. A user-centric, conversion-minded approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Web & UI Design: Deep proficiency in Figma for creating scalable, responsive web layouts, auto-layout components, and comprehensive design systems.
* Conversion-Driven Layouts: Expertise in structuring high-converting, pitch-style landing pages with a strong eye for clarity, spacing, and modern design trends.
* Developer Handoff: Solid understanding of how to prepare, spec, and package digital assets for efficient implementation via developers or no-code platforms (e.g., Webflow, Framer).
* Cross-Platform Consistency: Ability to seamlessly translate core brand aesthetics across varying touchpoints, ensuring web pages match existing social materials and pitch decks.

*Additional requirements*

* A structured, user-centric, and conversion-minded approach to design.
* Strong eye for clarity, white space, and modern web layout trends.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver production-ready assets fast.
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
* *Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with web design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant web design cases, will not be considered.*

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$40 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

You’re a brand designer with a strong focus on print and editorial, and you enjoy bringing brands into the physical world. You think beyond the screen, considering how a design will translate to a 20-foot vinyl wrap, event signage or printed piece. You’re equally comfortable supporting digital work, from social templates to landing page graphics, and you apply strong design fundamentals across every touchpoint. You’re curious, proactive and detail-oriented, digging into problems and catching the small things that make a big difference in the final execution.

Producing print marketing materials such as flyers and signage that stay on brand and print ready

Preparing print ready files with correct bleed, trim, color mode and vendor specs across InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop

Applying HighLevel brand guidelines consistently across every physical and print touchpoint

Taking feedback on assigned projects and applying it quickly to keep production timelines on track

Strong working knowledge of Adobe InDesign, this is the most important skill for this role

Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

*

Working knowledge of Figma

A portfolio that shows real print production experience, not just digital mockups of print pieces, digital branding samples are a plus

Understanding of print fundamentals including bleed, trim, color profiles, file setup and vendor requirements for large format printing

*

Comfort moving between print and light digital branding work without missing a beat

*

Sharp attention to detail, you catch the small things before they turn into big and expensive problems

A curious, hands on problem solving mindset, you want to understand how something gets built and installed, not just how it looks in a file

Ability to work independently on problems of limited scope while learning to apply company standards and processes

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and iterating quickly

1-3 years of professional design experience, internships and apprenticeships included

Bachelor's degree in graphic design, visual communication or a related field preferred, equivalent experience and a strong portfolio will be considered

Required portfolio showcasing print and editorial design work, large format or event based work and digital branding samples

Ability to balance speed, creativity, quality and business priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Strong written and verbal communication skills

High attention to detail and commitment to producing polished, professional content.

- Proficiency in SQL and experience with one or more programming languages commonly used in data/analytics (e.g., Python).

- Proven ability to design and communicate architectures for data integration, warehousing, BI/analytics, and data science/ML workloads.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, managing multiple complex opportunities in parallel.

- Someone who can balance strategic architecture thinking with hands-on execution.

- A strong collaborator who enjoys working with Sales to build and execute expansion strategies in complex enterprise environments.

- A candid, curious, and growth-minded individual who thrives in ambiguity and helps shape how customers think about data, analytics, and AI on Snowflake.

title: Staff Product Manager - Social Planner, Ad manager, blogs
description:
*About us*
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

*Our people*
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

*Our impact*
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the team
--------------

The Product team is responsible for driving lead generation and management of leads. We do this by building innovative products & features that solve real-world problems for agencies and allow them to consolidate their offering to their clients in a single platform packaged under their white-labled brand.
The marketing products OS team focuses exclusively on products that can demonstrate lead generation and drive up engagement, adoption in target segments. This team handles multiple product areas including Blogging, Social Planner, Email Marketing, Chat widget, Affiliate manager, Chat Widget, Template Library, Brand Boards etc.
*HighLevel is an exciting place to work as it gives adrenaline to build and help our user base.*

* We take care of our team so our team can take care of our users
* It’s never somebody else’s job - Take ownership as a company owner
* We are passionately focussed on adding value for our users
* We deliver fast using lean principles (Agile framework). We go to market in weeks instead of quarters
* A good innovative idea always gets tested and we deliver based on feedbacksWe embrace that improvement is constant and iterative.
* Constant Learning Growth graph - You will learn how to scale B2B SaaS Startup and build relevant, impactful products for customers
* We are do-ers and go-getters to achieve team adoptions.

The role
--------

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for three core products: Social Planner, Blogs, and Ad Manager.
You’ll be responsible for turning a strong product vision into reality, driving meaningful business and customer impact, and leveling up the product team around you. You’ll directly mentor and grow a team of APMs into solid PM2-level product managers while partnering closely with Design, Engineering, Data, Marketing, and GTM.
This is a highly strategic, high-impact role for someone who can think in systems, ship fast with quality, and raise the bar for product management across the organization.

What You’ll Own
---------------

1. Product Strategy & Vision
----------------------------

* Own the *end-to-end product strategy and roadmap* for Social Planner, Blogs, and Ad Manager.
* Translate company and product vision into *clear north-star metrics* , long-term bets, and a sequenced 12–18 month roadmap.

Identify and validate the most impactful problems to solve for our core customers (agencies, marketers, SMBs, etc.).
*2. Ad Manager – Smart, Data-Driven, AI-First System*

* Evolve Ad Manager into a *smarter, less API-dependent, more data-reliant, AI-driven system* aligned with the long-term product vision.

Partner with Data and Engineering to:

* Design systems that use *first-party and performance data* to optimize campaigns, budgets, and targeting.
* Reduce fragility and over-reliance on external APIs by building *intelligent abstractions and fallbacks*.
* Integrate *AI-driven recommendations* , automation, and guardrails to improve campaign outcomes and reduce manual work.
* Define and track success metrics such as campaign performance, time-to-launch, and user adoption of smart features.

*3. Social Planner – UI/UX Excellence & Competitive Parity*

* Own Social Planner as a *core flagship experience* that can compete with other tools
* Lead major improvements across:
* *UI & workflows* (scheduling, approvals, calendar, collaboration, automations, comment management).
* *Statistics & reporting* (post performance, account-level insights, content analytics).
* *Controls for owners* (permissions, approvals, governance, workspace controls).
* Partner with Design to deliver a *clean, intuitive, and scalable UX* , and ensure high-quality execution with Engineering.

*4. Blogs – WordPress-Level Experience with AI & Automation*

* Make the HighLevel blogging experience *seamless and familiar* , comparable to platforms like WordPress, Wix, and Blogger.
* Define and drive a roadmap that:
* Modernizes the *editor experience* into a full-featured, reliable, WYSIWYG-style (or block-based) editor.
* Introduces powerful *AI-assisted workflows* (content creation, outlines, rewrites, image suggestions, internal linking).
* Improves *SEO tooling* (on-page recommendations, metadata support, schema basics, publishing workflows).
* Ensure blogs integrate smoothly into the broader HighLevel ecosystem (funnels, websites, SEO, content strategy).

*5. Execution, Delivery & Cross-Functional Leadership*

* Turn strategy into *clear, prioritized roadmaps* , well-defined problem statements, and detailed specs where needed.
* Run *discovery* (customer interviews, data analysis, experiments) to validate problems and solutions.
* Partner with Engineering to plan releases, manage scope, and ensure *predictable and high-quality delivery*.
* Work closely with Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to:
* Shape *positioning, messaging, and GTM plans*.
* Enable internal teams with the right documentation and training.
* Incorporate market/field feedback quickly into the roadmap.

6. Mentorship & Team Development
--------------------------------

* Directly mentor and *grow two APMs into strong PM2s* , with clear expectations, coaching, and feedback.
* Build a culture of *data-informed, customer-obsessed, outcome-driven* product management.
* Lead by example on *craft* : PRDs, problem framing, stakeholder management, and prioritization.
* Evangelize best practices around experimentation, discovery, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring
-----------------

* *9-12+ years* of experience in Product Management, with at least *3+ years at Senior/Staff/Principal level* owning complex product areas.
* Proven track record of *shipping impactful products* in B2B SaaS, ideally in:
* Marketing automation
* Social media management
* Advertising platforms
* Content / CMS / blogging tools
* Strong *technical aptitude* :
* Understanding of APIs, data flows, and system design at a conceptual level.
* Experience working with *data/ML/AI-driven products* is a strong plus.
* Deep experience with *discovery and experimentation* : Defining metrics, running A/B tests, analyzing usage data, and validating hypotheses.
* Demonstrated ability to *rebuild or significantly revamp complex UX flows* (dashboards, editors, planners, calendars, etc.).
* Experience *mentoring and developing PMs/APMs* , with examples of helping them level up.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to *influence senior stakeholders* and drive alignment.
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments with multiple priorities.

What Success Looks Like (6–12 Months)
-------------------------------------

Within your first year, you will have:

* Delivered a clear, aligned *12–18 month roadmap* for Social Planner, Blogs, and Ad Manager.
* Shipped high-impact improvements that:
* Make *Ad Manager* meaningfully smarter, more reliable, and more data/AI-powered.
* Upgrade *Social Planner* UX and capabilities to be competitive with leading social tools.
* Transform *Blogs* into a modern, powerful editor with AI and SEO capabilities that users love.
* Improved key metrics (ad performance, usage, retention, satisfaction) across your product areas.
* Developed your APMs, with clear progress toward *PM2-level ownership and performance*.
* Earned a reputation as a *go-to strategic leader* who can connect dots across teams and drive big, meaningful outcomes.

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp Economics Lab is the go-to source for understanding how businesses spend on and adopt AI. Built on Ramp’s $200B+ business spend dataset, our flagship Ramp AI Index https://ramp.com/data/ai-index tracks the AI economy through actual business spend data. Our research is regularly cited by the Financial Times, The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, The Economist, The New York Times, CNBC, Reuters, Axios, JPMorgan analyst reports, and our favorite independent substacks. You will work with Ara Kharazian, lead economist.

We’re hiring an economics-minded data scientist to own and expand this work: own Ramp AI Index, add new metrics tracking token spend and ROI of AI, extend our research internationally, and publish rigorous but accessible analysis for policymakers, researchers, businesses, the press, and the public.

You’ll also build a new customer-facing economics function from the ground up: developing Ramp’s economic outlook, meeting with customers and prospects, presenting to CFOs and finance teams, and translating our data into practical recommendations for business planning, budgeting, and AI strategy.

This role combines economic judgment, applied data science, public writing, data visualization, and executive communication. You should be able to move from an important question to credible analysis, a clear visual or argument, and advice a business leader can act on.

WHAT YOU NEED

- Minimum of 5 years of industry experience as a Data Scientist or Economist

- Strong perspectives on the economics of AI, economic policy, new media, and writing

- Strong knowledge of SQL (preferably Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery) and how to write efficient SQL queries

- Familiarity with BI tools (preferably Looker, Omni, Sigma, Hex or equivalent) and experience distributing data insights via reports and dashboards

- Track record of shipping high-quality research, writing, and thought leadership under short, non-academic timelines

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly improving, start-up environment that focuses on solving problems with iterative technical solutions

- Active reader of the news in economics, business, and AI trends

- An advanced user of AI for data science, and an eye for good charts and web design (we vibecode ramp.com/data http://ramp.com/data ourselves and could use some help)

- At some point in the recent past, you have been described as “a breath of fresh air.” You will meet with customers and prospects and present data. It’s very important you don’t come off as dry or overly academic

NICE-TO-HAVES

- Experience with the modern data stack (Fivetran / Snowflake / dbt / Looker / Hightouch or equivalents)

- Experience within the payments and financial technology space

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

CANADA

- Life, AD&D, and disability coverage

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

Pleo's Intelligence function covers the full analytical picture - product behaviour, GTM performance, commercial data science, financial reporting, and operational intelligence. The Analytics Engineers who serve these teams own the data modelling layer that all of it runs on: dbt models, metric definitions, and semantic layer contributions that analysts, product teams, and AI tools depend on to get consistent, trustworthy answers.

You'll be embedded in the Product Intelligence team, building the tracking, experimentation, and data modelling foundations that make product data trustworthy and self-serve. You'll join a close-knit team actively migrating our analytics stack onto a new Analytics Warehouse and Omni, moving off legacy tools like Looker and Hippocampus. If you want to build the infrastructure that other people's product decisions run on rather than just report on what exists, this is the opportunity for you.

Who you'll work with and reporting to

You will report to an Analytics Manager leading Product Intelligence and Growth Intelligence. You'll partner closely with Product Managers, Product Analysts, and Engineering to get tracking, experimentation, and metric definitions right from the ground up. You'll also engage with the broader Analytics Engineering community across Pleo to drive shared standards, especially around the semantic layer that keeps metrics consistent across the organization.

What you'll be doing

- Build and maintain dbt models in our new Analytics Warehouse, using a clean, layered architecture and migrating logic off legacy tools as you go.

description:

SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER - MANAGEDDB TEAM

Location: Menlo Park, CA

Work Authorization: US Citizenship or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card holder) required due to compliance requirements.

BUILD THE FUTURE OF DATA. JOIN THE SNOWFLAKE TEAM.

Snowflake customers run more than 3.9 billion queries and over 515 million data workloads each day.

The Snowflake Engineering team is a global team of high-performing engineers focused on building best-in-class tooling, automation, and a scalable infrastructure platform to power the Snowflake service. Our focus areas include Snowflake's global-scale multi-cloud infrastructure, core platform services, edge traffic delivery, and reliability engineering. We automate the deployment of the Snowflake production service across dozens of regions and all major cloud providers.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our ManagedDB Team in Menlo Park, CA.

ManagedDB team is responsible in large number of databases running in every Snowflake region across several public cloud providers. Our systems sit at the critical path of multiple external and internal systems including Snowflake UI, Service Discovery, Deployment Automation, CoCo and many others. Given the massive and constantly accelerating volumes of data flowing through Snowflake, this role presents significant opportunities to architect, scale, and innovate at high-throuput, low-latency critical database systems.

AS A SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE MANAGEDDB TEAM, YOU WILL:

- Architect & Scale: Lead the technical vision, design, and implementation of database products to suit internal needs.

- Drive Multi-Cloud Strategy: Create elegant, cloud-agnostic abstractions and software infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and GCP to ensure seamless management and rapid feature delivery.

- Technical Leadership: Drive complex, cross-functional engineering initiatives from inception to production, mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, and establishing software engineering best practices.

- Ensure High Availability & Security: Continuously harden our database infrastructure meet SLAs around uptime, security, and durability.

- Production Excellence: Participate in an on-call rotation, lead incident investigations for complex production issues, and direct blameless post-mortems to drive permanent systemic improvements.

- Collaborate Across Teams: Partner closely with Security, Infrastructure, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to support new product capabilities at scale.

OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

- Work Authorization: Must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident (Green Card holder).

- Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).

- Experience: 7–12 years of professional experience designing, building, operating, and scaling large-scale backend distributed systems in high-growth production environments.

- Core Systems Knowledge:  Understanding of databases (PostgreSQL, Redis) and experience running large-scale distributed systems.

- Advanced Programming Proficiency: Strong hands-on coding experience in systems and application languages such as Go, Java, C++, or Rust.

- Public Cloud Mastery: Extensive experience architecting infrastructure on major public clouds (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including cloud networking constructs (e.g., VPC peering, PrivateLink, Transit Gateways).

- Infrastructure as Code & Automation: Proficient in automating global fleet deployment and configuration using tools like Terraform, Kubernetes, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

- Leadership & Influence: Proven track record of technical ownership, breaking down ambiguous problems into concrete roadmaps, and delivering high-impact projects across multiple engineering teams.

We value a strong growth mindset and a collaborative, blameless engineering culture. If you thrive on solving complex platform engineering challenges at massive scale, we would love to hear from you.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job posted: 8/28/2026

Location: Remote Central & South America- Pacific Time (PST) working hours required

Hi there!

Zapier’s mission is to make automation work for everyone, helping people eliminate repetitive work and focus on what matters most.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager to support our Enterprise customers on the post-sale team. You’ll serve as a named senior technical partner to builders, technical leaders, and executives, helping them turn important business problems into reliable, well-designed automations.

You’ll join a growing team of four Sr TAMs reporting to a Senior Manager. Customer portfolios vary by program, account size, technical complexity, and level of engagement. Customers typically receive an average allocation of approximately six dedicated TAM hours, which you’ll use for architecture, hands-on building, technical enablement, and proactive account planning.

You’ll design architectures, build and improve workflows, solve complex technical problems, and strengthen the resilience of customers’ automation systems. In partnership with Customer Success, you’ll connect this work to adoption, customer value, retention, and growth. You’ll also represent the customer internally, giving Product and Engineering clear insight into product gaps, critical bugs, and opportunities to improve the Enterprise experience.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

THINGS YOU’LL DO

Design, build, and improve customer automations

- Use customers’ dedicated TAM hours to design, build, and improve automations tied to meaningful business outcomes.

- Translate complex processes into practical workflow architectures covering data movement, business logic, exception paths, and operational controls.

- Build alongside customer teams to move high-value use cases from concept to reliable production operation.

- Review existing automations for reliability, efficiency, maintainability, and effective use of Zapier.

- Troubleshoot issues across Zapier, APIs, authentication, data formats, and connected applications.

- Identify recurring failures and improve error handling, monitoring, alerts, fallback behavior, and recovery processes.

Lead proactive technical partnerships

- Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s priorities, systems, technical constraints, governance needs, and automation maturity.

- Create technical account plans that identify valuable use cases, architectural recommendations, risks, and next steps.

- Lead working sessions, architecture reviews, implementation discussions, and executive conversations.

- Use sound judgment to determine when to solve directly, teach the customer, recommend another approach, or involve additional Zapier teams.

Drive customer and team outcomes through internal partnership

- Partner closely with Customer Success to connect technical priorities to adoption, realized value, retention, and growth.

- Bring technical evidence into account planning, business reviews, renewal preparation, and expansion conversations.

- Surface blockers, adoption gaps, and architectural risks early, and take ownership of moving the right people toward a solution.

- Proactively identify and lead team or cross-functional initiatives, turning recurring needs into scalable solutions, reusable practices, and better experiences for customers and the team.

Represent the customer inside Zapier

- Give Product and Engineering technically grounded feedback that explains the customer’s use case, business impact, urgency, and available workarounds.

- Use evidence and patterns across your portfolio to advocate for fixes and features that materially affect Enterprise customers.

- Coordinate complex escalations, keep customers informed, and set clear expectations.

- Share recurring insights that improve the product, documentation, supportability, and broader Enterprise experience.

Help customers make sound AI decisions

AI is changing how customers design and operate automations. You’ll help them move beyond surface-level terminology and make responsible implementation choices.

- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in your own work, applying appropriate review, verification, and judgment.

- Understand meaningful differences among AI models and discuss their capabilities, limitations, and selection criteria credibly with customers.

- Explain the difference between deterministic automation, AI-assisted workflows, and agentic systems, and help customers decide when and how to use each.

- Guide practical conversations about accuracy, reliability, evaluation, fallback behavior, human oversight, security, and governance.

- Understand emerging AI integration patterns, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how models, tools, data, and automation platforms can work together.

What We’re Looking For

- Significant experience (7+ years) in technical account management, solutions architecture, customer engineering, sales engineering, implementation consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.

- A track record of measurably improving customer outcomes across an Enterprise portfolio, for example, reducing churn risk, strengthening renewals, expanding adoption, or creating upsell and cross-sell opportunities through technical enablement.

- Demonstrated experience building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them.

- Hands-on familiarity with Zapier or comparable automation and integration platforms.

- Experience owning complex technical relationships with Enterprise customers and communicating effectively with both builders and executives.

- A track record of building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them.

- Strong working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, authentication, structured data, application integrations, and conditional workflow logic.

- The ability to diagnose ambiguous, multi-system problems and design for production reliability, monitoring, recovery, and maintainability.

- Strong customer judgment, balancing immediate needs with technical feasibility, risk, scale, and long-term value.

- The ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous environment: proactively identifying high-impact work, driving customer and team initiatives to completion across multiple internal teams.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools and a practical understanding of AI-assisted workflows, agentic systems, evaluation, oversight, and governance.

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Freelance Performance Creative Designer (m/w/d)
description:
AYLASHES ist eine erfolgreiche D2C-Beauty-Brand für DIY-Wimpernextensions. Mit unseren Produkten können sich unsere Kundinnen ihren individuellen Studio-Look in wenigen Minuten selbst zu Hause kreieren.
Für unsere weitere Entwicklung suchen wir einen erfahrenen Freelance Performance Creative Designer, der visuell starke und performanceorientierte Creatives für unsere Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages und unseren Onlineshop entwickelt.
Du solltest nicht nur ein ausgezeichnetes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie und Bildsprache besitzen, sondern auch verstehen, wie Designs im E-Commerce funktionieren: von einem aufmerksamkeitsstarken Einstieg über eine klare visuelle Hierarchie bis hin zu einer überzeugenden Produktinszenierung und einem eindeutigen Call-to-Action.
Aufgaben
- Du entwickelst performanceorientierte statische Werbeanzeigen und Grafiken für Meta, Instagram, TikTok, Google und weitere digitale Kanäle.

- Du gestaltest unterschiedliche Creative Angles, Hooks, Layouts und Varianten, damit wir Botschaften und visuelle Ansätze gezielt testen können.

- Du verwandelst Produktbilder, UGC-Material, Testimonials, Benefits und Werbetexte in aufmerksamkeitsstarke und verkaufsorientierte Creatives.

- Du gestaltest visuelle Konzepte, Seitenlayouts und einzelne Bereiche für Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.

- Du entwickelst unter anderem Hero Sections, Produkt-Benefit-Grafiken, Vergleichsdarstellungen, Anwendungsanleitungen, Vorher-Nachher-Visuals, Trust-Elemente und weitere Conversion-Elemente.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Marke, Produkt, Anwendung, Vorteile und Ergebnisse von AYLASHES hochwertig und verständlich präsentiert werden.

- Du adaptierst Creatives für unterschiedliche Plattformen, Platzierungen und Formate – insbesondere 1:1, 4:5 und 9:16 sowie weitere Display- und Webformate.

- Du achtest bei allen Formaten auf Safe Zones, Lesbarkeit, mobile Darstellung und eine konsistente visuelle Qualität.

- Du entwickelst aus erfolgreichen Ads neue Varianten und Iterationen, beispielsweise mit anderen Hooks, Bildern, Headlines, Farben, Layouts oder CTAs.

- Du setzt bestehende Brand-Vorgaben sicher um und entwickelst unsere visuelle Kommunikation gemeinsam mit uns weiter.

- Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing-Team zusammen, setzt Feedback schnell und zuverlässig um und bringst eigene Ideen und Empfehlungen ein.

Qualifikation
- Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Gestaltung von Performance Creatives für Meta, TikTok, Google oder vergleichbare Paid-Media-Kanäle.

- Du besitzt ein aussagekräftiges Portfolio mit relevanten Werbeanzeigen, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs – idealerweise aus den Bereichen Beauty, Fashion, Lifestyle oder D2C.

- Du verstehst die grundlegende Creative Strategy hinter erfolgreichen Werbeanzeigen und weißt, warum Hook, visuelle Hierarchie, Produktinszenierung, Lesbarkeit, Social Proof und CTA entscheidend sind.

- Du hast Erfahrung mit conversionorientiertem Web- und Landingpage-Design und kannst ansprechende Layouts entwickeln, die auch auf mobilen Geräten funktionieren.

- Du beherrschst relevante Designprogramme sicher, beispielsweise Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign oder vergleichbare Tools.

- Du hast ein sehr gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Farben, Komposition, Bildauswahl und modernes E-Commerce-Design.

- Du kannst Informationen visuell priorisieren und auch komplexere Produktvorteile schnell verständlich darstellen.

- Du weißt, wie man eine hochwertige Markenwirkung mit klarer, performanceorientierter Kommunikation verbindet.

- Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und detailgenau und hältst vereinbarte Deadlines zuverlässig ein.

- Du kannst deutschsprachige Werbetexte sicher verarbeiten und erkennst, wenn eine Headline oder Botschaft im Design nicht optimal funktioniert.

- Erfahrung mit A/B-Tests, Creative Iterations und der Auswertung von Ad-Performance ist ein starkes Plus.

- Erfahrung mit einfachen Animationen, Motion Graphics oder KI-gestützter Bildbearbeitung ist ebenfalls von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits
- Flexible und ortsunabhängige Zusammenarbeit auf Freelance-Basis.

- Die Möglichkeit einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit mit regelmäßigen Projekten und planbaren Aufgaben.

- Abwechslungsreiche Designprojekte für Paid Social, Google Ads, Landingpages, Produktseiten und unseren Onlineshop.

- Klare Briefings, vorhandene Brand-Guidelines, Produktmaterialien und Werbetexte als Grundlage für deine Arbeit.

- Direkte Kommunikation, schnelle Entscheidungen und konkrete Feedback-Loops.

- Einblicke in die Performance deiner Creatives, damit du nachvollziehen kannst, welche Designs funktionieren und warum.

- Raum für eigene Ideen, neue Designkonzepte und kreative Testansätze.

- Die Möglichkeit, die visuelle Weiterentwicklung einer wachsenden D2C-Beauty-Brand aktiv mitzugestalten.

- Faire und transparente Vergütung, abgestimmt auf Erfahrung, Qualität und Projektumfang.

Wir benötigen weder einen klassischen Lebenslauf noch ein Anschreiben. Entscheidend sind die Qualität deiner Arbeit, dein Gespür für Ästhetik und deine bisherigen Ergebnisse.
Bitte sende uns mit deiner Bewerbung:
- fünf bis acht deiner stärksten und relevantesten Arbeiten,

- Beispiele für Performance Ads sowie, wenn vorhanden, Landingpages oder E-Commerce-Designs,

- eine kurze Information dazu, was du bei den gezeigten Projekten übernommen hast,

- wenn möglich, konkrete Ergebnisse oder Erkenntnisse zur Performance deiner Arbeiten,

- deine aktuelle Verfügbarkeit und ungefähre wöchentliche Kapazität,

- deine Preisvorstellung pro Creative, Stunden- oder Paketpreis.

Wenn du bereits an einer besonders erfolgreichen Werbeanzeige oder Landingpage gearbeitet hast, zeige uns gerne, was daran funktioniert hat und welchen Beitrag du geleistet hast.
Bewerbungen ohne relevantes Portfolio können wir leider nicht berücksichtigen. Wenn deine Arbeiten und dein Profil zu uns passen, erhältst du von uns einen kurzen und klar abgegrenzten Test-Task.
Wir freuen uns darauf, deine Arbeiten zu sehen und gemeinsam Designs zu entwickeln, die nicht nur hochwertig aussehen, sondern Aufmerksamkeit erzeugen, Vertrauen aufbauen und echte Ergebnisse erzielen.

title: Junior Product Manager (with UI/UX background)
description:
*Що варто знати про SKELAR?* Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Маєш міцний *досвід у UI/UX* і відчуваєш, що готовий керувати продуктом? Ми в пошуку саме такого *Product Manager* , щоб разом ставити нові рекорди.

*Ключові виклики, які будуть стояти перед тобою:*

— Генерувати та пріоритизувати data-driven гіпотези;

— Формувати задачі та запускати A/B-тести для покращення продуктових метрик;

— Вести розробку фіч від ідеї до запуску в продакшен;

— Аналізувати потреби та проблеми користувачів;

— Проводити систематичні дослідження користувачів і ринку, щоб виявляти вузькі місця та точки зростання.

*Що для нас важливо:*

— Здатність аналізувати проблему комплексно — визначати її першопричину, ділити на складові частини та знаходити оптимальне рішення;

— Проактивність та ініціативність;

— Готовність брати на себе відповідальність.

*У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:*

— *SKELAR Platform.* Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

— *Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури.* Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

— *Ексклюзивна доменна освіта.* Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

— *Вплив на системну допомогу Україні.* Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

— *Екосистема для продуктивної роботи.* Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

— *Турбота про щоденний комфорт.* Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві.

*Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!*

title: 12 Month Creative Design and Digital Media Intern (Part time)
description:
Position Summary

The New Mexico Immigrant Law Center (NMILC) seeks a creative, organized, and mission-driven Creative Design and Digital Media Intern to support NMILC’s visual identity, digital communications, and immigrant-rights advocacy efforts.

This paid, part-time internship provides a meaningful opportunity to build practical experience in graphic design, photography, social-media management, website content, email marketing, campaign development, and nonprofit communications. Working under the supervision of the Communications Director, the Intern will help create engaging and accessible communications materials that elevate NMILC’s services, advocacy priorities, events, resources, and community-centered work.

The ideal candidate is a visual storyteller with a strong design eye; excellent attention to detail; interest in immigrant rights, public-interest law, advocacy, or nonprofit communications; and the ability to collaborate effectively while working independently in a semi-remote environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Creative Design and Content Development

* Create engaging, accurate, and visually compelling content for NMILC’s social-media platforms, website, email marketing, reports, presentations, outreach materials, and digital campaigns.
* Develop graphics, templates, layouts, infographics, digital toolkits, and other visual assets using NMILC’s brand standards and established style.
* Support the development of accessible and audience-appropriate materials that communicate legal, policy, advocacy, and community information clearly.
* Assist with formatting and preparing materials for digital distribution, presentations, internal use, and professional printing when needed.
* Proofread and quality-check content for grammar, spelling, accurate links, layout consistency, visual quality, and alignment with NMILC’s voice and branding.
* Organize and maintain digital files, design assets, photography, templates, and completed communications projects.

Social Media and Digital Campaigns

* Assist with managing NMILC’s social-media presence across multiple platforms.
* Create, schedule, and publish social-media posts and stories in coordination with the Communications Director and approved content calendars.
* Help develop content calendars that support organizational priorities, advocacy campaigns, community education, events, fundraising, and client-resource promotion.
* Identify opportunities to adapt and repurpose content across social media, email, web, print, and presentation formats.
* Monitor social-media engagement and flag comments, direct messages, emerging opportunities, or concerns for the Communications Director.
* Research digital-media trends, platform updates, best practices, and examples of effective nonprofit and advocacy communications.

Photography and Event Documentation

* Assist with taking, selecting, editing, captioning, organizing, and archiving photographs for NMILC communications.
* Help document community events, trainings, outreach activities, advocacy events, staff gatherings, and other organizational activities.
* Follow NMILC procedures related to photography permissions, consent, confidentiality, privacy, and respectful representation of community members.
* Support maintenance of photo releases, consent records, and organized image archives.

Website and Email Communications

* Assist with updates to NMILC’s Squarespace website, including uploading and formatting content, refreshing pages, checking links, and making basic layout adjustments.
* Support basic search-engine optimization and web-accessibility practices, including clear page titles, headings, links, image alt text, and readable content formatting.
* Assist with quality assurance for website content by identifying outdated information, broken links, inconsistent formatting, or accessibility concerns.
* Create graphics and visual materials for email marketing, newsletters, event notices, fundraising communications, and other digital outreach.

Reporting and Administrative Support

* Assist with tracking social-media, website, email, and digital-campaign performance.
* Help prepare concise reports or dashboards on audience engagement, content performance, campaign reach, and emerging trends.
* Maintain project trackers, content calendars, asset libraries, and other communications records.
* Participate in communications planning meetings, check-ins, trainings, and cross-functional collaboration as assigned.
* Perform other related duties and special projects consistent with the purpose of the internship.

Required Qualifications

* Interest in graphic design, digital media, communications, marketing, photography, advocacy, nonprofit work, public-interest law, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to create visually appealing graphics or digital materials using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design tools.
* Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign is preferred; willingness and ability to learn is required.
* Experience creating or managing social-media content for a school, organization, employer, campaign, volunteer activity, or personal portfolio.
* Familiarity with photography, photo editing, visual storytelling, or digital asset organization.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, including the ability to proofread, review links, verify formatting, and produce polished work.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize effectively, meet deadlines, and communicate early about workload or timeline concerns.
* Ability to work both collaboratively and independently in a semi-remote work environment.
* Ability to work respectfully and effectively with people from diverse backgrounds, lived experiences, identities, and communication styles.
* Basic proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to attend and document NMILC events, which may include local or occasional in-state travel.
* Submission of a portfolio or work samples, including examples of graphic design, photography, social-media content, digital campaigns, web content, or other relevant creative work.

Preferred Qualifications

* Current enrollment in, recent completion of, or demonstrated coursework in graphic design, visual communications, digital media, marketing, journalism, photography, communications, public relations, or a related area.
* Experience with Squarespace or another content-management system.
* Experience with email-marketing platforms and digital newsletter design.
* Experience preparing files or materials for professional printing.
* Interest in or experience with nonprofit communications, issue-based advocacy, immigrant rights, social justice, political campaigns, or public-interest work.
* Familiarity with bilingual English-Spanish communications or experience creating materials for multilingual audiences.
* Knowledge of accessibility and inclusive-design practices for digital content.
* Experience with fundraising, donor communications, community outreach, or event promotion.

Compensation and Status

This is a part-time, nonexempt employee position scheduled for 19 hours per week for a 12-month term. The hourly rate is $19.00 per hour. The selected candidate must accurately record all hours worked and obtain advance approval before working beyond the established schedule. Benefits eligibility, if any, will be determined in accordance with NMILC policy and applicable law.

title: Junior Product Manager
description:
Job Title: Junior Product Manager
---------------------------------

A bit about us:
---------------

We’re on a mission to change the tire industry — how it’s delivered and how it’s experienced. A pioneer in the automotive e-commerce industry, we take pride in our extensive selection of top-name brands and budget-friendly options, ensuring our customers find the perfect tire to suit their needs. As a part of our growing and dynamic team, you'll contribute to our commitment to exceptional service, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Embrace the opportunity to be a driving force behind one of the fastest growing e-commerce companies in the US and apply now!

*Summary*
---------

The Junior Product Manager will be responsible for defining and delivering the product capabilities that support Garage Hub's auto parts distribution platform as well as Tires Easy's Driveline platform. This role focuses on building systems that enable accurate product data, efficient catalog management, pricing integrity, and scalable internal workflows across a growing supplier-, customer-, and SKU- base. This position plays a central role in ensuring that these platforms reliably support customer- and distributor-specific needs such as part compatibility, order management, inventory visibility, and pricing logic.

The Product Manager will work closely with Operations, Engineering, and Strategic Partnerships teams to translate distributor and customer requirements into product solutions that improve catalog accuracy, pricing consistency, inventory transparency, sales, and execution. The ideal candidate is a Product Manager with experience in distribution, e-commerce, marketplace, or inventory-driven businesses who understands the operational realities of managing complex catalogs and supplier data in high-volume, data-intensive environments.

*Essential Duties and Responsibilities*
---------------------------------------

* Own the product definition and delivery of Garage Hub's and Driveline's core distribution platform capabilities.
* Design and evolve systems that support order management, catalog ingestion, part normalization, and data quality across customers and suppliers, including UX/UI where applicable.
* Partner with Engineering to plan and deliver product releases that support customer and distributor workflows and scale.
* Work closely with Operations and Strategic Partnerships teams to understand distribution-specific constraints (shipping logic, catalog complexity, pricing rules, inventory data, supplier variability) and translate them into product requirements.
* Partner directly with Operations to identify and resolve pain points, validate requirements, and ensure solutions are practical and adopted in live operating environments.
* Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap aligned to distributor/customer needs and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation, tooling, and workflow redesign.
* Communicate product priorities, tradeoffs, and delivery timelines clearly to stakeholders.
* Operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with evolving requirements and limited precedent.
* Other duties as assigned.

*Qualification Requirements*
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree from a top academic institution.
* 2-6+ years of product management experience in B2B, marketplace, e-commerce, or other operations- and data-intensive environments.
* Strong business judgment with a clear understanding of how product decisions impact operational execution, cost, and scalability.
* Demonstrated ability to ship, iterate, and improve complex products in fast-moving organizations.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Operations, Engineering, and Analytics teams to deliver scalable, business-ready solutions.
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous, real-world business problems into clear, actionable product requirements.
* Data-driven mindset with comfort using metrics, dashboards, and analysis to inform prioritization and tradeoffs.
* Strong organizational and execution skills with a clear bias toward delivery over process.
* Comfortable operating in high-growth, entrepreneurial, and ambiguous environments; startup or early-stage experience preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly around requirements, prioritization, and decision-making.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office; familiarity with common product management and analytics tools strongly preferred.

*Physical Demands*
------------------

Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The Product Manager may manage one or more junior staff and will engage with internal team members, external stakeholders, and supervise contractors.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

Product Strategy, Development, and Delivery

* Define, manage, and advance a clear and compelling product vision and strategy.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive product plans and roadmaps that span active development, maintenance, optimization, and retirement phases.
* Coordinate internal and external resources to ensure execution of the product plan.
* Collect, synthesize, and prioritize customer, staff, and market inputs to inform product decisions across the portfolio.

Product Lifecycle Management
----------------------------
