* Monitor and analyze product data to identify opportunities to increase revenue, market impact, and customer satisfaction.
* Define and monitor product goals and success measures, and regularly report on progress, risks, and performance for assigned products.
* Partner with finance, sales, and other team to define pricing strategy, packaging, and revisions over time.
* Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness through sales enablement resources, guidance, and training. Help to ensure internal teams are equipped to support products.
* Drive continuous improvement and innovation across the portfolio performance product suite to respond to evolving market, regulatory, and customer needs.

Market Intelligence, Positioning, and Go-to-Market Support

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of target customer segments, including needs, pain points, motivations, and decision drivers.
* Monitor and analyze market trends, policy and regulatory drivers, and competition to inform product strategy, positioning, and prioritization.
* Create and maintain product management artifacts, including target customer definitions, value propositions, benefit statements, and more.
* Work closely with market facing staff to inform messaging, campaigns, and go to market approaches, ensuring they accurately reflect product value for target markets.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
-----------------------

Experience
----------

* 5-7 years of relevant product management experience
* Familiarity with USGBC and GBCI mission, internal operations, and stakeholders
* Professional experience in sustainable resource management and understanding of zero waste concepts and practices and/or knowledge of the TRUE rating system
* >7 years of product or program management experience in green building, commercial real estate, zero waste, or equivalent areas (preferred)

Education
---------

* Bachelor's degree (required)
* Advanced degree (preferred)

Technology/System(s)
--------------------

* Demonstrated skills with Microsoft tools and one or more project/product management systems (e.g., JIRA, Notion, ProductPlan, etc.)

Skills
------

* The ability to communicate complex issues effectively with peers, senior leadership, and other key stakeholders.
* Ability to engage and build consensus across various levels of leaders in a matrixed organization through collaboration and influence.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work and communicate with diverse staff.

Certifications
--------------

* LEED GA or AP accreditation or TRUE Advisor Preferred

ABOUT OUR TOTAL REWARDS
-----------------------

Salary
------

Final compensation and benefits will be confirmed at the time of offer and may vary based on factors such as internal equity, relevant experience, qualifications, and employment status. *Please note that salary negotiations will not extend beyond the top of the internal salary range.*

Benefits
--------

We offer you:
-------------

* Competitive compensation
* 401(k) with employer matching
* Professional development reimbursement
* We offer a healthcare plan through Cigna that includes medical, dental, vision, and prescription drugs. USGBC covers 100% of the premiums and an HRA that will assist you and your dependents in reaching the in-network medical deductible. You will only be responsible for the $300 individual / $600 family up front deductible for medical services before the employer funded HRA will process payments for your in-network claims
* Generous paid time off (12 paid holidays, 9 paid personal sick days and based on career level either 2 to 3 weeks PTO), including operations closed for a full week between Christmas and New Year’s
* 6 weeks paid renewal leave after 7 years of continuous service

LOGISTICS
---------

*Location:* This position is remote in USA

*Work Schedule:* Monday – Friday 9 AM to 5:30 PM Eastern

Travel %:10%
------------

*ABOUT US*

*The U.S. Green Building Council is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

**U.S. Green Building Council (USGBC)* is a mission-driven nonprofit dedicated to accelerating and scaling the transformation of the built environment. title: Test Automation Engineer
description:

We are seeking a T2 Software Test Automation Engineer to operate with high autonomy in designing, expanding, and maintaining our robust automated testing frameworks. In this role, you will own the automation strategy for specific product features, configure automated test execution directly within CI/CD pipelines, and conduct code reviews to mentor junior staff. You will blend advanced software development skills with modern quality assurance methodologies to validate application functionality, performance, and security across front-end interfaces and RESTful APIs. Working closely with developers and product managers, you will catch defects early in the software development lifecycle and ensure overall system stability. The ideal candidate brings 3 to 5 years of professional automation experience, strong programming skills

* *Monthly Image Validation:* Lead the manual verification of monthly Windows OS image builds, ensuring stability, security compliance, and driver compatibility across different hardware models.

* *Microsoft Stack & App Testing:* Conduct deep-dive testing of *Office 365* (Teams, Outlook, Excel) and enterprise browsers (Edge, Chrome) to ensure seamless performance in a managed environment.

* *Virtualization & Remote Access:* Validate application delivery and user experience through *Citrix Workspace* and *Remote Desktop (RDP)* tools.

* *Windows Ecosystem Mastery:* 3+ years of experience testing *Windows OS* , *Office 365* , and enterprise-grade software.

* *Virtual Environments:* Proficiency in testing and navigating *Citrix Workspace* and RDP sessions.

* *Fast Learner (Programming):* Practical knowledge of *Python* and a strong interest/preferred experience in *Robot Framework* for test orchestration.

* *Operating Systems:* Comfortable working in both *Windows and Linux* environments for system configuration and log analysis.

* *Tools:* Experience using *GitHub* for version control and *Azure DevOps (ADO)* for sprint tracking and test case management.

* Ability to work on-site in the Topside BSLN Test Lab to manage physical hardware.

* Ability to lift and move standard IT equipment (laptops, monitors, small servers).

* Collaborate and coordinate with external customers, management, subcontractors, vendors, and other engineering disciplines.

* Lead small size and low-complexity projects as requested by the Test Automation Lead.

*Basic Qualifications*

* Requires B.S. Degree and 2 to 4 years of prior relevant experience or M.S. with 0 to 2 years of prior relevant experience (in System Engineering, Software Engineering, or related engineering discipline) from an accredited college or university.

* Must be a U.S. Citizen and have a Secret clearance.

* Able to synthesize knowledge from multiple domains to apply to new, complicated problems.

* Experience in collaborating with other enterprise technologists both internal and external to resolve complex technical issues.

* Experience using Atlassian JIRA to define, schedule, and track work assignments within an engineering team.

* Must be able to work collaboratively and remotely in a team environment.

*Strong Communication:* Excellent written English with a natural, professional tone when communicating with creators.

*Tech-Savvy:* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM-style systems, influencer databases, and adapting quickly to new digital tools.

Weekly volume of qualified creators sourced.

*

Personalized outreach and follow-up completion rates.

*

Creator response and conversion rates.

*

Total confirmed collaborations and on-time delivery rate.

Overall quality and view performance of published content.

*Engagement Type:* Full-time, exclusive independent contractor role.

title: Junior Recruiter
description:
We are looking for an ambitious and proactive Junior Recruiter to join our fully remote, international team. This is an entry-level role where you will support the HR Team and Hiring Managers, primarily focusing on building and maintaining a talent pipeline for our fast-growing company.

If you are highly organized, an excellent communicator, and eager to learn the art of international, remote recruiting, this role is your launchpad! 🚀

Who We Are
----------

We're GreenTomatoMedia —a global, mostly remote team of 100+ people from 40+ countries who love building and scaling cool digital products. We live and breathe organic growth, with core expertise in ASO, Google, YouTube, and LLM SEO.

We run two main ventures:
-------------------------

* Mobile Apps– Entertainment apps like Party Games, and Couple Games.
* Media & Affiliate– High-value content sites & a YouTube channel in the iGaming and finance space.

We move fast, learn every day, and love what we do. If you’re looking for big challenges, awesome teammates, and a place to grow fast while having fun — you’ll fit right in! 🌍

What You'll Do
--------------

Working closely with the HR Team and Hiring Managers, you'll be an essential part of our global recruitment engine:

Own Full-Cycle Recruiting
-------------------------

*

* Sourcing: Run creative, targeted campaigns to find and engage passive candidates, primarily via LinkedIn and specialized platforms.
* Screening & Assessment: Review resumes and conduct structured video screens to evaluate skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* Hiring Manager Partnership: Understand role requirements and deliver shortlists with own assessment notes.
* Job Postings & ATS: Manage job postings across boards and keep our BambooHR pipeline clean, current, and visible to the team.

Drive Candidate Experience & Coordination

*

* Interview Scheduling: Coordinate international interviews across multiple time zones, keeping the process seamless and on time.
* Offer Support: Help prepare and extend offers, working with the HR Team on communication.
* Brand Ambassadorship: Be a transparent, prompt point of contact who reflects GTM's culture at every step.

Process & Team Support
----------------------

*

* Provide general support to the HR team as needed, pitching in on ad hoc projects.

Who You Are
-----------

You are a motivated self-starter who is passionate about people's potential and thrives in high-paced, high-energy recruitment within a remote environment. You are highly detail-oriented and ready to learn the fundamentals of strategic talent acquisition.

Must-Have
---------

* Strong Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with a professional and engaging phone presence.
* Organization: Exceptional organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple complex schedules and pipelines simultaneously.
* Tech Savvy: Comfortable learning and working with recruitment software, specifically a BambooHR ATS.
* Curiosity: A genuine curiosity for connecting business goals with people strategy and a drive to learn about various digital/tech roles.

Nice-to-Have
------------

* 1-2 years of experience in an administrative, HR, or recruitment coordination role.
* Familiarity with sourcing techniques on LinkedIn Recruiter/Navigator.
* Experience in a remote-first or international business setting.

💚 Why Join GreenTomatoMedia?
----------------------------

🌎 Global & remote-first team – collaborate with people across 20+ countries.
🧠 Impact-driven culture – we value action, honesty, and A-player energy.
🏝️ Flexible time off – generous vacation policy and true work-from-anywhere.

🎯 Career growth – annual salary reviews and opportunities to shape the TA function’s future.

🌍 Location: Fully remote.

⚙️ Our Hiring Process
---------------------

* Intro Call with HR (30–45 mins)
* Practical Task - showcase your sourcing and coordination abilities.
* Final Interview with the HR Director

title: Experience Designer
description:
Deeplocal creates inspiring moments for brands in the real and virtual worlds. We strategize, imagine, design, and fabricate ambitious experiences from concept to execution. Our work is driven by inventive technology, design, storytelling, craft, and most importantly, humans.

We’re seeking a junior *Experience Designer* to join our creative team, with a strong foundation in 3D, spatial, industrial, environmental, or experiential design. What matters most is that you can translate ideas into experiences people can see, touch, move through, and interact with.

This is *not a traditional UI/UX role* , and it is not a strict graphic, motion, or digital design position. Deeplocal’s work lives in physical space. We are looking for someone who can think beyond screens and communicate ideas through spatial, physical, interactive, and human-centered experiences.

Your portfolio should show strong creative thinking, visual taste, and evidence that you can work with physical interaction. That might mean environments, installations, objects, prototypes, interactive exhibits, spatial storytelling, event experiences, kinetic ideas, product-like concepts, or other work that shows how people engage with an idea in the real world.

*Although remote employees will be considered, preference will be given to candidates in Pittsburgh, or those willing to relocate.*

You care deeply about design quality, from the high-level concept to the smallest detail.

* You are curious about how things work, how people move through spaces, and how physical, visual, digital, and interactive elements come together to create an experience.
* You may have a primary creative discipline, but you are excited to work across disciplines and learn new tools, methods, and ways of making.
* You enjoy participating in cross-functional teams, balancing aesthetic considerations with engineering, technology, fabrication, brand, and user experience.
* You can communicate ideas visually and verbally, whether through sketches, diagrams, storyboards, renders, references, mockups, writing, prototypes, or decks.
* You can handle multiple projects simultaneously, keeping track of deadlines and self-directing your workload and priorities.
* You are aesthetically agile and can design for a variety of brands with different styles, tones, palettes, and voices.
* You are eager to develop creative concepts that integrate thoughtful user experience, physical interaction, and strong storytelling.
* You like getting your hands dirty, using rapid prototyping, low-fidelity models, tests, sketches, or mockups to prove out design concepts.
* You have 2–4 years of experience, preferably in a creative agency, experiential studio, design studio, architecture/interiors practice, production environment, or similar setting.

------------------
*Responsibilities*
------------------

*Creative Concepting* *
* Collaborate with Creative Directors, Designers, Strategists, and Creative Technologists to develop concepts that are inventive, strategic, and meaningful for audiences.

*Physical + Spatial Thinking* *
* Contribute to ideas that live in physical space, including installations, environments, objects, interactive moments, exhibits, activations, and brand experiences.

*3D + Spatial Design* *
* Translate creative concepts into physical form. Design environments, installations, objects, exhibits, and spatial experiences through sketching, 3D modeling, rendering, and prototyping. Explore scale, proportion, materiality, layout, sightlines, human interaction, and how an experience occupies and transforms a space.

*Experience Design* *
* Concept, develop, and diagram user experiences through storyboards, flowcharts, spatial diagrams, journey maps, or other tools. Help ensure the experience remains clear, compelling, and on brand.

*Visual + Verbal Communication* *
* Create compelling ways to communicate ideas, using the media that best fits the concept: sketches, references, renderings, motion tests, copy, diagrams, layouts, moodboards, decks, prototypes, or AI-assisted visualization.

*Cross-Discipline Collaboration* *
* Work closely with creative, technology, engineering, fabrication, and production teams to shape ideas that are ambitious but achievable.

*Bringing Ideas to Fruition* *
* Contribute across project phases, from early concepting and pitch development through design refinement, pre-production, and production.

*Creative Excellence* *
* Stay curious about culture, emerging technology, materials, interaction patterns, visual trends, and new tools. Bring references, ideas, and energy that help push the work beyond the expected.

----------------
*Desired Skills*
----------------

*Experiential Design* *
* Ability to think through physical experience: form, materiality, interaction, layout, flow, behavior, sequence, and user journey.

*Concept Development* *
* Ability to craft cross-discipline ideas and support them with visuals, language, references, and clear rationale.

*Spatial + Physical Communication* *
* Ability to show how an idea works in space. This could include sketches, diagrams, renderings, models, prototypes, storyboards, plans, sections, physical mockups, or other visual methods.

*Concept Visualization* *
* Ability to communicate abstract concepts through compelling visual mockups using whatever media you feel most comfortable with: sketching, rendering, Photoshop, motion tests, AI tools, deck design, 3D software, or other methods.

*3D Modeling*

Strong proficiency in at least one 3D modeling environment such as Rhino (strong preference), SketchUp, Blender, Cinema 4D, Fusion, or similar. You should be comfortable rapidly translating early concepts into spatial studies and developing selected ideas into clear, compelling 3D visualizations that communicate form, material, scale, interaction, and atmosphere.

*Design Craft* *
* Strong taste, strong composition, and an ability to make ideas feel considered, polished, and intentional.

*Interaction Awareness* *
* Interest in how people engage with physical experiences, objects, interfaces, environments, and technology.

-------------------
*Hybrid Candidates*
-------------------

Ideal candidates are those who can contribute across several disciplines. We’re a small, collaborative creative team with mostly multidisciplinary backgrounds. We value people who have a strong primary craft but are eager to stretch into unfamiliar territory.

*Candidates may come from backgrounds such as:*

* Industrial Design
* Spatial / Environmental Design
* Architecture / Interiors
* Exhibit Design
* Experiential Design
* 3D Design / Visualization
* Product Design

*Additional strengths may include:*

* Interaction Design
* Graphic Design
* Motion / Animation
* Art Direction
* UX/UI
* Strategy
* Creative Technology

Regardless of your primary discipline, we need to see evidence that you can think about *people, space, objects, interaction, and experience*. The strongest portfolios will show how ideas become tangible, spatial, interactive, or experiential — not just how they look on a screen.

--------------------
*Portfolio Guidance*
--------------------

Please include work that demonstrates how you think, not just final outcomes.

We are especially interested in seeing:

* Concepts for physical or interactive experiences
* Environmental, spatial, installation, or exhibit work
* Storyboards, diagrams, sketches, or process work
* Prototypes, mockups, models, or tests
* Motion or graphic systems applied to physical spaces
* Digital concepts that connect to real-world behavior or interaction
* Examples of how you communicate an idea to a team or client

Your portfolio does not need to show finished experiential work from major brands. Student work, self-directed projects, prototypes, speculative concepts, small installations, event work, spatial studies, or experimental projects are welcome if they show strong thinking and a clear relationship to physical experience.

The base salary range for this position at the time of this posting is $50,000 - $84,000 USD. Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package.

You don’t need to match every skill on this list to apply—we welcome applicants with a variety of experiences.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during the interview process, please email us at hr@deeplocal.com

*About Deeplocal*

Deeplocal is an internationally-recognized innovation studio based in Pittsburgh, PA. Our team includes experts in marketing, engineering, design, and fabrication who collaborate to develop never-seen-before physical experiences for brand clients.

Deeplocal has been behind some of advertising’s most talked about campaigns: the Netflix Switch, Google Photos Pay With A Photo, and the Nike Chalkbot. From creating a mind-controlled bike that allowed riders to shift with their thoughts, to building a robotic pitching machine that allowed a child to throw out the first pitch at a baseball game from thousands of miles away, to a single button that dims the lights, orders food, silencers your phone and puts on your favorite show, our projects are wide-ranging and unique. Our work has been featured on Fast Company, Wired, NYTimes, USA Today, the Today Show, Good Morning America, Gizmodo, Engadget, Forbes, and many more.

Deeplocal’s studio is located in a renovated brewery loft space in Sharpsburg, PA—just outside of Pittsburgh and within a few minutes of Lawrenceville. All team members at Deeplocal contribute and participate in work for our amazing roster of clients.

*Our Mission*

Invent products and experiences for innovative brands.

*Our Purpose*

To be a place where amazing talent can invent, create and inspire.

*Our Core Values*

Deeplocal is committed to maintaining the company's core values and culture as the company grows. Employees should exhibit the following Deeplocal core values:

* Inventive
* Impactful
* Resourceful
* Humble
* Efficient

Deeplocal is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

title: Junior Software Engineer with Accounting Experience
description:
*The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $4,000 per month (Gross in USD)*

*About Sezzle:*

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a talented and motivated Junior Software Engineer with a unique blend of *accounting experience* who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This role is tailored for professionals who started their careers in accounting but pivoted to engineering and now want to leverage their domain expertise to solve technical challenges in fintech. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

*Interview Process*

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

* Application submitted (you are here)
* Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
* Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
* Interview with recruiters (30 min)
* Interview with engineers (1 hour)
* Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
* Offer!

*Sezzle Technical Stack:*

* Golang backend, React / React Native front-end
* Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics
* Kubernetes
* AWS
* Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS
* Gitlab CI/CD deployments
* Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing

*What You'll Do:*

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
* Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle.
* Work as an integrated team member developing new features.
* Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and *improve automation and reconciliation workflows*.
* Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
* Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
* Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.

*What We Look For:*

* *Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.*
* Solid understanding of financial operations such as *reconciliation, reporting, and compliance*.
* Proficient in at least one programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and familiar with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Experience with backend API development.
* Experience with relational database storage and retrieval.
* Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
* Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Computer Science, or a related field.

*Sezzle’s Technology Stack:*

* *Languages:* Golang, Typescript, Python
* *Frontend:* Typescript - React and React Native
* *Backend:* Golang
* *Database:* MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
* *DevOps & Cloud:* AWS, Kubernetes
* *Version Control:* Git
* *CI/CD:* Gitlab
* *Testing:* Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
* *Sezzle* is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

*About You:*

* *You have relentlessly high standards* - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* *You’re not bound by convention* - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* *You need action* - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* *You earn trust* - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* *You have backbone; disagree, then commit* - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* *You deliver results* - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

*What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:*

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

We’re looking for a motivated Junior Developer to help us build reliable, modern software solutions as part of our growing engineering team.

Do you enjoy learning new technologies, writing clean code, and improving a little every day? Are you excited about turning ideas into working features? We're looking for someone who can collaborate closely with teammates, follow established development practices, and help build solid, maintainable applications.

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll focus on implementing well-defined features, learning best practices, and growing your technical foundation. You’ll work within an established architecture, supported by experienced engineers who will guide you through design decisions, patterns, and development processes.

You’ll contribute across the stack—building APIs, developing UI components, working with databases, and delivering features that teams and customers rely on.

*What Will You Be Doing?*
-------------------------

Application Development
-----------------------

You will:
---------

* Develop features using *.NET (C#)* and *ASP.NET Core*
* Build and extend *REST APIs*
* Create UI components using *Angular* or *React*
* Integrate frontend applications with backend services
* Apply foundational understanding of:

* HTTP protocol
* Request/response lifecycle
* Status codes
* Basic API design principles

Your focus will be on implementing features in accordance with clear technical guidelines.

Code Quality & Design Principles
--------------------------------

You should demonstrate:
-----------------------

* Understanding of *SOLID* principles
* Familiarity with *Clean Code* practices
* Knowledge of common *GoF design patterns*
* Understanding of layered architecture (Controller → Service → Repository)

---------------------------------

* What microservices are
* Basic cloud concepts (Azure / AWS)

* Environment separation (Dev, QA, Prod)

--------------------

---------

* Work with *relational databases* (MS SQL, PostgreSQL)
* Understand relationships and normalization basics
* Use *Entity Framework* for CRUD operations
* Understand basic indexing concepts

* Authentication vs. authorization
* JWT basics
* Role-based access control
* Basic REST security practices

* Use *Git* effectively (branching, merging, pull requests)
* Follow the team’s branching strategy
* Use debugging tools
* Implement logging and error handling

* Deliver tasks within sprint commitments

* Take responsibility for assigned work
* Communicate blockers early
* Deliver within the agreed scope

----------------

* Eager to learn and grow
* Accept and apply feedback
* Show initiative with new tools and technologies

* Collaborate respectfully
* Participate actively in team processes

title: Junior Proposal Manager
description:
----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

Peraton is seeking a *Junior Proposal Manager* to support the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) DCCO account. The successful candidate will assist in the planning, coordination, development, and submission of competitive federal proposals. This individual will work closely with Proposal Managers, Capture Managers, Business Development, Technical Leads, Pricing, Contracts, Recruiting, and other functional teams to ensure proposals are compliant, compelling, and submitted on schedule.

The Junior Proposal Manager will support multiple proposal efforts simultaneously and play an integral role throughout the proposal lifecycle, from pre-solicitation planning through final proposal submission. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

*Work Location:* This is a fully telework position. Candidates located in the Eastern or Central time zones are preferred.

*Day to Day Work Responsibilities:*

* Support Proposal Managers throughout all phases of the federal proposal lifecycle, including pre-RFP planning, proposal development, production, and submission.
* Assist in developing and maintaining proposal schedules, compliance matrices, action item trackers, and milestone calendars.
* Track proposal assignments and follow up with contributors to ensure timely completion of deliverables.
* Coordinate with technical subject matter experts, pricing, contracts, recruiting, graphics, production, and business development teams to collect proposal content.
* Assist with proposal editing, formatting, document management, version control, and quality assurance reviews.
* Support proposal compliance reviews to ensure all solicitation requirements are addressed.
* Maintain proposal repositories, templates, lessons learned, and other proposal management documentation.
* Prepare status reports and communicate proposal progress to leadership.
* Support multiple concurrent proposal efforts while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of business development and proposal operations.

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

*Basic Qualifications:*

* Bachelor's degree and 2 years of experience, or a High School diploma/equivalent and 6 years of experience
* U.S. Citizenship is required with the ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance
* Experience coordinating multiple proposal activities and meeting aggressive deadlines.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Exceptional organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Microsoft Teams.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience supporting federal government proposals, RFP responses, RFIs, or other government solicitation responses.
* Familiarity with the federal proposal lifecycle, including compliance matrices, proposal schedules, and color team reviews.
* Experience coordinating proposal inputs and deliverables across cross functional teams.
* Experience developing proposal schedules, action item trackers, compliance matrices, and other proposal documentation.
* Proficiency with Microsoft SharePoint and other collaboration or proposal management tools.
* Familiarity with Shipley proposal development methodologies and federal contracting terminology.

----------------
Peraton Overview
----------------

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

-------------------
Target Salary Range
-------------------

$66,000 - $106,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

title: UI/UX Designer (10-12 Month Maternity Cover)
description:
Are you passionate about creating thoughtful digital experiences that make it easier for travellers to discover and book unforgettable trips? We’re hiring a UI/UX Designer to help shape the ToursByLocals traveller experience and evolve our design system. (This is a Maternity Leave Cover lasting for approximately 10-12 months depending on start date, with a possibility for extension.)

ToursByLocals is an online travel marketplace; our platform connects discerning travellers in search of customized, private tours with handpicked tour guides, providing meaningful and memorable travel experiences in over 170 countries, worldwide. We believe in keeping travel human: our global team of nearly 100 people support and engage our customers as they search for out-of-the-ordinary travel experiences. You can learn more about our hiring process here.

This is a full-time remote position, based in Canada. You must be legally able to work in Canada. We are unable to sponsor candidates at this time.

As a UI/UX Designer at ToursByLocals, you’ll help design the flows travellers use to discover, explore, and book tours—from our homepage and search experience to tour and guide pages and the booking process. Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll also contribute to our partner-facing tools and grow our design system to create consistent, scalable experiences across the product range.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers and Engineering to turn customer needs, business goals, and data into thoughtful designs that can be built, tested, measured, and optimized. If you’re excited about combining customer empathy, strong design craft, and experimentation to create a best-in-class global marketplace, apply below!

Your primary goal will be to create intuitive, high-performing experiences that help travellers discover and book the right tour. Here’s how you’ll do that:

* Design pages and components across the traveller side of the ToursByLocals marketplace, including search, tour and guide pages, and the booking experience.
* Continuously optimize existing experiences to improve booking conversion, inquiry conversion, average order value, attach rate, and other customer engagement metrics.
* Extend our design system with scalable primitives, components, and patterns that create consistency across the product.
* Own and maintain our Figma library, including variables, styles, and components, keeping designs aligned with what ships to production.
* Create detailed, responsive designs that clearly define states, breakpoints, and behaviours so Engineering can confidently build from your files.
* Partner with Product Managers to develop A/B testing plans, using data and experimentation to validate ideas and improve the customer experience.

You may be the right person for this role if you:

* Have a deep understanding of UX best practices in a marketplace or e-commerce environment, with a strong focus on creating intuitive, customer-centered experiences.
* Bring strong design system expertise, including hands-on experience with Figma Variables, styles, components, and design tokens to create scalable designs that translate effectively into production.
* Have experience with usability research and A/B testing, using customer insights and data to validate hypotheses and deliver design improvements that measurably impact product or business KPIs.
* Have a mobile-first mindset, with experience designing responsive, accessible experiences that meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards and consider performance throughout the design process.
* Can balance rapid iterations with larger redesign initiatives and are comfortable using AI-powered design tools to explore, evaluate, and refine solutions.
* Love to learn and grow – you challenge yourself to learn, fail, and constantly improve, whether that’s through formal education or by gaining professional experience.

Some bonuses for us are if you:
-------------------------------

* Have experience in travel, e-commerce, or three-sided marketplaces.
* Have worked with a headless CMS where content length and quantity can vary based on editor input.
* Love using data to identify opportunities, validate your instincts, and frame productive discussions.

At ToursByLocals, we believe great talent comes from all backgrounds. Our travellers and guides come from all walks of life, and so do we! We encourage candidates of all experiences to apply, even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications.

We are committed to equitable compensation across regions. The hiring range for this role in Canada is $75,000-$90,000 CAD/year. We look forward to discussing this with you during our hiring process.

We want to make your recruitment experience as smooth as possible. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know when applying—we’re happy to help!

Why ToursByLocals?
------------------

Founded in Vancouver in 2008, ToursByLocals is the go-to platform for private tours worldwide. With a presence in over 170 countries, we enrich people’s travel by connecting them with our network of 5,000+ expert guides to book personalized tours anywhere they’re going. Our global team of 100 support all users of the platform as they embark on one-of-a-kind travel experiences.

We offer competitive benefits based on location.

In Canada, these benefits include:
----------------------------------

👩‍⚕️ Health & Wellness: Comprehensive health and dental coverage for you and your family, plus up to $1,000 annual health spending account.

💻 Home Office Support: A Mac computer, accessories, and furniture to set up your workspace.

✈️ Time Off & Flexibility: Three weeks of paid vacation, additional flexible PTO, and the ability to switch statutory holidays.

✈️ Explore90 program: After one year, work from anywhere in the world for up to 90 days

✈️ Travel Perks: A 25% discount and an annual voucher for ToursByLocals experiences.

💯 Remote Work: We are a fully remote workplace.

Salary: $75,000 - $90,000 CAD

Aktualnie współpracujemy z ponad 300 stałymi kontraktorami oraz obsługujemy klientów ze znanych korporacji bankowych, ubezpieczeniowych i medialnych. title: Pessoa Designer UI/UX Sênior com Inglês Avançado
description:
Somos inspired by tech powered by people. Por isso, precisamos de pessoas apaixonados por desafios e com sede de aprendizado contínuo.

Buscamos por novos makers para sonharem com a gente, que enxerguem além do óbvio e que estejam prontos para se juntar a nós nessa jornada de transformação e crescimento. Estamos expandindo nossos horizontes e buscamos pessoas que compartilhem dessa mesma paixão pela tecnologia e pelo aprendizado contínuo. Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
-------------------------------

* Projetar experiências intuitivas e centradas no usuário para produtos de analytics, relatórios e inteligência comercial.
* Conduzir pesquisas com usuários, entrevistas com stakeholders e sessões de levantamento e descoberta de requisitos.
* Criar wireframes, fluxos de usuário, protótipos e designs de alta fidelidade.
* Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Product Owners, especialistas de negócio (SMEs), Analistas de Dados, Cientistas de Dados e equipes de Desenvolvimento.
* Garantir consistência entre interfaces de usuário, sistemas de design e produtos digitais.
* Apoiar testes de usabilidade e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
--------------------------

* Sólida experiência em Design de UI/UX para aplicações corporativas (enterprise).
* Forte experiência com Figma e sistemas de design modernos.
* Experiência no desenvolvimento de soluções para plataformas com grande volume de dados, dashboards, analytics ou soluções de BI.
* Conhecimento em pesquisa com usuários, testes de usabilidade e metodologias de design centrado no ser humano.
* Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de interagir com stakeholders de negócio.
* Inglês avançado para colaboração com equipes globais.

Diferenciais
------------

* Experiência com Tableau, Power BI, Salesforce ou plataformas comerciais/de trading.
* Experiência em ambientes Agile e em equipes de produto multifuncionais.
* Experiência ou conhecimento nos setores de agricultura, commodities, cadeia de suprimentos (supply chain) ou analytics comercial.

title: [Job - 31098] Mid-Level UI/UX Designer, Brazil
description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

We are digital specialists impacting some of the world’s most valuable brands. We’re looking for a *UX / Product Designer* to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to define and deliver intuitive, user-centered digital products. You will own design problems end-to-end — from user research and concept to interactive prototypes and handoff — helping drive business outcomes through great design.

Must-Have Skills (Required)
---------------------------

* Product UX Experience: proven track record designing successful digital products and services.
* User-Centered Design: strong knowledge of UX principles, user research methods, personas and user journeys.
* Design Tools: proficiency in Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, Principle, or similar.
* Prototyping Tools: experience with InVision, Figma prototyping, Origami, Axure, or similar tools.
* Visual Design Foundations: solid understanding of typography, color theory, layout and interface design.
* Research & Validation: experience planning and running user research, usability testing and synthesizing insights.
* Collaboration & Handoff: ability to create specs and documentation for engineering handoff and work closely with engineers and product teams.
* Communication: strong verbal and visual storytelling skills to present and justify design decisions.
* Language: fluent English.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Define design requirements in collaboration with product, engineering and research stakeholders.
* Create wireframes, user flows, sitemaps, specifications and other UX deliverables.
* Conduct user research to understand user needs and behaviors; develop personas and journeys.
* Design intuitive interfaces and interactive prototypes to validate concepts and drive alignment.
* Ensure consistency by following brand guidelines and design systems.
* Own design problems end-to-end — from concept through delivery and post-launch iteration.
* Identify opportunities and act as a strategic design partner to product and business stakeholders.
* Facilitate team discussions that drive decisions and align priorities.

Nice to Have (Differentials)
----------------------------

* Strong visual/interface design and information design skills.
* Excellent storytelling and presentation skills for stakeholder alignment.
* Experience producing detailed documentation for development handoff.
* Understanding of HTML/CSS to improve collaboration with development teams.
* Experience facilitating workshops and cross-functional design sessions.

The successful candidate delivers user-centered solutions that solve real business problems and noticeably improve user experience and product metrics. You will be a trusted design partner who helps the team move from insights to impactful, production-ready experiences while ensuring design consistency and high-quality handoffs.

If you’re passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences and want to join an innovative team, please apply — we’d love to meet you. Good luck!

Our benefits:
-------------

-Health and dental insurance
-Meal and food allowance
-Childcare assistance
-Extended paternity leave
-Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
-Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
-Life insurance
-Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
-Discount club
-Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
-Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
-Partnerships with online learning platforms
-Language learning platform
And many more!
More details about our benefits here:
At CI&T, inclusion starts at the first contact. If you are a person with a disability, it is important *to present your assessment during the selection process.* See which data needs to be included in the report by clicking here.This way, we can ensure the support and accommodations that you deserve. *If you do not yet have the assessment, don't worry: we can support you in obtaining it.*
We have a dedicated Health and Well-being team, inclusion specialists, and affinity groups who will be with you at every stage. Count on us to make this journey side by side.

title: Mid-Level UI/UX Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mid-Level UI/UX Designer based in Brazil.*

This role offers the opportunity to shape intuitive, user-centered digital products within a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
You will take ownership of design challenges from early discovery and research through prototyping, delivery, and post-launch iteration.
Working closely with product, engineering, and research teams, you will translate user insights and business needs into impactful experiences.
Your work will influence both the quality of digital products and measurable business and user outcomes.
You will contribute to design systems, visual consistency, usability, and high-quality development handoffs.
The role combines hands-on design execution with strategic collaboration and stakeholder engagement.
It is an excellent opportunity for a designer who wants to grow their impact while working on complex digital transformation initiatives.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Define UX and design requirements in partnership with product, engineering, research, and business stakeholders.
* Create wireframes, user flows, sitemaps, interface specifications, and other UX deliverables to communicate design solutions effectively.
* Conduct user research to understand behaviors, needs, and pain points, translating findings into actionable design insights.
* Develop personas, customer journeys, and other research-based artifacts to support user-centered decision-making.
* Design intuitive interfaces and interactive prototypes that help validate concepts, gather feedback, and align stakeholders.
* Own design problems end-to-end, from initial concept and discovery through development handoff, launch, and post-release improvements.
* Ensure consistency across digital experiences by applying established brand guidelines and design systems.
* Partner closely with engineers to provide clear specifications, documentation, and design assets for efficient implementation.
* Identify opportunities where design can improve user experiences, product performance, and broader business outcomes.
* Facilitate collaborative discussions, workshops, and design sessions that help teams reach decisions and align priorities.
* Present design concepts and recommendations using clear verbal and visual storytelling tailored to different stakeholder audiences.
* Advocate for user needs while balancing technical constraints, business priorities, and product objectives.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of design practices, processes, and the quality of delivered digital experiences.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Proven professional experience designing successful digital products and services, ideally in a mid-level UX, UI/UX, or Product Design capacity.
* Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, including user research, personas, customer journeys, usability testing, and insight synthesis.
* Proficiency with modern design tools such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, Principle, or comparable platforms.
* Hands-on experience creating interactive prototypes using tools such as Figma, InVision, Origami, Axure, or similar.
* Solid visual design foundations, including typography, color theory, layout, composition, and interface design.
* Demonstrated ability to plan and conduct user research and usability testing and turn findings into practical design decisions.
* Experience producing clear design specifications and documentation for engineering handoff.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, research, and business teams.
* Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain and defend design decisions clearly.
* Fluent English communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and a user-focused approach to solving complex problems.
* Ability to balance user needs, business objectives, technical considerations, and delivery constraints.
* Understanding of HTML and CSS is an advantage for effective collaboration with development teams.
* Experience facilitating workshops or cross-functional design sessions is a plus.
* Strong visual/interface design, information design, storytelling, and stakeholder presentation skills are considered valuable differentiators.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Health and dental insurance.
* Meal and food allowances.
* Childcare assistance.
* Extended paternity leave.
* Access to gyms, fitness programs, and health and wellness professionals through partner platforms.
* Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR).
* Life insurance.
* Continuous learning opportunities through an internal learning platform.
* Partnerships with online learning and professional development platforms.
* Language learning resources and platforms.
* Discount club with access to additional products and services.
* Free online resources supporting physical, mental, and overall well-being.
* Pregnancy and responsible parenting courses.
* Dedicated health and well-being support.
* Inclusion specialists and employee affinity groups.
* A collaborative, multidisciplinary environment with opportunities to work on complex digital transformation initiatives.
* Opportunities for continuous professional development and career growth.

title: Freelance Brand Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

What We Do
----------

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role
--------------

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
* Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
* Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
* Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
* Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

How to get started
------------------

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Educational qualifications*

* At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

*Academic and/or Professional Experience*

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

*Technical Skills (Essential)*

* Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
* Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
* Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
* Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

*Additional requirements*

* A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
* Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
* Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
* Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
* English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations
-------------------------

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation
------------

On this project, contributors can earn up to *$40 per hour equivalent* , depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Bottom line: what you make is how Pluckers looks everywhere it shows up.

This role needs someone with the creativity to design new content from scratch, but who's also not above rolling up their sleeves for quick edits and tweaks to work that already exists — big swings and small fixes both matter here. You'll collaborate closely with fellow marketing team members like our Social Media Manager, Events and Entertainment Coordinator, and Video Team, and you'll produce content for multiple departments across the company, so range and reliability both go a long way.

* Associates or Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design or Communication Design
* Photography
* Understanding of front-end web design
* Experience with the Webflow platform
* Videography
* Experience with professional audio equipment and microphones

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Product Designer based in India.*

As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape digital experiences designed to help people build healthier, more sustainable habits. You’ll work at the intersection of product design, behavioral psychology, AI, and gamification to create experiences that are both engaging and effective. Your work will influence the customer journey of a large-scale consumer product used by millions of people worldwide. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to turn behavioral insights, research, and data into innovative product solutions. AI will be a core part of the design process, rather than an optional feature layered onto the experience. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional approaches, experiment rapidly, and create meaningful experiences at significant global scale.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Lead the design of innovative B2C product experiences that improve the customer journey and support long-term behavior change.
* Design with AI as a fundamental component of the user experience, exploring meaningful ways to integrate AI-powered functionality into product journeys.
* Apply gamification principles and behavioral psychology to create experiences that motivate users and encourage sustainable habits.
* Use UX research, behavioral insights, analytics, and product data to identify opportunities and validate design decisions.
* Develop original UI/UX concepts and unconventional solutions that differentiate the product and improve user engagement and effectiveness.
* Analyze user behavior, market trends, and emerging product patterns to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Develop, test, and refine design hypotheses through rapid experimentation and iterative product development.
* Work closely with product, engineering, research, analytics, and other cross-functional teams to bring design concepts from idea to implementation.
* Present, explain, and confidently defend design decisions and hypotheses to relevant stakeholders.
* Continuously raise the quality and effectiveness of the product experience by challenging assumptions and seeking better solutions.

------------
Requirements
------------

* 5+ years of experience designing high-quality B2C digital products, ideally within recognized consumer-facing products or platforms.
* Strong expertise in modern mobile product design and UX/UI principles.
* Demonstrated ability to incorporate AI technologies into product experiences and design workflows.
* Strong understanding of gamification mechanics and how behavioral psychology can influence product engagement and user habits.
* Experience using UX research and data analytics to inform, validate, and iterate on design decisions.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to look beyond surface-level design problems and identify underlying user needs and behaviors.
* Data-driven mindset with a strong appetite for rapid experimentation, testing, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to formulate original hypotheses and translate them into compelling design solutions.
* Confidence presenting and defending design concepts, decisions, and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of user motivation, habits, behavior, and the factors that contribute to long-term engagement and loyalty.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies, evolving consumer behavior, and market trends, with the ability to turn relevant trends into meaningful product opportunities.
* Experience designing for Health & Fitness products or applications is a strong plus.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional product environment.

--------

title: Senior Designer
description:
Certa is the AI-first third-party operating system. Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

We're looking for a Senior Designer who believes B2B products should feel as intuitive, delightful, and human as the best B2C experiences — and that AI should amplify, not complicate, them. Reporting to the VP of Product, you'll own the design vision, raise the bar for craft, and turn complex enterprise workflows into AI-native, consumer-grade experiences — helping establish Certa as a benchmark for modern B2B and AI-native UX.

--------------
What You'll Do
--------------

*

*Own the design vision:* Define and own the end-to-end product design vision with a B2C-quality bar for B2B experiences, and lead the evolution toward AI-native UX where AI is embedded into workflows rather than bolted on as a feature.

*

*Design trustworthy AI:* Establish principles for human-in-the-loop design, trust, explainability, and transparency, and decide when automation, recommendations, or agentic flows truly create user value.

*

*Lead product & UX end-to-end:* Own design across the full lifecycle — discovery, research, ideation, prototyping, validation, and delivery — partnering deeply with Product, Engineering, and Customer teams to translate complex enterprise workflows into intuitive, self-serve, scalable experiences.

*

*Build the team & culture:* Build, mentor, and grow a high-impact design team as Certa scales, establishing strong critique, feedback, and experimentation practices and a collaborative, design-led culture.

*

*Influence stakeholders:* Clearly communicate design and AI-UX decisions to leadership and cross-functional teams, advocate for user trust and long-term experience quality, and balance speed with craft and innovation with usability.

----------------
What You'll Need
----------------

*

*Experience:* 5–8 years of product design experience, with a strong B2C background and exposure to B2B or enterprise products, and a proven ability to simplify complex workflows into elegant, intuitive experiences.

*

*AI-native design:* Hands-on experience designing AI-native products — copilots, agentic workflows, conversational and multimodal interfaces, recommendation systems — with enough grasp of LLM/agent concepts to partner with engineering on feasibility, evaluate model outputs, and design around latency, uncertainty, and failure states.

*

*Tools:* Fluent with AI-assisted design and prototyping tools (Figma AI, v0, Cursor, Claude/ChatGPT) and comfortable using them daily to accelerate your work.

*

*Portfolio:* A strong portfolio of shipped work demonstrating craft, clarity, and impact — bonus if it includes AI-native or agentic product experiences.

*

*Leadership & communication:* Experience leading design initiatives or small teams (people management a plus), with excellent communication and storytelling and the ability to influence product direction through design.

*

*Mindset:* A belief that great design is a competitive advantage even in complex enterprise software, a clear point of view on how AI should feel (helpful, trustworthy, human), and high ownership, curiosity, and bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

*

*Nice to have:* Designing AI-native products from the ground up; a background in enterprise, workflow-heavy, or data-intensive SaaS; experience modernizing legacy or complex systems; and startup or high-growth company experience.

-------------------------
Compensation and Benefits
-------------------------

*

*Compensation:* Top of market salary + bonuses

*

*Time off:* 49 days paid time off

*

*Benefits:* PTO, full benefits, retirement and wellness plans

*

*Growth:* Professional development support, remote workspace setup bonus

*

*Team building:* Annual company offsites in exciting locations around the world

--------
Location
--------

This role is based in India (remote). Certa is a remote-first company and we hire globally. We believe strongly in each team member working from the location that they choose. Should Certers wish to meet and work in person, they have 3 lively office locations they can travel to:

*

London

*

San Francisco

*

Jaipur

The perfect place for Certers to collaborate, co-work, and have face-to-face meetings.

---------
Why Certa
---------

*

*Category leadership.* Certa was named a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Third-Party Risk Management Tools — recognition that we're defining the category, not following it.

*

*Industry recognition.* We've been honored across the analyst and awards landscape, including Top Tech and Customer Value distinctions in The Hackett Group's 2026 Risk Management SolutionMap, the ProcureTech100 (Advanced AI and Risk Management categories), and Best Overall eProcurement Software in the FinTech Breakthrough Awards.

*

*A top place to work.* Certa was named one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in the US. We're a fast-growing company where you'll wear many hats, ship quickly, and shape decisions that matter.

*

*Real scale with strong backing.* We've processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries. We're well-funded by leading investors including Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures, on the back of an oversubscribed Series B, headed towards Series C.

We're excited to meet you!

title: Product Manager, Inventory & Orders
description:
At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real-world impacts. Whether it’s medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.

Industry Context: AI-driven supply chain innovations reduce logistics costs by 15%+, inventory by 35%+, and improve service efficiency by 65%+. Companies prioritize AI-enabled automation as the key enabler for customer experience, sustainability, and resilience.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity *.
*

FourKites is building a next-generation Inventory & Orders module that gives supply chain teams unified, real-time visibility into on-hand stock, in-transit inventory, open orders, and stockout risk — across their entire network. We are looking for a Product Manager I to own day-to-day execution for this module: writing precise specifications, synthesizing customer discovery into prioritized backlogs, and partnering with engineering to ship features that help supply chain planners move from reactive firefighting to proactive decision-making.

This is a high-visibility role on a nascent product. You will work at the intersection of supply chain planning, procurement, and real-time logistics data — with your contributions directly shaping the foundational decisions of this offering.

What you'll be doing

*Product Execution & Specification*

* Author detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and feature specifications for capabilities such as safety stock threshold configuration, order-at-risk dashboards, and AI-assisted stock transfer recommendations.
* Translate ambiguous customer requirements into structured, engineering-ready backlog items with clear scope boundaries.
* Own sprint-level backlog grooming in collaboration with the engineering manager, ensuring tickets are well-defined and prioritized before each cycle.

*Customer Discovery & Feedback Synthesis*

* Conduct structured discovery sessions independently with supply chain planners, procurement leads, and operations teams.
* Synthesize raw customer feedback, field notes, and survey data into prioritized problem statements and product hypotheses.
* Maintain a continuous feedback loop with pilot customers during early rollouts, identifying adoption gaps and surfacing them as actionable product improvements.

*Integration & Data Requirements*

* Own integration requirement specifications — defining how data from ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), warehouse management systems, and demand planning tools flows into FourKites via flat-file SFTP, API, and EDI.
* Work with Solutions Engineering to validate integration feasibility, data freshness requirements, and schema mapping during pre-sales and onboarding.
* Identify and escalate data quality risks that could compromise dashboard accuracy during early customer deployments.

*Cross-Functional Collaboration*

* Partner closely with engineering, design, and Solutions Engineering throughout the feature lifecycle — from discovery through general availability.
* Coordinate with Customer Success during pilot rollouts to ensure smooth adoption and capture post-launch learnings.
* Support pre-sales activities by providing product clarity on capabilities, integration requirements, and roadmap direction.

*Who you are*

* 3+ years of professional experience in product management, supply chain operations, procurement, or demand planning.
* Demonstrated understanding of inventory and procurement workflows — including safety stock parameters, days-of-supply calculations, MRP outputs, and order fulfillment processes.
* Ability to write clear, structured product specifications and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can execute without ambiguity.
* Comfort owning integration requirement discussions — understanding data flow, feed latency tradeoffs, and schema mapping without needing to write code.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS product tooling: Jira, Confluence, or equivalent.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex customer conversations into concise product requirements.
* Comfortable working across time zones in a remote or hybrid environment.

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Prior experience at a supply chain software company, a shipper/manufacturer, or a supply chain consulting practice.
* Familiarity with ERP and WMS ecosystems (SAP, Oracle, Manhattan, HighJump) and how they integrate with third-party visibility or planning tools.
* Exposure to AI/ML-assisted recommendations in an operational supply chain context — such as automated reorder suggestions, stockout prediction, or inventory rebalancing.
* Background as a demand planner, procurement analyst, or supply chain operations professional who has transitioned into a product or technical role.
* Experience with supply chain visibility platforms or similar real-time logistics and inventory products.
* Familiarity with KPIs such as OTIF, inventory turnover, case fill rate, and days of supply.

*Who we are:*

FourKites, the leader in AI-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit www.fourkites.com.

FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.

*Benefits:*

* Medical benefits start on first day of employment
* 36 PTO days( Sick, Casual and Earned) , 5 recharge days, 2 volunteer days
* Home Office set ups and Technology reimbursement
* Lifestyle & Family benefits
* Mental Wellness support and guidance
* Ongoing learning & development opportunities ( Professional development program, Toast Master club etc.)
