*Lead Product Partnerships Manager (Fixed Term Contract)*

*Location:* Remote, US | Duration: 6 month fixed term contract

*Hours:* 40hpw (full time), available for synchronous collaboration 15:00- 20:00 UTC

*Background Information*

The Wikimedia Foundation (WMF) seeks an experienced Lead Product Partnerships Manager to increase the global reach of Wikipedia's products and knowledge in a rapidly changing web landscape. The successful candidate will serve as a front-facing representative for external partnerships where the primary value is directly tied to product integration and new distribution opportunities for the Product and Technology (P&T) department, working within P&T with our org-wide partnerships cohort.

This person will cultivate relationships to grow the reuse of Wikimedia content in new work in new products and spaces, as well as fostering increased presence of our content with existing reuse partners via adoption of Wikimedia attribution tools provided. Key audiences include AI providers, social/EdTech platforms, and other companies seeking product integration. This is a highly independent and self-directed lead position requiring candidates to possess existing, strong connections in the soft and hardware tech space.

*Scope of Work*

* *New Product & Technology Partnerships Cultivation:* Identify and secure new partnerships with existing and new technology platform partners. Collaborating closely with Product and Design teams, define and execute on a portfolio of non-commercial value exchange partnerships that advance the P&T department’s strategic goals, exploring areas such as new product development and integrations; data- and lead-sharing; and/or in-kind donations of technical products/services..
* *Attribution and Content Reuse:* Assist in designing and and securing pilots with high-priority Wikimedia content reusers to drive attribution visibility by adopting the Wikimedia Attribution Framework and API.
* *Cross-organizational Collaboration:* Coordinate across teams and departments (WME, Legal, Communications, Fundraising, Content Enablement, Community Resources & Partnerships) to build and maintain an up-to-date partner and opportunity pipeline. Be the voice of Product and Technology in cross-departmental discussions of the reuser and partner ecosystem.
* *Execution and Coordination:* Manage partnership processes and artifacts, including drafting LOI/MOUs (zero-dollar contracts), CRM management, creating pitch decks, and coordinating with other Partnerships staff across departments and teams.
* *Industry Engagement:* Attend relevant conferences, events, and gatherings to represent the needs of our organization and share back industry intelligence on product and technology trends. Monitor technology news to identify new launches that may impact our goals or provide new partnership opportunities.

*Deliverables/Responsibilities*

* Creating LOI/MOUs (zero-dollar contracts)
* CRM management in concert with Partnerships cohort across the organization
* Creating & refining pitch decks
* Creating, refining, & implementing pitch strategy (developing lists of friendlies, managing comms & scheduling with partners)
* Strong product and technical fluency to align the P&T product roadmap for high-scale reusers, ensuring alignment on data formats, reliability SLAs, and repeatable "Partner Kits".
* Coordinating with other Partnerships staff across departments/teams
* Attending partner conferences/events
* Monitoring for new partnership opportunities around new product releases

*Skills*

* Proven experience forming and managing high-level, multi-stakeholder partnerships, particularly in the technology and/or media industry, with demonstrated independence and self-direction expected in a lead role.
* Existing Network: Strong connections across the media and technology ecosystem, particularly within AI, social, media, and EdTech platforms
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the proven ability to influence both internal and external stakeholders, and operate in a complex, consensus-driven, cross-cultural environment.
* Analytical mindset to uncover and independently analyze insights from partners and market conditions.
* Experience in program/project management, including workflow management, managing comms and scheduling with partners, and note-taking and following up on action items.
* A passion for the mission and values of the Wikimedia movement.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

*As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. title: Senior Product Partnerships Manager
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Product Partnerships at Ramp is where we go when the right partner doesn't exist yet — or when the canonical partner doesn't move fast enough. The team owns the integrations that expand Ramp's product surface area: tax and compliance automation, agentic commerce, data partnerships, international payments, receipt and payment automation, and the technical substrate that lets Ramp plug into any system a customer runs.

This role isn't about hitting a quota. It's about picking the right partners in emerging categories, negotiating the terms, shipping the integration with our Product and Engineering teams, and turning the launch into something customers actually feel. Recent and active examples: selecting an AI-native VAT compliance partner, white-labeling eInvoicing for international markets, shipping receipt automation, building agentic payment partnerships, and negotiating data governance terms with the largest platforms in the industry.

You'll work directly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and GTM. You'll own deals end-to-end. The bar is partnerships that move Ramp's product forward — not deals that move a number on a dashboard.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the full lifecycle of strategic product partnerships: source, qualify, negotiate commercial and legal terms, structure the integration with Product and Engineering, launch, and scale

- Translate partner capabilities into product opportunities: work side-by-side with Product and Engineering to scope what's worth building, and with Legal on risk, liability, and regulatory framing

- Negotiate complex commercial terms — pricing, rev share, MSA, BAFO cycles, multi-year structure, data and IP rights

- Quarterback launches across Marketing, Sales, and Solutions to make sure customers actually adopt what we ship

- Build durable relationships with senior counterparts at partner organizations and run formal cadences (QBRs, exec syncs) once partnerships are live

- Define and report against partnership KPIs that map to Ramp's product and revenue priorities

WHAT YOU NEED

- 7+ years across Business Development, Strategic Partnerships, Product Partnerships, Product Management, or a related discipline, with a clear track record of owning deals end to end (sourcing through launch)

- Experience structuring and closing partnerships that required real product and engineering work — not channel referrals or reseller motions

- Strong fluency with API-based integrations: comfortable scoping technical work directly with engineers and PMs, and translating between partner-side and product-side stakeholders

- Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you've picked partners in spaces where there was no obvious incumbent and made the call stick

- Strong commercial instincts: pricing, term structure, risk allocation, and the ability to drive a contract to signature without hand-holding from legal

NICE TO HAVES

- Background that includes one of the categories above. Strong preference for Product Management

- Direct experience negotiating data, API, or model-access governance terms (MCP, model providers, platform data exposure)

- Shipped a product partnership that opened a new vertical, geography, or category for your company

- Prior exposure to ERP or accounting ecosystems (relevant context, not the primary job)

- Experience as a design-partner manager for early-stage products

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns. We work to communicate the value of our financial solutions, attract new customers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones. By leveraging data-driven insights and creative strategies, we ensure Airwallex stands out in a competitive market. Our team is passionate about telling the Airwallex story and supporting the company's growth and success.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

You will be the first dedicated marketing hire for Mexico, responsible for building Airwallex's marketing presence from the ground up in one of Latin America's most dynamic cross-border commerce markets. You will localize global campaigns, develop Mexico-specific programs, and partner with the local commercial team to generate pipeline and accelerate customer growth. This role requires someone who can operate independently, move fast in ambiguity, and connect marketing activity directly to business outcomes. You will report to the VP, Marketing, NA and collaborate with global Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Operations teams across multiple time zones.

This role is based in Mexico City.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Plan, produce, and execute all local physical and hybrid field events—including intimate C-level roundtables, networking dinners, customer workshops, trade shows, and industry conferences.

- Develop and execute the local content roadmap; define structural frameworks ("skeletons") and quarterback the end-to-end development of localized thought leadership, whitepapers, industry reports, and high-converting lead magnets that drive top-of-funnel demand and establish Airwallex as a market authority.

- Localize global messaging and campaigns for Mexican businesses, decision-makers, and buying journeys.

- Build marketing programs around Mexico's cross-border commerce, international business, fintech, payments, and digital-business ecosystem.

- Develop high-quality Spanish-language content, customer communications, events, and campaign experiences appropriate for the Mexican market.

- Partner with the Mexico commercial organization to identify priority industries, customer segments, use cases, and local proof points.

- Build relationships with Mexican fintech, technology, commerce, startup, and business communities.

- Coordinate local market requirements with Product, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and central Marketing teams.

- Own the regional marketing budget for Mexico, ensuring efficient spend and measurable return on investment.

- Define and track local marketing KPIs tied to pipeline, revenue, brand awareness, and customer acquisition; report on campaign effectiveness and continuously optimize strategies.

- Act as Airwallex's marketing voice in Mexico, representing the brand at local events, in media, and with ecosystem partners to position Airwallex as a thought leader in the market.

WHO YOU ARE

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 8+ years of experience in marketing, with meaningful experience in regional, country, growth, demand-generation, integrated, field, or product marketing.

- Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing plans for a country, region, business line, or new market.

- Strong track record of building programs from the ground up and delivering measurable outcomes rather than only managing existing campaigns.

- Experience partnering closely with Sales, Partnerships, SDR, RevOps, Product, and global Marketing teams.

- Proven ability to connect marketing activity to business outcomes, including pipeline, revenue, acquisition, conversion, activation, or customer growth.

- Strong understanding of integrated marketing channels, campaign operations, measurement, attribution, and funnel optimization.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.

- Strong local-market knowledge and credibility with relevant customers, partners, media, industry groups, or ecosystem stakeholders in Mexico.

- Experience operating independently in a high-growth, ambiguous, or evolving environment.

- Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders and coordinate complex cross-functional work without direct authority.

- Experience in fintech, payments, banking, SaaS, or B2B technology sectors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience marketing cross-border payments, treasury, FX, or global financial infrastructure products to business audiences in Mexico or Latin America.

- Prior experience at a high-growth fintech or technology company during a new-market launch or early-stage expansion phase.

- Comfort operating in environments with high standards, fast iteration cycles, and evolving priorities.

- Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action and continuous improvement.

- Experience managing external agencies, freelancers, or vendor relationships in the Mexican market.

Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

As a Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you will be a hands‑on coach leading a pod of Account Executives focused on SMB and mid‑market customers across UK and selected EMEA territories.

- Attract, hire and onboard A‑player AEs in partnership with Talent Acquisition, providing clear expectations, coaching and development paths for each team member.

- Partner with Product, Marketing, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other stakeholders to feed structured market feedback, shape local GTM strategy and support new market or business‑line launches.

- Experience in high‑growth tech or fintech, ideally with one or more of: payments, FX, cards, accounts, or spend management products.

- Organize and facilitate board, committee and general meetings, including preparing agendas, resolutions, minutes and presentation materials, and manage follow-ups and action item tracking.

- Maintain statutory registers, board books, minute books and corporate records for all group entities, keeping them accurate and accessible across the organization.

- Support Options and RSU administration and shareholder-related matters, partnering with People & Talent and Corporate Development.

- Keep the group compliant with licensing conditions, regulatory obligations and internal governance standards in every jurisdiction Airwallex operates in, and advise on governance improvements.

- Prior experience managing multi-jurisdictional entities and complex group structures, including entity incorporation, restructuring and statutory compliance across different legal regimes.

- Strong knowledge of corporate governance frameworks, directors' duties and regulatory compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear, concise board materials and interface effectively with directors, regulators and cross-functional stakeholders.

description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. ABOUT THE TEAM

The Strategy & Operations team at Airwallex plays a pivotal role in driving the company's overall growth and efficiency. We are a collaborative group of analysts, strategists, and operational experts who are passionate about translating vision into action. We leverage data insights, sharp problem-solving skills, and a deep understanding of the business to optimize processes, identify growth opportunities, and ensure Airwallex operates efficiently and effectively at scale.

Our Revenue Operations team is a multidisciplinary function focused on building a scalable and efficient revenue engine across people, process, systems, data and enablement. We work closely with regional commercial teams and Global Revenue Operations to deliver scalable, predictable revenue growth through better commercial and customer experiences.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

We are looking for a commercially minded Revenue Strategy & Operations professional to help scale our revenue engine across ANZ.

You will act as a strategic and operational partner to ANZ commercial leadership, strengthening forecasting, pipeline management, target setting and commercial execution. You will combine rigorous analysis with hands-on delivery across Salesforce, commissions, reporting and commercial tooling.

During this 12-month engagement, you will lead priority initiatives that improve revenue visibility, operating cadence and process scalability across ANZ. You will also help develop practices that can be adopted more broadly across Airwallex.

This role is based in Sydney, Australia.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial planning and performance

- Partner with ANZ commercial leaders to identify growth opportunities, improve execution and raise the bar for commercial performance.

- Support go-to-market planning, target setting and resource allocation across Sales and Account Management.

- Analyse the end-to-end revenue funnel - from lead generation and acquisition through to growth and retention - to identify performance gaps and recommend practical actions.

- Translate commercial data and business context into clear insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.

Forecasting and revenue management

- Establish and improve forecasting, pipeline-review and performance-management cadences across ANZ.

- Monitor pipeline health, win rates, conversion, sales velocity and churn to surface risks, opportunities and leading indicators.

- Build dashboards, reports and operating processes that enable leaders to make timely, data-informed decisions.

- Drive quarterly target-setting and commissions processes in partnership with Sales and Finance, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.

Operational excellence and scale

- Own and improve core commercial processes across Salesforce and other revenue tools, with a focus on accuracy, efficiency and user adoption.

- Strengthen CRM governance and data quality to improve visibility and accountability across the revenue funnel.

- Identify and implement opportunities to automate recurring workflows and remove operational friction.

- Design scalable processes that can be adopted beyond ANZ in partnership with Global Revenue Operations.

- Collaborate across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Customer Success and Operations to deliver effective process improvements and a seamless commercial experience.

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

- 5+ years of relevant experience in revenue operations, sales operations, commercial strategy, business operations, consulting, finance or a related field, together with a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

- Demonstrated experience using data to analyse commercial performance, identify opportunities and make practical recommendations.

- Experience managing or supporting revenue operations processes such as forecasting, pipeline management, quota or target setting, commissions, performance reporting or CRM governance.

- Strong analytical skills, with practical experience using Excel, Google Sheets and Google Workspace to build reports, models and operating processes.

- Experience working with Salesforce or another CRM and the ability to maintain accurate, reliable commercial data.

- Proven ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations and other cross-functional stakeholders, including senior leaders.

Preferred qualifications:

- Experience with SQL and business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Looker or similar platforms.

- Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, SaaS or another international, high-growth technology environment.

- Experience designing scalable processes, implementing automation or improving systems and tools across a revenue organisation.

title: Forward Deployed Consultant, Manufacturing
description:
About the Team

The Professional Services organization at Miro is focused on ensuring our Enterprise customers achieve exceptional outcomes through the Innovation Workspace. Our team of strategic advisors, implementation experts, and forward deployed consultants work side-by-side with customers to transform how they collaborate, build, and innovate—powered by agentic AI and Miro's world-class platform.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Consultant, Manufacturing, you will apply AI solutions to transform and automate the core operating processes of leading industrial enterprises. You will engage directly with C-level executives, help them identify high-impact opportunities, build and test enterprise-grade AI solutions on their own data and systems, and drive measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology. You will be paired with an Account Executive against named accounts—hunting for problems worth solving, then proving they can be solved. Generalist FDCs lead client discussions across industries; as the Manufacturing Specialist, you are the dedicated depth they bring in when a pursuit turns on industrial expertise.

What you’ll do

Executive Agenda:

- Partner with senior executives—COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Chief Digital Officer, VP Manufacturing, VP Quality—to define an AI transformation agenda Miro can attach to

- Lead the initial CxO conversation that creates awareness of what AI makes possible for the business

- Qualify opportunities before committing to a Validation Sprint: sponsor authority, commitment, and the account's potential to become a multi-year, seven-figure relationship

Validation Sprints:

- Co-author the Sprint charter with the AE: the business problem, its value, our approach, exit criteria, and the partnership proposal that follows success

- Run the Sprint end to end—immerse, prioritise, build, read out—developing and testing the solution on the customer's real data and systems

- Take manufacturing processes apart and rebuild them on AI-first principles across five workflows: new product development and gate review, quality and continuous improvement, portfolio and program management, operations and launch readiness, and process development and transformation

- Build using Miro's AI Workflows, Prototypes, and Goals, Roadmaps & Delivery capabilities, extended through Miro's API, WebSDK, and MCP integrations into ERP, PLM, MES, and quality systems

Value and Conversion:

- Turn Sprint outcomes into a business value story, ROI model, and KPI baseline—grounded in metrics the customer already runs on: gate cycle time, requirement coverage at gate, defect recurrence, cost of poor quality, capacity utilisation, on-time launch rate, ramp-to-full-rate time

- Support executive leadership in delivering the Value Story read-out to the sponsor

- Co-own with the AE the conversion of Sprint outcomes into the partnership proposal and commercial approach

- Define the scope of Professional Services involvement post-sale and hand over cleanly

- Package what you learn and radiate it—internally to Sales, Marketing, and Product, and externally through thought leadership

What you’ll need

- 8+ years in top-tier consulting, forward deployed engineering, solution consulting, or enterprise transformation, weighted toward manufacturing and industrial environments

- Deep understanding of manufacturing operating processes: NPI and stage-gate/APQP, engineering change management, quality systems (FMEA, 8D, PPAP), S&OP and production planning, lean and continuous improvement, maintenance and reliability

- Fluency with the industrial enterprise stack—ERP (SAP or equivalent), PLM (Teamcenter, Windchill, 3DEXPERIENCE), MES, quality management systems—and where the data lives

- Credibility with COO, Chief Supply Chain Officer, VP Operations, VP Quality, and Plant General Manager stakeholders

- Exceptional GenAI skills: Miro, Cursor, Claude Code and Cowork, ChatGPT, Google and Microsoft suites, MCP integrations, prompt and context engineering. You can build working solutions yourself and orchestrate an AI Engineer when the build demands it

- Ability to build a before/after value story with financial and ROI analysis that survives finance scrutiny

- A business-problem-first rather than product-first mindset, and the curiosity to take any process apart

- Comfort in both the boardroom and the plant

- Self-starter who operates independently and under ambiguity

- Willing to travel to customer sites up to 40%

What's in it for you

We want you to feel supported, connected, and ready to grow. Our global benefits package generally includes equity, a wellbeing benefit, a WFH equipment allowance, and an annual Learning & Development stipend. Join a diverse team where you can do your best work. Full benefits may differ per location. If you would like to learn more about location-specific benefits, please refer to our Global Miro benefits board. https://miro.com/app/board/uXjVG8Fi8Yc=/?moveToWidget=3458764661021134968&cot=10

description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

Summary:
Leads the development of complex software features and contributes to architectural decisions across Tekion’s platforms. Mentors junior engineers, promotes engineering best practices, and drives technical excellence in both design and implementation.

Duties & Responsibilities:
•  Designs and builds scalable, high-performance systems and services to support business growth and technical evolution.
•  Leads feature development from concept to deployment, ensuring quality, performance, and maintainability.
•  Collaborates with architects and senior engineers to influence system design and technical strategy.
•  Mentors junior engineers and fosters a culture of continuous learning and code quality.
•  Conducts code reviews, sets engineering standards, and drives adoption of best practices across the team.
•  Identifies bottlenecks and proactively resolves technical challenges in production and development environments.

Qualifications:
•  5–7 years of experience in software engineering
•  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
•  Expertise in one or more modern programming languages (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, C++)
•  Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native services, and performance optimization
•  Experience with microservices, containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
•  Excellent problem-solving, mentorship, and communication skills
•  Proven track record of delivering production-grade software and improving team effectiveness

Summary:

Leads advanced financial analysis and optimization strategies for cloud infrastructure, providing expert-level insight and technical guidance to drive cost efficiency, forecasting accuracy, and financial accountability across multi-cloud environments. This role partners closely with engineering, finance, and procurement teams to enable strategic cloud investment decisions.

Duties & Responsibilities:

•   Lead in-depth cost modeling, forecasting, and trend analysis for AWS, Azure, GCP, and other cloud platforms.

• Define and drive FinOps best practices, governance standards, and cross-functional training initiatives.
• Mentor other analysts and serve as a lead contributor to FinOps maturity and tooling strategies.

Leads the most complex, high-impact cloud financial analysis and optimization initiatives. Translates technical usage into strategic financial insights.

Required Supervision:

Operates independently with a high degree of autonomy. Trusted to guide FinOps execution and influence enterprise cloud strategy.

Expertise:

Deep subject matter expertise in cloud billing, cost modeling, and FinOps strategy. Recognized as a key influencer in cloud financial planning and optimization.

Qualifications:

•   Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in cloud cost optimization, infrastructure finance, or enterprise technology operations.
• Advanced knowledge of public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), billing constructs, and pricing strategies.
• Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
• Experience with cloud cost management platforms (e.g., Apptio Cloudability, CloudHealth, native tools).
• Strong technical acumen, communication skills, and ability to collaborate across engineering and finance.

title: Construction Estimator
description:
Estimator
We are seeking a detail-orientated and analytical Estimator with a passion for construction to join our team.
Overview

Working alongside the Senior Estimator, the ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates for a wide variety of commercial construction projects.
Candidates must have a building background with extensive knowledge of all aspects of refurbishment and commercial construction across numerous sectors.
This role requires a strong understanding of cost control and the ability to communicate effectively with various stakeholders. The Estimator will work closely with project managers, engineers and other sub-contractors, and play a crucial role in ensuring our bids are technically accurate, timely and competitive.
Min 3 years experience in an estimating role. Full driving licence and the ability to travel when required is essential.
Duties
- Prepare detailed cost estimates for projects, including materials, subcontractors, labour and pre - lims from tenders, drawings and client briefs.
- Read and interpret technical drawings and specifications
- Liaise with clients, suppliers, and internal design/production teams
- Ensure our tenders are cost-effective and meet budget targets
- Assess site constraints (levels, drainage, access, services, etc)
- Conduct thorough analysis of project specifications and drawings to identify all necessary components for accurate estimation.
- Conduct site surveys as required, to assess project conditions and support the tendering process.
- Maintain up-to-date estimating tools, pricing databases and cost records to ensure accuracy and efficiency in future tenders.
- Assist in the preparation of tender submissions and proposals as required.
- Source, evaluate and manage quotations from suppliers and subcontractors to ensure competitiveness and compliance.
Qualifications/Requirements
- 3 years+ proven experience in estimating
- Strong understanding of cost estimating principles and practices.
- Excellent analytical skills with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy in all estimates.
- Proficient in using estimating software and tools, alongside advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, enabling clear interaction with team members and clients.
- Estimating construction projects up to Â£5m in value.
- HND or equivalent in a surveying or construction related discipline

title: Freelance Presentation Designer
description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Presentation Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create high-quality presentations for real-world use cases. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in visual communication, information design, and storytelling to create clear, engaging, and professionally designed presentations. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in visual communications, information design, and storytelling.
What We Do The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.
About the RoleThis is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Presentation Designer, you will focus on storytelling and visual hierarchy. We need a specialist who knows how to communicate complex information beautifully, turning raw data and narratives into compelling, highly persuasive slides and one-pagers. You will use tools such as PowerPoint, Keynote, Adobe Creative Suite, and Figma to create polished, presentation-ready deliverables.
Key Responsibilities
- Design high-stakes pitch decks and professional one-pagers tailored for specific audiences.

- Translate complex data into clear visual storytelling with a strong focus on minimalism and precise information hierarchy.

- Elevate presentations using custom fonts, elegant animations, and perfect visual consistency.

- Enforce a polished, persuasive, and premium corporate-meets-creative style across all deliverables.

- Execute formatting quality standards through meticulous validation of visual alignment, pacing, and brand adherence before final delivery.

How to get started Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.
Educational qualifications

- At least 2 years of relevant experience in graphic design, presentation design, visual storytelling, or data visualization is desirable.

- Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, Visual Communications, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience
Candidates must have a strong portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization (not just basic templates). We are looking for specialists who have a deep understanding of pacing, storytelling, and information design. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently to transform complex narratives into premium visuals are essential.
Technical Skills (Essential)

- Presentation software: Expertise in PowerPoint, Keynote, etc., for building complex, dynamic, and perfectly animated decks.

- Design tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop) or Figma to create custom graphics and layouts.

- Data & information design: Ability to translate complex data and multi-level hierarchical structures into clear, minimalist visual storytelling.

- Typography & animation: Advanced skills in working with custom fonts and smooth, elegant animations for premium deliverables.

Additional requirements

- Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

- Strong attention to detail and absolute commitment to visual perfectness.

- Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot design challenges independently.

- English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

- Your CV must include a link to your portfolio featuring high-end presentations, pitch decks, and data visualization. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant presentation cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.
Compensation On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.
Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

description:
Ми шукаємо молодого дизайнера на початку його професійного шляху - людину, яка є допитливою, креативною та щиро захоплюється візуальним дизайном. Ця роль для тих, хто вже експериментує з Photoshop або Illustrator, можливо навчався самостійно, створює графіку для себе, досліджує AI-інструменти або просто любить проводити багато часу за дизайном. Для цієї позиції не потрібен багаторічний досвід роботи. Набагато важливіші: візуальний смак, цікавість до дизайну та велике бажання розвиватися.

Кому підійде ця роль: дана позиція може стати гарним стартом для людини, яка
любить візуальний дизайн та графіку
любить експериментувати з типографікою, текстурами або ілюстраціями
можливо малює або робить скетчі
цікавиться брендингом, мерчем або fashion-графікою

Базові навички: комерційний досвід не є обов’язковим, але важливо, щоб ви вже знали основи та могли створювати просту графіку. Базово ми очікуємо знання таких інструментів: Adobe Photoshop та Adobe Illustrator.

Буде плюсом:
профільна вища освіта
англійська від Upper-Intermediate
досвід роботи або базове розуміння Figma
досвід використання AI-інструментів для дизайну
навички ілюстрації або малювання
інтерес до типографіки та експерименти зі шрифтами
базові навички анімації / motion-графіки

Основні задачі:
На початку основний фокус буде на внутрішніх дизайн-задачах, які допоможуть вам отримати практичний досвід та розвинути власний стиль.
Приклади задач:
створення дизайнів для мерчу (футболки, худі, принти) для внутрішнього бренду компанії
допомога маркетинговій команді з банерами та візуальними матеріалами
експерименти з графікою, типографікою та композицією
допомога у створенні ідей для логотипів та візуальних концепцій
дослідження різних стилів візуальної айдентики

Важливо розуміти, що ця позиція створена для початківців.
На старті основний фокус буде на практиці та навчанні та ви працюватимете переважно з внутрішніми проєктами, поступово набираючись досвіду та розвиваючи власний стиль. Компенсація на початку буде помірною, проте ця роль дає можливість отримати реальний досвід роботи в середовищі IT-компанії, отримувати фідбек і підтримку від більш досвідчених дизайнерів та поступово формувати сильне портфоліо. Якщо ви справді захоплюєтесь дизайном і готові вкладати час у навчання та експерименти - ця позиція може стати чудовим першим кроком у вашій кар’єрі.
Наразі ми не шукаємо впевнений досвід - ми шукаємо великий потенціал та щиру зацікавленість у дизайні.

Як податись на вакансію:

напишіть кілька слів про себе (розкажіть коротко про себе як людину: як ви прийшли у дизайн, що вам у ньому найбільше подобається або що вас зацікавило у цій ролі. Можна написати будь-що, що, на вашу думку, допоможе нам трохи краще познайомитися з вами.)
надішліть, будь ласка, приклади ваших робіт (ке можуть бути: постери, логотипи,графіка, ілюстрації, концепти мерчу, експерименти з типографікою, особисті або навчальні проекти). Не хвилюйтеся, якщо ваші роботи здаються занадто експериментальними, незвичайними або «не надто серйозними», які ви створювали просто для себе - обов’язково поділіться ними. Іноді саме такі роботи найкраще показують потенціал дизайнера.

Що ми пропонуємо:

* Практичний досвід у реальних проєктах – можливість працювати над задачами у середовищі IT-компанії та формувати власне портфоліо.
* Професійний розвиток – доступ до внутрішніх навчальних програм, воркшопів та освітніх матеріалів для розвитку професійних навичок.
* Робота в компанії з міжнародними клієнтами – можливість отримати досвід співпраці з відомими брендами та різними індустріями.
* Корпоративні знижки та партнерські програми – спеціальні пропозиції для співробітників та їхніх родичів від партнерських компаній, включаючи одну з найбільших мереж спортзалів в Україні.
* Баланс роботи та відпочинку

21 календарний день оплачуваної відпустки,
15 оплачуваних лікарняних днів та додаткові вихідні за потреби.

title: UX Design Intern
description:
This is not your typical internship. There are no coffee runs, no busywork, and no fighting 200 other applicants for one spot.

GWEN is an AI-powered UX internship where you work on real-world design projects with AI teammates and a mentor. You'll build portfolio-ready case studies, get detailed feedback on your work, and receive a reference letter on completion.

Upfront, because it matters: This is a paid training programme, not employment. The job interview and your first project are free. The full internship is a one-time $199, and regional pricing applies automatically in lower-income countries.

*How it works:*

*

Pass a simulated job interview, then start your first project the same day

*

Your first project is free: tear down a real client's signup flow with your mentor, redesign it, and get both screens reviewed

*

Work through 7 structured UX projects at your own pace, from anywhere

*

Collaborate with AI teammates who challenge your thinking and give real-time feedback

*

Build portfolio pieces you can actually show employers

There is no salary and no job offer at the end. What you get is practice, feedback and proof of work: the three things every junior UX application is missing.

*Requirements:*

*

A laptop or desktop (the internship doesn't run on phones)

*

Interest in UX design (student, fresher, graduate)

*

Self-motivated and able to work independently

*

Willingness to learn, take feedback, and build something you're proud of

*Benefits:*

Reference letter at completion, certificate and a portfolio review on request. Pay once, keep lifetime access including future projects.

What others are saying, like Michael Ghaliy: "This internship will improve your skills and ability putting your hands on real project briefs using AI tools, and learn to be confident and successful in finding a job."

*Drive Customer Growth. Deliver Better Outcomes.*

At Nextiva, we’re transforming how businesses connect with their customers through our unified, AI-powered customer experience platform. We help organizations grow revenue, operate more efficiently, and build lasting customer relationships through Amazing Service® and innovation.

* Demonstrating strong business acumen in identifying and solving customer challenges
* Effectively incorporating AI tools into your workflow to improve productivity and outcomes
* Building trusted relationships with customers through professionalism and reliability (this is a role where you will interface directly with customers over video)

*About You*

You are someone who takes ownership of your work, seeks continuous improvement, and brings energy and resilience to a high-activity sales environment.

* 2+ years' experience in sales, account management, or customer-facing roles in a fast-paced environment
* Proven ability to meet or exceed performance goals (revenue, retention, or activity-based metrics)
* Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex concepts, advanced English fluency required (spoken & written)
* Comfortable with outbound engagement and proactive customer communication
* Highly organized with strong follow-through and attention to detail
* Coachable and open to feedback, with a track record of applying it
* Self-motivated and resourceful, you take initiative to solve problems and develop your skills
* Interest in AI and technology, with a willingness to continuously learn and apply new tools
* *Nice to Have* :

* Bachelor's degree in business or a related field
* Experience selling SaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or related technologies
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
* Familiarity with qualification frameworks (BANT / MEDDPICC)
* Exposure to AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot) in a professional setting
* Prior experience supporting US based customers in a B2B environment

*Who Thrives in This Role*

* You take initiative and don’t wait for direction to move work forward
* You follow through on commitments and take accountability for results
* You stay resilient and maintain a positive, solutions-oriented mindset
* You are motivated by growth, both in your performance and your career
* You prioritize learning and actively invest in your own development

This role is well-suited for individuals early in their career, making a career transition, or looking for an opportunity where effort, consistency, and growth mindset directly translate into success.

*What Matters Most*

We value the behaviors that drive long-term success:

* Ownership and accountability
* Consistency and discipline
* Coachability and continuous improvement
* Curiosity and willingness to learn
* Drive to achieve meaningful results

Experience matters, but mindset and execution matter more.

*Compensation & Growth*

* Competitive base salary + uncapped commission
* Opportunity to grow and advance your career with a company at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience

*Nextiva DNA* (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

* *Drives Results* : Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and *simplicity* to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.
* *Critical Thinker:* Data-driven, *forward-thinking* individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.
* *Right Attitude:* Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and *care* for customers and teammates.

*Total Rewards*

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses.

* *Health* *🍏* - Major Health insurance for you, your legal partner, and children under 25 years, including Vision and Dental coverage
* *Insurance* *💼* - ** Life Insurance (24 times your monthly salary)
* *Work-Life Balance* *⚖️* ** - Newly hired full-time employees at Nextiva receive 10 personal days before their first anniversary, 12 vacation days on their first anniversary, and 5 personal days annually thereafter in addition to vacation time
* *Financial Security* ** *💰* - ** Enjoy a 30-day Christmas bonus, 50% vacation premium, company-matched food vouchers (1 UMA/month), and a 13% matched savings fund (capped at 1.3x annual UMA)
* *Wellness* *🤸‍* - ** Employee Assistance Program and comprehensive wellness initiatives
* *Growth* *🌱* - ** Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Influencer Marketing & UGC Coordinator based in Brazil.*

This is an execution-focused opportunity for someone passionate about creators, social media, and short-form content.
You will manage the creator collaboration pipeline from discovery and outreach through campaign delivery and publication.
The role combines influencer research, relationship building, pipeline management, and campaign coordination.
You will evaluate creators based on engagement, audience relevance, content quality, and brand alignment—not simply follower counts.
Working in a fast-moving global environment, you will have significant ownership and the opportunity to contribute ideas directly to business and marketing initiatives.
The position is ideal for someone highly organized, persistent, digitally savvy, and comfortable managing high-volume workflows independently.
It also offers strong exposure to leadership, rapid learning, and meaningful opportunities to grow with the function.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Discover and vet relevant creators across Instagram and TikTok using native platforms and influencer discovery tools, assessing engagement, average views, audience relevance, content consistency, production quality, and brand fit.
* Conduct personalized creator outreach and structured follow-up sequences based on creator profiles, priorities, and campaign objectives.
* Maintain an organized creator pipeline by accurately tracking communications, creator records, campaign status, priorities, and next steps in CRM and other systems.
* Coordinate creator collaborations end to end, from initial outreach and briefing through product development, content review, approval, and final publication.

*Requirements*
--------------

* Demonstrated understanding of Instagram, TikTok, short-form video trends, and current creator and influencer culture.
* Strong content judgment and the ability to recognize effective storytelling, audience alignment, engagement quality, and content performance beyond follower counts.
* Highly organized, proactive, persistent, and comfortable managing a high-volume outreach and follow-up pipeline with limited supervision.
* Excellent written English with a professional, natural, and engaging communication style when interacting with creators.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to quickly assess information, identify patterns, and make practical decisions.
* Comfortable working with spreadsheets, CRM-style platforms, influencer databases, and other digital tools, with the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, urgency, and follow-through, with a willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.
* Comfortable receiving direct, constructive feedback and adapting quickly in a changing environment.
* Previous experience in influencer marketing, UGC, social media, PR, brand partnerships, or outbound sales is advantageous, but motivated entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with teammates across different time zones.

*Benefits*
----------

* Full-time independent contractor engagement.
* 100% remote position with global working opportunities.
* Flexible working hours with overlap as needed with teammates in European and U.S. time zones.
* Competitive, market-based compensation for a junior-level position, adjusted according to location and level of impact.
* Direct exposure to senior leadership and opportunities for mentorship and professional development.
* High level of autonomy with the opportunity to influence marketing workflows, processes, and strategic initiatives.
* Fast-paced environment offering significant opportunities for personal and professional growth.
* Opportunity to build practical expertise in influencer marketing, UGC, creator partnerships, and performance-driven content.
* Opportunity to work at the intersection of technology, global commerce, product creation, and digital marketing.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
At MEDFAR, we are transforming the relationship between healthcare providers and patients through innovative digital health solutions. As an Intermediate UI/UX Designer, you will help strengthen the quality, consistency, and usability of our products by working closely with our Product Designer and Product Owners.

Our Product Owners play an active role in product solutioning and UX definition, from shaping workflows to creating early prototypes. In this role, you will complement their work by bringing strong UI/UX craft, helping refine product designs, and translating our design system strategy into well-designed, reusable components and clear documentation.

You will also play an important role in the day-to-day evolution and maintenance of our Figma design system, working with the Product Designer to turn design system priorities into practical improvements that can be adopted across our product teams.

*Responsibilities*

*

Design, build, document, and maintain reusable components, patterns, and variants within our Figma design system.

*

Collaborate closely with the Product Designer to execute the design system strategy, including component improvements, new patterns, accessibility standards, and prioritized system updates.

*

Support Product Owners throughout feature definition, by reviewing requirements and early prototypes. Provide design documentation based on those requirements.

*

Translate feature designs into clear and detailed UI specifications in Figma, including relevant states, interactions, responsive behaviours, component usage, and accessibility considerations.

*

Work with Product Owners to ensure designs provide sufficient clarity for development, while Product Owners remain accountable for overall requirements, workflows, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and development handoff.

*

Participate in product design reviews and critiques, providing thoughtful and actionable feedback on usability, interaction design, visual design, accessibility, and design system consistency.

*

Partner with front-end developers early in the design process to validate component feasibility before finalizing their design in Figma.

*

Participate selectively in UAT and implementation reviews to assess whether developed experiences are consistent with approved designs and intended interactions.

*

Support micro- and component-level UX exploration, research and testing in collaboration with the Product Designer when needed.

*

Contribute to UI copy and content design where appropriate, helping improve the clarity and consistency of labels, messages, empty states, errors, and other interface content.

*

Collaborate effectively with Product Owners, the Product Designer, developers, and other cross-functional partners in a fast-moving product development environment.

*

3+ years of professional experience in UI/UX, product design, interaction design, or a related discipline, ideally working on complex digital products.

*

Strong proficiency with Figma, including components, variants, auto layout, libraries, prototyping, and design system workflows.

*

Demonstrated experience creating and maintaining reusable UI components and contributing to a design system.

*

Strong UI design skills, with excellent attention to detail and a solid understanding of usability principles.

*

Ability to take early-stage wireframes or prototypes and develop them into polished, coherent, implementation-ready designs without losing sight of the original product intent.

*

Good understanding of accessibility principles and the ability to apply established accessibility standards to components and product interfaces.

*

Experience documenting design components, behaviours, states, and usage guidance in a way that can be understood and reused by designers and non-designers.

*

Comfortable providing constructive design feedback and collaborating with colleagues who have varying levels of design expertise.

*

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain design decisions and trade-offs clearly.

*

Organized and able to balance design system work with support for multiple concurrent product initiatives.

*

title: UI/UX Designer for Accounting software (SaaS)
description:
ABOUT THE OFFER
This is not a full-time job but rather part-time to one-off for creating designs for the product.

ABOUT THE PRODUCT
We are building the accounting software that accounting firms run their daily work on. The user is a professional who spends hours in front of this screen and repeats the same operation hundreds of times a day.
This is different from designing a marketing site or a consumer app. The product's core screens are data entry, tables, filters and multi-step operations. We want an interface that looks current and feels considered, but the real measure is how many seconds and how many mistakes it takes an experienced user to record an invoice.
We are not building another generic dashboard. Most accounting software looks and behaves the way it did fifteen years ago, and that is exactly the gap we're going after.
We are currently in the pre-coding phase. Business rules are being written by our domain expert, and screens will be designed and approved before they are built. The designer is part of this process, not something that happens at the end of it.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

* Design the product's core screens and user flows: invoice creation, customer accounts, chart of accounts, journal entry, period-end operations, reports
* Map the flows before the screens: what the user is trying to finish, where they enter, what they see at each step, and where things can go wrong
* Build fast, keyboard-first, low-click flows for users doing heavy data entry
* Design layered interactions deliberately: decide what belongs in a full page, a slide-over, a modal or a popover, and keep those choices consistent across the product
* Create a reusable component library, design system and written guidelines: tables, forms, filters, notifications, modals, type and spacing scale, and the rules for when each is used
* Design not just the ideal state of a screen, but its empty, error, loading and no-permission states
* Review your designs with the domain expert and catch conflicts with the business rules while they are still in design
* Hand off designs a developer can implement without asking questions: dimensions, states, behaviors and exceptions defined

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* At least 3 years designing B2B, internal or data-heavy products
* Experience designing complex table and form screens
* A current visual sensibility: familiar with where interface design is today and able to apply it to a dense professional tool without turning it into decoration
* You treat UX as seriously as UI. A screen that looks good but adds a step to the user's day is not a finished design
* Experience with user flows and with writing the guidelines that keep a product consistent as it grows
* Comfort with multi-layer interactions and nested flows: slide-overs, modals, popovers, and knowing when not to use them
* Fluency in Figma with components, variants and design systems
* The ability to explain why your design is the way it is, and to change it in response to feedback
* You don't need to know accounting, but you do need to be willing to learn the rules of an unfamiliar domain and ask questions

NICE TO HAVE

* Experience in accounting, finance, ERP or another regulated domain
* Experience with accessibility and keyboard-driven interfaces
* Enough HTML/CSS to read it and discuss implementation details with developers

HOW TO APPLY
Apply with your portfolio. What we want to see: complex screens from a real product. Include at least one piece with tables, forms, filters or a multi-step operation.
For one of your pieces, briefly answer these three questions:
1. Who used this screen, and what were they trying to get done?
2. What design decision did you make, and why?
3. How did you know whether it worked?
We can't evaluate portfolios that show only visuals with no reasoning behind the decisions.

PROCESS
1. Intro call: the product and how we work
2. Portfolio: you walk us through one piece and the decisions behind it

COMPANY
Dream LLC, Wyoming, United States
15 Employees

It will be a plus if you have:

* Knowledge of Motion Design tools, Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, 3D Graphic Tools
* Experience in designing and creating illustrations
* Knowledge of interface development steps
* Sense of humor - no kidding:)

Reasons to join us:

* Remote work;
* Flexible schedule, with a standard 40 hours a week schedule;
* Market salary fixed in USD (based on level of experience & portfolio)

* We are ready to support your well-being in various ways, and our focus is maintaining your work-life balance in check.

Everyone dreams of a working process without burnouts, and we are going to turn this into reality.

If you’re still here and would like to join us, we look forward to hearing from you!

Please note that only the candidates with the following will be considered:

* Link to your amazing portfolio (Figma links accepted)
* Your expected salary

Feel free to share any meme you like in your job application

title: UX/UI Designer
description:

If you have a clear grasp of player psychology, online casino and slot game interface logic, know how to build a strong visual hierarchy, and create user-friendly interfaces across all devices — we’d love to welcome you to our team!

Opportunity to build new game products from scratch
Direct collaboration with product stakeholders and decision-makers
Fast decision-making and startup-like environment
A chance to influence the future portfolio of instant and crash games
