title: Senior UX/UI Designer (m/w/d)
description:
*Standort:* München│ *Start:* asap │ *Art:* Fulltime │ *Bereich:* UX/UI Design │befristeter Einstieg mit Perspektive auf eine Festanstellung

Bei COBE gestalten und entwickeln wir digitale Produkte, die nicht nur funktionieren, sondern sich auch verdammt gut anfühlen. Wir wollen jedem Nutzer eine beautiful experience verschaffen und dafür suchen wir dich: eine:n UX/UI Designer:in, mit Fokus auf UI Design, der/die Interfaces mit echtem Gespür baut und Designsysteme nicht nur nutzt, sondern aktiv mitgestaltet.

----------------
Was du tun wirst
----------------

*

Du übernimmst die Designleitung für mehrere Projekte und arbeitest eng mit einem ambitionierten Team zusammen

*

Du verinnerlichst unsere markengetriebene Designmethode (UXi) und schaffst bedeutungsvolle Nutzererlebnisse, die wirklich zur Marke passen

*

Du gestaltest digitale Interfaces mit hoher visueller Qualität: Typografie, Layout, Spacing, Hierarchie: konsistent und sauber über ganze Flows hinweg

*

Du arbeitest komponentenbasiert und entwickelst Designsysteme aktiv weiter (Patterns, Komponentenlogik, Guidelines, Tokens)

*

Du triffst Design-Entscheidungen bewusst und kannst sie begründen, im Kontext von Nutzer*innen, Produktzielen und Marke

*

Du setzt qualitative Leitplanken, damit das Team schneller, konsistenter und besser wird (Reviews, UI-Checks, Quality Bars)

*

Du arbeitest eng mit Product, Engineering und Brand zusammen, von entwicklungsreifen Designs bis zur Unterstützung im Sprint

*

Du holst proaktiv Feedback von erfahrenen Kolleg:innen ein, um vor Deadlines eine hohe Qualität sicherzustellen

*

Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale im Designprozess und setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Team um

*

Du übernimmst, organisierst und moderierst Präsentationen für wichtige Meilensteine, Workshops oder kreative Sessions innerhalb deiner Projekte

*

Du bleibst über UI-Trends auf dem Laufenden und teilst dein Wissen innerhalb von COBE

*

Du erstellst Aufwandsschätzungen und hilfst den PMs, Aufwand und Kapazitäten im Einklang zu halten

*

Du nimmst an Pitches teil und verantwortest je nach Umfang den markengetriebenen Design-Part

-----------------
Was du mitbringst
-----------------

*

Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung als UX/UI Designer in einer Agentur oder der entsprechenden Abteilung eines Unternehmens

*

Du triffst Designentscheidungen bewusst und kannst sie begründen mit starkem Gespür für Typografie, Farbe, Layout und Hierarchie

*

Hohe handwerkliche UI-Qualität bis ins Detail (States, Responsiveness, Edge Cases etc.)

*

Starkes Verständnis für Designsysteme und komponentenbasiertes Arbeiten

*

Sicherer Umgang mit Figma: Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens (und du weißt, wie man Dateien so baut, dass Teams damit arbeiten können)

*

Erfahrung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering (z. B. Komponentenlogik, Handover-Prozesse, Token-Strategien).

*

Ein Portfolio mit realen, digitalen Interfaces, das visuelle Klarheit und Konsistenz über mehrere Screens/Flows zeigt - wir freuen uns drauf!

*

Du hast Lust, andere Designer:innen visuell zu coachen und UI-Qualität im Team auf ein neues Level zu bringen

*

Dein Deutsch ist mindestens auf C-Level und dein Englisch mindestens auf B-Level

------------
Nice to Have
------------

*

Du hast bereits komplexe, skalierende Interfaces gebaut: SaaS, Plattformen, datenreiche UIs

*

Branding-/Grafikdesign-Background oder ein starkes Gefühl dafür, wie Marke und Produkt-UI zusammenspielen

------------------
Was wir dir bieten
------------------

*

Work from anywhere: Ob Büro, Zuhause, Lieblingscafé oder Berghütte, du entscheidest, wo du am besten in den Flow kommst

*

Dein Tag, deine Regeln: Solange Stunden und Deadlines passen, arbeitest du so, wie’s für dich und das Team am besten funktioniert

*

Mehr Urlaub, jedes Jahr: Jedes Jahr gibt’s einen Urlaubstag obendrauf bis zu 30 Tage

*

Keine starren Hierarchien: bei uns zählen Ideen, nicht Titel.

*

Flexible Gleitzeit: Überstunden flexibel aufbauen und entspannt wieder abfeiern

*

Fairness & Wachstum: Transparentes Gehaltsmodell, ehrliche Wertschätzung und die Chance, deine Entwicklung aktiv zu gestalten

*

Offene Feedback-Kultur: monatliches Mentoring als Safe Space und zweimal im Jahr ausführliches Team-Feedback

*

Projekte, die nicht langweilig werden: Spannende Kunden, innovative Produkte, Abwechslung garantiert

*

Mehr als nur ein Büro: ein echter Wohlfühlort mit Lunch, Afterwork-Drinks auf dem Balkon und dem ein oder anderen Dinner

*

Menschen, die den Unterschied machen: smarte, herzliche Kolleg:innen, die Herausforderungen gemeinsam angehen

*

Team-Events, die Spaß machen: Regelmäßig zusammenkommen, Erfolge feiern, Connection stärken und einfach gemeinsam eine gute Zeit haben

*

Mentale Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Deshalb bieten wir ab Start einen OpenUp-Zugang an mit wöchentlicher Team-Meditation als Arbeitszeit

*

Deutschlandticket: Damit du easy und entspannt unterwegs bist, übernehmen wir dein Ticket zu 100%

*

Corporate Benefits & FutureBens: Rabatte & Deals bei vielen Marken und Shops

Bewirb dich über den Link & wenn's passt, laden wir dich auf ein Coffee-Date ein und schauen gemeinsam, ob du unsere nächste UX/UI Power bist! 🚀

title: Product UI/UX Designer
description:
Ми розвиваємо міжнародну платформу для онлайн-знайомств і шукаємо Product UI/UX Designer, який допоможе нам створювати web-продукти, якими хочеться користуватися - і які при цьому показують сильні бізнес-результати.
У нас велика кількість користувачів, багато трафіку та постійний потік продуктових задач. Тому нам потрібен дизайнер, який мислить не тільки екранами та візуалом, а user journey, конверсією, поведінкою користувачів та бізнес-метриками.
Ти працюватимеш безпосередньо з Product та Marketing командами, Data Analysts і розробниками - від пошуку проблеми та формування гіпотези до дизайну, запуску та аналізу результатів.

Обов'язки
Проєктування та розвиток web-продуктів у сфері online dating.
Створення та покращення ключових user flows: registration, onboarding, profile creation, discovery, matching, messaging, engagement та monetization.
Аналіз User Journey та пошук точок friction, drop-off і можливостей для зростання конверсії.
Розробка UX/UI для нових фічей та покращення існуючих продуктових сценаріїв.
Створення wireframes, prototypes та high-fidelity designs у Figma.
Формування UX/UI гіпотез на основі даних, поведінки користувачів та бізнес-задач.
Співпраця з Product Managers, Product Marketers, Data Analysts та розробниками.
Участь у плануванні та проведенні A/B-тестів дизайнів і продуктових сценаріїв.
Аналіз результатів тестів та ітеративне покращення рішень.
Робота над конверсією ключових етапів продуктової воронки.
Робота з monetization flows, paywalls, subscription / purchase flows та іншими конверсійними сценаріями.
Аналіз конкурентів та пошук нових UX/UI підходів для dating-продуктів.
Підтримка та розвиток дизайн-системи.

Що нам важливо
4+ роки досвіду у Product / UX/UI Design.
Досвід дизайну web-продуктів.
Сильне портфоліо з прикладами продуктових задач та кейсів.
Впевнене володіння Figma.
Глибоке розуміння UX/UI та принципів побудови сучасних web-продуктів.
Досвід роботи з user flows, wireframes, prototypes та high-fidelity designs.
Розуміння принципів conversion optimization та продуктової воронки.
Досвід роботи з A/B-тестуванням або продуктовими експериментами.
Вміння використовувати дані та дослідження поведінки користувачів для прийняття дизайн-рішень.
Розуміння продуктових метрик та їхнього зв'язку з UX.
Сильне product thinking та business thinking.
Вміння аргументувати дизайн-рішення та захищати їх перед стейкхолдерами.
Високий рівень автономності та ownership.

Буде плюсом
Досвід роботи саме з dating / social / subscription продуктами.
Досвід роботи з growth та conversion optimization.
Досвід роботи з monetization / paywall / subscription flows.
Досвід проведення UX-досліджень.
Досвід роботи з великими consumer-продуктами.
Розуміння HTML/CSS та базових frontend-обмежень.
Досвід використання AI-інструментів у design workflow.

Що ми пропонуємо
⚡ Мінімум бюрократії та швидкий цикл прийняття рішень - від ідеї до реалізації без довгих погоджень.
💰 Конкурентну винагороду - відповідно до рівня експертизи, досвіду та впливу ролі на продукт.
🌍 Повністю remote - можливість працювати з будь-якої точки світу, Europe-friendly time zone.
💪 Сильну автономну команду без мікроменеджменту - цінуємо ініціативність, відповідальність та здатність самостійно знаходити рішення.
📈 Реальний вплив на продукт - твої рішення безпосередньо впливатимуть на UX, конверсію, engagement та monetization.
🎨 End-to-end ownership - від дослідження проблеми та формування гіпотези до дизайну, запуску та аналізу результатів.

Етапи відбору
Співбесіда з HR.
Фінальна співбесіда з Head of Product / Design.
Portfolio review / тестове завдання.

title: Middle UI/UX Designer (Gamedev / Gamification)
description:
Live Animations is a Ukrainian gamification company. We create and integrate games and gamified mechanics into mobile applications and digital products for leading brands.
Our projects reach millions of users. Our partners include Silpo, Sense Bank, Nova Poshta, Uklon, Mastercard, Auchan, Kaufland, and other leading Ukrainian and international brands.

We help businesses grow through gamification by increasing retention, user engagement, and app interaction frequency. We develop everything from eye-catching seasonal activations to complex long-term gaming ecosystems.

Position: Middle UI/UX Designer (Gamedev / Gamification)
Work format: Hybrid (Kyiv, 1–2 days in the office) or fully remote
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00

We are looking for a talented designer who can create not only visually stunning game graphics but also design logical, intuitive, and engaging interfaces for millions of players.

Your daily focus:
UX/UI Design: Design UI kits, game interfaces, windows, and screen layouts — from the first wireframes to the final polish.
Gamification: Design user experience logic (UX flows) that immerses players and keeps them engaged.
Graphic Design: Create and adapt game assets, icons, buttons, and promotional materials.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers and PMs, prepare design files for implementation, and hand them over to the development team.

Your background:
Experience: 2+ years of UI/UX design experience in Gamedev or Mobile Games (a portfolio featuring game interfaces is required).
Tools: Figma at an expert level (components, auto layouts, wireframes, UI kits). Confident proficiency in Photoshop and Illustrator for creating and editing 2D graphics.

Skills & Mindset:
Strong understanding of mobile game development, game usability, and UX best practices.
Excellent sense of style, colour, composition, and attention to even the smallest pixel.
A visual storyteller who can confidently explain design decisions and openly embrace constructive feedback.

What you’ll get:
Projects — Design game UI/UX for products used by millions of users.
Team — A friendly, creative environment with no micromanagement or tedious reporting.
Growth — Continuous learning, knowledge sharing with a creative team, and real professional growth through challenging projects.
Flexibility — Choose between comfortable remote work or a cozy office in Kyiv.
Work-Life Balance — 17 days of paid vacation to recharge and maintain a healthy balance.

📩 Already picturing your interfaces in our products? Send us your portfolio and CV — we’d love to get to know you!

title: Mobile UI/UX Designer
description:
Про нас:
Button — застосунок, який допомагає покликати близьких, коли це справді важливо. Одне натискання — і довірені люди отримують сигнал із геолокацією, фото, відео та звуком. Ми будуємо продукт, яким користуються щодня, і від якості інтерфейсу тут залежить не просто конверсія, а те, чи спрацює застосунок у критичний момент.

Зараз активно ростемо: нові фічі виходять щотижня, працюємо над воронкою, підпискою та розширенням продукту на нові платформи.

Кого шукаємо:
Продуктового дизайнера рівня Middle+ / Senior, який фокусується на мобільних інтерфейсах, розуміє платформні гайдлайни і вміє доводити фічу від задачі до готового макета без нескінченних ітерацій.

Що потрібно робити:
Проєктувати екрани та флоу мобільного застосунку (iOS та Android) — від первинного онбордингу до складних сценаріїв усередині продукту
Працювати з дизайн-системою: підтримувати, розширювати, тримати консистентність
Готувати макети до розробки: стани, граничні випадки, адаптація під різні розміри екранів
Проєктувати підписочні екрани та воронки (пейволи, онбординг-квізи) — з фокусом на конверсію
Час від часу — веб (лендинги, вебворонки) та графіка (сторові скріншоти, банери для реклами, промо-візуали)
Працювати в парі з продактом і розробниками: обговорювати рішення, а не просто виконувати ТЗ

Що для нас важливо:
Портфоліо з мобільними продуктами — саме застосунки, не тільки концепти з Dribbble
Впевнене володіння Figma: компоненти, варіанти, автолейаут, прототипи
Уміння думати сценаріями, а не окремими екранами: що бачить людина, коли немає інтернету, немає даних, немає дозволів
Уважність до деталей: відступи, стани, поведінка при скролі — те, що зазвичай ламається на продакшені
Самостійність: ти отримуєш задачу і повертаєшся з рішенням, а не з питанням «а як зробити?»

Буде плюсом
Досвід із підписочними продуктами та A/B-тестами інтерфейсів
Робота з анімацією (Lottie, Rive) або розуміння моушену
Досвід у продуктах, пов'язаних із безпекою, здоров'ям або сімейними сценаріями

Що пропонуємо
Повністю віддалена робота, гнучкий графік
Продукт, а не аутсорс: ти бачиш, як твої рішення впливають на метрики
Швидкі цикли — від ідеї до релізу тижні, а не квартали
Пряма комунікація з продактом і засновниками, без бюрократії

Як відгукнутися:
Надішли портфоліо (посилання на Figma, сайт або PDF) і кілька слів про себе: над якими мобільними продуктами працював і що з цього вважаєш найкращою своєю роботою.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
We are – a growing e-commerce company with around 40 employees, specializing in customizable stationery. As a wholly owned subsidiary of MYPOSTER, we combine emotional design with digital expertise – from AI-powered personalization in the configurator to automated production. We design our processes ourselves, thoughtfully and with meticulous attention to detail. We combine structured quality with the spirit of a start-up: short communication channels, plenty of creative freedom, and a team that works together.

You analyze A/B tests, heatmaps, and funnels, deriving optimizations to skyrocket our conversion rate.

You conduct user tests and customer surveys to validate your designs not only quantitatively but also qualitatively.

You develop AI-powered prototypes for new ideas and strategies, enabling us to quickly validate them hands-on.

You build, maintain, and expand our design system as the foundation for an AI-first product development process.

When AI reaches its limits, you create your own designs in Figma for complex topics.

You evaluate new ideas regarding feasibility and effort from a UX perspective and ensure they deliver real added value to users.

WHAT YOU BRING

You have at least 5 years of experience in UX/UI design – ideally, advanced knowledge as a senior with experience in the B2C e-commerce environment.
You have comprehensive skills in All phases of the design process – from research and design to testing

You have experience in evaluating metrics, usage data, and A/B results, and can derive concrete hypotheses and design decisions from them, as well as measure the impact of your ideas

You are passionate about building variations, testing them quickly, and bringing features live

You can translate complex design requirements into a simple, user-friendly UI, always prioritizing the user perspective

You enjoy trying out new AI tools and finding clever ways to make processes faster and smarter

You'll have complete design responsibility for our online shop and determine how millions of customers experience our product.

You'll use insights from tests, analyses, and user feedback to develop targeted features that noticeably boost our conversion rate.

Your prototypes won't get lost in a drawer; they'll be launched and their results measured in short cycles.

What You Can Expect From Us

No ego trips, no downtime: Here, what counts is proactive thinking, hands-on work, and shaping the future.

Development that suits you: Quarterly goals, feedback sessions, and professional development without budget caps—with room for initiative and on-the-job growth.

AI as a tool: You'll work with the latest tools and automate wherever possible.

Family-friendly and self-determined work style: Trust-based working hours and flextime for a work schedule that fits your everyday life.

EGYM Wellpass, Jobrad or MINI leasing – the choice is yours!
Team events with character: We celebrate successes and our team spirit at summer parties, pub quizzes, barbecues, and moreimage (9).png"

advanced knowledge as a senior with experience in the B2C
e-commerce environment.

description:

title: Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. ** We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

The Design Systems team creates the visual and interaction foundations that help Vanta deliver coherent, accessible, and high-quality experiences across the product. This team partners across the EPD organization to build the systems, patterns, and practices that enable product teams to move faster while maintaining a high bar for craft and usability.

As a Staff Visual Product Designer focused on Design Systems at Vanta, you will shape the visual language of our product and the systems that bring it to life. You will define and evolve scalable patterns across our design and engineering ecosystems, partner closely with product designers and engineers, and help create a cohesive experience for customers navigating complex security and compliance workflows. You’ll combine exceptional visual craft with systems thinking, product judgment, and the ability to influence across teams.

*What you’ll do as a Staff Visual Product Designer, Design Systems at Vanta:*

*

Define and evolve Vanta’s visual design language across product surfaces, creating a cohesive, distinctive, and scalable customer experience.

*

Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, and interaction details.

*

Partner with Design Systems, Product, Engineering, Research, Content Design, and Brand teams to translate customer and business needs into effective system-level solutions.

*

Own and evolve foundational design system elements, including design tokens, component visual states, responsive behavior, theming, density, and platform-specific adaptations.

*

Create reusable patterns and guidance that help product teams solve common problems consistently while preserving flexibility for different customer workflows.

*

Design and prototype system components and end-to-end product experiences, using high-fidelity exploration to communicate intent and accelerate alignment.

*

Bring visual clarity and hierarchy to complex, data-rich workflows used by security, compliance, IT, legal, finance, and business stakeholders.

*

Collaborate with engineers to ensure designs are implemented with fidelity, accessibility, performance, and maintainability in mind.

*

Establish principles, standards, and review practices that raise the quality and consistency of product design across Vanta.

*

Advocate for inclusive and accessible visual design, ensuring that color, contrast, typography, motion, and interaction states work for a broad range of users and contexts.

*

Help define how the design system supports emerging product needs, including AI-powered experiences, personalization, automation, and increasingly complex enterprise workflows.

*

Use customer insights, product data, usability feedback, and competitive research to identify opportunities to improve the system and its impact.

*

Facilitate critiques, workshops, and cross-functional reviews that help teams make stronger visual and product decisions.

*

Influence product strategy and roadmap decisions through strong design perspectives, compelling narratives, prototypes, and a clear point of view.

*

Mentor product designers and contribute to a culture of thoughtful critique, continuous learning, experimentation, and customer obsession.

*

Create documentation, examples, and enablement materials that make the design system easy to understand, adopt, and extend.

*

Define and measure the impact of the design system through adoption, consistency, accessibility, usability, delivery efficiency, and customer outcomes.

*

Represent Design Systems in planning processes, product reviews, and other cross-functional forums, helping teams align around a shared vision for the Vanta experience.

*

Contribute to the broader Design organization by sharing best practices, strengthening design craft, and improving how Vanta approaches visual product quality.

*How to be successful in this role:*

*

8+ years of experience designing digital products, with significant experience in visual product design for complex B2B SaaS or enterprise software.

*

Deep expertise in visual design for digital products, including typography, color, composition, layout, iconography, illustration, motion, interaction states, and data visualization.

*

A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft, thoughtful systems thinking, and the ability to improve product experiences at both the component and end-to-end workflow level.

*

Experience creating, evolving, and scaling product design systems used by multiple teams across a growing organization.

*

Strong understanding of design tokens, component architecture, responsive design, accessibility, and the relationship between design tools and front-end implementation.

*

A track record of turning ambiguous product and customer problems into clear, elegant, and reusable visual solutions.

*

Experience partnering closely with engineers to bring detailed visual designs to life and to make pragmatic decisions when implementation constraints arise.

*

Strong product thinking, with the ability to understand customer needs, business goals, technical constraints, and the broader relationships among product surfaces and workflows.

*

Excellent communication, storytelling, and facilitation skills, with the ability to influence product and engineering partners without relying on formal authority.

*

Experience balancing consistency and flexibility, knowing when to use an existing pattern, when to extend it, and when to introduce something new.

*

A demonstrated ability to give and receive thoughtful feedback, mentor others, and raise the quality bar across a design organization.

*

Comfortable operating in ambiguity, making decisions with incomplete information, and balancing strategic thinking with a bias for action.

*

Experience designing products in cybersecurity, compliance, GRC, IT, infrastructure, financial services, or another complex and regulated domain is a plus.

*

Experience with tools such as Figma and familiarity with front-end technologies or design system implementation workflows is a plus.

*

A strong commitment to Vanta’s principles: putting customers first, biasing for action, winning as one team, deciding with frameworks, leading with resilience, and doing what it says on the tin.

*

Required: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field.

*

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

*

Responsible for protecting Vanta and customer data in how you operate and deliver results.

*

Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

*What you can expect as a Vanta’n:*

*

Industry-competitive salary and equity

*

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

*

16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

*

Health & wellness stipend

*

Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

*

Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

*

Family planning benefits

*

Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

*

Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

*

11 company-paid holidays

*

Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

*

Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

*About Vanta*

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

*Referral Instructions*

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

title: Brand Designer (Contract)
description:
Who we are
----------

Hey, we’re Bunsen. We’re a strategic and creative partner for bio and deep tech startups solving the world’s biggest problems. We don’t sell soda or sneakers. We shape the identities of the most consequential technologies of our time—think drug discovery, affordable diagnostics, abundant energy, robotics, novel materials. Our clients are the world’s leading scientists and engineers building the future.

We’re looking for a Brand Designer who can craft visual identity systems for our clients, inspired by their technologies and their visions. Maybe that’s you?

What you’ll do
--------------

*Conceptualization & Moodboarding:* At Bunsen, our priority is to create brands that don’t just look visually stunning, but also tell a deeper story about our client. Together with our Creative Director, you will translate insights into compelling visual metaphors to serve as the foundation for the brand. In addition, you’ll curate inspiration to align on look and feel.

*Brand Exploration:* Before going all-in on a single idea, you’ll develop various brand directions to explore different concepts and visual styles. This includes logo, typography, color, layout, and graphics. You’ll join client review calls to present the directions with our Creative Director and absorb/apply feedback.

*Brand Refinement:* After aligning on a clear brand direction, you will build out a cohesive brand system with various applications for social media, print, and digital.

*Brand Delivery:* Once the final brand is approved, you will create and package brand guidelines, logo files, and graphics for easy use by other designers.

Opportunity
-----------

*Time:* This role is a project-based contract, approximately 10-20 hours per week.

*Location:* We are remote-first but require a workday with ~3 hours overlap with EST (our meetings are typically within 12-5pm EST).

*Communication:* We will primarily communicate asynchronously via Slack and Loom, with ~1 synchronous Zoom meeting per week per project.

Application
-----------

In addition to sharing your full portfolio, please provide links to three brand projects that you feel are the best representation of your skills. Bonus points if they are biotech or deep tech-specific, but not required.

title: Senior Creative Designer (Design and Video)
description:
Coinask.ai — a B2C AI SaaS product at the intersection of AI, Crypto, and FinTech.
We're looking for a hands-on Senior Creative Designer who will own Coinask's visual quality and personally produce strong graphic and video content.
We don't need someone who just executes a brief — we need a strong designer with great visual taste and an understanding of how design drives business results. You'll create banners, static creatives, landing pages, social content, and video, quickly test different approaches, and improve them based on results.

About the Role
The core focus of this role is hands-on design production.
You'll work across a range of formats — from ad creatives and social content to Figma mockups, landing pages, and video. It's not just about making things "look nice" — it's about understanding composition, hierarchy, typography, visual storytelling, attention, and conversion.
You'll work closely with the Head of Marketing and Lead Brand & Community Manager, turning marketing and communication tasks into quality visual content.
Your Responsibilities
Graphic Design: create static creatives, banners, social content, marketing materials, and other visual assets.
Web & Landing Pages: create Figma mockups and the visual side of marketing landing pages.
Video & Motion: edit short-form and performance creatives for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and ad campaigns; work with footage, screen recordings, UGC, captions, graphics, basic motion elements, and format adaptations.
Creative Development: independently develop visual concepts and propose solutions, rather than just executing ready-made briefs.
Visual Consistency: maintain a cohesive and recognizable visual style for Coinask across channels and formats.
Creative Performance: analyze the results of your creatives together with Marketing, understand which approaches work better, and apply those insights to future iterations.
AI Workflow: use AI tools for research, ideation, generation, and production, speeding up the work without sacrificing quality.

What We Expect From You
A strong portfolio with examples of graphic design, digital creatives, and video/motion work.
Confident with Figma, Photoshop, and other professional design tools; hands-on experience editing and producing short-form video creatives.
Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes design high-quality, modern, and professional.
Able to work fast and independently, adapting one design across different formats and tasks.
Understand the basics of marketing design and performance creatives: hierarchy, hooks, readability, CTAs, attention, and visual storytelling.
Willing to look at creative results, draw conclusions, and apply them to the next iteration.
Able to independently find and propose visual solutions rather than waiting for a detailed brief.
Experience with AI creative tools, used as part of the production workflow.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with lots of iteration.

Nice to Have
Experience with B2C SaaS, AI, FinTech, or Crypto/Web3.
Experience with performance marketing / creative testing.
Motion design and 3D.
Experience building or evolving a visual identity.

How We Work
We're an AI-native team.
For us, AI is part of the daily creative workflow. We expect you to use AI to speed up research, ideation, generation, and production — but the final output needs to meet a professional design standard.
We value speed, quality, and the ability to move quickly from idea to finished creative.
Create → Launch → Measure → Learn → Iterate

This Role Is for You If You're Looking For
Lots of hands-on work. You'll be directly producing creatives, not just briefing others.
Freedom in visual decisions. We expect you to bring your own taste and initiative.
Impact on results. You'll see the performance of your creatives and use that data for the next iterations.
The chance to shape the visual direction of a new AI product.
An AI-native environment and a fast creative workflow without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Функціональні обов'язки

1. Розробка рекламних креативів
Створення концепцій та візуальних рішень для рекламних оголошень.
Розробка статичних та адаптивних креативів під різні рекламні формати.
Тестування різних візуальних підходів та креативних гіпотез.
Адаптація креативів під різні платформи, аудиторії та формати.

2. Робота з креативними гіпотезами та аналітикою
Спільна робота з PPC-командою над формуванням креативних гіпотез.
Участь у плануванні тестів рекламних матеріалів.
Аналіз ефективності креативів та пошук можливостей для їх покращення.
Використання даних рекламних кампаній для створення нових візуальних рішень.

3. Робота з командою
Отримання та уточнення технічних завдань.
Участь у креативних мітах, генерація ідей та пропозицій щодо покращення.
Взаємодія з PPC-спеціалістами, Team Lead та іншими учасниками команди.
Дотримання дедлайнів та погоджених форматів.

4. Організація процесу виробництва та зберігання матеріалів
Структурування створених креативів у загальній системі зберігання.
Підтримка актуальної бази креативів та зручної навігації для команди.
Оновлення версій та архівування застарілих матеріалів.
Участь у створенні бази знань щодо креативів та рішень із використанням AI.

Вимоги до кандидата
Досвід роботи Graphic Designer / Creative Designer від 1 року.
Досвід створення креативів саме для digital-реклами буде перевагою.
Розуміння принципів композиції, типографіки, кольору та візуальної ієрархії.
Вміння працювати з ТЗ та самостійно пропонувати креативні рішення.
Досвід створення креативів для Meta Ads, Google Ads та інших digital-каналів.
Впевнене володіння графічними редакторами.
Англійська мова — Intermediate або вище.

Досвід роботи з рекламними креативами та performance marketing.
Розуміння метрик та принципів оцінки ефективності креативів.
Досвід роботи з AI-інструментами для генерації зображень, відео та креативів.
Досвід роботи з Envato.
Досвід роботи з HeyGen.
Досвід роботи з Higgsfield AI.
Досвід роботи з іншими AI-інструментами для створення фото/відео.
Навички motion design та відеомонтажу.

Очікуваний результат роботи
Своєчасне створення якісних рекламних креативів.
Регулярне тестування нових креативних гіпотез.
Створення візуальних рішень, які допомагають покращувати результати рекламних кампаній.
Дотримання дедлайнів та технічних вимог.
Систематизована база рекламних матеріалів.

title: Graphic Designer (Digital Marketing)
description:
Sunco.com is a leading online lighting retailer headquartered in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, we are proud to be one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We deeply value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture and are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day. With our new state-of-the-art distribution center in Georgia, we continue to expand our reach and enhance our ability to serve our customers with excellence and efficiency. Join us and be part of a dynamic team that is lighting the way to a brighter future.

We light up the world, literally. Customers have chosen Sunco to provide millions of LED lights and trust us for our exceptional customer service, eco-conscious product expertise, and unmatched value.

Note to applicants:
This is a full time role. We hire globally and welcome candidates from different countries and backgrounds. Regardless of location, this role requires your regular working hours to substantially overlap with 9:00 am to 5:00 pm Pacific Time (Valencia, California), Monday through Friday.

**About the role**

As a Graphic Designer on the Marketing team, you will bring the Sunco brand to life across every touchpoint. You will create digital assets for paid and organic social, display and banner ads, paid social ads, storefront, marketplace, and other marketing channels. You will help evolve and protect our visual identity through thoughtful logo work, style guide development, and consistent design systems.

You will sit on the design team, report to the Lead Designer, and collaborate closely with marketing, ecommerce, and marketplace teams. A key part of your role will be developing high performing PDP creative assets for our storefronts on Amazon and Shopify that clearly communicate product benefits and drive conversion. You will primarily work in digital but will also support print projects, including but not limited to trade show mechanicals, swag, and printed promotional material.

**What** **you'll** **do**

* Design landing page assets, and other campaign collateral with strong attention to hierarchy and UX best practices.

* Develop and maintain high quality PDP creative for Sunco storefronts on Amazon and Shopify, including product imagery, infographics, comparison charts, and benefit driven visuals.

* Work with the Lead Designer, marketplace, and ecommerce teams to ensure PDP assets are optimized for clarity, scannability, and conversion.

* Adapt designs for different marketplaces and placements while staying true to the core brand.

* Create social content for platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and others as needed.

* Design digital assets for paid social, display ads, banner ads, retargeting, and other performance marketing campaigns.

* Help define and evolve the Sunco visual identity across channels and formats.

* Assist with the development of iconography, typography and style guide modifications for creative assets, ensuring all creative assets are aligned to brand standards and tell a consistent visual story.

* Occasionally Design and build mechanicals for swag, event graphics, signage, and other print promotional materials.

* Work closely with the Lead Designer to prioritize requests, manage timelines, and maintain a healthy workflow.

* Collaborate with copywriters, marketers, and product teams to understand project goals and translate them into effective visual solutions.

* Organize design files, maintain libraries, and follow naming and version control practices that support a growing team.

* Take and apply feedback constructively while advocating for best practices in design and user experience.

* Work closely with the Lead Designer to prioritize requests, manage timelines, and maintain a healthy workflow.

* Collaborate with copywriters, marketers, and product teams to understand project goals and translate them into effective visual solutions.

* Organize design files, maintain libraries, and follow naming and version control practices that support a growing team.

* Take and apply feedback constructively while advocating for best practices in design and user experience.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communication, or a related field.

* Proven experience as a graphic designer, brand designer, or marketing designer with a portfolio that highlights both brand identity work and digital marketing assets.

* Demonstrated expertise in logo design and visual identity development, including style guide creation and system thinking.

* Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Adobe XDa plus) and familiarity with Figma (we use this for design boards and feedback).

* Experience designing for digital marketing channels, including social, email, web, and paid media, with an understanding of performance and UX considerations.

* Experience preparing print ready files and working with vendors for print materials, signage, and promotional items.

* Strong understanding of layout, typography, color theory, and visual hierarchy

* Familiarity with basic UX and UI best practices for web and mobile and an ability to design assets that support a clean, user-friendly experience.

* Experience designing PDP assets or ecommerce creative for platforms such as Amazon and Shopify is a strong plus.

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to interpret briefs, ask clarifying questions, and present your work.

* High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast moving environment.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Availability to work between 9 AM to 5 PM Pacific Time

* Reliable internet access and a private remote workstation.

**How to apply**

* Please send or attach your resume to the application

* Kindly ensure that your resume is submitted in English, as applications with resumes in other languages will not be considered.
* Once your application is received and reviewed, we will be sending an email with questions and request for your portfolio

About the Company

Sunco Lighting is an online lighting retailer based in Valencia, CA. Thanks to our amazing and talented employees, today we are one of the largest online lighting retailers in the US. We value our collaborative, open, and people-first culture deeply, and we are invested in making Sunco a positive place where our team members thrive every day.

**Job Type:** Independent contractor, Full-time and fixed hours (requiring Pacific Time overlap), starting at $10 to $15 per hour . Depending on location and experience.

While this is intended to accurately reflect the current job, management reserves the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed as assigned.

Sunco Lighting Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and complies with Ban the Box laws, which prohibit us from inquiring about an applicant's criminal history until after a conditional job offer has been made. We also prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Motion/Graphic Designer (iGaming)
description:
Шукаємо Motion & Graphic Designer, який вміє перетворювати ідеї на креативи, а креативи — на результат.
Ти працюватимеш у тісній зв’язці з media buying-командою, створюватимеш візуали для Facebook Ads та in-app трафіку, тестуватимеш нові підходи та швидко адаптуватимеш креативи на основі результатів рекламних кампаній.
Для нас важливий не просто красивий дизайн — нам потрібна людина, яка розуміє, як візуал впливає на CTR, CR та ефективність реклами.

Що потрібно буде робити
Створювати статичні та динамічні рекламні креативи для performance- та affiliate-кампаній.
Розробляти motion-креативи: короткі відео, анімовані банери, тизери, лупи та інші динамічні формати.
Створювати статичні банери, сторіс, прев’ю та графіку для лендингів, застосунків і промо.
Адаптувати та унікалізувати креативи під різні формати, GEO та рекламні майданчики.
Швидко доопрацьовувати та оновлювати креативи за результатами тестів.
Працювати разом із media buyers над пошуком нових візуальних концепцій та підходів.
Брати участь у формуванні та розвитку візуального стилю продуктів.
Використовувати AI-інструменти для пришвидшення роботи, пошуку ідей та експериментів із візуалом.

Що для нас важливо
2+ роки досвіду у графічному та/або motion-дизайні.
Досвід у performance, affiliate або iGaming буде великою перевагою.
Впевнене володіння After Effects, Premiere, Illustrator або аналогами.
Хороше знання Figma.
AI-інструменти — частина твого робочого процесу, а не просто щось, що ти пробував.
Розуміння специфіки рекламних креативів для Facebook та in-app.
Хороше відчуття композиції, динаміки, типографіки та візуальної ієрархії.
Готовність працювати в режимі швидких ітерацій та постійного тестування.
Базове розуміння performance-метрик: CTR, CPA, CR та того, як креатив може на них впливати.
Уміння сприймати дизайн не лише як візуальне завдання, а як інструмент для досягнення бізнес-результату.

Що ми пропонуємо
Повністю віддалений формат роботи.
Конкурентну оплату — обговорюємо індивідуально залежно від досвіду.
Роботу в сильній команді у сфері iGaming / performance marketing.
Пряму взаємодію з media buyers та можливість бачити, як твої креативи працюють у реальних рекламних кампаніях.
Багато простору для тестів, експериментів та власних ідей.
Швидкі процеси та мінімум зайвої бюрократії.
Можливість професійно розвиватися разом із командою та впливати на візуальний напрямок продуктів.

Якщо тобі цікаво не просто створювати дизайн, а робити креативи, які реально впливають на рекламні показники — будемо раді познайомитися.

title: Graphic and Web Designer  Landing Pages, Brand and Presentations (German B2)
description:
About us
VL Ventures GmbH is a Munich-based group with two operating brands in the German construction and energy transition market:

PILLAR Germany GmbH manufactures and installs solar carports, PV mounting systems and screw foundations. We sell B2B — to EPCs, installers, project developers and commercial property owners across Germany.

Betsa GmbH is a general contractor specialising in energy-efficient building renovation, serving property owners and investors in and around Munich.

Two brands, two audiences, one design function — yours.
The role

We are building our marketing department from scratch, and design is where most of it becomes visible. You will be the person who turns our products, projects and pitches into something people actually want to look at.

Roughly two thirds of your work is digital: landing pages, website design and ad creative. The rest is presentations and brand collateral — sales decks, product one-pagers, trade fair materials. You will work closely with our PPC Specialist (who needs creative that converts) and with sales (who need decks that win meetings).

This is a builder's role. Our brand systems exist but are young. You will not just execute inside a finished style guide — you will help finish it.

What you will do
Web & landing page design
Design landing pages for paid campaigns and organic traffic across both brands — conversion-oriented, mobile-first, built around a clear message hierarchy
Own the visual design of our websites (pillar-de.com, betsa.de): page layouts, component design, iterative improvements
[Build and maintain pages directly in our CMS / Hand off designs to development — specify]
Work with the PPC Specialist on landing page variants for A/B testing

Graphic & brand design
Produce ad creative for Google Display, Meta and LinkedIn — including sizing families and iterations for testing
Design product one-pagers, datasheets, case studies and reference project sheets
Create trade fair and print materials: roll-ups, banners, brochures, booth graphics (e.g. Intersolar Europe)
Prepare project photography and product imagery for use across channels
Extend and maintain the brand systems for both brands: colour, type, iconography, layout rules, asset libraries

Presentation design
Design sales presentations, partner and co-branded decks, and management-level reports
Turn rough content from sales and leadership into clear, structured, visually consistent slides
Build reusable master templates in PowerPoint and Google Slides so the team can self-serve for everyday decks

Systems & efficiency
Maintain an organised, accessible asset library — the team should find the right logo, image or template without asking you
Create templates and components that reduce repeat requests
Manage your own queue across two brands and communicate realistic timelines

What we are looking for
Must have
A portfolio that shows web/landing page design and presentation or brand collateral work — we need both, not a specialist in one
3+ years of professional design experience, agency or in-house
Strong command of Figma plus Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
Genuine web design competence: responsive layout, type at scale, understanding of what is realistic to build and how design decisions affect load speed and conversion
Real presentation design skill in PowerPoint and Google Slides — this is a core part of the job, not an afterthought
Ability to work from a brief, ask the right questions, and deliver without heavy supervision
Professional English; German is a strong plus (you will be laying out German copy, which behaves very differently from English)

Nice to have
Video: short-form editing for social, simple motion graphics, animated ad variants (Premiere, After Effects, CapCut)
3D visualisation or rendering (Blender, SketchUp, Twinmotion) — highly relevant for carport and mounting system visuals
Hands-on build experience in [WordPress / Webflow / your CMS]
Print production knowledge: CMYK, bleed, prepress files
Experience in construction, industrial, technical or B2B categories

What success looks like
First 30 days: You have audited the existing assets for both brands, identified what is inconsistent or missing, and delivered your first landing page and first deck.
First 90 days: Both brands have a working template system — slides, ad formats, one-pagers — and campaign creative ships on the PPC schedule rather than holding it up.
First 6 months: Anyone in the company can produce an on-brand document without designing from scratch, and our landing pages and decks look like they belong to companies twice our size.

What we offer
Visible work. Your designs are what customers see first, on every channel, for two brands.
Scope. Web, brand, print, presentations, campaign creative — this is not a role where you resize banners all day.
Short decision paths. Direct contact with management, fast feedback, no five-round approval loops.
A brand you get to shape, not just apply.
Flexible working. Remote-first
Compensation: 1200 to 1500 USD but we are building our Marketing Team fully from Scratch that means you can develop in all directions.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to design intuitive, connected, and scalable experiences across Weave’s Digital Forms products. This role will help shape how practices collect information, communicate and collaborate, and manage the tasks and workflows that support their day-to-day operations.

The Senior Product Designer will contribute across the full product lifecycle from problem discovery, customer research, and journey mapping through ideation, interaction design, execution, and iteration while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Markeeting, and other cross-functional teams. This role will help create cohesive experiences across connected workflows, simplify complex operational tasks, and establish scalable UX patterns that can evolve across the broader platform.

We value a diverse range of perspectives and look for designers who can navigate complex problems, understand and advocate for customer needs, bring clarity to ambiguous spaces, and collaborate effectively across disciplines. The ideal candidate will bring strong interaction and visual design skills, product thinking, and a systems mindset to create experiences that are intuitive, efficient, accessible, and impactful for the people who use them.

*About Weave*

Weave is the all-in-one customer communication and engagement platform for small-to-medium healthcare practices. We build modern tools that elevate the patient experience through a unified platform that improves business operations so healthcare professionals can focus on patient care and realize their dreams.

This position is *remote (India)* and reports to the *Product Design Manager*.

-----------------
What You Will Own
-----------------

The duties and responsibilities of the role.

*

Design end-to-end product experiences across Digital Forms, Team Chat, Task Center, and related workflows, translating complex operational needs into intuitive, seamless, and accessible experiences.

*

Collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to turn complex customer problems into clear, actionable solutions that improve productivity and deliver meaningful product outcomes.

*

Partner with Product Managers to shape product vision, strategy, and roadmap for key workflow and collaboration experiences across the Weave platform.

*

Define scalable interaction patterns and UI solutions that simplify multi-step workflows while balancing clarity, usability, flexibility, and efficiency.

*

Leverage and contribute to Weave’s Design System to create consistent, high-quality experiences while evolving patterns to support new and increasingly complex product needs.

*

Conduct customer research with practice owners, office managers, and front-office teams to understand real-world workflows, pain points, and opportunities to improve how teams communicate, collect information, and manage work.

*

Use product analytics, customer feedback, and tools such as Pendo and Sigma to understand user behavior, evaluate design effectiveness, and continuously improve experiences based on evidence.

*

Collaborate with designers across the broader platform to identify opportunities for shared patterns, connected experiences, and a cohesive end-to-end customer journey.

*

Contribute to a strong and inclusive design culture through thoughtful critique, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and mentorship.

*

Partner closely with Engineering throughout implementation to ensure design quality, accessibility, and consistency from initial concepts through the shipped experience.

----------------------------------------
What You Will Need to Accomplish the Job
----------------------------------------

The minimum qualifications for the role - education, experience, certifications, skills.

*

5+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UX Designer, or equivalent combination of education and practical experience.

*

Strong UX and visual design fundamentals, with the ability to simplify complex workflows and create intuitive, efficient experiences across Digital Forms, Team Chat, Task Center, and related product areas.

*

Proficiency with design tools such as Figma, with experience creating prototypes, exploring interaction patterns, and applying user-centered design methods.

*

Familiarity with product analytics and research tools such as Pendo, Sigma, Maze, or similar platforms to understand user behavior and inform design decisions.

*

Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product, Engineering, Research, and other cross-functional partners.

*

Ability to translate customer needs, product requirements, and business goals into clear, thoughtful, and scalable design solutions.

*

Strong attention to detail and design craft, with a focus on creating accessible, consistent, and high-quality product experiences.

*

Curiosity and a continuous learning mindset, with an interest in understanding customer workflows, exploring new problems, and using feedback and evidence to improve experiences over time.

--------------------------
What Will Make Us Love You
--------------------------

Preferred qualifications - including personality traits and soft skills.

*

You stay hungry, care more, and stay curious. You care deeply about the customer and the quality of the work.

*

You take ambiguous problems, create clarity, and drive them forward without waiting for someone to tell you what to do.

*

You understand the day-to-day reality of healthcare practices and design around their real needs, not just what they ask for.

*

You look beyond individual features to find patterns, simplify complexity, and build experiences that scale across the product.

*

You can navigate multi-tenant products, legacy systems, integrations, and technical constraints without losing sight of the user experience.

*

You mentor, give thoughtful feedback, share what you learn, and raise the bar for design around you.

*

You build trust with product and engineering, challenge assumptions, and bring people along even across teams and time zones.

*

You care about the details and know how to make experiences feel clear, intuitive, and polished.

Employment with Weave is contingent upon the successful *completion of a background check* , conducted in accordance with applicable laws.

At Weave, *we use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools* to help us work more efficiently and create a smoother candidate experience. AI may assist with things like writing job descriptions, scheduling interviews, or reviewing applications against job-related criteria. For additional information, please review the External AI Policy Statement available on our Careers page.

Weave is an *equal opportunity employer* that is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and supported. We welcome anyone who is hungry to learn, problem-solve and progress regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

*Beware of recruitment fraud*. All official correspondence will occur through Weave branded email. We will never ask you to share bank account information, cash a check from us, or purchase software or equipment as part of your interview or hiring process.

title: Lead Learning Experience Designer
description:
The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a *Lead Learning Experience Designer* to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You'll help contributors develop the confidence, skills, and knowledge they need to participate effectively, navigate Wikimedia’s communities and practices, and grow as contributors.

In this role, you'll partner with Foundation teams, affiliates, researchers, subject matter experts, and volunteers to understand learner needs, identify barriers to participation, and develop learning experiences that support contributors at different stages of their journey.

This role goes beyond traditional instructional design. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.

Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference.

*Responsibilities*

* Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.
* Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.
* Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance.
* Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.
* Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, multimedia, and AI tools.
* Apply learning science, user-centered design, and learning experience design methodologies to create engaging, effective, and inclusive solutions.
* Evaluate learning effectiveness using learner feedback, participation data, and other qualitative and quantitative insights, continuously improving content based on evidence and community feedback.
* Contribute to the ongoing evolution of the Foundation's learning strategy by staying current with learning technology, online learning, AI, and digital engagement, identifying opportunities to expand and strengthen learning offerings across the movement.
* Ensure learning resources reflect Wikimedia's values of openness, collaboration, equity, and knowledge sharing.

*Qualifications*

*Required*

* Experience designing and developing digital learning experiences for diverse, global audiences.
* Demonstrated experience creating engaging e-learning, instructor-led, virtual, or blended learning solutions.
* Experience using a learning management system (LMS) to develop, organize, and publish learning content.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose capability gaps, identify the right interventions, and rapidly design, build and improve learning experiences.
* Excellent written communication and content development skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for diverse audiences.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders and subject matter experts.
* Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and culturally responsive learning practices.

*Preferred*

* Experience working with volunteer communities, open knowledge initiatives, nonprofits, or international organizations.
* Experience designing learning for multilingual audiences and collaborating across cultures and time zones.
* Experience creating learning in modern digital environments using tools such as Rise, Storyline, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, video editing tools, AI content generation platforms, or similar technologies.
* Experience partnering with product teams or using product design approaches, such as user research, experimentation, prototyping and iteration.
* Knowledge of experimentation methods, A/B testing, learning analytics, product analytics, and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with Wikimedia projects, the Wikimedia movement, or open-source communities.

*You'll Thrive in This Role If You...*

* Think like a designer and builder, comfortable moving from identifying challenges to creating, testing and improving solutions.
* Are curious about how people learn, what motivates participation, and how to leverage modern methods and technology to create memorable learning experiences.
* Are energized by ambiguity and enjoy figuring out what needs to be built rather than waiting for a predefined assignment.
* Excel at collaborating with people from different backgrounds, languages, and areas of expertise.
* Balance creativity with evidence and structure, using data, research, and feedback to guide decisions.
* Care deeply about accessibility, inclusion, and creating learning that supports equitable participation.
* Are inspired by Wikimedia's mission to make knowledge freely available to everyone.

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

*As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

*What you’ll be part of:*

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values : High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

------------------------------
What you'll be responsible for
------------------------------

You will own product areas within Managed Payments, Circle’s regulated payments infrastructure that enables PSPs, financial institutions, banks, and enterprises to use stablecoin-powered payment rails without operating crypto infrastructure themselves. You will define and evolve product capabilities that support managed pay-ins, payouts, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management across stablecoin and fiat endpoints. Working closely with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Treasury, and commercial teams, you will translate complex customer and business needs into clear product priorities, lead cross-functional execution, and deliver measurable improvements to how customers move money across geographies and payment rails.

-------------------
What you'll work on
-------------------

*

Own the roadmap for product areas across managed pay-ins, payouts, fiat endpoints, conversion, and transaction lifecycle management, aligning priorities with customer needs and Circle’s goals.

*

Define and launch capabilities that expand Managed Payments across Circle’s regulated hubs, including new entities, corridors, payout methods, and geographic coverage.

*

Shape simple, reliable customer experiences for accepting funds, converting value, and disbursing globally across stablecoin and fiat rails, including integrations with CPN and other Circle systems.

*

Improve customer and operator workflows across onboarding, account setup, transaction visibility, reporting, exception handling, reconciliation, refunds, RFIs, and bulk payments.

*

Use customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify friction, prioritize investments, and measure improvements in reliability, efficiency, adoption, and customer experience.

*

Evaluate opportunities to support new payment rails, payout use cases, and digital assets based on customer demand, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and business priorities.

*

Lead complex cross-functional initiatives with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, BD, and Product, navigating technical and business trade-offs and driving alignment from definition through launch.

---------------------------
What you'll bring to Circle
---------------------------

Core requirements
-----------------

*

4+ years of relevant experience, including product management experience building payments, fintech, financial infrastructure, or similarly complex B2B products.

*

Experience owning product vision, roadmaps, and execution for B2B capabilities such as payments, pay-ins, payouts, settlement, treasury infrastructure, APIs, or financial operations.

*

Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional initiatives spanning Engineering and partners such as Compliance, Operations, Legal, Treasury, or commercial teams.

*

Strong analytical and technical fluency, with experience using customer, product, payment, and operational data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.

*

Track record of delivering measurable improvements to customer experience, product adoption, operational efficiency, reliability, or business performance.

*

Ability to evaluate technical and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and translate complex requirements into clear product priorities and execution plans.

Preferred requirements
----------------------

*

Knowledge of cross-border payments, PSP infrastructure, settlement systems, correspondent banking, or other payment network concepts.

*

Familiarity with stablecoins, blockchain-based financial infrastructure, or crypto-enabled payment systems.

*

Experience with enterprise APIs, payment networks, or compliance-forward systems involving payment lifecycle states, reconciliation, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or SLAs.

---------------------
Why this role matters
---------------------

Managed Payments is a core part of Circle’s strategy to make stablecoin-powered payments accessible to businesses beyond crypto-native customers. Customers increasingly need complete payment programs that allow them to accept funds, manage balances, convert across assets, and disburse globally without assembling wallets, banking partners, liquidity providers, compliance systems, and payout networks themselves. As Senior Product Manager, you will help turn that complexity into an integrated customer experience and scale Managed Payments into a reliable, global, enterprise-grade product.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Solutions Team are technical experts that work directly with customers and partners to provide world-class product, sales, industry, and domain expertise. Through deep customer/partner and product understanding, Partner Consultants are trusted advisors externally, and able to positively influence the product roadmap internally. Partner Consultants support Ramp’s Partner Managers across our diverse channel ecosystem — including accounting firms, value-added resellers, private equity firms, and more — by delivering deep product expertise and workflow advisement to partners and their clients. PCs build partner competency, guide best-practice adoption, and strengthen partner trust in Ramp’s capabilities to help them drive meaningful outcomes for the businesses they serve.

- Partner with Channel, Partnerships, Sales, Product and Partner Firms to advocate for product & integration development in-line with customer needs

- Help partners build service packages targeted at Ramp customers and identify opportunities for client-advisory services or managed-services. Develop product solutions based on a deep understanding of integration and configuration options, ensuring effective alignment with customer needs

- Architect, advise on, and validate custom API-based integrations between Ramp and third-party platforms — supporting partners in the design, build, and testing of reliable, scalable integrations.

- Support Sales and Post-Sales teams in executing advanced technical and accounting implementations for Ramp in conjunction with Channel partners

- Evaluate customer requirements for new partner opportunities, determining Ramp's suitability through use-case analysis, ROI assessments, and technical evaluations during customer discovery

- Work alongside Channel, Product, Product Marketing, and Product Operations to create and maintain technical assets and an internal knowledge base of customer use cases and best practices

WHAT YOU NEED

- 6+ years of experience in Partner Architecture, Solutions Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or similar customer-facing roles, focusing on implementing business SaaS solutions

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, business, finance, accounting or related field

- Strong communication skills: able to translate complex technical solutions into business value, guide customers toward scalable approaches, and diplomatically steer conversations when requests are misaligned with best practices or product capabilities

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will build and run the operating systems that help Juno ship reliably and support customers as we scale. On the product operations side, you will turn product decisions into clear operating plans, maintain visibility in Linear, coordinate customer testing and launch readiness, keep commitments and risks visible, and make sure product changes are communicated clearly.

You will partner closely with product and engineering to make decisions executable, keep work organized, surface gaps and dependencies, and ensure the team follows through on what it has committed to ship.

On the customer support side, you will be the first line of defense when customers encounter product issues. You will triage and investigate problems, coordinate the right response, and redirect travel-service questions to our travel partners. Because you sit close to both the product process and the customer, you will turn recurring friction into clear insights, accountable follow-up, and better operating systems.

Success means Juno ships through a lightweight and dependable process, customers understand what changed, risks and commitments do not get lost, recurring issues reach the right owners, and support demand does not grow one-for-one with the business.

*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week*

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Provide holistic support through the entire launch lifecycle across program management, customer testing, launch readiness, change management, customer communication, and post-launch iteration. Own and improve Juno's shipping process so the right reviews, testing, documentation, internal enablement, and customer updates happen at the right time.

- Maintain Linear as a reliable operating system for projects, owners, milestones, dependencies, status, and product decisions. Surface risks early and follow through until they are resolved.

- Serve as the first line of defense for product-related customer issues across email and chat, join customer calls when needed, manage escalations to resolution, and route travel-service questions to the right partner.

- Be the voice of the customer in product decisions. Analyze support trends and customer feedback, diagnose recurring friction, size the problems you find, and translate messy input into clear findings, recommended actions, prioritization input, and accountable follow-up for product and engineering.

The Marketing team at Airwallex drives brand awareness and customer engagement through innovative and strategic campaigns.
