title: Junior Video Editor and Social Media Manager
description:
This is a remote position.

About Aidapt

Aidapt is the operator's AI firm for MEA and APAC. We build the AI that our clients' businesses actually run on: businesses that make, move and sell real things, where the buyer is an operator rather than a CTO. Our approach is translation first, because the gap between AI and results is almost never the technology. It is the translation into work that people actually do.

We are a small, founder led firm with senior ambition. This role sits in our go to market team and reports directly to the Managing Partner.

The role in one line

You cut the video and run the publishing rhythm behind a founder led content engine that publishes every day across LinkedIn, X, YouTube Shorts, Instagram and TikTok.

What you will actually do

Video, first and most of it. Around seven short form productions a week, each one distributed natively to YouTube Shorts, Instagram and TikTok. Vertical, subtitled, the point landed inside the first two seconds, cut to hold attention without gimmicks.

• Turn raw founder material into finished short form pieces: talking head recordings, voice notes, phone footage from client floors, warehouses and factories.

• Cut long recordings into several standalone clips, each one making a single point that stands on its own.

• Subtitles and captions, sound design, light motion graphics, cover frames.

• Work inside our locked visual identity. We have a design system with fixed colours, type and logo usage. Your job is to work inside it, not to invent a new look every week.

AI is part of the craft here, not a bonus.

Seven productions a week is only survivable if AI is doing the heavy, boring part of the work. We expect you to already work this way, and to get considerably better at it with us.

• Use AI to compress production time on real footage: transcription and transcript based editing, automatic captions, silence and filler word removal, audio cleanup and voice isolation, reframing to vertical, upscaling.

• Use AI to find the piece inside the raw material: pull the three usable moments out of a 40 minute unscripted recording, then apply your own judgement to which one actually earns a post.

• Use generative AI for support only: b-roll, supporting visuals, motion, cover frames. Never as the subject of the piece.

• Use AI on the social side too: drafting caption variants from what was actually said, summarising performance data, triaging comments for the ones that matter.

• Bring your own stack and your own opinions about it. We want to hear what you use, where it genuinely saves you an hour, and where it produces work you would throw away.

Where the line sits, and it is a hard line. The face is real and the voice is real. No AI avatars, no cloned voice, no synthetic presenter, ever. The opinions and the words are the founder's own: AI helps shape what he actually said, and never invents what he did not say. A candidate whose portfolio is mostly generated footage is not who we are looking for. AI is how the work gets made faster, not what the work is.

Publishing and the calendar.

• Own the publishing calendar in ClickUp. ClickUp is our single source of truth for content: every idea, every scheduled post, every published link and every number lives there.

• Upload natively to each platform in the format that platform wants. No cross posting with another platform's watermark on it.

• Publish on time, in the right slot, in the right format, without being chased.

Community and measurement.

• Watch comments and direct messages, and surface anything that looks like a real buyer conversation to the Managing Partner the same day. You flag them, he answers them.

• Log real performance against every published post: impressions, comments, saves, reposts. Real numbers only. An estimate is always labelled as an estimate.

• Bring one weekly read: what worked, what did not, and what we should be making more of.

What this role is not

• You are not the voice. The opinions, the stories and the words are the founder's. Our content process shapes his own words and never invents them. If you want a seat where you write the takes, this is the wrong seat.

• You are not running a company presence on every platform. The Aidapt company channel is LinkedIn only. The multi platform work is the founder's personal channel.

• This is not an engagement bait job. No manufactured urgency, no clickbait, no borrowed trend audio that would make an operator wince. Our audience is CFOs and COOs of real businesses and they can smell theatre from a distance.

• You will not get a finished brief every morning. You will get raw material and a calendar.

Who this is right for

Someone one to three years in who edits fast, finishes, and already has AI doing the parts of the job that should not take a human an hour. You would rather ship seven good pieces this week than one perfect piece this month. You are organised enough to run a calendar on your own. We are an AI first firm on our own operations, not only for clients, so this is a seat where working that way is the standard rather than an experiment.

Show us the work. A portfolio we can watch matters far more to us than a CV.

Requirements
------------

Must have

• One to three years editing short form vertical video, with a portfolio or set of links we can watch.

• Fluent in at least one professional editing tool (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut) and one fast mobile first tool (CapCut or equivalent).

• Subtitling and caption work that reads cleanly with the sound off.

• Basic motion graphics and sound design: text animation, lower thirds, music beds, levels that do not clip.

• Hands on experience publishing natively to YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok, including what each one wants technically.

• Working knowledge of LinkedIn and X as publishing surfaces, including what a video post needs on each.

• Written English strong enough for hooks, captions and headlines. This is a written brand as much as a visual one.

• Organised. You can run a weekly publishing calendar and hit your slots without reminders.

• Comfortable working daily inside a project management system. We run ClickUp.

AI skills, required not optional

• You already use AI in your daily editing workflow and can show us exactly where. Transcription and transcript based editing, automatic captioning, silence and filler removal, audio cleanup, vertical reframing and upscaling are the baseline.

• You can take a long unscripted recording and use AI to find the usable moments in it, then decide for yourself which ones are worth cutting.

• You use AI for supporting visuals and b-roll, and you know when generated footage cheapens a piece rather than helping it.

• You use AI on the social side: caption and hook variants drafted from what was actually said, performance data summarised, comments triaged.

• You can name your stack, defend your choices, and tell us honestly where AI output is not good enough yet.

• You understand the hard line: no AI avatars, no cloned voices, no synthetic presenters, and no AI invented opinions. AI accelerates the work, it does not become the work.

Nice to have

• Experience editing for a founder or a personal brand rather than a product brand.

• Cover frame and carousel design.

• Some analytics literacy: reading a retention curve and spotting where viewers leave.

• Exposure to a B2B or professional services audience.

• Any experience building or automating a repeatable content workflow rather than editing one off pieces.

How we will assess you

1. Portfolio review. Three to five short form pieces you cut. For each one, tell us what you were given, what you did with it, and where AI did part of the work.

2. A paid test edit. We give you one real recording and a brief. You return two vertical cuts and a caption set within 48 hours, along with your tool list and the time it took you.

3. A conversation with the Managing Partner about the work, the weekly rhythm, your AI workflow, and what you would do in a week where the raw material is thin.

Working arrangement

• Full time, on a contract basis.

• Based in Karachi, working to a schedule that overlaps the Gulf business day.

Benefits
--------

• Direct working access to the Managing Partner. On this seat you work with him every week, not through three layers.

• A real audience to learn on. You will see what an operator audience responds to, measured properly, week after week. Most editors at your level never get that feedback loop.

• An AI first firm that means it. We run our own operations on the tooling we sell, so you will work with AI video, design and publishing tools daily and get much sharper with them.

• Ownership from the start. This is the first dedicated production seat for the channel, so the rhythm and the standard become yours to hold.​​

title: Junior+ User Acquisition Manager ( Google UAC)
description:

Ми, Boosta — холдингова ІТ-компанія, що створює, масштабує та інвестує в digital-бізнеси з глобальним потенціалом.

12 років на ринку;
800+ фахівців;
15+ бізнесів.

У нас чудова команда, де кожен є професіоналом. Ми дуже цінуємо і нагороджуємо проактивність та наполегливість.
Зараз ми шукаємо амбітного User Acquisition Manager для проектів в ніші Finance.

Про тебе:

* 6+ місяців досвіду з Google Ads (UAC)
* кейси управління рекламними бюджетами в Google UAC від 10 000$
* бажаний досвід роботи з нішами leadGen, utilities
* досвід роботи з Firebase, GA4
* чітке розуміння маркетингових метрик та їх впливу на кінцеву рентабельність проекту: CPM, CTR, CR, CPA, ROAS
* Бажаний досвід роботи з Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Keitaro
* Аналітичні навички та вміння приймати рішення на основі даних
* Розуміння воронок мобільних додатків і точок впливу на ключові показники
* Бажаний рівень англійської не нижче B1 (Intermediate)

Твоїми задачами буде:

* Створення, керування, масштабування рекламних кампаній в Google Ads (UAC) під LeadGen воронки, гео US
* Оптимізація рекламних кампаній для максимізації ROAS
* Генерування гіпотез та їх впровадження для досягнення цільових CPA, CAC
* Тісна робота з Marketing Team Lead, Senior UAM
* Дослідження конкурентів

Етап 1: Pre-screen.
Етап 2: Співбесіда.
Етап 3: Фінальна співбесіда.
Етап 4: Збір рекомендацій.
Етап 5: Job Offer!

28 робочих днів оплачуваної відпустки.
Гнучкий графік та можливість працювати віддалено.
Медичне страхування та підтримка ментального здоров’я.
Компенсація вартості курсів та тренінгів.
Заняття з англійської мови та розмовні клуби.
Внутрішня бібліотека, освітні заходи.
Незабутні корпоративи та тімбілдинги.

АнглійськаB1 – Середній
УкраїнськаНосій мови

Google UAC

Boosta — холдингова ІТ-компанія, що створює, масштабує та інвестує в digital-бізнеси з глобальним потенціалом.

12 років на ринку;
800+ фахівців;
15+ бізнесів у екосистемі.

З 2014 року ми будуємо та розвиваємо бізнеси у 10+ нішах, серед яких EdTech, FinTech, Health & Fitness, Webtoons, Legal Services, SaaS, iGaming та Affiliate & Performance Marketing.

Dream Big. Build Bigger.

title: Junior AI & Data Engineer
description:

We are hiring smart, analytical freshers and early‑career engineers for a Junior AI & Data Engineer role. This is a developmental position focused on building strong fundamentals in Data Science, Machine Learning, and Data Engineering.

* Strong interest in mathematics + programming + problem‑solving

*Soft Skills*

* Curiosity and eagerness to learn

* Ownership and accountability

* Ability to take feedback and improve rapidly

* Clear communication and teamwork

* Structured problem‑solving mindset

Benefits
--------

* Competitive compensation as per industry standards

* Strong mentorship‑driven learning environment

* Hands‑on exposure to enterprise AI & data problems

* Clear growth path toward AI Engineer, ML Engineer, or Data Engineer roles

* Collaborative, global, innovation‑focused culture

title: Junior Software Engineer (Turkey)
description:
*The salary range for this role is $1,500 - $3,000 per month (Gross in USD)*

*About Sezzle:*

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

*About the Role:*

We are seeking a talented and motivated *Junior Software engineer* who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. The Junior Software Engineer will assist us with the design, development, and installation of software solutions. Your duties will include development, writing code, and documenting functionality. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards and technical design.

*Compensation* :

For this junior development role, with 0-3 years of experience, the compensation range is $1,500 - $3,000 USD per month. This range is designed to accommodate early-career professionals and reflects the foundational skills and potential for growth within the role.

*Interview Process*

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

* Application submitted (you are here)
* Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
* Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
* Interview with recruiters (30 min)
* Interview with engineers (1 hour)
* Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
* Offer!

*Sezzle Technical Stack:*

* Golang backend, React / React Native front-end
* Grafana / Loki / Prometheus metrics
* Kubernetes
* AWS
* Amazon Aurora (MySQL) RDS
* Gitlab CI/CD deployments
* Unit, Integration, and end-to-end testing

*Responsibilities:*

* Be an integral part of the software development lifecycle
* Work as an integrated team member developing new features
* Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics
* Provide support and consulting on software systems usage
* Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards

*Ideal Skills and Experience:*

* Experience working on single page web applications (SPA)
* Experience with backend API development
* Experience with relational database storage and retrieval
* Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes
* Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
* BS degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience

*Sezzle’s Technology Stack:*

* *Languages:* Golang, Typescript, Python
* *Frontend:* Typescript - React and React Native
* *Backend:* Golang
* *Database:* MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
* *DevOps & Cloud:* AWS, Kubernetes
* *Version Control:* Git
* *CI/CD:* Gitlab
* *Testing:* Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
* *Sezzle* is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

*About You:*

* *You have relentlessly high standards* - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
* *You’re not bound by convention* - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
* *You need action* - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
* *You earn trust* - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
* *You have backbone; disagree, then commit* - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
* *You deliver results* - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

*What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:*

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

title: Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Ubuntu Software Engineer based in Canada.*

This is an opportunity for an early-career engineer to build a strong foundation while contributing to one of the world’s most widely used open source operating systems.
You will work across software development, packaging, integration, testing, automation, and Linux distribution engineering.
Depending on your skills and interview process, you may join a team focused on foundational systems, server technologies, desktop experiences, or software archive maintenance.
You will work with technologies including Rust, Go, Python, C/C++, and Flutter while learning from experienced engineers in a highly distributed environment.
The role combines hands-on engineering with opportunities to contribute to upstream open source projects and improve technical and community documentation.
You will help develop reliable, performant, and resilient software used by millions of people across cloud, AI, IoT, enterprise, and developer environments.
With a strong emphasis on continuous learning, technical excellence, and collaboration, this role provides an excellent path for graduates and early-career engineers passionate about open source.

Accountabilities:
-----------------

* Design, develop, test, and ship software across foundational systems, server, desktop, cloud, and other areas of the Ubuntu engineering ecosystem.
* Build software using technologies such as Rust, Go, Python, C/C++, and Flutter, depending on the team and project requirements.
* Package, integrate, test, maintain, and publish open source software within Linux distribution repositories.
* Debug complex software and system issues, identify root causes, and implement robust and maintainable solutions.
* Contribute to the architecture and integration of open source technologies across environments ranging from boot firmware and system software to cloud application deployment.
* Build and maintain automation, testing, and delivery processes that support the reliable development and release of software.
* Contribute to the maintenance, evolution, and overall quality of a large-scale Linux distribution and its software repositories.
* Author and improve technical documentation and community-facing documentation to make software and development processes easier to understand and use.
* Contribute to upstream and neighboring open source projects while engaging constructively with the wider open source community.
* Collaborate effectively with engineers and stakeholders across a globally distributed organization.
* Continuously develop technical and professional skills while adopting new technologies, methodologies, and engineering practices.

*Requirements:*

* An exceptional academic track record in high school and university, or a compelling alternative path demonstrating strong ability and achievement.
* An undergraduate degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related discipline, or equivalent evidence of technical capability.
* Early-career or graduate-level software engineering experience with a strong motivation to build a career in open source.
* Experience with at least one relevant programming language or technology, such as Rust, Go, Python, Flutter, C, or C++.
* A genuine passion for open source software and an interest in contributing to software communities and projects.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the drive to go beyond expectations when tackling technical challenges.
* Professional written and spoken English, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a globally distributed team and collaborate across different cultures and time zones.
* Familiarity with Linux distributions is an advantage.
* Familiarity with system debugging tools and techniques is an advantage.
* Experience with automation tools and CI/CD systems is an advantage.
* Previous contributions to open source projects are an advantage.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately twice per year for team events lasting up to two weeks.

*Benefits:*

* Competitive compensation based on geographical location, experience, and performance.
* Performance-driven annual bonus.
* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly in-person team sprints.
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
* Annual compensation reviews, with additional reviews possible for graduates and associates.
* Recognition rewards for outstanding contributions and performance.
* Annual holiday leave.
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* Team Member Assistance Program and Wellness Platform.
* Opportunities to travel internationally and meet colleagues in different locations.
* Priority Pass access and travel upgrades for long-haul company events.
* Opportunity to build a career around widely used open source technologies while developing skills across software engineering, Linux, cloud, automation, and systems development.

title: Junior Human Resources Specialist
description:
*Position Title:* Junior Human Resources Specialist (Employee Benefits)
*Work Location:* Remote
*Job Type:* Full-time, Contract

*Summary*
---------

C² Technologies seeks a *Junior Human Resources Specialist* to support federal retirement and benefits services for a government client. Working closely with senior HR specialists, this role assists with the review and processing of benefits and retirement documents, supports employee counseling on federal benefits programs, tracks workload through HR systems, and contributes to training, briefings, and process documentation. This position is ideal for an early-career HR professional who is eager to build expertise in federal benefits and retirement operations while supporting mission-critical HR services.

*Responsibilities*
------------------

• Assist in reviewing benefits and retirement documents, including beneficiary forms and FEHB and FEGLI enrollment forms
• Support the review and certification of benefits-related documentation for accuracy, completeness, and compliance
• Assist senior specialists in developing responses to employee questions related to federal benefits and retirement programs
• Assist in counseling employees on federal benefits using HR rules, regulations, and OPM policies, and help provide coverage when a higher-graded specialist is unavailable
• Utilize HR systems and tools to complete, track, and manage workload, including Salesforce, HRBE, and SharePoint
• Assist with the development and delivery of training and briefings for management and employees in individual, group, in-person, and virtual settings
• Support updates to Standard Operating Procedures to help guide HR staff on retirement and benefits processing and procedures
• Under quality review by senior specialists, team leads, or supervisors, assist in providing advisory and counseling support related to voluntary, disability, deferred, and postponed retirement matters
• Support benefits and retirement services for employees under general federal retirement provisions as well as special retirement coverage for Law Enforcement Officers and Customs and Border Protection Officers
• Maintain accurate HR records, case files, and tracking systems to support timely and effective service delivery
• Respond to employee inquiries by providing clear, accurate information or routing issues to senior staff, as appropriate
• Contribute to HR projects and perform other duties as assigned

*Requirements*
--------------

*Education Requirement*

•Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

*Experience Requirement*

• Up to 3 years of HR, benefits, retirement, or administrative experience, preferably supporting federal employee benefits or retirement programs
• Familiarity with federal retirement, health benefits, life insurance, and Thrift Savings Plan programs preferred
• Experience interpreting policies, procedures, and guidance related to employee benefits is preferred
• Familiarity with OPM policies and federal HR regulations is a plus

*Experience Requirement – Tools and Software*

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and HR information systems or similar case management tools
• Experience using Salesforce, HRBE, SharePoint, or related systems is preferred
• Familiarity with federal benefits systems and retirement processing tools is a plus

*Experience Requirement – Soft Skills*

• Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
• Excellent oral and written communication abilities with a customer-service mindset
• Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and learn complex HR policies quickly
• Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion
• Ability to explain benefits and retirement information clearly to employees and management
• Ability to research, interpret, and apply HR guidance to routine and moderately complex situations

Employment is contingent upon the ability to obtain and maintain a *DHS background investigation/security clearance*.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
------------
*About Brim*
------------

Brim Financial is a category defining fintech, building the operating system for credit cards and payments. Our platform powers card programs for banks, credit unions, fintechs, and global brands across North America. We are a fast growing company. We are backed by EDC Growth Equity, Epic Ventures, Vistara Growth, and Impression Ventures and have been recognized as a CB Insights Fintech 100 company and Deloitte Fast 50 and Deloitte Fast 500 winner.

This is a role where you'll ship real code into production systems that process credit card transactions and power rewards programs used at merchants worldwide. You'll work alongside senior engineers who will help you grow fast - and you'll be encouraged to use modern tooling to do your best work.

----------------
*What You'll Do*
----------------

* Build and maintain services and RESTful APIs that power our credit card and payments platform
* Work across the full stack - from backend services and databases to the interfaces our partners and internal teams rely on
* Work with MySQL databases, JSON data structures, and third-party API integrations across our banking and payment network connections
* Investigate and resolve bugs in existing systems, developing your debugging skills across the full stack
* Collaborate with senior engineers and product leads on feature development and technical design discussions
* Explore and experiment with emerging tools and approaches, sharing what you learn with the team
* Step in wherever the team needs help - we're a small, flexible team where no task is beneath anyone and the best solution wins regardless of who proposes it

-------------------
*What You'll Bring*
-------------------

* 1-2 years of hands-on development experience (internships, co-ops, and personal projects count)
* Solid understanding of SQL and RESTful API design
* A problem-solving mindset and genuine curiosity about how things work under the hood
* Willingness to learn the business domain. You'll be expected to understand how credit cards, payments, and rewards actually work, not just the code that powers them
* Strong written communication skills for async collaboration across time zones
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment while staying connected to your team. Comfort with remote-first, sync and async daily collaboration with fluid times
* Comfort working across the full stack and willingness to pick up whatever technology the problem requires

-------------------
*Bonus If You Have*
-------------------

* Exposure to Docker, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud infrastructure
* Interest in fintech, payments, or credit card infrastructure
* Experience working with AI coding tools or LLM APIs
* Familiarity with high-availability systems or real-time data processing

---------------
*What We Offer*
---------------

* Competitive compensation and equity
* Remote-first workplace
* Comprehensive health plan and PTO
* A team that treats AI as a force multiplier, not a threat
* Real mentorship - you'll write code that ships to production, not tickets that sit in a backlog
* Clear path to grow into a mid-level role as you demonstrate ownership and technical judgment

-------------------
*Other Information*
-------------------

* Remote (US/Canada) | Full-time
* Compensation: CA $85,000-$110,000

Маєте від 6 місяців досвіду в запусках освітніх/інфопродуктів або пройшли профільні курси та маєте базове розуміння запусків.
Розумієте основи digital-просування: воронки, прогріви, вебінари.
Вмієте організовувати процеси та самостійно помічати задачі, про які інші могли забути 😄
Любите, коли все чітко: таски структуровані, таблиці зрозумілі, а дедлайни під контролем.
Знаєте, як виглядає хороше ТЗ, або легко вчитеся цьому.
Працювали з Miro, Notion, Asana та не боїтеся освоювати нові інструменти.
Проактивні, відповідальні та спокійно працюєте в ситуаціях, коли одночасно потрібно тримати під контролем кілька процесів.

Що потрібно буде робити?
Підтримувати маркетингові процеси — допомагати в підготовці та реалізації запусків, воронок, вебінарів і зйомок.
Координувати задачі команди та підрядників — ставити ТЗ, трекати виконання, контролювати дедлайни та нагадувати про важливе.
Допомагати з контентом і маркетинговими матеріалами — підготовка текстів, заголовків, матеріалів для прогрівів і розсилок, участь у копірайтингу.
Організовувати інформацію та матеріали — збирати дані, оформлювати документи, фіксувати домовленості та підтримувати порядок у робочих системах.
Контролювати актуальність інформації на сайті, Taplink та інших зовнішніх ресурсах.

💛 Чому наша команда залишається з нами 💛
Віддалена робота з будь-якої точки світу та гнучкий графік 10:00–19:00.
Конкурентна винагорода: фіксована ставка із можливістю зростати разом із твоїми результатами.
Постійний професійний розвиток: доступ до всіх курсів NewLook, підтримку навчання, обмін досвідом всередині команди та компенсацію зовнішніх курсів, конференцій і профільних заходів.
Необмежені оплачувані лікарняні. Якщо погано почуваєшся — відпочивай і відновлюйся. Нам важливо, щоб команда працювала в ресурсі.
Робота над продуктом, який має вплив. Щодня ми допомагаємо сотням людей отримувати нові професії, розвивати навички та змінювати своє життя на краще.
Команда, яка підтримує. Ми відкрито ділимося досвідом, довіряємо одне одному та цінуємо ініціативність більше, ніж мікроменеджмент.
Свобода впливати на результат. Якщо бачиш можливість зробити щось краще — пропонуй. Ми відкриті до нових ідей, експериментів і нестандартних рішень, які допомагають розвивати продукт і компанію.

title: Junior Data Analyst

Das wünschen wir uns von dir:
-----------------------------

*

*

*Reisebereitschaft:* Da du unser Team regelmäßig auf Messen und Branchen-Events im DACH-Raum vertrittst, bringst du die entsprechende Flexibilität mit.

*

*Sprachkompetenz:* Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir für den professionellen Kundenkontakt voraus.

--------------------
*Was hast Du davon:*
--------------------

*

*Flexibilität pur* : Arbeite so, wie es zu deinem Leben passt – remote im Bundesgebiet, hybrid, oder in einem unserer Offices in Deutschland (Magstadt, Darmstadt, Berlin, München, Hamburg, Köln, Ulm, Heidelberg, Frankfurt).

*Teamspirit* : Ob Teamevents (altern. Hackathons), Sommerfest oder Weihnachtsfeier – wir feiern Erfolge zusammen.

--------------------------

--------------------------

Bei uns zählt das Talent, nicht das Etikett – wir heißen Bewerber:innen jeglicher Herkunft und Identität herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

title: Remote  UX/UI Designer - Part Time & Full Time
description:
*UX/UI Designer*

*Job Overview*
TauRx Therapeutics is seeking a talented and user-centric UX/UI Designer to join our innovative team. This is a *remote position* with both *full-time and part-time opportunities* available. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing engaging and intuitive digital experiences that support our mission to combat Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. You will play a crucial role in translating complex scientific requirements into clean, effective, and user-friendly interfaces for our researchers, clinical partners, and stakeholders. This is a unique opportunity to apply your design skills to a field with a profound impact on global health.

*About Us*
TauRx was established to address one of the world’s biggest challenges – beating Alzheimer’s disease and other degenerative brain disorders through a completely new approach. A leader in Alzheimer’s research, our mission is to discover, develop and commercialise innovative products for the diagnosis, treatment, and cure of neurodegenerative disorders. Our strong research team, supported through cooperative relationships with multiple academic institutions around the world, has focussed on the tau pathway. Our novel tau aggregation inhibitors (TAIs) target the formation of tau protein ‘tangles’ in the brain, with our lead compound having shown a strong pharmacological effect in early trials.

*Key Responsibilities*
• Translate complex concepts and scientific data into intuitive user flows, wireframes, mock-ups, and prototypes.
• Design and deliver elegant and user-friendly interfaces for web and mobile applications.
• Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to inform design decisions and gather valuable feedback.
• Collaborate effectively with product managers, software developers, and scientific researchers to define and implement innovative solutions.
• Create and maintain a consistent design system, style guides, and UI pattern libraries across all our digital products.
• Present and articulate design concepts and solutions to internal teams and key stakeholders.
• Champion user-centred design principles and best practices throughout the organisation.

*Qualifications and Skills*
• Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer or in a similar role, supported by a strong portfolio showcasing your design process and visual skills.
• Proficiency in standard design and prototyping software (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD).
• A solid understanding of user-centred design principles, user research methodologies, and usability best practices.
• Exceptional visual design skills with a keen eye for detail, typography, and colour.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly explain design choices.
• The ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fully remote environment.
• Experience designing for healthcare, life sciences, or complex data visualisation is highly desirable but not essential.

*What We Offer*
• A competitive hourly rate of *$25 - $35 USD*.
• A *fully remote* working arrangement.
• Flexible working options with both *full-time and part-time* contracts available.
• The opportunity to make a significant contribution to pioneering research in neurodegenerative disease.
• A collaborative and forward-thinking work culture.

title: Product Designer
description:
We're looking for a Product Designer to join a small, fast-moving design team building a 0→1 AI voice assistant product from the ground up. You'll report into our design lead, working closely with them day to day. This is a hands-on execution role: you'll take loosely-defined inputs, figure out what needs to be built, and ship clean, polished UI fast.

Requirements
------------

* 3+ years of experience designing tech products
* Experience working in a cross-functional product team (agile/scrum-like environment)
* Strong UI/visual execution: portfolio showing solid craft and composition sense
* Working knowledge of Figma
* UX at a working level: understanding of user flows, breakpoints, layout and composition, but the priority is delivery and execution speed over deep UX ownership
* Logical, structural, analytical thinking: able to take a vague or open-ended task and break it into a sequence of deliverable steps without hand-holding.
* Good communication: can clearly explain design decisions and ask the right questions
* Proactive mindset: doesn’t wait for detailed instructions and brings ideas and solutions
* Nice to have: consumer product experience, animation tools (After Effects, Principle), experience with TV/smart devices.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Take inputs that are often not fully specified and turn them into shippable UI: proactively clarifying scope with engineers/PM
* Deliver clean, production-ready UI at speed ( this is a 0→1 product, so visual polish and craft matter from the start)
* Work in Figma as primary tool; build/maintain components in a way that supports parallel workstreams
* Bring UX thinking to the work (understand user flows, breakpoints, layout/composition logic) but the primary bar is delivery and execution speed, not deep UX research ownership
* Participate in design discussions with the team and incorporate feedback quickly, minimizing feedback loops
* Gradually take on more complex problems and ownership as you grow within the team

What we offer
-------------

* The team has built award-winning AI products for tech corporations: devices, voice assistants, products that are actually in the world
* Cutting-edge tech stack: Speech Technologies, NLP, Generative AI (LLMs, diffusion models), voice-first agentic architecture with privacy-first and on-premises deployment
* High engineering bar and real ownership: the team cares about what actually works in production, not what looks good in a demo, and you'll see the impact of your work directly
* Fast career progression: a senior-heavy team and a high volume of real problems means you grow faster than you would anywhere else
* Startup pace with enterprise stability: real clients, real revenue, no bureaucracy
* Fully remote across Europe
* 21 vacation days + public holidays + 5 sick days
* Private English lessons via Preply
* Company-paid subscriptions to top AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and others)

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*About BJAK*
------------

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

*About the Job*
---------------

We’re looking for a *Graphic Designer* who can bring ideas to life through creative visuals, motion, and digital storytelling. You’ll design and produce engaging graphics and multimedia assets across multiple platforms — from social media and digital ads to internal and brand campaigns.

This role is perfect for someone who’s hands-on, versatile, and passionate about visual communication — combining design, animation, and creativity to enhance brand impact and engagement.

*Key Responsibilities*
----------------------

Creative Design & Production
----------------------------

*

Design high-quality static and animated assets for marketing campaigns, social media, digital ads, websites, and email communications.

*

Create visually compelling layouts, infographics, and visuals that align with BJAK’s brand identity.

*

Support video and motion projects with visual elements such as titles, transitions, and lower thirds.

*

Ensure all creative outputs maintain brand consistency and meet performance objectives.

Collaboration & Ideation
------------------------

*

Work closely with the Creative, Marketing, and Social Media teams to conceptualize and execute campaign ideas.

*

Contribute creative ideas and design solutions to enhance brand storytelling and audience engagement.

*

Collaborate with videographers, motion graphic artists, and copywriters to produce cohesive multimedia content.

Technical & Workflow Management
-------------------------------

*

Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and high creative quality.

*

Optimize designs for different digital formats and platforms (web, mobile, social).

*

Maintain an organized library of design assets, templates, and brand materials.

Trend & Innovation
------------------

*

Stay current with design trends, visual storytelling techniques, and emerging creative tools.

*

Experiment with new visual styles and digital formats to keep BJAK’s content fresh and relevant.

*

Continuously seek ways to improve design efficiency and creative impact.

*Requirements*
--------------

*

Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Multimedia Design, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or related field.

*

2–4 years of experience in multimedia or digital design.

*

Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro) or equivalent tools.

*

Strong design portfolio demonstrating creativity, attention to detail, and versatility across media formats.

*

Understanding of visual hierarchy, color theory, typography, and layout principles.

*

Ability to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

*

Motion design or animation experience is an advantage.

*Our Team & Culture*
--------------------

We move fast. We’re lean. We don’t do fluff - we do results. Everyone at BJAK is expected to take ownership of their work, speak up with ideas, and move the needle. As a digital marketing team, we act like operators - we don’t just set campaigns live, we track, tweak, and scale what works.

If you want to grow fast, operate with autonomy, and work on campaigns that reach millions, this is the right environment for you.

*What You’ll Get*
-----------------

*

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

*

Ownership of campaigns that directly impact revenue and growth.

*

Exposure to regional markets and cross-functional collaboration.

*

A team that values clear thinking, fast execution, and measurable outcomes.

*Location*
----------

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in *the Philippines*. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in *the Philippines*.

*Language*
----------

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

*Interview Process*
-------------------

Our process is designed to move fast:
-------------------------------------

*

Online assessment or practical task
-----------------------------------

*

Technical interview
-------------------

*

CEO / final round
-----------------

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Graphic Designer
description:

High Tide is a leading cannabis retailer and eCommerce company with a portfolio of brands across North America and Europe and we're looking for a *Graphic Designer.*

Are you creative, curious, strong visual skills and fresh ideas, apply today and bring your creativity to High Tide!

Our Graphic Designer will play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional in-house graphic services to the sales, marketing, and purchasing departments. Your responsibilities will span print and web design, encompassing product, packaging, signage, email, and website design.

English fluency is required for this role. Resumes must be submitted in English and also provide a portfolio in English as well to showcase your work.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

*Motion Graphics*

* Create motion graphics, animated assets, and visual effects for social media, digital advertising, and campaign content.

* Edit short-form video content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and other digital platforms.

* Create eye-catching POP displays, such as counter and shelf displays, sidekicks, and side-stacks.

* Ensure all design deliverables align with branding guidelines.

* Ensure compliance with customer style-guides and prepare necessary approval documents.

* Develop packaging dielines according to customer requirements and design specifications.

*Product Design, Photography and Illustration*

* Design and format product instructions, catalogs, and brochures.

* Produce necessary technical and classical illustrations.

* Collaborate effectively with fellow designers to achieve accurate and efficient work.

* Demonstrate superior multitasking abilities by managing multiple projects with strict adherence to deadlines and exceptional attention to detail.

* Proficiency in Adobe Cloud (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and working on a MAC environment is essential.

* Exceptional multitasking and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.

* Strong verbal and written *English skills* are necessary to effectively communicate with clients and colleagues.

* Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to articulate design decisions clearly.

--------

--------

*High Tide Inc.* is the leading community-grown, retail-forward cannabis enterprise engineered to unleash the full value of the world’s most powerful plant and is the second-largest cannabis retailer globally by store count *⁷*. High Tide (HITI) is uniquely-built around the cannabis consumer, with wholly-diversified and fully-integrated operations across all components of cannabis, including:

Wholesale Distribution: High Tide keeps that cannabis category stocked with wholesale solutions via Valiant™.

High Tide consistently moves ahead of the currents, having been named one of Canada’s Top Growing Companies in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024 by the Globe and Mail’s Report on Business Magazine, and was named as one of the top 10 performing diversified industries stocks in both 2022 and 2024 TSX Venture 50. This is a high-ownership role for someone who loves turning ideas into stories that convert - and who’s as comfortable in Webflow or Figma as they are in a Google Doc or Notion.

-----------------------

* Own the PLG narrative: Shape how users discover, try, and upgrade across both products. Turn product updates and AI features into compelling growth loops.

* Build and maintain GTM assets: Keep our pitch decks, one-pagers, proposals, and outbound materials crisp, current, and on-brand.
* Record product demos and explainers: Use tools like Arcade, Screen Studio or Loom to highlight key use cases (PDP asset creation at scale &, brand compliance).
* Study the market: Track competitors and category trends to refine messaging and identify whitespace opportunities.
* Prioritize what moves the needle: Balance polish and speed - know when “good enough” gets us faster to learning or traction.

*Requirements*

* *4–6 years total experience in a pure Product Marketing Manager role* — experience *must be exclusively in product marketing* , not in product management, program management, or other adjacent roles.
* *Experience working at least in 2 product-led SaaS or startup environments* — ideally *Seed to Series B stage companies* where you’ve owned positioning, launches, and go-to-market execution.
* You can write fast and clearly. You care about clarity over fluff, and you know how to make complex AI features sound useful, not abstract.
* You’re comfortable publishing in Webflow, building decks in Figma Slides, and working from Figma mocks, PLG tools like Product Fruits or Arcade demo videos.

* You’re organized, proactive, and comfortable working directly with a founder in a fast-moving, no-handholding environment.

* Understand the visual production and creative-operations needs of retailers, marketplaces, and post-production teams
* Are sharp, resourceful, and decisive - you don’t wait for perfect specs, you move things forward
* You know how to research competitors, analyze market moves, and shape product messaging that stands out

*Preferred Experience*

* B2B SaaS demand generation.
* LinkedIn content programs and executive thought leadership.
* Reddit marketing and community engagement.
* SEO-driven content strategies.
* Product-led growth motions.
* Marketing AI, SaaS, workflow automation, creative operations, or adjacent technology products.

--------------

Send us two things that show you’re a strong fit for this role:

* A link to something you’ve worked on (site, deck, landing page, etc.) that demonstrates your *aesthetic quality and content clarity*. It should look as good or better than . If it doesn’t, this isn’t the right fit.

It could be a campaign, a channel play, a partnership, or something else that could make an impact fast. Record it using Loom, Screen Studio, or even your phone - we’re evaluating clarity and insight, not production quality.

*Benefits*

Why This Role Is Epic
---------------------

* Be part of a potential GenAI unicorn from day one
* Collaborate directly with founder and leadership to execute winning strategies
* Build something massive with backing from Evolphin and 12,000+ existing users
* Work with cutting-edge Gen AI platform that creative professionals actually love
* Help craft the product marketing playbook for brand visual consistency tools
* Establish yourself as a pioneer in an emerging product category
* Receive meaningful equity at an early stage with massive upside potential

About Our Products
------------------

At the intersection of AI and visual media, our platforms are transforming how brands maintain consistency at scale:

leverages cutting-edge AI to help brands ensure visual consistency across all media assets. With over 12,000 users already, our platform automates image and video processing to maintain brand identity across product photos, promotional materials, and more.

Evolphin is a leader in digital & media asset management, with deep expertise in transforming media workflows for retail, eCommerce, media & entertainment, and beyond.

As these platforms converge, you'll be at the forefront of a revolutionary approach to brand management – combining intelligent asset organization with AI-powered brand compliance in a unified solution that will redefine creative workflows.

description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will be a front-line manager to a group of Account Executives (AEs) who will be hunting, pitching, and closing new business for Ramp. You will be responsible for 1:1 coaching, mentoring, and strategy development, working closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and the executive team to drive positive outcomes for this segment. As a key member of the sales leadership team, you will have the opportunity to help build and refine Ramp’s sales development motion.

Please note that this Sales leadership role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ or SF office at least 3 days/week

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage, develop and execute career development and leadership plan for a group of Account Executives and provide daily 1:1 mentoring and coaching

- Set and maintain a high-performing culture and morale by overseeing the daily activities and quota performance management of individual AEs to ensure key performance metrics are met

- Hire and train new AEs on Ramp’s product, buyer personas, competition, and tools through various methods (ie. role-plays)

- Strategize with sales and marketing counterparts on pipeline and prospecting initiatives to meet company objectives

- Build dashboards and report on customer and team performance and forecast to senior leadership

- Improve team output and efficiency over time by optimizing systems and processes

- Build and execute on pipeline with new clients and partners to run the end-to-end sales process

- Establish a library of playbook resources for the AE team

- Partner with Ops to create and polish existing metrics that evaluate the individual and team’s performance

- Represent the AE team cross-functionally with leaders of other departments

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- Minimum 3 years of quota carrying sales experience as an individual contributor

- Minimum 2 years of experience building and leading successful, high-performing sales teams

- Demonstrated success in fast-paced, results-oriented GTM environments, ideally at SaaS companies, and history of consistently performing above quota in an outbound sales environment

- Passion and excitement for hiring, with a thoughtful approach to team planning and development

- Experience working cross-functionally to build successful top of the funnel activities to drive more pipeline; Strong collaboration and influencing skills demonstrated through excellent communication and presentation skills

- Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including executive leaders

- Proficiency in data analytics tools (ie. Salesforce, Looker, Gong and Excel) and familiarity with email and call automation platforms

- Ability to leverage data to drive decisions, create systems, and identify process improvements to improve efficiency

NICE TO HAVES

- Experience with financial services sales in a full-cycle sales role

- Financial services or Fintech experience at a high-growth startup

BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO ALL FULL-TIME RAMP EMPLOYEES (GLOBAL)

- Flexible PTO

- Centralized home-office equipment ordering

- Health and wellness stipend

- Budget for intra-office travel

- Weekly coffee stipend

UNITED STATES

- 100% medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you, with partial coverage for dependents

- One Medical annual membership

- 401(k), including employer match on contributions made while employed by Ramp

- Fertility HRA (up to $10,000 per year)

- Parental leave: up to 16 weeks (birthing + bonding) or 8 weeks (bonding only) at 100% pay

- Pet insurance

- In-office perks: lunch, snacks, drinks, and more

CANADA

title: Staff Software Engineer, Payments
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

About the team

In our Payments Team, your responsibilities extend beyond delivering product features to achieving business outcomes. Your tasks will involve developing various REST services and integration components within a backend microservices architecture, connecting with our React frontend.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help define the technical direction of our Payments platform, lead complex architecture decisions, and build highly reliable, high-volume distributed systems that directly impact merchant experience and business outcomes.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead the architecture and evolution of next-generation Payment Acceptance infrastructure.

- Design and build scalable backend services, REST APIs, event-driven systems, and integration components within a microservices architecture.

- Drive complex initiatives across payment gateways, acquiring, issuing, card networks, and local payment methods.

- Partner with product, business, infrastructure, and external engineering teams to translate merchant needs into technical solutions.

- Conduct architectural reviews, address technical debt, and improve system reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.

- Raise the engineering bar through strong design practices, code quality, testing, observability, and mentorship.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, including Staff-level technical leadership or equivalent ownership of complex backend systems.

- Strong experience designing and operating high-volume distributed systems, preferably in payments, fintech, commerce, or financial infrastructure.

- Recent hands-on experience with Java or Kotlin and Spring / Spring Boot.

- Expertise building REST APIs, backend microservices, Kafka-based event streams, and distributed data stores such as Cassandra, Hazelcast, Oracle Coherence, or similar.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP or AWS, plus Docker and Kubernetes.

- Strong familiarity with observability and operational tooling such as New Relic, StatsD, ELK, Datadog, Prometheus, or similar.

- Proven ability to lead projects from concept to production with a focus on quality, testing, reliability, and maintainability.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to influence across engineering, product, and business stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building payment gateways, acquiring platforms, issuing platforms, or payment acceptance infrastructure.

- Experience integrating major card networks such as Visa and Mastercard.

- Experience with local payment methods such as iDEAL, Klarna, Trustly, or similar.

- Familiarity with authorization, capture, refunds, chargebacks, settlement, reconciliation, fraud, risk, or PCI/compliance workflows.

- Experience mentoring senior engineers and leading cross-team technical initiatives.

APPLICANT SAFETY POLICY: FRAUD AND THIRD-PARTY RECRUITERS

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters.  Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). title: Account Executive - Spanish Market
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join our Commercial team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll help drive end-to-end sales cycles and new customer acquisition, joining our commercial team as we scale our spend management solution across key markets. If you're excited about replacing outdated business expense processes with smart SaaS automation and are passionate about B2B sales and spend management, then this is the opportunity for you!

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You’ll report to the Manager, Sales and work closely with teams in SDR and Customer Success. Our team of revenue generators is highly collaborative and dedicated to expanding Pleo’s footprint while helping clients eliminate out-of-pocket expenses. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across Marketing, Product, and Finance to ensure success.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Executive, you will:

- Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion

- Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships

- Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo

- Become an expert in expense management

- Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As an Account Executive, you will:

- Own the entire sales cycle - from outbound to qualification, product demos and deal conversion

- Achieve new business revenue targets - focusing on building new relationships

- Collaborate closely with the Customer Success team - to ensure the customers in your portfolio successfully adopt with Pleo

- Become an expert in expense management

- Give outstanding product presentations - acing those demos to get deals closed

What you bring
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- A background in SaaS sales, ideally coming from an Account Executive or Senior SDR outbound role ready to take on a full-closing position

- Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas, including sourcing, managing, and closing your own deals.

- Complete fluency in Spanish and English (interviews, onboarding, and internal communication are in English)

- Exceptional rapport-building and presentation abilities to lead product demos and close prospects smoothly.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You thrive in a target-driven environment managing new business

- You prefer a collaborative team environment free of internal politics, egos, or sharp elbows.

- You want a structured hybrid model working 3 days in-office and 2 days from home

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You are looking for a fully remote position

- You prefer non-quota-bearing or purely reactive customer management roles without outbound responsibilities.

- You have never worked with quotas or revenue objectives

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 3 months at Pleo, you’ll:

- Lead full-cycle sales opportunities from qualification to close to drive revenue impact in your assigned market.

- Collaborate with Customer Success to improve account onboarding, adoption rates, and expansion cycles.

- Grow your skills in spend management expertise and deal negotiation, taking on larger strategic accounts as the company continues to scale

We’re committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into leadership, or acquiring new skills in [specific area].

THE LOCATION

Please note: We can hire on a hybrid set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

2. Hiring Manager Call: 45 mins to meet with Sales leadership, here they will look to discuss your experience and relevance in greater detail. Understanding strengths and weaknesses.

3. Pleo Challenge: A 60 mins, here we look to dive deeper. This interview will be split into 2 sections 30 min mock Discovery Call, and a 15 min Pleo presentation as an Account Executive with 15 min Q&A.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired an Account Executive, we received a total of 120 applications but only 15 were selected for an intro call. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Principal Business Operations Manager, Ops & AI Tooling
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake's AI Native Engineering (FDE) Operations organization is seeking a Business Operations Manager, Ops AI & Tooling to build the operating engine of the business. Rather than operating in team-aligned silos, this function aligns to the entire business, specializing in a unique swimlane with a deep cross-functional mindset and flow. In short: this team builds the operating engine — think leverage.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director, Services Global Operations. You will build the internal operational tools that plan and run the business, own the automation and AI agents that eliminate manual work, and set the roadmap and tooling strategy that the operations team and broader FDE business use to operate. If you're a builder at heart — equally comfortable defining a roadmap and shipping the automation behind it — this is where you'll have outsized impact.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Own Tooling Strategy & Roadmap: Define and own the operational tooling strategy and roadmap — the intake, prioritization, and release plan for the internal tools that run the business.

- Build Business Planning & Operating Tools: Design and build the internal tools that plan and run the business, partnering with the Business Planning and Commercial Ops functions to turn their processes into scalable systems.

- Automate Workflows: Build workflow automation across staffing, planning, forecasting, and reporting to remove manual effort and increase speed and accuracy.

- Develop AI Agents for Operational Workflows: Design and deploy AI agents and GenAI-powered workflows for operational use cases — anomaly detection, staffing intelligence, predictive forecasting, and automated summaries.

- Drive Cross-System Integration & Orchestration: Architect and maintain integration and process orchestration across the operations tech stack (e.g., PSA, CRM, planning, and BI tools), ensuring clean data flow and system integrity.

- Own Tool Adoption, Standards & Optimization: Drive adoption, define standards, and continuously optimize the tooling portfolio — measuring usage, retiring redundancy, and improving the operator experience.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Serve as the tooling and automation advisor to the operations leadership team, Enterprise Technology, and the Data, Analytics & AI teams, translating business needs into scalable systems.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 7+ years (IC4) or 10+ years (IC5) of experience in business operations, ops tooling/systems, revenue operations, or professional services operations, with a strong build orientation.

- Proven track record designing and shipping internal operational tools, workflow automation, or agentic/AI workflows.

- Hands-on experience with automation and integration across systems such as Salesforce, Certinia/FinancialForce, Smartsheet, and BI tools; comfort using SQL and coding/coding agents to solve problems.

- Demonstrated fluency with GenAI and LLMs to automate operational workflows and accelerate insight generation.

- Expertise in workflow design, systems architecture, and data governance, with a bias toward simplifying complex processes.

- Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, with the ability to influence without authority. (IC5: expected to set direction and drive org-wide initiatives independently.)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Computer Science, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?
