To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Sales Development Representative to come aboard to focus on the Australia market! Our SDRs will work hand in hand with Inside Sales to generate leads and build customer pipelines. This is an entry-level role with a dedicated growth path and the training to be a great technical sales professional. We are looking for self-starters with a passion for technology and people.

AS A SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE AT SNOWFLAKE YOU WILL:

- Generate appointments by means of proactive outbound prospecting and lead activity management in an effort to qualify and market our solutions to potential customers.

- Work directly with marketing to discover opportunities from leads, and set appointments from those leads.

- Use of strong selling and influencing skills to set up qualified appointments.

- Understand the Snowflake Database enough to provide a high level introduction.

- Leverage taught sales techniques to maximize customer interactions.

- Log, track, and maintain outbound activity.

- Work closely with Sales Directors and attend customer meetings as required.

- Attend sales meetings, vendor training, and local trade shows to keep current with technology.

OUR IDEAL SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE WILL HAVE:

- 3+ years of experience in prospecting roles and a university degree from an accredited institution.

- Excellent verbal and written communication in English

- Strong in-person, phone, and written customer communication skills.

- Must be able to interact and communicate with individuals at all levels of the organization.

- Understanding of workflow systems and their application to customer business process improvement.

- Ability to make formal and informal presentations to staff and clients.

- Ability to prioritize work assignments and shift work efforts based on the needs of the department or business goals.

- Strong PC skills required; knowledge of Salesforce.com http://Salesforce.com a plus.

- Ability to manage time effectively, work independently, and be self-motivated.

- Prior track record of achievement in positions with significant accountability.

- Interested in pursuing a career in technology.

- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

- Pro-active, independent thinker with a positive attitude.

- Strong presentation, and relationship management skills

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Customer Value Manager
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Customer Value Manager is the primary owner of the customer relationship and long-term success of assigned dealership accounts within Tekion’s Customer Value Services organization. This is not a support role with a retention overlay. It is a strategic value leadership role responsible for understanding each dealer’s business goals, connecting those goals to measurable outcomes within the Tekion platform, and ensuring value is visible, documented, and expanding over time.

The Customer Value Manager serves as the strategic quarterback for every account in the portfolio. This role leads the ongoing customer relationship across operational and executive stakeholders, owns the Customer Value Plan (CVP) for each account, drives outcome-focused Value Reviews, maintains visibility into portfolio health and risk, and helps ensure renewals and expansion opportunities are supported by a clear, data-backed value narrative. The Customer Value Manager partners closely with Customer Value Architects, who provide product expertise and maturity diagnostics, and with Virtual Value Managers, who help support account activity between strategic touchpoints. Together, these roles help close the gap between what a dealer purchased and the value they are actually realizing.

KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the customer relationship across assigned dealership accounts, building and maintaining trusted relationships with operational contacts, general managers, dealer principals, and other key stakeholders

- Develop, maintain, and execute a Customer Value Plan for every account in the portfolio, ensuring plans remain current, actionable, and aligned to dealer priorities and business outcomes

- Lead regular Value Reviews that replace traditional QBRs with structured, outcome-focused conversations grounded in dealer performance, platform adoption, operational progress, and realized value

- Partner with Customer Value Architects (CVAs) to interpret Dealer Maturity Model (DMM) positioning, product adoption data, workflow maturity, and module utilization in order to shape account strategy and identify value gaps

- Translate platform usage, operational performance, and maturity progress into a compelling value narrative that helps customers understand where they are realizing value and where additional opportunity exists

- Maintain visibility into portfolio health through active management of account health indicators, maturity assessments, customer risks, renewal status, and expansion potential

- Forecast renewal readiness across the portfolio, ensuring each renewal is anticipated, supported by documented evidence of realized value, and aligned with Sales-led execution

- Identify and surface expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales by understanding customer needs, value realization progress, operational gaps, and growth potential across accounts

- Represent the voice of the customer internally by escalating risks, highlighting friction points, advocating for improvements, and informing internal priorities that improve customer outcomes

- Partner with Virtual Value Managers (VVMs) to ensure account documentation, operational support activity, weekly account digests, and proactive dealer touchpoints help reinforce broader customer strategy

- Ensure Customer Value Plan documentation, account records, and customer interaction history remain current, accurate, and useful for internal alignment and execution

- Monitor customer progress against agreed goals and maturity milestones, helping dealers move forward in a structured way across the Tekion Dealer Maturity Model

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, Implementations, and other internal teams as needed to remove blockers, align account strategy, and improve customer outcomes

- Operate effectively in a high-growth environment where portfolio size, segment design, account structures, and team configurations may evolve over time

- Travel to dealership sites and customer engagement events as needed to strengthen relationships, support value conversations, and improve understanding of dealer operations

- Support broader Customer Value Services goals by improving retention readiness, expansion visibility, customer trust, and measurable value realization across the portfolio

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Automotive Management, Communications, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted in lieu of degree

- 3–5 years of experience in customer value, account management, client-facing consulting, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS environment

- Demonstrated ability to manage executive relationships and lead value-focused conversations with dealer principals, general managers, or comparable senior customer stakeholders

- Strong analytical instincts, including the ability to review performance data, adoption trends, and operational signals and translate them into a compelling customer value narrative

- Experience developing account plans, success plans, value plans, or comparable structured customer engagement strategies preferred

- Experience forecasting account health, renewal risk, or expansion opportunity across a portfolio preferred

- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, or similar internal teams to improve customer outcomes

- Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce preferred

- Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI preferred

- Automotive industry experience or familiarity with dealership operations strongly preferred

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for dealership visits, onsite engagement, and customer events

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead executive conversations and prepare clear internal account context

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities, portfolio needs, and organizational structures

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation and generous stock options

- 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage

- Great benefits including unlimited PTO, parental leave and free snacks and beverages

- The opportunity to work with some of the brightest minds from Silicon Valley’s most dominant and successful companies

- Be part of an early stage, hyper-growth start-up with the opportunity to grow and prosper

- Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up

- A dynamic work environment with a strong sense of community and collaboration

- The open and transparent culture that encourages innovation, rewards performance and discourages hierarchy

- Exciting opportunities for career growth and development

title: Junior Graphics Designer
location: Remote, Greater Las Vegas Area, NV
description:
About Evo

For over 20 years, The Evolution Championship Series (Evo), has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are rallying points where fans, publishers, developers, and brands celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them. Beyond our established live events, Evo’s mission continues to evolve to create, celebrate, and renew fighting game fandom.

**Role Overview**

We're looking for a Junior Graphic Designer with strong design fundamentals and a sharp visual sensibility to support the RTS creative team, with a primary focus on presentation and sales materials.

This role will work closely with the RTS sales team to design, refine, and maintain polished presentation decks used for sales meetings, pitches, proposals, and client-facing communications. The ideal candidate is someone who understands how typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, imagery, and visual consistency work together to communicate information clearly and persuasively.

While this is a junior-level role, we're looking for someone who can bring a strong design point of view and a high level of attention to detail to their work. You should be comfortable taking existing content and transforming it into a clean, compelling presentation, while also being able to work within established brand systems and templates.

You will also support Evo and other RTS creative needs, including templated graphics, digital assets, and other design production as needed.

This is an excellent opportunity for a designer early in their career who wants hands-on experience working at the intersection of design, sales, esports, and entertainment, while developing their skills across a range of creative projects.

**Reporting Structure**

You will report to Evo's Creative Director.

**Key Responsibilities**

* RTS Sales & Presentation Design
*

* Design, refine, and maintain presentation decks for RTS sales meetings, pitches, proposals, and other business needs.
* Translate written information, data, and sales messaging into clear, visually compelling presentation layouts.
* Create and maintain presentation templates and deck themes, ensuring consistency across multiple presentations and projects.
* Develop and update slide layouts, visual systems, charts, graphics, and other presentation elements.
* Create mockups and visual representations of proposed campaigns, partnerships, sponsorships, and other client-facing concepts.
* Work closely with the Sales team to understand project goals, incorporate feedback, and adapt presentations to meet specific client or pitch needs.
* Maintain a high level of consistency, polish, and attention to detail across presentation materials.
* Organize and manage presentation assets, templates, and source files so they remain easy to update and reuse.

* Evo & General Creative Support
*

* Support the creative team with design and asset production for Evo events and other RTS projects.
* Create and update templated digital assets, including broadcast graphics, YouTube thumbnails, and other high-volume creative deliverables.
* Adapt existing creative systems and templates to efficiently produce polished, consistent assets.
* Support additional design and production needs as projects and priorities evolve.

**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of graphic design experience, or equivalent experience through internships, freelance work, personal projects, or other relevant creative work.
* A strong design portfolio demonstrating excellent fundamentals and a thoughtful visual approach.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and the broader Google Workspace/G Suite, including Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive.
* Working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, composition, hierarchy, spacing, and general graphic design principles.
* Strong attention to detail and an eye for visual consistency and polish.
* Ability to take complex or information-heavy content and organize it into clear, easy-to-understand visual presentations.
* Ability to work within established brand guidelines while making thoughtful design decisions.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
* Clear and professional communication skills.
* Comfortable receiving feedback, asking questions, and iterating on work.
* Ability to work collaboratively and adapt to the needs of different teams and projects.
* Comfortable working closely with the RTS sales team and responding to evolving project needs and feedback.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when to ask for direction or clarification.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience designing presentation decks, sales materials, proposals, or other client-facing communications.
* Experience creating or maintaining presentation templates and visual systems.
* Experience working with high-volume or templated creative production.
* Familiarity with Figma.
* Knowledge of or interest in esports, fighting games, gaming, or the FGC.
* General familiarity with the esports and gaming industry.

Compensation

The salary for this role is $45,000.00 to $60,000.00 depending on experience.

**Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
* 401k plan available for employee contributions
* Flexible work schedule
* Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
* Remote-first culture

title: Junior Design System Designer
description:
Description
-----------

As a *Design System Designer* , you will help build and evolve a scalable design system that supports digital products and experiences across web, mobile, and emerging platforms. Working closely with design, development, and cross-functional teams, you will contribute to the creation, maintenance, documentation, and quality assurance of a comprehensive component ecosystem.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys systems thinking, component design, documentation, and creating reusable assets that enable teams to work more efficiently and consistently.

What You'll Do
--------------

* Collaborate with design system team members to build, maintain, and evolve the organization's design system.
* Create, update, QA, and manage components, patterns, design tokens, and layout systems within Figma.
* Produce and maintain documentation for components, including usage guidance, behaviors, accessibility considerations, and implementation requirements.
* Partner with designers and developers to support design system adoption and address component-related questions.
* Contribute to design system governance, helping ensure consistency and quality across products and experiences.
* Support the implementation of scalable design solutions across digital platforms.
* Assist in defining reusable design assets that improve efficiency and accelerate product delivery.
* Work with team members and stakeholders to continuously improve design system processes, documentation standards, and workflows.

Required Qualifications
-----------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Graphic Design, Visual Design, Interaction Design, Product Design, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of professional experience in UI design, design systems, product design, UX design, or related fields.
* Demonstrated experience building, maintaining, updating, or governing Figma component libraries.
* Strong portfolio showcasing design system contributions, component work, documentation, and systems-thinking capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency with Figma, including components, variants, libraries, design tokens, and documentation workflows.
* Experience creating clear documentation, specifications, and usage guidelines for design systems.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across design and engineering teams.
* Understanding of accessibility standards, inclusive design principles, and scalable design patterns.

Skills
------

* Product Design
* Component Design
* Design Systems

Top Skills
----------

* Product Design
* Component Design
* Design Systems

Preferred Qualifications
------------------------

* Experience documenting large-scale design systems and component libraries.
* Understanding of design system governance, maintenance, and adoption strategies.
* Experience partnering with both design and engineering teams throughout implementation.
* Familiarity with complex digital products, enterprise applications, or multi-platform user experiences.
* Understanding of front-end development concepts and design-to-development workflows.
* Portfolio examples demonstrating component architecture, documentation, and design systems thinking.

Experience Level
----------------

*Entry to Mid-Level (3+ years of relevant experience)*

Key Changes
-----------

* Removed all references to GM, GMUI, vehicles, automotive programs, and in-vehicle experiences.
* Broadened platform references to include any digital product environment.
* Replaced industry-specific language with universally applicable design system terminology.
* Updated the experience level to align more closely with the stated 3+ years of experience requirement.

This is a Contract position based out of Warren, MI.

Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

description:
*TO APPLY: Please submit a PORTFOLIO that exhibits proficiency in graphic design principles.*

*WHY JOIN AGU?*

Our employees are our most valuable assets! You will feel welcomed and supported from the moment you join our team, and you will take part in strengthening and evolving our workplace culture.

We offer work-life balance- We are a remote-first organization, with flexible work hours.

*WHO WE ARE?*

The American Geophysical Union (AGU) supports a global community of more than half a million professionals and advocates in the Earth and space sciences.

Through broad and inclusive partnerships, AGU aims to advance discovery and solution science that accelerates knowledge and creates solutions that are ethical, unbiased, and respectful of communities and their values. We live our values in everything we do, such as our net-zero energy renovated building in Washington, D.C., and our Ethics and Equity Center, which fosters a diverse and inclusive geoscience community to ensure responsible conduct.

*HIRING SPECIFICS*

* Full Time/ Hourly, 3-month internship, This remote role is open to candidates based in most U.S. states (excluding WA, OR, and CA at this time).

title: Junior Marketing Video Editor
description:
*Junior Video Editor*

Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model.

Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint).

We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance.

Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below.

-----------------
*About the Role:*
-----------------

As a Junior Video Editor you'll join Labhouse's video editing team to take concepts that are already proven and expand them into the volume of variations needed to find their best-performing version. Your focus won't be creating new concepts from scratch, but producing hooks, CTAs, pacing, and format variants of existing ads at scale and A/B testing them to identify what wins. This is a hands-on, operational role from day one: you'll be expected to deliver around 100 iterations a week, working closely with senior editors and Creative Strategists, and building your skills across both classic editing and AI-powered creative tools.

-------------------
*Responsibilities:*
-------------------

*

Produce iterations of existing, proven ads: new hooks, alternate CTAs, pacing changes, and small creative tweaks aimed at keeping performance strong.

*

Work at high volume, delivering around 100 iterations a week without losing attention to detail or quality.

*

Adapt existing ads into new formats and versions for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, including localized or platform-specific cuts.

*

Apply feedback and direction from Creative Strategists accurately and quickly, iterating until the ad is ready to ship.

*

Learn and apply AI-powered creative tools to speed up iteration work, under the guidance of the wider team.

*

Keep iteration work organized and on-brief, hitting agreed formats, lengths, and specs across platforms.

*

Flag opportunities for further iterations based on what you notice in an ad's performance or audience response.

*

Support the wider video editing team with production capacity during high-volume periods.

------------
*About You:*
------------

*Academic background:*

*

No specific degree required. We care about your editing skills and eagerness to learn, not your diploma.

*Technical expertise:*

*

Some experience editing short-form video content.

*

Comfortable with Adobe Premiere and After Effects.

*

A good sense of what makes short-form video engaging: pacing, hooks, captions, and current trends on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook.

*

Knowledge in AI creative tools such as Seedance, Veo3, Kling, ElevenLabs, NanoBanana, Claude Design, ChatGPT.

*

Comfortable following detailed briefs and applying precise, iterative feedback quickly.

*Problem-solving and product focus:*

*

Detail-oriented, with a good eye for what looks and feels right.

*

Eager to learn, open to feedback, and quick to turn notes into a better version of the ad.

*

Organized and able to manage several small iteration tasks in parallel without losing quality.

*

Comfortable working at high volume, while keeping a steady, consistent standard of work.

*Communication:*

*

Good level of spoken and written English and Spanish.

*

Comfortable asking questions, sharing progress, and collaborating closely with senior editors and the wider team.

---------------
*Nice to Have:*
---------------

Pluses that are needed occasionally:

*

Previous experience or coursework in video editing, motion graphics, or social media content creation.

*

Experience with AI creative tools.

*

Exposure to app marketing or performance marketing environments.

----------------
*What we Offer:*
----------------

*

Remote work from LATAM.

*

Flexible working hours.

*

High-end equipment for your development.

*

A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment.

*

Real hands-on experience across a high volume of live, performance-driven campaigns.

*

Work with cutting-edge technologies, including AI creative tools used daily in production.

----------------
*Hiring Process*
----------------

1. TA Interview – Initial conversation to get to know each other and understand your background.

2. Hiring Manager Interview – Deep dive into your editing experience, portfolio, and fit with the team.

3. Technical Case – Practical exercise assessing your editing skills, attention to brief, and ability to apply iterative feedback.

4. Final Interview – Final conversation to ensure alignment on expectations, culture, and role fit.

------------------
*You should Know:*
------------------

Labhouse is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. However you identify or whatever your journey to this point, we welcome all candidates to apply for the position that inspires them.

Come join us and help us build a company that everyone is proud to be part of.

title: Marketing Data Analyst II
description:

You’ll support our *marketing, web, and product teams* by analyzing performance, implementing tracking strategies, and proactively identifying trends that drive decisions.

This is a mid-level position for someone who enjoys translating data into strategy and wants to shape how insights are delivered across the company. You'll report directly to the Director of Analytics and work alongside a junior analyst. *Working knowledge of AUTOMOTIVE AGENCY and/or MARKETING AGENCY, highly preferred.*

This is a full-time, salaried, remote position. Employee must be located within the Continental U.S., *Eastern or Central time zone highly preferred* , but all are welcome to apply.

*Responsibilities:*

* Configure and maintain Google Analytics and other web analytics tools
* Build and iterate dashboards to help stakeholders monitor KPIs
* Analyze user behavior and marketing channel performance to generate actionable insights
* Assist in troubleshooting tracking and data collection issues
* Conduct ad hoc analyses and deep dives to support product and marketing decisions
* Lead A/B test planning, execution, and post-test analysis
* Monitor performance metrics and set up alerts for key anomalies
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand goals and translate them into measurement plans
* Mentor junior analysts on tools, best practices, and analytical approaches

*Qualifications:*

* BA/BS in computer science, mathematics, statistics, business or related field, *required*
* *3+ years of experience in web, marketing, or product analytics, required*
* *Proficiency in tools like Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI, required*
* Working knowledge of AUTOMOTIVE AGENCY and/or MARKETING AGENCY, highly preferred
* Hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager or other tag management systems, *required*
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong skills in Excel/Google Sheets, *required*
* Familiarity with A/B testing methodologies and tools (e.g., Google Optimize, Optimizely), highly preferred
* Comfortable with troubleshooting tracking issues, debugging, and QA
* Strong communication skills - you can share findings clearly with technical and non-technical audiences
* Bonus: Familiarity with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, or Google App Script, a plus!

*COMPENSATION*
Competitive compensation will be commensurate with experience. Participation in company benefit offerings include medical, dental, vision, 401(k), wellness, unlimited paid vacation, and more.

*NEXT STEPS*
If you are interested in this position and believe your experience is a perfect fit, please COMPLETE the online application. ** Please be sure to include a current resume along with your contact information. Incomplete submissions will not be considered. No phone calls please.

*ABOUT TEAM VELOCITY*
Team Velocity is a full-service marketing agency serving the automotive industry, providing fully integrated marketing solutions to OEMs and dealerships nationwide.

We are revolutionizing the automotive industry with cutting-edge technology to help dealers sell and service more cars. Made by dealers for dealers, Team Velocity’s proprietary technology platform Apollo® analyzes consumer behavior to predict who will buy, what they will buy, and when they are ready to service. Apollo automates the entire communication process by delivering hyper-personalized campaigns across every touchpoint, maximizing ROI, and lifetime revenue.

title: Junior Marketing Specialist (Remote)
description:
Jitterbit is looking for a high-energy, detail-oriented *Junior Marketing Specialist* to join our performance marketing team.

We are looking for a true go-getter and self-starter — someone who is naturally curious, loves figuring out how platforms work, and takes absolute pride in flawless execution. If you are eager to get hands-on experience managing campaigns, diving into data, and owning critical marketing systems, this is your launchpad.

In this role, you will help run our marketing engine. You'll spend half of your time on the technical, operational side — building automation workflows, scheduling emails, and tracking data in *HubSpot and Salesforce*. The other half will be spent in the exciting world of paid acquisition — creating ads, partnering with design to build creatives, and working with our agency to launch and optimize *PPC and Paid Social* campaigns.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Marketing Operations*

* *HubSpot Automation:* Set up, test, and maintain HubSpot workflows to support lead nurturing and campaign tracking.
* *Email Logistics:* Build and schedule marketing emails in HubSpot (we provide the templates and the copy; you handle the technical setup and QA).
* *AI Project Coordination:* Support inbound and outbound AI functions across various AI tools and platforms (e.g., Gong, Artisan, Qualified, etc.).
* *Tracking Setup:* Ensure tracking pixels, UTMs, and campaigns are correctly set up so data flows smoothly into Salesforce.
* *Basic Reporting:* Help pull campaign data and maintain reports in HubSpot and Salesforce to show what campaigns are working.

*Paid Media & Ad Management*

* *Ad Copywriting & Asset Coordination:* Write short, punchy ad copy for paid social/search and work directly with our Design team to get the images/videos needed.
* *Agency Collaboration:* Act as a key coordinator with our external ad agency to help get campaigns live on time.
* *Ad Optimization:* Monitor Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager daily to identify quick-win optimizations (e.g., pausing underperforming ads, adjusting budgets).

*Campaign Project Management & Reporting*

* *End-to-End Campaign Management:* Manage marketing campaign timelines, workflows, and launch schedules from kickoff to execution to ensure on-time delivery.
* *Cross-Functional Coordination:* Collaborate directly with Content, Design, Sales, and external partners to gather assets, align messaging, and ensure successful campaign launches.
* *Dashboards & Performance Insights:* Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards to monitor campaign performance, track KPIs, and provide actionable insights to stakeholders.

* *Experience:* 2-3 years of experience in digital marketing, operations, or paid ads (agency background is a huge plus!).
* *The "Go-Getter" Attitude:* You are a self-starter. When you don't know how to do something, your first instinct is to research, watch a tutorial, and try to solve it before asking.
* *Tool Exposure:* Familiarity with HubSpot (or a similar automation tool) and Salesforce is highly desired, but a proven ability to learn complex software quickly is a must.
* *Detail-Oriented:* You triple-check your links, your spelling, and your workflow logic before hitting "Publish."
* *Communication:* Excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can collaborate smoothly with design, our agency partners, and internal stakeholders.

*Why You'll Love This Role*

You won't be stuck doing just one thing. You’ll have full visibility into how operational efficiency directly impacts paid revenue, making you a highly visible and critical contributor to Jitterbit's growth.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Junior Business Development Manager
description:
*Bouw mee aan de groei van Nedcargo — en aan je eigen commerciële carrière*

Ben jij commercieel, nieuwsgierig en klaar om het vak van business development echt te leren? Krijg je energie van nieuwe contacten, het ontdekken van kansen en het bedenken van oplossingen voor klanten? Dan is dit jouw kans om je bij Nedcargo te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige Business Development Manager.

Je wordt onderdeel van ons commerciële team in Nederland en België. Je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s, gaat mee naar klanten en beurzen en leert hoe logistieke oplossingen, offertes, tenders en contracten tot stand komen. Vanaf het begin krijg je verantwoordelijkheid, maar je staat er nooit alleen voor.

Over Nedcargo
-------------

Nedcargo is een toonaangevende logistieke dienstverlener voor de food- en beveragesector. Vanuit onze vestigingen in Nederland en België helpen wij producenten, importeurs en bekende merken succesvol te zijn in hun markt.

Wij bieden geïntegreerde oplossingen op het gebied van warehousing, transport, forwarding, value-added services, douane, accijnzen en internationale supply chains. Voor sommige klanten verzorgen we de import naar Europa, voor andere de wereldwijde distributie.

Onze missie is helder: *We enjoy making our customers win.*

Dat doen we volgens onze vier kernwaarden: bevlogen betrokkenheid, investeren in de toekomst, continu verbeteren en recht door zee.

Nedcargo heeft grote ambities. In de komende vijf jaar willen we onze omzet verdubbelen en onze positie in de Benelux verder uitbouwen richting West-Europa. Daarom investeren we niet alleen in technologie en duurzame logistiek, maar vooral ook in nieuw commercieel talent.

Hoe ziet jouw werkdag eruit?
----------------------------

Als Junior Business Development Manager leer je stap voor stap hoe je nieuwe klanten wint en bestaande klantrelaties verder uitbouwt. Je combineert commercieel denken met inhoudelijke kennis van logistiek en supply chains.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

*

commerciële kansen ontdekken bij bestaande en potentiële klanten;

*

prospects onderzoeken en benaderen via deskresearch, social selling en netwerken;

*

klantbezoeken in binnen- en buitenland voorbereiden en bijwonen;

*

meewerken aan offertes, businesscases, tenders en klantvoorstellen;

*

jouw eigen salespipeline opbouwen en beheren;

*

deelnemen aan nationale en internationale food- en beveragebeurzen;

*

samenwerken met Operations, Customer Support en Supply Chain Engineering;

*

klanten helpen met slimme, schaalbare en duurzame logistieke oplossingen.

Naarmate je groeit, krijg je steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid en bouw je jouw eigen klantenportefeuille op. Ons doel is duidelijk: jou opleiden tot een zelfstandige Business Development Manager volgens de Nedcargo way of working.

Requirements
------------

Wat verwachten we van jou?
--------------------------

Wij zoeken niet per se iemand met een lang cv. We zoeken vooral iemand met commerciële energie, nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om snel te leren. Jij:

*

hebt mbo+- of hbo-werk- en denkniveau;
--------------------------------------

*

bent commercieel, ondernemend en resultaatgericht;

*

legt gemakkelijk contact en durft initiatief te nemen;

*

bent nieuwsgierig naar logistiek, food en beverage;

*

kunt goed luisteren en complexe vragen helder maken;

*

werkt graag samen, maar neemt ook zelf verantwoordelijkheid;

*

spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels;

*

herkent jezelf in de kernwaarden van Nedcargo.

Stage- of eerste werkervaring in sales, logistiek of supply chain is welkom, maar niet noodzakelijk. Mentaliteit, talent en ambitie vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk.

Wat bieden wij jou?
-------------------

Bij Nedcargo krijg je de ruimte om te leren, initiatief te nemen en daadwerkelijk invloed te hebben op onze groei.

Je kunt rekenen op:
-------------------

*

een marktconform salaris;
-------------------------

*

intensieve begeleiding door ervaren commerciële collega’s;

*

een duidelijk groeipad naar Business Development Manager;

*

opleidingen via de Nedcargo Academy;
------------------------------------

*

veel vrijheid, afwisseling en verantwoordelijkheid;

*

contact met bekende internationale klanten;

*

klantbezoeken en beurzen in binnen- en buitenland;

*

een goede pensioenregeling en vakantiegeld;

*

aandacht voor gezondheid en vitaliteit via Nedcargo Vitaal;

*

vooral: een ambitieus en betrokken team in Nederland en België.

Klaar om te groeien?
--------------------

Wil jij je commerciële carrière starten bij een organisatie die de ambitie heeft om dé toonaangevende duurzame supplychain-innovator voor food en beverage in Europa te worden? Reageer dan door op de knop solliciteren te drukken of stuur dan je sollicitatie naar . Onze procedure bestaat uit een telefonische kennismaking, een eerste gesprek en een verdiepend tweede gesprek. Een VOG-aanvraag maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

title: Junior Support Manager
description:
Про Reelly

Reelly — B2B tech-платформа №1 у GCC на ринку нерухомості Дубая. Ми зʼєднуємо агентів та агенції із забудовниками через наш ключовий продукт — BRM (Broker Relationship Management).
Ми — невелика, згуртована команда (до 20 людей), яка будує інфраструктуру для одного з найдинамічніших ринків нерухомості у світі. Цінуємо самостійність, швидкість і щире бажання рости разом із компанією. Спілкуємось відкрито, без зайвої бюрократії — але й без хаосу: у нас є чіткі процеси, і ми поважаємо час одне одного.

Про позицію

Відділ Support — перша лінія взаємодії з користувачами платформи: обробка звернень лідів, кваліфікація, і, що особливо важливо, верифікація агентів та агенцій — процес, який безпосередньо впливає на якість даних усієї платформи.
Ми шукаємо Junior Support Manager, який приєднається до команди Support і візьме на себе частину щоденного потоку заявок і верифікацій. Це дозволить команді якісно масштабувати обробку звернень без втрати швидкості чи уважності до деталей.

Це junior-позиція — попередній досвід у нерухомості не потрібен. Досвід на аналогічній чи суміжній позиції (підтримка клієнтів, CRM, обробка заявок) — перевага, але не обовʼязкова умова. Для нас важливіше, щоб ви хотіли вчитись і рости разом із командою на перспективу.

Чим доведеться займатись

Обробляти перші звернення лідів, проводити первинну кваліфікацію заявок
Швидко реагувати на чати — перша відповідь до 10 хвилин у робочі години
Видавати тестові ключі доступу новим користувачам
Вести процес верифікації користувачів: від заповненої анкети до перевірки даних у чаті та присвоєння статусу
Перевіряти ліцензії агентів у рамках процесу верифікації
Комунікувати з лідами й користувачами через CRM (Kommo), WhatsApp, Telegram
Підтримувати актуальність робочих таблиць та інших профільних реєстрів
Допомагати з підготовкою щоденної / тижневої звітності по верифікаціях, реєстраціях і лістингах
Опрацьовувати звернення, які не закрив автоматичний AI-бот підтримки — складніші чи нестандартні кейси

Що для нас важливо

Хард-скіли

Впевнена робота із CRM
Письмова англійська — рівень A2–B1 (щоденна переписка з міжнародними користувачами)
Адаптивність і швидкість — уміння підхоплювати нові інструменти та зміни в процесах без втрати темпу
Багатозадачність — паралельна робота з кількома заявками, чатами й таблицями одночасно

Любов до навчання та AI

Щирий інтерес до навчання й професійного розвитку — готовність опановувати нові підходи та інструменти
Впевнене користування AI-інструментами (ChatGPT / Claude) у щоденній роботі та бажання розвивати ці навички далі

Відповідальність

Розуміння важливості якісної верифікації — неточність тут напряму впливає на якість даних, якими користується вся команда
Прогнозованість, дотримання встановлених термінів обробки заявок

Уважність і акуратність

Здатність без помилок працювати з даними користувачів під час верифікації
Увага до невідповідностей — коли щось у наданих документах чи даних не сходиться

Комунікабельність

Коректна, дружня комунікація з лідами та користувачами на всіх етапах — від першого звернення до верифікації
Здатність ставити точні уточнюючі питання, якщо даних для верифікації бракує

Робота в умовах невизначеності

Готовність до змінних процесів (оновлення в адмінці, нові правила верифікації) — і спокійне ставлення до цього як до нормальної частини росту команди

Команда та графік

Формат роботи — онлайн (віддалено)
Найтісніша щоденна комунікація — з командою Support (Senior Support Manager і тім-лід відділу); у команді завжди підкажуть і допоможуть
Графік: 9:00–18:00 (літній час) / 8:00–17:00 (зимовий час)
Один вихідний день — робочий (субота або неділя), у чергуванні. Графік вихідних складається між двома спеціалістами підтримки; за відпрацьований вихідний надається компенсуючий вихідний іншого дня за домовленістю
Основне коло задач стабільне, але варто бути готовим і до додаткових — без стресу, це нормальна частина роботи в команді, що росте
Фінальний графік узгоджується додатково.

Оплата

Випробувальний термін (перший місяць): $500
З другого місяця роботи: $600

Це позиція з реальною перспективою зростання ваших навичок. Тут ви навчитесь працювати з реальними користувачами платформи в динамічному B2B-середовищі, освоїте AI-інструменти в щоденній роботі та станете частиною команди, яка напряму впливає на якість даних усього продукту Reelly.

Як проходить пошук нового члена команди
Через велику кількість відгуків ми, на жаль, не завжди маємо змогу відповісти особисто кожному кандидату. Але обіцяємо: якщо ваш профіль відповідає позиції — ми обовʼязково з вами звʼяжемось. Дякуємо за розуміння й за час, який ви приділили відгуку 🙏
Дзвінок з HR (до 30 хвилин) — знайомимось, розповідаємо детальніше про позицію та компанію
Тестове завдання (орієнтовно 4 години) — виконуєте у будь-який зручний робочий день; на звʼязку для допомоги буде тім-лід відділу
3 дні ознайомчого стажування — знайомство з ключовими процесами й перше занурення в роботу
Випробувальний термін — ближче знайомство з командою й процесами, повноцінне включення в роботу

title: Junior DevOps Engineer
description:

*Responsibilities:*

* Support the management and maintenance of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure.
* Assist in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of cloud services.
* Contribute to the design and maintenance of GitLab CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with Kubernetes, Argo CD, Argo Workflows, and Helm to support deployment automation and orchestration.
* Write and maintain automation scripts; familiarity with Python is a plus.
* Monitor system health using observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK).
* Collaborate with senior DevOps engineers to troubleshoot issues and implement best practices.
* Communicate effectively in English with team members across India and Portugal.

* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and GitLab pipelines.

title: Junior Security Analyst
description:
Terra Security provides agentic AI-powered continuous penetration testing aligned to code changes and evolving attack surfaces, combining a swarm of trained AI agents with human supervision for safety and control. Fortune 500 organizations trust Terra to ensure every attack surface is covered across the web, AI, internal apps, APIs, mobile, networks, and the cloud.

Terra is on track to become the next breakout cybersecurity company with $38 million raised to date, including a $30 million Series A led by Felicis Ventures with participation from Dell Technologies Capital, Silicon Valley CISO Investments (SVCI), SYN Ventures, LAMA Partners, Underscore VC, and Capital One Ventures.

*Summary*

As a Junior Attack Surface Analyst, you will analyze customer web applications and build accurate attack surface models that power Terra’s automated security testing platform. You will study authentication flows, APIs, navigation structure, and role-based access across diverse applications, combining automated discovery with hands-on security analysis to ensure complete surface coverage before assessments begin. This is an internal delivery role based in Poland, ideal for someone with solid web fundamentals who wants to grow into application security and penetration testing.

*What You’ll Do*

* Perform structured attack surface discovery - identifying endpoints, pages, API routes, and interactive functionality across authenticated and unauthenticated contexts.
* Analyze authentication flows, session handling, and role-based access to ensure testing covers the full permission model.
* Validate automated discovery output and apply reconnaissance methodology to achieve complete surface coverage.
* Document security context for each application: auth prerequisites, critical business workflows, API behavior, navigation structure, and scope constraints.
* Analyze API specifications (OpenAPI/Swagger) and traffic patterns to enrich endpoint models and parameter understanding.
* Confirm application testing readiness - verifying asset models, domain scope, and credentials before assessments are launched.
* Identify recurring architectural patterns (SPA behavior, custom auth, WAF interactions) and contribute insights that improve Terra’s discovery automation.

Requirements
------------

* 0–2 years of hands-on experience in web technologies, IT, or application security or equivalent self-driven learning through projects, bootcamps, or CTFs.
* Strong understanding of how web applications work: HTTP methods, status codes, cookies, sessions, headers, and REST API fundamentals.
* Solid knowledge of common authentication patterns form-based login, bearer tokens, session management, and role-based access.
* Practical expertise with browser developer tools and an interest in proxy-based security analysis (Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar).
* Exceptional attention to detail and methodical approach to analyzing complex application architectures.
* High-level English proficiency fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.

Advantage

* Familiarity with OpenAPI/Swagger specifications and API documentation.
* Awareness of OWASP Top 10 vulnerability classes and basic offensive security concepts.
* Experience with single-page applications (SPAs), GraphQL, or multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
* Security-related degree, bootcamp completion, CTF participation, or personal AppSec projects.
* Genuine motivation to build a career in penetration testing and offensive application security.

Please note that this position is for candidates based in Poland and is offered as an *Independent Contractor (B2B) engagement*.

title: Junior / Junior+ B2B Sales Manager
description:
DiGrow Solutions шукає Junior / Junior+ Sales Manager, який хоче розвиватися у міжнародних B2B-продажах та працювати з технологічним продуктом для захисту брендового трафіку.

Про продукт

Брендовий трафік — один із найцінніших ресурсів бізнесу.
Коли користувач шукає бренд у пошуковій системі, він уже має намір скористатися саме цим брендом. Але замість офіційного сайту він може побачити рекламу конкурентів або посередників — і в результаті бренд втрачає цінного клієнта.
Наш продукт допомагає компаніям захищати свій брендовий трафік та повертати контроль над пошуковою видачею. Ми мінімізуємо перехоплення користувачів небажаною рекламою та допомагаємо спрямовувати їх безпосередньо на сайт бренду.

Що буде у твоїй зоні відповідальності

Пошук та залучення нових B2B-клієнтів на міжнародних ринках.
Проведення первинної комунікації з потенційними клієнтами.
Робота з лідами та ведення клієнтів по sales funnel.
Презентація продукту та його цінності для бізнесу.
Проведення онлайн-зустрічей та переговорів.
Робота з CRM та підтримання актуальності даних.
Участь у розвитку sales-процесів разом із командою.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
----------------

Does the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you? We call it “Doing good while doing well” and invite you to apply to join us and begin moving forward along a beneficial career path – one built on providing solutions by helping others navigate through the complex world of health care benefits.

Here at BeneLynk, our mission is to improve lives and positively impact social determinants of health barriers by providing our healthcare partners with the information they need, and people with the advocacy they deserve. We are laser-focused on our longstanding area of expertise in the healthcare world. We fully understand barriers and surface solutions, then provide the advocacy that changes lives and improves outcomes. Everything we do, from the systems we build, to our government relations, to our outreach operations, is in service of this one central vision.

WHO WE ARE
----------

We are big-hearted people, passionate about serving our health plan clients, their members, and each other. We are a team in every sense of the word, striving toward a common mission – that is the goal of everyone at BeneLynk. Every day, we are relentless in helping people who need essential resources to make their lives easier and healthier. The members we serve call us "miracles," "kind," "professional," "human," and "compassionate," and all with "service that gets the job done." We pride ourselves on creating a healthy environment for our employees to thrive in their ability to assist others.

UI/UX PRODUCT DESIGNER
----------------------

POSITION SUMMARY
----------------

Benelynk is building the technology platform that powers Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to be the connective tissue between the people who use this platform and the engineers who build it.

BeneLynk’s Engagement Advocates engage Veteran’s enrolled in VA’s Veteran Directed Care (VDC) to help ensure that the Veteran has the tools and support needed to coordinate the care they need at home. These Advocates/Agents utilize an internal and proprietary platform (i.e., Veteran choose) to guide them through the process from onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission/approval, payroll and reporting. This platform is designed to support BeneLynk Enrollment Advocate; however, it also has a self-service module to enable the Veteran, Case Manager, and the Direct Care Worker to access the system directly to perform the functions they require and to access their unique actions and reports. This role owns the process of turning the “voice of the user” — veterans, family caregivers, Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates (case managers), and partner agencies (ADNAs) — along with input from subject matter experts, internal stakeholders, and engineering, into clear wireframes and interactive prototypes. These wireframes/prototypes will be rapidly created through the intersection of research (Outside In and Inside Out), useability expertise and the use current tools (e.g., AI, Claude, Figma). At BeneLynk, this role is a key to address usability issues and to proactively design an intuitive user experience within an Agile development process, collaborating with leadership to define and execute on its strategic vision. Because this platform serves veterans (many of whom are elderly or non-technical), family caregivers, professional Direct Care Workers, and internal operations staff, this role requires designing distinct, appropriately simple experiences for several very different audiences within a single connected system.

The candidate hired for this position will be both strategist and tactician. At BeneLynk we know that innovation does not come without rolling up our sleeves and getting the work done. The UI/UX Product Designer will be an integral piece in driving efficiency to executing existing product development processes/priorities and bringing new products to market.

Key Responsibilities
--------------------

* *Represent BeneLynk’s Customers* : This function is listed first, because we always want to be thinking of how best to serve our internal and external customers.

* *Oversee Product Development:* The UI/UX Product Designer will work with the Operations team, development team, sales team, and all other appropriate stakeholders to prioritize and deliver solutions on time.

* *Set Product Strategy:* In conjunction with the senior management team, the Product Owner and Veteran Choose team, the UI/UX Product Designer will inform and help to define the product strategy for the company.

* To accomplish this goal, the Designer will need to develop and maintain excellent working relationships with the Product Owner and the heads of relevant departments within BeneLynk and maintain a deep and current understanding of the work of such departments.

* The UI/UX Product Designer will be expected to challenge other members of the management team, to ask the difficult questions and execute with disciple that will lead to more rapid innovation.

* *Anticipate Opportunities:* The UX Product Designer will be responsible for developing and maintaining a cutting edge understanding intuitive design principles as well as all the industries that BeneLynk touches. The Designer will use this knowledge to bring new products to market.

This position is both tactical and strategic reflecting the small, but growing, size of BeneLynk as a company. All of us, including our senior management team are on the front-line doing what needs to be done to establish BeneLynk as the nation’s financial management services for Veterans.

Additional Duties/Responsibilities:
-----------------------------------

* Partner with subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to translate complex program rules — eligibility, service authorizations, budgets, timesheets, payroll, and compliance — into workflows that are simple and error-resistant for end users.
* Produce user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using a combination of standard design tools and AI-assisted design/prototyping tools, applying design judgment to refine AI-generated output into production-ready, on-brand designs.
* Facilitate design-alignment workshops and structured reviews with product, engineering, compliance, and operations stakeholders to drive the team to consensus on system design and resolve open questions quickly.
* Translate approved designs into detailed, developer-ready specifications, interaction notes, and edge-case documentation so engineering can build directly from your artifacts with minimal back-and-forth.
* Design and maintain a consistent design system and component library used consistently across all user-facing roles and modules of the platform.
* Plan and conduct user research (interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing) with veterans, family caregivers, Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates, and partner agency staff, and synthesize findings into clear personas, journey maps, and problem statements.
* Design for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA or higher) as a baseline requirement, given the platform's elderly, low-tech, and non-native-English-speaking user populations.
* Run usability testing on new and existing flows, and iterate designs based on user feedback, support/complaint themes, and product analytics.
* Maintain clear documentation of design decisions and rationale to support audit readiness and compliance traceability (e.g., HIPAA, VA program requirements).
* Stay embedded with engineering through implementation, reviewing built screens against design intent and resolving fidelity gaps.

Required Skills/Abilities/Experience:
-------------------------------------

* Bachelors/Associates degree and 2 - 5+ years in healthcare with 5+ years in UI/UX Product Design
* Experience in Agile business/software development lifecycle process and methodologies.
* Excellence in the integration of expertise and experience with the use current tools (e.g., AI, Claude, Figma) to rapidly build wireframes and prototypes
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* End user workflow experience.
* Excellent Interpersonal and relationship management skills
* Strong judgment and decision-making skills
* Strong leadership and problem-solving skills
* Adaptability, communication, empathy, problem-solving and teamwork. As a UI/UX designer, it’s important that you can collaborate effectively with those around you—from clients and stakeholders to developers and fellow designers, all the way through to the end user.

PreferredSkills/Abilities/Experience
------------------------------------

* Value based care providers and related entities

Physical Requirements:
----------------------

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
* Must have a stable internet connection.

WORK ENVIRONMENT
----------------

This role is a remote position.
-------------------------------

POSITION TYPE/ EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK
-------------------------------------

Full-time/Exempt – This is a salaried position

SALARY
------

Based on Experience; Up to $150k annually

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS
-----------------

We offer competitive salaries and benefits here at BeneLynk, as we truly value our employees and the amazing work that they do each day. Please see below for a list of some of our awesome employee benefits:

* Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistant Program Benefits
* 401K Match
* 15 Paid Days Annually
* Excellent Growth & Advancement Opportunities

EMPLOYEE PERKS
--------------

Work hard, play hard! Having an engaged workforce and positive work environment is one of our top priorities here at BeneLynk. We do so through numerous initiatives that can be found below. We like to call our virtual work community, “The Bene-Verse”. We also have an internal Culture Ambassador committee dedicated to ensuring all employees have a pleasant and exciting work experience.

* Monthly Company Town Hall Events:We love the opportunity to come together as a company. Join us monthly as we discuss exciting company updates, internal promotions, internal awards, upcoming events, and more!

* Monthly Internal Mental Health Newsletters:Our Culture Ambassadors spearhead an internal newsletter centered on mental health topics. Our employees’ overall wellbeing is our top priority, so we like to provide support whenever it is needed through this uplifting internal newsletter.

* Monthly Streaming Services Perk:Yes- we pay YOU to enjoy the television shows that you enjoy! We pay up to a $12 per month for any streaming service subscriptions that you currently have.

* Tickets at Work Perk:Enjoy discounted movie tickets, hotel stays, and more through our company’s ‘Tickets at Work’ perk!

* Monthly Lunch & Learn Events:Meet key members of our Senior Management team through engaging Lunch & Learn sessions on a monthly basis. Lunch is on us for those employees that sign up!

* Monthly Bene-Verse Events:We put on awesome monthly events for our employees including virtual trivia, team building exercises, guided painting sessions, and more!

EEO STATEMENT
-------------

At BeneLynk, we don’t just accept differences; we celebrate, support, and thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and the communities that we serve. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling this company’s unwavering commitment to equal employment opportunity. BeneLynk is an equal opportunity employer, and as such, employment here is solely based on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to their professional expertise.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any preemployment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR team.

E-VERIFY
--------

BeneLynk participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employer’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer (Ukraine Private Entrepreneur only)

The ideal candidate is hands-on, resourceful with constrained data, and proactive about recommending tools and processes — including AI-assisted tools such as Claude and Claude for Design — that speed up development, improve adoption, and strengthen UX research and feedback.

* Drive UX research proactively and independently, including in environments with limited resources (e.g., no in-product analytics for clicks or time-on-page); conduct user interviews and usability testing and synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights.

Minimum Qualifications (Required):

* 5-8+ years of hands-on UI/UX experience with a strong portfolio of shipped, real-world products.
* Advanced Figma proficiency, including building, scaling, and maintaining design systems from scratch.
* Proven end-to-end design experience with complex products: SaaS, enterprise/B2B platforms, and data-heavy dashboards.

* Solid understanding of HTML/CSS constraints and front-end engineering feasibility.

Preferred Qualifications (Optional):

* Experience with ServiceNow (SN), or designing UI/UX for applications built on top of platforms like SN.
* Experience producing product documentation — user guides and one-pagers to support research and adoption.

Competencies & Technical Skills:

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proactive, self-directed approach to research and process improvement, especially with limited data or resources.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple design initiatives at once.
* Ability to function well in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
* Proficiency with Figma and familiarity with Sketch or Adobe products.

Shift: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–8:00 PM Kyiv Time, with a 1-hour break.

title: Senior UI/UX Product Designer (AI and Browser Automations)
description:
About the Product & Team

Our client is an innovative tech startup building an AI-powered platform for autonomous browser and web workflow automation. The platform combines advanced LLMs with browser automation engines to execute complex, multi-step web tasks and integrate directly into enterprise business workflows for clients across the US and Europe.

You will step in as the lead design authority and take full ownership of our product UX/UI. Your mandate is to translate intricate engineering logic—autonomous AI agents, execution logs, dynamic DOM interactions, and data mapping pipelines—into clean, predictable, and scalable enterprise-grade user experiences.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Senior UI/UX Product Designer with exceptional English fluency and a forward-thinking approach to AI-native product design.

In this role, you will lead the product interface strategy from concept to execution. You will design data-dense dashboards, visual workflow builders, AI interaction patterns, and complex configuration surfaces. With high autonomy, you will partner directly with the founders, CTO, and engineering teams, articulate strategic design decisions, and engage international enterprise customers to refine the product experience.

Key Responsibilities
Lead End-to-End Product Design: Own the UX architecture and visual design across all platform modules—from discovery, journey mapping, and wireframes to production-ready Figma components and interactive prototypes.
Architect Complex Workflows & AI UI: Design intuitive, robust interfaces for highly technical features, such as workflow visualizers, agent execution logs, error-handling states, dynamic selectors, and integration setups.
Design System Architecture: Establish, scale, and govern a multi-product design system in Figma, utilizing modern tokens, reusable component libraries, and strict design-to-code alignment.
AI Tooling Integration: Actively leverage next-generation AI design and prototyping tools into your daily workflow to accelerate ideation, automate asset production, and validate design concepts rapidly.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with engineering and product leadership to define specifications, resolve edge cases, ensure technical feasibility, and oversee high-fidelity implementation.
Stakeholder & Customer Facing: Drive design reviews with leadership, present rationales confidently in English, and participate in customer discovery calls or usability tests with US/EU clients.

Requirements
7+ Years of Experience: Proven track record leading UI/UX product design for complex B2B SaaS platforms, developer tools, workflow automation engines, or data-intensive web applications.
English Mastery (C1/C2): Near-native or fully fluent verbal and written communication. Absolute comfort presenting to executive stakeholders, defending UX choices, and leading user discussions independently.
Advanced Figma & Design Systems: Expert command of Figma (auto-layout, component architecture, nested variants, design tokens, interactive prototyping, and variables).
AI-Native Workflow: Demonstrated active daily use of modern AI design and prototyping tools (e.g., Cursor, v0, Claude, Lovable, or AI-driven Figma plugins) to streamline workflows and rapidly build prototypes.
Systems Thinking & Edge-Case Rigor: Strong ability to deconstruct complex technical systems into coherent user flows, accounting for error recovery, async processing states, and platform scalability.
Autonomy & Strategic Mindset: Ability to drive product design independently with minimal direction, transforming ambiguous business goals into polished, validated user interfaces.

Nice to Have
Prior experience designing for AI agents, prompt-based interfaces, or low-code/no-code visual workflow builders.
Working understanding of front-end web technologies (HTML, CSS/Tailwind, React component models) to ensure seamless engineering handoffs.
Background in early-stage, fast-paced venture-backed startup environments.

We OFFER:
​A fast-paced, highly professional, international team environment with a flat structure and rapid decision-making.
​Competitive compensation packages commensurate with your background and product portfolio.
​Flexible, remote-first workflow optimized for seamless global alignment.
Medical Insurance in Ukraine and a Multisport program in Poland.
Offices in Ukraine (Kyiv, Kharkiv) and Poland (Wroclaw) or Remote.
Paid vacation, sick leave, and official holidays.
Legal & Accounting services.
The company provides all necessary equipment.
English classes and Education reimbursement.

This is a marketing design role focused on brand storytelling, product launches, growth, and performance creative—not product or UI/UX design. You are the hands-on designer and systems builder for Growth Creative: concepting, art directing, designing, learning, and iterating.

You’ll report to the Head of Growth Creative and work closely with Paid Media, Brand, and Site. You’ll move between Figma, creative reviews, and the performance dashboard, accountable for both the quality of the work and what it does in-market.

*What You’ll Own:*

* Design best-in-class acquisition creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging channels, owning the loop from customer insight and concept through production, performance read, and iteration.
* Build and maintain Brick’s modular ad design system in Figma, including components, templates, shared libraries, and repeatable product, offer, proof, and CTA modules.
* Turn strong campaign ideas into production-ready creative matrices and meaningful variants across formats, audiences, placements, and stages of awareness.
* Bring brand and performance together in every asset. Start with a clear hypothesis and apply direct-response hierarchy, message-to-market match, mobile-first legibility, platform-native behavior, and a clear conversion path.
* Partner with the Growth Content Producer and external creators to turn photography, video, UGC, customer stories, and product footage into cohesive ad campaigns across static, motion, and carousel concepts.
* Take a creative strategy brief and own production through delivery: clarify requirements, manage versions, maintain clean files and libraries, prepare channel-ready exports, and quality-check every asset.
* Partner with the Site team to translate ad-performance insights into CRO hypotheses, helping create a cohesive journey from first impression through conversion.
* Use AI and emerging creative tools to accelerate exploration and production without sacrificing originality, accuracy, taste, or Brick’s voice.

*Who You Are:*

* You have 3–5 years of experience in growth, marketing, brand, or performance design at a consumer brand, startup, or creative agency—or a body of work that proves equivalent ability.
* Your portfolio includes high-performing paid social and multi-channel campaigns, and you can explain the insight, hypothesis, design choices, result, and lesson behind the work. Direct-response and performance best practices are second nature.
* You have expert-level command of Figma (including components, Auto Layout, variables, and shared libraries), Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* You bring exceptional typography, layout, color, visual hierarchy, art direction, and storytelling across static, light-motion, and multi-frame formats.
* You understand that successful ad creative depends on meaningful variety and disciplined testing—and that Meta Andromeda has changed the way creative is developed, diversified, and optimized.
* You can clearly explain your decisions, give and receive direct feedback, and collaborate closely with strategists, media buyers, producers, and creators.
* You’re a high-output, low-ego owner who moves quickly, manages multiple workstreams, brings solutions before a brief is perfect, and cares deeply about Brick’s mission.
* Nice to Have:

* Experience with consumer hardware, wellness, mobile apps, subscriptions, or creator-led DTC brands.
* You have motion-design and editing skills in After Effects and Premiere Pro.
* You’re comfortable reading creative performance data—including spend, CTR, CPC, CPA, CVR, hook rate, and hold rate—and turn the “why” behind wins and losses into the next round of design, and recommending what to test next.

This is a full-time remote role (preference for New York City or Chicago based candidates) with a $90,000-$110,000 annual base salary depending on experience and qualifications.

*What we care about*
We’re building a team of people who take ownership, move with focus, and care deeply about the quality and impact of their work. We hold a high bar, prioritize what matters, and believe the best ideas come from thoughtful, driven individuals who are trusted to execute.

*Compensation & benefits*
We offer competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits for you and your family. We also prioritize flexibility, time to recharge, and a culture that supports both high performance and sustainable work.

If you’re excited about our mission and this role, we’d love to hear from you.

title: High Craft UI Designer (AR/VR)

*About the Opportunity*

*Join a team designing the next generation of immersive digital experiences for VR and wearable technology. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly creative and detail-oriented UI Designer to help shape intuitive, visually compelling interfaces that will be experienced by users on cutting-edge device platforms.*

*The ideal candidate is passionate about visual design, thrives in fast-paced environments, and can translate complex requirements into elegant, user-friendly experiences. While experience with VR, AR, or XR is a plus, exceptional visual craft and strong UI execution are the primary focus.*

*Responsibilities*

* Design high-fidelity, production-ready user interfaces for VR and wearable device experiences.
* Create end-to-end user flows, from information architecture and wireframing through final visual design.
* Translate product requirements into intuitive and visually engaging interface solutions.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional partners, including product, engineering, and design teams.
* Maintain visual consistency across experiences and contribute to scalable design systems.
* Iterate quickly based on feedback while balancing multiple projects and priorities.
* Adapt to evolving business needs and support a variety of product initiatives.
* Deliver polished designs that meet a high standard of usability, quality, and visual excellence.

*Required Qualifications*

* 4+ years of UI, visual, or product design experience.
* A portfolio showcasing exceptional visual design craft and execution.
* Expert knowledge of typography, color, layout, spacing, iconography, and grid systems.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma and modern design tools.
* Experience designing end-to-end user experiences and interface flows for digital products.
* Strong ability to manage multiple workstreams and changing priorities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* NYC-based candidates strongly preferred.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience designing for VR, AR, XR, wearable technology, or emerging device platforms.
* Background in device UI, operating systems, platform experiences, or hardware-adjacent products.
* Motion design experience or a strong understanding of motion principles.
* Experience working within or contributing to established design systems.
* Experience in large-scale consumer product environments.

*What Success Looks Like*

* Consistently delivers visually polished, production-ready design work.
* Quickly adapts to new product areas and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Balances creativity with practicality to create intuitive user experiences.
* Collaborates effectively across disciplines and incorporates feedback constructively.
* Maintains a high bar for quality, craftsmanship, and execution across all deliverables.
