title: Graphic Designer & Web Manager
description:
*Graphic Designer & Web Manager*

*Department: Marketing & Communications*

*Reports to: Executive Director of Marketing, Communications & Engagement*

*Location: Remote - US*

*Employment Type: Full-Time*

*Salary Range: $85,000-90,000/year*

*Position Overview*

Minerva University is seeking a versatile and highly skilled Graphic Designer & Web Manager to support the university’s visual brand across print, digital, and web channels.

At its core, this is a hands-on graphic design role responsible for creating high-quality materials for Marketing & Communications and departments across the university. The role will manage a wide range of internal creative requests, from brochures, flyers, presentations, and event collateral to digital graphics and institutional materials, while ensuring consistent application of Minerva’s visual identity and brand standards.

The position will also play a significant role in maintaining and improving the Minerva University website using Webflow and will provide video editing and digital creative support as needed.

The ideal candidate is an experienced designer who is equally comfortable developing a polished print piece, building or updating a webpage, editing a short video, and helping colleagues translate their ideas into effective, on-brand creative.

*Key Responsibilities*

*Graphic Design & Internal Creative Support — 45%*

* Design high-quality print and digital materials, including brochures, flyers, one-pagers, presentations, reports, event collateral, signage, advertisements, institutional materials, and other branded assets.
* Fulfill creative requests from departments across the university, translating stakeholder needs into effective visual solutions.
* Manage multiple design projects simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting established deadlines.
* Create and maintain reusable templates for presentations, documents, events, and other recurring university needs.
* Prepare production-ready files and coordinate with printers and other vendors when necessary.
* Provide graphics and other creative assets to support social media, enrollment marketing, institutional communications, events, and digital campaigns.
* Collaborate with Minerva’s Social Media Manager to create graphics and visual assets for social channels as needed.

*Website Design & Webflow Management — 30%*

* Maintain and update the Minerva University website using Webflow.
* Build and update webpages and page components within Minerva’s established design system.
* Make design and layout improvements that enhance usability, readability, and the overall user experience.
* Work with stakeholders across the university to ensure academic, admissions, programmatic, and institutional information remains accurate and current.
* Optimize images and other visual assets for web performance and accessibility.
* Support ongoing website quality assurance, including identifying and correcting visual inconsistencies, broken elements, and formatting issues.
* Assist with basic SEO implementation and website optimization.
* Help evolve the website as Minerva’s programs, content, and marketing needs change.

*Brand Management & Visual Standards — 15%*

* Serve as a day-to-day steward of Minerva’s visual identity and ensure consistent application of brand standards across university materials.
* Review creative materials and provide guidance to colleagues to ensure appropriate use of Minerva’s logos, typography, colors, imagery, and other visual elements.
* Maintain and organize brand assets, templates, and creative resources.
* Develop new templates, tools, and guidelines that enable teams across the university to create consistent, on-brand materials.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen and evolve Minerva’s visual identity while maintaining overall brand consistency.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external creative partners to ensure work meets Minerva’s brand and quality standards.

*Video & Multimedia — 10%*

* Edit short-form and promotional video content for digital campaigns, the website, social media, events, and other university needs.
* Transform existing footage, photography, graphics, and other assets into polished video content.
* Incorporate graphics, titles, captions, music, and other elements as appropriate.
* Resize and adapt video content for different platforms and formats.
* Provide multimedia support for enrollment, institutional, and storytelling initiatives as needed.

Requirements
------------

*Qualifications*

*Required*

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in graphic design, visual communication, digital design, or a related field.
* Professional graphic design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating print, digital, and brand work.
* Advanced proficiency in Canva and Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop.
* Strong understanding of typography, layout, visual hierarchy, composition, and brand systems.
* Experience designing for both print and digital environments.
* Experience maintaining websites using Webflow or a comparable CMS/web design platform.
* Experience with video editing using Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable software.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining brand consistency.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, particularly when working with non-designers and translating stakeholder needs into creative solutions.

*Preferred*

* Advanced experience with Webflow, including page building and responsive design.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS.
* Experience with UX/UI and responsive web design principles.
* Experience with motion graphics or animation.
* Experience developing and maintaining organizational brand guidelines and template systems.
* Familiarity with Canva and creating templates for use by non-designers.
* Understanding of SEO, website accessibility, and web optimization.
* Experience designing for enrollment, higher education, or other mission-driven organizations.

*What Success Looks Like*

The successful candidate will become a trusted creative resource across Minerva, producing high-quality work while helping ensure that the university presents a consistent and distinctive visual identity across every touchpoint.

They will be a designer first, but with the digital skills and versatility to manage substantial website work, provide video support, and help colleagues across the university turn their needs into polished, effective creative.

Success in this role means Minerva’s materials are consistently on brand, internal design requests are handled efficiently, the website remains visually strong and up to date, and the Marketing & Communications team has the creative capacity to support the university’s evolving needs.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
------------
*Who we are*
------------

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

----------
*The role*
----------

The work is unlike anything you've done before.

Defence. Autonomous aircraft. Sovereign AI. Ethics. These are not the usual inputs for a graphic designer. But they are yours now, and the question of how you communicate them, visually, with precision and intelligence, is one of the most interesting design problems in Europe right now.

This is a high-output role. You will be the engine of a fast-moving creative team, executing across the full range of Helsing's visual output.

----------------
*The day-to-day*
----------------

* Design web pages, social content, and digital assets

* Create exhibition stands, event environments, and branded experiences

* Develop identities for new and existing products or partnerships

* Design product brochures, technical publications, and campaign materials that make complex ideas feel inevitable

* Build presentations shown to the highest levels of government and industry

* Work across clothing, merchandise, and brand objects

* Own projects from brief to production, managing timelines, vendors, and your own judgment

-------------------------
*You should apply if you*
-------------------------

* Have a portfolio demonstrating high-quality work across diverse formats and disciplines. P *lease include a PDF or link, with any relevant websites or videos*

* Your portfolio shows range: you have worked across formats, found solutions that feel inevitable in retrospect, and done the legwork to make things excellent

* You are comfortable with feedback, fast iteration, and working in an environment with multiple stakeholders

* You can manage several projects simultaneously without losing quality on any of them

* You take pride in the craft

* Have a rigorous understanding of typography, colour theory, layout, and composition

* Can translate complex, abstract, and technical subject matter into clear and compelling visuals

* Are experienced building presentations and visualising proposals

* Are organised, self-directed, and able to anticipate what a project needs before you're asked

* Are intellectually curious, prepared to learn a lot about autonomous systems, military doctrine, and AI

* Are proficient in Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

* Are comfortable being wrong, getting notes, and making the work better for it

Note: We work in a field where women and other minority groups are systematically under-represented. We actively encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every listed qualification. Potential and craft cannot be reduced to a checklist.

Send us your portfolio. Show us how you think.

--------------
*Nice to Have*
--------------

*

Another creative skill such as copywriting, photography or videography

*

Knowledge of After Effects or Premiere

*

A second language, ideally French or German

------------------------------------------------------------------
*Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields*
------------------------------------------------------------------

*

Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

*

The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

*

Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

*

In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

*

We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

---------------
*What we offer*
---------------

*

*Competitive salary* and *VSOP options*

*

*Relocation support* : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

*

*Learning* : €500/£450 yearly allowance

*

*Health & wellness* : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

*

*Social* : regularly company events and monthly social allowances

*

*Enhanced parental leave* : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.

*

*Family support:* 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

*#LI-DNI*

Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

title: Graphic Designer - Health Data Dissemination (Job 1367)
description:
*About Us*

DLH delivers improved health and national security readiness solutions for federal programs through science research and development, systems engineering and integration, and digital transformation. Our experts in public health, performance evaluation, and health operations solve the complex problems faced by civilian and military customers alike by leveraging advanced tools – including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud enablement, modeling, and simulation, and more. DLH is dedicated to the idea that “Your Mission is Our Passion” and brings a unique combination of government sector experience, proven methodology, and unwavering commitment to innovation to improve the lives of millions.

*Overview*

DLH Corp, is looking for a Public Health ** *Graphic Designer* , ** to join our talented and innovative team supporting the *Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)* in Atlanta, GA.

CDC’s National Center for HIV/AIDS, Viral Hepatitis, STD, and TB Prevention (NCHHSTP), the Division of HIV Prevention (DHP) is charged with preventing HIV infection and reducing the incidence of HIV-related illness and death. The overarching objectives of the contract held by DLH are to assist DHP in addressing its public health mission by providing data management, data governance, data analysis, and data dissemination support to strengthen the nationwide capacity to monitor the HIV epidemic.

*This position is 100% remote*. However, employees may be required to attend occasional in-person meetings, trainings, or team events on an as-needed basis. To support onboarding and compliance requirements, candidates must reside within a reasonable commuting distance of Atlanta, GA; Chicago, IL; or Washington, DC. Access to one of these secure office locations is required for smart card issuance, background investigation processing, and other periodic administrative or security-related activities.

*Responsibilities*

* Write, edit, create images for, design, develop, and enhance dissemination products including Web content, social media materials, fact sheets, and other documents.
* Use information from various data/information sources to prepare information content and documents.
* Ensure dissemination products are accurate, clearly written, and accessible on the web using established usability and Section 508 guidelines.
* Support efforts on multiple health promotion campaigns.

*Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related discipline
* 2 years of experience working with digital tools such as Adobe Creative Suite.
* Ability to develop and design visual assets for print, web, and social media marketing.
* Skilled at developing concept art for stakeholder feedback.
* *Must be able to obtain a NAC clearance*

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience with HIV prevention promotion
* Prior experience with CDC, HHS, or other federal or state health agency.
* Master’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or related discipline.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Strong time-management skills and ability to juggle multiple projects to meet tight deadlines.

*Basic Compensation: $50,000 - $80,000 yearly salary*

The salary range listed reflects what we reasonably expect to pay for this role at the time of posting. The final offer may vary based on skills, experience, geographic location, market conditions, and internal equity. Additional compensation may include performance incentives and program-specific awards. We do not use salary history to determine compensation, in line with applicable law.

description:

*Who We Are:* At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

*Who The Client Is* : The client is a Canberra-based strategic brand and digital studio working with business owners and organizations who want to be clearly positioned for sustainable growth. Based in Canberra, they help clarify direction, shape strong foundations and support visibility through thoughtful strategy and execution.

They are helping shape environments - brands, teams, systems and experiences.

Across our clients we consistently focus on:

* The full end-to-end brand experience
* How people feel before, during and after engaging with your business or practice
* Consistency, clarity and care rather than hype or scale-for-scale’s-sake

*Role Overview:* This is a hands-on design and production role for a strong mid-to-senior designer who can take strategic and creative direction and turn it into polished, practical design across brand identity, digital, print and web.

Working closely with the Studio Director, you’ll translate brand strategy and creative direction into considered visual identities and carry those identities through to high-quality execution across multiple formats.

You will not be expected to develop brand strategy independently, but you will be expected to interpret a brief intelligently, make sound design decisions, identify inconsistencies or production issues, and deliver work without needing every detail art-directed.

The right person will be equally comfortable developing a visual identity in Adobe Illustrator, preparing packaging or collateral correctly for commercial print, building client-ready templates in Canva, adapting assets for social and digital use, and working within practical website constraints.

This is a role for someone who can take ownership of design production and significantly reduce the amount of day-to-day design management required from the Studio Director.

*Key Responsibilities:*

Brand Identity & Visual Systems

* Develop and refine visual identities based on established brand strategy and creative direction
* Create and maintain logo suites, brand marks, colour palettes, typography systems and supporting graphic elements
* Develop clear, practical brand guidelines and identity documentation
* Translate an initial creative concept into a cohesive visual system that works across multiple touchpoints
* Maintain consistency across established client brands
* Work confidently within existing brand guidelines as well as contribute to the development of new visual identities

Print Design & Production

* Design and prepare professional artwork for commercial print
* Create packaging, product labels, signage, brochures, flyers, advertising, stationery and other printed collateral
* Work confidently with printer specifications and supplied dielines
* Set up artwork correctly using CMYK, Pantone and other appropriate print colour specifications
* Prepare bleed, trim, crop marks and print-ready files correctly
* Check image resolution, fonts, links and other production requirements before artwork is supplied Preflight files and supply press-ready PDFs
* Liaise with supplied printer specifications and identify potential production issues before artwork reaches the client or supplier
* Strong commercial print-production knowledge is essential for this role.

Digital & Cross-Format Rollout

* Apply brand identities consistently across social media, email marketing, advertising and other digital assets
* Adapt creative concepts appropriately for different channels and formats rather than simply resizing artwork
* Create campaign graphics, promotional material and ongoing marketing assets for a range of client brands
* Maintain visual consistency while working across multiple clients, industries and brand styles

Canva & Client Template Set-Up

* Translate professionally developed brand systems into practical Canva Brand Kits
* Create easy-to-use Canva templates for client teams
* Set up social media, presentation, promotional and other client-ready templates
* Ensure templates are well structured, visually consistent and simple for non-designers to use
* Maintain professional design standards when translating Adobe-created brand assets into Canva

* This role requires someone who is highly capable in Canva, but Canva should complement strong professional design skills rather than replace them.

Web Design & Implementation

* Design and adapt visual assets directly for use within websites
* Work comfortably within platforms such as Shopify and Squarespace
* Create and implement page graphics, banners, imagery and other visual content
* Understand responsive design and how layouts need to adapt across desktop and mobile
* Work within practical website and platform constraints rather than designing only static concepts
* Maintain brand consistency across live website environments

* Advanced coding expertise is not required, but you must understand how design translates into a functioning website.

Video & Social Content

* Support social content with basic video editing where required
* Edit short-form video and Reels using supplied footage
* Create simple motion graphics or animated brand assets where appropriate

* Video capability is highly regarded

*Requirements*

*Required Skills & Qualifications*

* Strong portfolio demonstrating professional brand identity and graphic design experience
* Excellent Adobe Creative Suite skills, particularly:

* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop

* Strong commercial print-production experience
* Experience preparing packaging, labels, signage or other technically produced print artwork
* Strong Canva skills, including Brand Kits and client template creation
* Demonstrated experience rolling brand identities out across digital, print and web
* Strong typography, layout, hierarchy and visual composition skills
* Ability to interpret a strategic or creative brief and develop design solutions independently
* Practical understanding of web design and implementation
* Comfortable working within Shopify, Squarespace or similar website platforms
* Excellent attention to detail
* Strong file management and version-control habits
* Confident working across multiple client brands and visual styles
* Comfortable managing competing priorities and deadlines
* Strong written communication and ability to collaborate remotely
* Agency, studio or multi-client brand experience strongly preferred

*Highly Regarded*

* Social video editing and Reels experience
* Simple animation or motion graphics
* Experience with packaging and label production
* Experience liaising with commercial printers or production suppliers
* Experience with retail, hospitality, beauty, lifestyle, professional services or consumer brands
* Experience working with Australian clients or businesses
* Familiarity with email marketing platforms and digital campaign production

*Portfolio Requirements*

Applicants should provide a portfolio that demonstrates:

* Brand identity development
* Logo systems and broader visual identities, not only standalone logos
* Brand rollout across multiple touchpoints
* Professionally produced print work

* Website or web implementation work

This is a remote role that will be set up as an independent contractor engagement.

title: Ad Designer
description:
is the leading AI teammate for meetings, trusted by more than 20 million users across over 500,000 organizations, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises. Fireflies captures knowledge, automates repetitive work, and helps teams become more productive before, during, and after every meeting.

Fireflies has achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion. In 2024, Ramp recognized Fireflies as the sixth most popular AI platform by number of paying customers, alongside companies including OpenAI, Midjourney, and Anthropic. There is a good chance you have already seen Fireflies quietly powering one of your recent meetings.

We're hiring an *Ad Designer* to become the dedicated creative engine behind our Meta, Instagram, and social ad output. Today, ad turnaround runs through founders and the design lead directly — every cricket-sponsorship creative, every carousel, every quick test. We want that to change: *someone who can own the full loop from "here's an insight" to "here are 10 variations live and being tested," in hours, not days.*

This isn't a "make it look nice" role. It's for someone who thinks like a marketer first — who can sit inside Meta Ads Manager, form a real opinion about why an ad is or isn't working, and turn that opinion into the next creative before being asked.

---------------
What you'll do:
---------------

* Design high-performing ad creative for Meta, Instagram, and other paid social channels — statics, carousels, and short-form video assets
* Take one working ad and rapidly produce *10+ variations* (copy, colour, format, hook) to keep testing and scaling what performs
* Handle basic video clipping - repurposing raw founder/event/product footage into short-form social and ad-ready clips
* Live inside *Meta Ads Manager* : track performance, study competitors and industry trends, and use that data to decide what to design next
* Turn around carousels and quick-test creative in *hours, not days* - speed is part of the job, not a nice-to-have
* Partner directly with founders and the marketing/design team on messaging, testing hypotheses, and creative direction
* Own visual execution end-to-end, concept to shipped ad , without needing a designer to be looped in on every asset
* Build a reusable system of ad templates and winning formats so output scales without reinventing each brief

----------------------
Who we're looking for:
----------------------

* *You think like a marketer who designs, not a designer who makes ads look nice.* You have a real opinion on what copy will land, what colours will work, what visual stops the scroll, and what makes a value prop instantly understandable.
* A portfolio or reel that shows *live, shipped ad creative* - ideally with a sense of what performed and why, not just concept work
* Strong graphic design fundamentals: layout, colour, typography, and an instinct for what gets attention on Meta/IG
* Comfort with basic video editing/clipping for short-form social and ad placements
* A bias for speed and iteration - you'd rather ship 10 variants of something that's already working today than polish one thing for a week
* Real experience close to performance advertising - you've run ad accounts yourself, or worked tightly enough with founders/marketers to understand what the data is telling you
* Ability to work quickly, communicate clearly over Slack, and overlap with *US Pacific or European working hours*

*Strong plus:* You've personally run or scaled an ad account, an Instagram page, or a creator/brand page from scratch — we'd rather see that than an agency résumé. We're also widening our aperture beyond typical SaaS design: backgrounds in luxury, fashion, entertainment, sports, hospitality, or agency work are all welcome. Portfolio beats pedigree.

------------
How to apply
------------

Send us:

* Your *portfolio or reel* of ad creative
* *One ad you designed that performed well* - and your read on why it worked
* Your typical turnaround time for a quick-turn carousel or ad variation set

-------------------
What matters to us:
-------------------

* You're a strong communicator and contribute positively to the team
* You take ownership and have an internal compass
* You value candid feedback and overcommunication
* You care about quality and design, while keeping things simple
* You measure your impact and look for ways to improve and automate
* You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment and getting a little better every week
* You're customer-focused and care about the end result, not just the output
* You value fast, incremental ways of working

-----------------
Perks & benefits:
-----------------

* Competitive compensation
* Work remotely from anywhere in your respective country
* Flexible working hours
* Paid time off and flexible leave policy
* Ability to move laterally within the team and grow quickly
* No-boss culture
* LGBTQ+ friendly workplace
* Company offsites
* Tech reimbursements

-------
About :
-------

At , we're changing how teams use AI in their daily work. Our culture is built around security, innovation, customer experience, and growth. Backed by $19M from investors including Canaan and Khosla Ventures, along with angels from Slack, Facebook, Dropbox, Amazon, and Salesforce, Fireflies is a global team of 100+ people across 20+ countries and every time zone. We're building a global-first company and use our own product every day to help us work better.

* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail

* Front-end fluency and understanding of how React components integrate with AI APIs, including streaming UI states
* Experience in B2B enterprise environments, particularly GovCon or regulated industries

title: Platform Engineering Intern
description:
*3-Month Unpaid Internship → 1-Year Full-Time Trainee Program → Software Engineer / Product Role*

Conversion is performance-based and is not guaranteed. Candidates will be evaluated on learning ability, technical/product capability, ownership, problem-solving, communication, collaboration and potential.

*Internship Note:*

This is a structured three-month internship and learning opportunity. The program is designed to provide practical exposure to Vector, real-world customer problems, mentorship, and hands-on product development. Any subsequent employment opportunity will be subject to performance, business requirements, and applicable company policies.

*About Us:*

ProArch is a global software development and consultancy firm specializing in cloud, data, AI, and digital transformation solutions. We are building Vector, an AI-native enterprise platform designed to help organizations understand, optimize, and automate their cloud operations.

Vector uses a Six Intelligence Model - Reactive, Proactive, Predictive, Prescriptive, Reflective, and Adaptive - to progressively move from answering questions to predicting outcomes, recommending actions, learning from results, and eventually enabling autonomous operations.

*Requirements*

Platform Engineering Interns help build Vector across three connected engineering tracks: Frontend & Experience, API & Data, and AI & Intelligence. You will join one common engineering team, contribute across the platform, and develop deeper expertise based on your strengths, interests, and the needs of the product.

You will not be hired into a narrow technology silo. A candidate may begin with strength in one area and grow into another through real product work, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.

*Engineering Tracks and Technologies:*

Interns may contribute across all three areas and will develop deeper expertise in one or more tracks based on demonstrated strengths and interests.

*1. Experience Engineering*

• React / TypeScript

• UI components

• Microsoft Teams experiences

• Dashboards and visualizations

• Ask Vector

• Real-time experiences

*2. Platform, API & Data Engineering*

• Python / C# / Java

• REST APIs

• SQL

• Data pipelines

• Integrations

• Microsoft Graph

• Azure

• Enterprise data

*3. AI & Intelligence Engineering*

• Python

• LLMs

• RAG

• Embeddings

• AI workflows

• Agents / tool calling

• AI evaluation

• Vector's Six Intelligence Model

*Key Responsibilities*

• Build working product capabilities across Vector's experience, platform, data, and intelligence layers.

• Translate real enterprise use cases into clear user experiences, reliable services, usable data, and evaluated AI capabilities.

• Create test cases, evaluate results, analyze failures and edge cases, and improve the quality, reliability, and performance of your work.

• Engineering practices: use Git, write documentation and tests, debug issues, participate in code reviews, and build maintainable software with the wider product and engineering team.

*Qualifications:*

• Knowledge of at least one programming language, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Java, or a similar language.

• Basic understanding of programming fundamentals, problem-solving, and software development.

• Familiarity with at least one relevant area: frontend development, REST APIs, SQL/data, or AI/ML concepts.

• Basic familiarity with Git and the willingness to write, test, debug, and improve code.

• Interest in AI-native products, cloud platforms, enterprise software, and modern application development.

• Strong analytical ability, curiosity, ownership, communication, and willingness to experiment and learn.

• Nice to have: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Azure, Microsoft Graph, Cosmos DB, Microsoft Fabric, Spark, OpenAI APIs, LangChain/LangGraph or similar frameworks, vector databases, charting libraries, or Microsoft Teams development.

You do not need to know all of these technologies. We are looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, problem-solving ability, and the hunger to learn.

*What We're Looking For:*

We value curiosity, ownership, learning ability, problem-solving, and the hunger to contribute more than prior experience. Candidates should be comfortable learning quickly, asking questions, experimenting, collaborating across engineering areas, and taking responsibility for their work.

*Why Join Vector?*

• Work on a real AI-native enterprise product, not a training project.

• Work with experienced product, architecture, and engineering leaders.

• Solve real customer problems using real product experiences, data, integrations, and AI capabilities.

• Gain exposure to Agentic AI, cloud, data, Microsoft technologies, and modern platform engineering.

• Contribute to a product being built for global customers; your work may become part of the production platform.

• Opportunity to be considered for a full-time Trainee role based on performance.

title: Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI)
description:
*This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Partner Sales Director - Global System Integrator (GSI) based in Switzerland.*

This is a senior, globally focused partner sales role responsible for accelerating growth through strategic Global System Integrator relationships. You will shape and execute partner strategies that expand adoption of open-source, Linux, cloud, and enterprise technologies. The role combines executive relationship management with hands-on ownership of sell-to, sell-through, and sell-with motions. You will work across engineering, sales, marketing, and product teams to identify opportunities and turn customer needs into scalable solutions. Success will depend on your ability to influence stakeholders from technical teams through C-suite executives. The environment is highly distributed, autonomous, fast-moving, and designed for people who thrive with significant ownership. International travel will be an important part of building relationships and driving joint business outcomes.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Build and maintain strategic relationships with Global System Integrator partners, creating long-term engagement and strong alignment around technology and business opportunities.
* Develop and execute partner strategies covering sell-to, sell-through, and sell-with motions, with a focus on increasing market share, adoption, and partner-driven revenue.
* Lead business interactions across partner organizations, from engineers and sales teams through senior executives and C-suite stakeholders.
* Develop a deep understanding of partner organizations, sales structures, capabilities, and go-to-market models to identify areas for joint growth.
* Negotiate contracts, commercial agreements, and business terms while ensuring mutually valuable and sustainable partnerships.
* Collaborate closely with marketing, sales engineering, product management, and other internal teams to deliver partner and business objectives.
* Capture customer and partner requirements, identify gaps in existing offerings, and create new opportunities for technology adoption and digital transformation.
* Lead executive interlocks, customer workshops, sales events, public presentations, and other strategic engagements that strengthen partner relationships and generate pipeline.
* Act as a voice of the partner internally, bringing market intelligence, customer needs, and partner feedback into business and product decisions.
* Travel internationally as needed, potentially up to 40% of the time, to support partner engagements, customer opportunities, and strategic business initiatives.

------------
Requirements
------------

* Extensive experience in alliance management, channel sales, indirect sales, or a comparable partner-focused commercial leadership role.
* Proven experience working with Global System Integrators and understanding their organizational structures, sales motions, and business models.
* Strong knowledge of Linux, open-source technologies, and the broader cloud software ecosystem, including experience with OpenStack, virtualization, containers, or related technologies.
* Demonstrated ability to develop strategic partnerships, influence senior stakeholders, and manage complex sales cycles involving multiple organizations and decision-makers.
* Strong commercial skills, including experience negotiating contracts, commercial terms, and partnership agreements.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into actionable opportunities, assess capability gaps, and develop solutions that create measurable business value.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with confidence engaging audiences ranging from technical experts to C-suite executives.
* Highly autonomous and disciplined, with a hands-on, results-oriented approach and the ability to move initiatives forward without extensive supervision.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with ambitious growth and performance objectives.
* Genuine enthusiasm for open-source technology, Linux, cloud platforms, and the broader mission of accelerating digital transformation.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally and participate in regular in-person team events, typically 2–4 times per year.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Performance-driven annual bonus or commission in addition to base compensation.
* Compensation reviewed annually, with adjustments reflecting geography, experience, and performance.
* Fully distributed, remote-first working environment.
* Twice-yearly in-person team sprints in locations around the world.
* Annual personal learning and development budget of *USD $2,000*.
* Recognition and performance rewards.
* Annual holiday leave.
* Maternity and paternity leave.
* Team Member Assistance Program and wellness platform.
* Opportunities to travel internationally and collaborate with colleagues across a global organization.
* Priority Pass access and travel upgrades for eligible long-haul company events.
* Global career exposure within a highly distributed technology environment.

*How Jobgether works:*
We use an *AI-powered matching process* to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
Why Apply Through Jobgether?

*Data Privacy Notice:* By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

title: Senior Account Manager - Enterprise Sales
description:
*Who are we and what do we do?*

BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.

With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.

Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.

*Location:* This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.

*Role in a Nutshell*

The Enterprise Account Manager (AM) role is focused on owning, retaining, and expanding a defined book of strategic executive through structured farming, deep customer engagement, and long-term value creation. This role emphasizes account growth with success driven by multi-product expansion, renewal strength, and durable executive relationships.

You will work with complex, global accounts within engineering-led organizations, partnering closely with internal teams to unlock expansion opportunities across usage, teams, and product lines. This role reports to the Sales Manager.

*Desired Experience* **

We are looking for a seasoned Account Manager with a strong track record of expansion-led revenue ownership in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environments.

*

8- 10 years of B2B SaaS experience, with 3-4 years of experience in a farming / Account Management focused role

*

Demonstrated success achieving and exceeding expansion, renewal, and net revenue retention targets

*

Recent experience explicitly aligned to Account Management, Farming, Expansion, Upsell / Cross-sell

*

Willingness to work region-aligned time zones, based on customer coverage

*

Passionate about tech and SaaS; extreme customer centricity and empathy; strong desire to work in a fast-paced, self-directed start-up environment

*

Solid understanding of Software SaaS/ SaaS adjacent business models and a high degree of comfort and skill in selling to and engaging with technical audiences and executive-level stakeholders.

*

Global Market Experience (Preferred): Previous exposure or success in international sales and account management will be considered a significant plus.

*

Bachelor’s degree required; Engineering / Technology background preferred

*What Will You Do?*

*Account Ownership, Expansion & Lifecycle Expertise*

*

Own a portfolio of Enterprsie customers with accountability for long-term revenue growth and retention.

*

Strong understanding of upsell, cross-sell, and renewal mechanics across multi-product SaaS portfolios

*

Proven ability to identify expansion levers using usage data, customer maturity, org structure, and business goals

*Executive & Technical Engagement*

*

Ability to engage confidently with engineering leaders, technical stakeholders, and economic buyers

*

Strong grasp of SaaS business models and comfort selling into technical organizations

*Own & Grow Strategic Accounts and Build Customer Partnerships*

*

Engage customers through regular in-person meetings, including onsite visits, to strengthen relationships and accelerate account growth

*

Own a defined book of strategic accounts with full responsibility for retention, expansion, and net revenue growth

*

Develop trusted relationships with technical user, and executive stakeholders

*Drive Renewal & Retention Excellence*

*

Ensure predictable renewals by reinforcing value, outcomes, and ROI ahead of contract milestones.

*

Identify and mitigate renewal or contraction risks in partnership with Internal teams.

*Operate Cross-Functionally with Rigor*

*

Act as the central point of ownership across internal teams

*

Maintain strong Salesforce hygiene to support forecasting and decision-making

*Benefits:*

In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves
* Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Sales Development Program Consultant - Michigan/NE Ohio
description:
----------------------------------------------------------
*Creating Peace of Mind by Pioneering Safety and Security*
----------------------------------------------------------

At Allegion, we help keep the people you know and love safe and secure where they live, work and visit. With more than 40 brands, 14,000+ employees globally and products sold in 130 countries, we specialize in security around the doorway and beyond.

Additionally, Allegion is proud to be recognized with the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award (GEWA) for the third consecutive year, earning distinction in both the employee engagement and strengths categories. This year, Allegion also received Gallup’s With Distinction honor — a designation reserved for a select group of organizations that go above and beyond in building exceptional workplace cultures.

Remote Location Ohio

*Sales Development Program Consultant - Michigan/NE Ohio*

The Sales Development Program is a 12-month rotational training and development program designed to enable an individual with no prior selling or security hardware knowledge to succeed in the evolving world of door hardware and security products. The program will guide you in learning through a varied mix of classroom, field, office, and factory settings to gain knowledge of consultative selling as well as the Allegion products and solutions that will enable you to add value within different sales channels at Allegion. The program will begin June 2027 and following the final rotation of the program, you will transition into a full-time sales role within the organization.

Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. The company does not intend to provide sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, TN, etc.) for this employment position.

*What You Will Do:*

* Fully engage in SDP training program to increase knowledge about industry and Allegion customers, products and processes.
* Participate in a 3-month product and industry training module on location at our Training Facility in Denver, CO. During this time, you’ll learn from industry experts side by side with other development program employees. Allegion provides corporate housing and temporary transportation for program employees.
* Participate in a 2-month rotation with corporate sponsors from some of our non-regional sales teams at Allegion, including completion of individually assigned projects and presentation on results.
* Participate in a 7 month field training rotation where you’ll get exposure to each of Allegion’s field selling teams. During this on-the-job learning experience you will:

* Coordinate and conduct joint sales calls throughout assigned sales territory with all members of the regional sales office (RSO).
* Participate in various local security tradeshows representing Allegion’s portfolio of products and demonstrating our solutions.
* Obtain an understanding of the customers within your trade area and build relationships with decision makers as appropriate.

* Attend all required factory training and additional outside product training to obtain a further understanding of the products.
* Learn Allegion organizational structure and develop relationships with co-workers throughout the matrixed organization.
* Learn how to utilize Allegion tools/resources (i.e. Dynamics CRM, Overtur, PowerBI data analytics) to gather and maintain information on projects.
* Maintain awareness of all Allegion policies, guidelines, and procedures and ensure compliance.

*What You Need to Succeed:*

* Bachelor’s degree in Sales, Business, or Marketing preferred
* Strong mechanical and electronics aptitude
* Detail oriented with a high level of organization and time management skills
* Proficient w/ MS Office tools
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, influencing skills essential along with a bias for action
* Ability to travel up to 20%

*Why Work for Us?*

*Allegion is a Great Place to Grow your Career if:*

*

You're seeking a rewarding opportunity that allows you to truly help others. With thousands of employees and customers around the world, there’s plenty of room to make an impact. As our values state, “this is your business, run with it ”.

*

You’re looking for a company that will invest in your professional development. As we grow, we want you to grow with us.

*

You want a culture that promotes work-life balance. Our employees enjoy generous paid time off, because at Allegion we recognize that you have a full life outside of work! **

*

You want to work for an award-winning company that invests in its people. Allegion is proud to be a recipient of the *Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award* for the second year in a row, recognizing our commitment to employee engagement, strengths -based development, and unlocking human potential.

*What You’ll Get from Us:*

*

Health, dental and vision insurance coverage, helping you “be safe, be healthy”

*

Unlimited Paid Time Off

*

A commitment to your future with a 401K plan, which currently offers a 6% company match and no vesting period

*

Health Savings Accounts – Tax-advantaged savings account used for healthcare expenses

*

Flexible Spending Accounts – Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare and/or dependent daycare expenses

*

Disability Insurance –Short-Term and Long-Term coverage, paid for by Allegion, provides income replacement for illness or injury

*

Life Insurance – Term life coverage with the option to purchase supplemental coverage

*

Tuition Reimbursement

*

Voluntary Wellness Program – Simply complete wellness activities and earn monetary rewards

*

Employee Discounts through Perks at Work

*

Community involvement and opportunities to give back so you can “serve others, not yourself”

*

Opportunities to leverage your unique strengths through CliftonStrengths assessment & coaching

*Compensation:* This range is provided by Allegion. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience.

*

The expected Base Salary Range : $60,000 - $75,000. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

*Apply Today!*

Join our team of experts today and help us make tomorrow’s world a safer place!

Not sure if your experience perfectly aligns with the role? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification and every single preferred qualification of a job posting. At Allegion, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. So, if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every item in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. --------------------------

Allegion is committed to building and maintaining a diverse and inclusive workplace. Together, we embrace all differences and similarities among colleagues, as well as the differences and similarities within the relationships that we foster with customers, suppliers and the communities where we live and work. Whatever your background, experience, race, color, national origin, religion, age, gender, gender identity, disability status, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law, we will make sure that you have every opportunity to impress us in your application and the opportunity to give your best at work, not because we’re required to, but because it’s the right thing to do. title: Product Operations Specialist L3
description:
*Who we are*

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

*Hiring and how we work*

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

*See yourself at Twilio*

Join the team as Twilio’s next Product Operations Specialist 3

*About the job*

Twilio is seeking an Product Operations Specialist 3 to join the team that runs Twilio’s phone number operations globally. This role will work directly with customers to help them port their phone numbers into Twilio, procure short codes and Sender IDs, and have access to phone numbers they require for their applications. The Senior Product Operations Specialist is the third tier on the Level 1 team. The Product Operations team is a key part of Twilio’s Super Network, whose mission is to provide the infrastructure that catalogs, orchestrates, and delivers the world's connectivity.

*Responsibilities*

In this role, you’ll:

* Provide support for common customer inquiries received by email to ensure customers have an excellent experience with Twilio.
* Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve basic-to-intermediate level problems.
* Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly.
* Learn new processes across a variety of subject areas and ensure our operations are running smoothly.
* Respond to and action incoming carrier partner notifications.
* Quickly and confidently triage complex issues to the Level 2 team.
* Effectively respond to advanced questions from customers (external and internal) in core area and intermediate questions across multiple areas.
* Work independently to troubleshoot/determine resolution for issues across the entirety of your team's domain.
* Coach and mentor less experienced teammates.
* Wear the Customer Shoes: Provide support to the team by being a front line support system for customer escalations, received primarily by email and phone.
* Draw the Owl: Assess the nature of product or service issues and resolve intermediate to advanced level problems.
* Ruthlessly Prioritize: Log customer interactions and tag/categorize issues accordingly.
* Be Bold: Learn new processes across a variety of subject areas and ensure our operations are running smoothly.
* Be an Owner: Effectively respond to all basic and some advanced questions from customers (external and internal) in your core area and quickly and confidently triage complex issues via documented internal escalation paths.
* Write it Down: Enable a consistent experience for our customers, team members and internal teams, and ensure all documentation on processes are up to date.

*Qualifications*

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

**Required:*

* Ability to work in rotational shifts 18:30 - 3:30AM or 21:00- 6:00 IST
* You're thorough, organized, and detail-oriented, and you’re able to prioritize and execute multiple processes.
* Experience Required: 3 - 7 Yrs*( depending on candidature)
* Previous experience into Advanced Email writing, handling international escalations(voice, chat and email)
* International stakeholder handling
* Monitoring tasks and queues, ensuring SLAs aren’t breached for self and the team
* Coach as per requirement to individuals in the team
* Interaction with the technical team frequently to understand the core nature of the process and implement process improvements as in when demanded
* Previous experience into doing root cause analysis
* Ready to take up additional tasks depending on requirements
* You’re empathetic and customer centric to the core.
* You’re a clear verbal and written communicator.
* You’re introspective and committed to continuous self-improvement.
* You’re capable of learning quickly and mastering complicated systems.
* You’re capable of working independently but also energized from working within a team and cross-functionally to achieve the company's goals.
* You’re able to complete tasks in core areas within SLAs.
* Able to perform quality audits for individuals only when required
* Should be able to manage the team and the process during manager’s absence

*Desired:*

* Knowledge of Looker queries/ reporting and creating dashboards in Tableau is a must
* Running SQL queries , having knowledge of Zendesk, JIRA would be an added advantage

*Location*

This role will be based remotely in India (Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi)

*Travel*

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

*What We Offer*

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

*Twilio thinks big. Do you?*

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

*.*

*Stay alert to recruitment fraud*

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

. **

*Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.* We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

Customer Success Manager, Growth
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

- Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at Linear’s mid-market customers - act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback

- Become a product expert and help customers use Linear to drive business outcomes

- Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

- Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with product, sales, and support teams to address challenges and drive enhancements in the product

What we're looking for

- 3+ years relevant work experience in a technical customer-facing role

- SaaS and start up experience a must; comfortable working and adapting in a fast paced and flexible environment

- Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

- Previous experience working with product + engineering teams and/or developer tools is preferred

What we offer

- Interesting and challenging work

ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Ramp is in a critical phase of growth. We grew immensely in 2025 and are building out a talented business systems team to ensure we maintain this trajectory for years to come. You’ll work directly with our Post Sales, GTM, and Quote-to-Cash teams to execute mission-critical business systems projects across the organization. - Identify and qualify leads through various channels, including phone, email, and social media.

- Build relationships with potential customers and understand their needs and pain points, presenting Airwallex's innovative solutions and crafting compelling value propositions.

- Qualify opportunities and schedule appointments for Account Executives, ensuring a smooth handoff with clear context on prospect needs and fit.

- Collaborate with Marketing and cross-functional teams on targeted campaigns, content localization, and feedback loops to refine messaging and go-to-market strategy for the Mexico market.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

- 1+ years of experience in outbound B2B sales, account management, or a related customer-facing role.

- Strategic thinker who is able to drive "partnership" conversations vs. "sales" conversations; solution oriented.

- Strong analytical skills and an organized way of thinking and working.

- Proficient in GSuite and sales tech tools like Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar platforms.

- Prior experience in fintech, payments, SaaS, or financial services, with an understanding of cross-border payments, FX, or global treasury operations.

- Familiarity with the Mexican business ecosystem, including local payment landscape, regulatory environment, and key industry verticals.

- Ability to drive the sales cycle in collaboration with existing AE/AM teams, and to translate technical detail into business value for the customer.

- Evidence of working cross-functionally across multiple stakeholders to drive product or solution adoption.

- The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment.

- A proven ability to be a self-starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision.

- Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person and online meetings with multiple stakeholders with different backgrounds across finance, product, and engineering.

- Background at a billing platform or competitor, for example Stripe, Chargebee, or Recurly, or at a billing startup.

- Alternatively, experience at a technical consulting firm, for example Accenture, Deloitte Digital, or BCG X, designing and selling technical solutions.

title: Finance & Reconciliation Analyst / Safeguarding
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst to join our Safeguarding function at Pleo.

In this role, you'll be at the heart of how we meet our safeguarding obligations under FCA rules. You'll perform daily and periodic reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions, contribute to process improvement initiatives, and support our external audit activity. You'll also help produce the management information that feeds into our governance oversight. If you're genuinely curious about payments and financial infrastructure, good with data, and keen to learn and improve as you go, then this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll report to our Head of Safeguarding and work closely with teams across Finance Operations, Compliance, and Product.

Our Finance function is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of safeguarding and financial control. You'll also have the opportunity to partner with colleagues across our operations, audit, and leadership teams to help drive strong governance and regulatory compliance.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

As a Finance & Reconciliations Analyst in Safeguarding, you will:

- Perform and support the review of daily and periodic safeguarding reconciliations across customer funds, balances and transactions

- Monitor reconciliation outputs and carry out post-review checks and manual follow-up activity

- Investigate breaks and exceptions, escalating where needed and tracking issues through to resolution

- Maintain accurate records, supporting documentation and clear audit trails

- Help collate and prepare management information on reconciliations and exceptions for governance forums including the Safeguarding Committee

- Work with data in spreadsheets and internal systems to extract, check and present information clearly

- Spot patterns in exceptions or recurring issues and flag them to the team

- Contribute to reconciliations-related projects, including system changes, tooling improvements and process redesign

- Flag inefficiencies or recurring control weaknesses and bring forward practical ideas to address them

- Support the development and automation of reporting processes over time

- Help prepare and organise documentation, evidence packs and reconciliation outputs for external audit

- Respond to auditor queries and requests in a timely and accurate manner

WHAT YOU BRING

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- 2+ years of experience in a reconciliations, payments, finance operations or similar role

- Comfort working with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets or Excel) and a keen interest to develop further

- A methodical and accurate approach — you take care with the details and notice when something doesn't look right

- Strong communication skills and the ability to explain what you've found clearly to colleagues and, where needed, to external auditors

- Genuine interest in how financial services and payments regulation works in practice

- A passion for solving problems in practical and innovative ways

- Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise tasks effectively

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You're genuinely curious about fintech and how payments infrastructure actually works

- You enjoy working with data and understanding systems, not just using them

- You're excited by the responsibility of maintaining financial controls and regulatory compliance

- You thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy improving processes and ways of working

- You bring a self-starter attitude — you don't wait to be told what to do next

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You struggle working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities

- You do not enjoy detailed analytical or investigative work

- You prefer working in isolation rather than collaborating with colleagues across teams

- You're not interested in the practical application of financial regulation

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Develop a strong understanding of Pleo's safeguarding obligations under FCA rules, including the CASS and DFSA safeguarding requirements. Learn how our reconciliation processes work across all our systems and develop expertise in carrying out and reviewing reconciliations

- Collaborate with colleagues to help improve and streamline our reconciliation and reporting processes

- Grow your skills in data handling, financial analysis, and audit preparation

- Take on new challenges as you build confidence and the company continues to scale

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger projects, stepping into process improvement leadership, or acquiring new skills in areas you identify for growth.

THE LOCATION

- Corporate administration by drafting, reviewing, and amending internal policies, procedures, and standardised legal templates that the business can use efficiently.

- Assist managing fraud and compliance escalations by conducting liability assessments, performing compliance checks, and providing risk mitigation advice to protect the business.

- Assist with customer disputes and regulatory engagement with the UK Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS), supporting escalations, preparing responses, and helping to ensure we meet all regulatory deadlines and requirements.

WHAT YOU BRING

- A Cand.Jur or equivalent legal qualification recognised in Denmark.

- Strong vendor and contract management skills – you can review, negotiate, and draft commercial agreements efficiently.

- Excellent communication skills – you can translate complex legal concepts into practical business advice for non-legal stakeholders.

- A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset – you see problems as opportunities and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience with compliance and risk management in a regulated industry is a plus as well as managing regulatory escalations and disputes, particularly with financial regulators or ombudsman services.

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You want a real look at how the law works in practice, where you implement it and explain it rather than argue it in theory

- You want genuine input into decisions, balancing the technically correct answer against what actually works commercially

- You like building things that outlast you: templates, policies and process that the business will use long after your contract ends

- You want a clean roadmap. The team is under-resourced and the workload is heavy, so expect more firefighting than planned work

- You want to specialise deeply or lead. This is a broad, hands-on individual contributor role where you'll be supported, not managing
