ABOUT THIS ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Transaction Monitoring and Fraud Framework Specialist at Pleo in the first line of defence (1LoD). You’ll be the architect of our defence strategy across transaction surveillance and fraud, with a clear focus on leading innovation and embedding AI into how we detect, investigate, and prevent financial crime.

This isn’t a purely reactive role. Within our Financial Crime Framework & Innovation team, you’ll run cross-functional projects that bring together Financial Crime Operations, Engineering, 2LoD, and leadership to design controls and processes that scale. You’ll translate emerging threats and regulatory expectations into practical, automated, and measurable interventions and controls — including the thoughtful use of AI tools to improve decision quality, reduce manual effort, and strengthen governance.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Lead innovation in transaction monitoring and fraud by identifying high-impact opportunities for automation, model/rule optimisation, and AI-assisted investigation workflows.

- Run end-to-end change and delivery projects (discovery → design → build → rollout → monitoring), coordinating stakeholders across 1LoD/2LoD, Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data.

- Design and maintain our financial crime frameworks, controls, and procedures, ensuring they remain effective as our products, customer base, and threat landscape evolve.

- Partner with Engineering on the development, deployment, and lifecycle management of transaction surveillance and fraud rules and models, including performance monitoring, drift detection, and continuous tuning.

- Integrate AI tools into processes responsibly, including:

- improving alert triage and case prioritisation,

- enhancing investigation quality and consistency,

- accelerating root cause analysis and emerging-risk discovery,

- strengthening documentation, auditability, and control testing.

- Turn insights from transaction alerts and fraud cases into actionable improvements across the framework, leading with data to reduce false positives, close control gaps, improve prevention and improve coverage of complex typologies.

- File SARs for all EEA customers.

- Act as Pleo’s go-to transaction monitoring and fraud subject matter expert, sharing learnings on threats, regulatory developments (including AML/CTF), and industry best practice.

WHO YOU ARE

You’re a builder and a problem-solver who can turn strategy into operational reality. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, confident leading cross-functional delivery and taking on responsibility, and you have a track record of driving meaningful change transaction monitoring.

- You’re a builder and a problem-solver who can turn strategy into operational reality. You’re comfortable in ambiguity, confident leading cross-functional delivery and taking on responsibility, and you have a track record of driving meaningful change transaction monitoring.

- You have significant experience designing and improving transaction monitoring and fraud frameworks, controls, and operating models in a scaling or high-volume environment.

- You have demonstrable experience leading innovation (for example: new monitoring approaches, automation, analytics improvements, or AI-enabled workflows) with measurable outcomes.

- You are experienced in running projects and change initiatives, including stakeholder management, prioritisation, and delivery planning.

- You’re hands-on with data: you can interpret performance metrics, investigate root causes, and translate findings into clear requirements and control enhancements.

- You understand the practical governance needs of AI-enabled and automated controls (documentation, explainability, testing, risk acceptance, and audit readiness).

- You communicate clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, and you can translate complex financial crime concepts into actionable guidance.

- You’re comfortable balancing customer experience, operational efficiency, and risk management.

- You are an expert within the transaction monitoring and fraud area and preferable also a high knowledge about KYC in general.

- You thrive in an environment where responsibility often will find you and where there is a lot of flexibility.

- You may have been or are a people leader.

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You're energised by translating complex regulatory and operational challenges into practical, scalable solutions.

- You have a proven track record of driving measurable improvements in transaction monitoring or financial crime prevention, and you're excited to do this at scale.

- You're comfortable operating in ambiguity, owning cross-functional delivery, and taking responsibility for outcomes that span multiple teams.

- You believe AI can strengthen financial crime defences and are keen to explore responsible, explainable approaches to automation.

- You're a builder and problem-solver who can move quickly while maintaining rigour and governance.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You prefer highly structured, process-driven environments with little room for ownership and initiative.

- You're looking for a role focused purely on operational execution without strategic input or innovation.

- You're uncomfortable with ambiguity, complexity, or the need to influence without direct authority across teams.

HOW YOU'LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first 6–12 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Lead a high-impact project – Own end-to-end delivery of a transaction monitoring improvement (e.g., new rule set, AI-assisted workflow, or false positive reduction initiative) that demonstrates your ability to drive change across teams.

- Build deep relationships across the business – Collaborate with Financial Crime Operations, Engineering, Product, and Risk to understand how transaction monitoring sits within the broader control environment.

- Grow your skills in AI governance – Deepen your understanding of designing, testing, and auditing AI-enabled controls in a regulated environment.

We'll invest in your development through mentorship, access to industry networks, and exposure to cutting-edge financial crime prevention strategies.

title: Procurement Ops Specialist
description:
ABOUT PLEO

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Procurement Operations Specialist to join our Procurement team at Pleo. In this role, you'll manage the day-to-day operations of procurement end-to-end, driving ticket workflows, purchase requests, vendor due diligence, and keeping approvals moving seamlessly across the business. You will also own the critical final stages of the procurement lifecycle, managing contract workflows, approvals, and contract signatures. You won't just keep the operational wheels turning; you'll also act as a process architect, partnering with our Omnea CSM to optimize, streamline, and scale our procurement workflows to be faster, leaner, and fully compliant. Procurement at Pleo is still taking shape, so you'll have real ownership and high visibility, regularly partnering with function leaders and C-level executives. If you are highly methodical, thrive on managing multiple moving parts simultaneously, and are excited to shape an efficient way of buying, this could be your next step.

WHO YOU’LL BE WORKING WITH AND REPORTING TO

You'll report to our Head of Procurement and work closely with Finance, Legal, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and function leaders across the company. You'll also work closely with our dedicated CSM at Omnea (our procurement platform) to drive system and process continuous improvements. As the main point of contact for day-to-day procurement operations, you will be the bridge between internal teams, C-level stakeholders, and external vendor representatives.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

As a Procurement Operations Specialist, you will:

- Manage Daily Procurement Operations: Own the intake and lifecycle of procurement tickets and purchase requests, ensuring every step from initial request to final sign-off runs smoothly.

- Drive Contract Management & Signatures: Lead the end of the procurement process by managing contract execution, coordinating internal/external signatures, and ensuring executed agreements are properly archived and tracked.

- Proactively Drive Approvals & Diligence: Actively chase approvals, coordinate cross-functional handoffs (Legal, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Finance), and ensure rigorous vendor due diligence is executed without letting requests stall.

- Architect & Optimize Processes: Continually evaluate our procurement workflows to eliminate bottlenecks, working in a project-manager capacity alongside our Omnea CSM to make our end-to-end buying journey leaner, faster, and more efficient.

- Maintain Compliance & Quality: Embed regulatory standards, security requirements, and risk mitigation steps directly into daily workflows, making compliance frictionless and standard for stakeholders.

- Engage High-Level Stakeholders: Confidently communicate and align with function leaders, department heads, and C-level executives to clear blockers and maintain clear alignment.

- Support Tactical Negotiations: Provide ad-hoc negotiation support on day-to-day purchases and renewals to secure fair commercial terms when needed.

WHAT YOU BRING

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- Exceptional Organizational & Methodical Skills: You excel at multitasking, prioritizing high ticket volumes, and tracking complex workflows simultaneously without letting details slip through the cracks.

- Contract Management Expertise: Hands-on experience navigating the final stages of the procurement lifecycle, including managing contract reviews, driving approval workflows, and ensuring timely contract execution and signatures.

- Proactive Stakeholder Management: You are comfortable communicating across all seniority levels (including C-suite executives) and aren't afraid to proactively follow up to get approvals over the finish line.

- Process Design & Project Management Ability: You naturally analyze workflows, identify operational friction, and take initiative to redesign processes for speed, scalability, and compliance.

- Operational Procurement Experience: You've managed daily procurement ops, vendor due diligence checks, and purchase request approvals in a fast-paced environment.

- Tool & System Familiarity: Comfortable using and navigating procurement platforms, with hands-on experience using tools like Omnea (or similar procurement management platforms) to manage intake and workflow execution.

WHY IS THIS ROLE A GOOD FIT FOR YOU

This role is a total match if:

- You are a master of momentum: You get a legitimate rush from clearing tickets, knocking out blockers, and bringing pure order to operational chaos.

- You’re direct, proactive, and zero-percent intimidated: You have no problem nudging a C-level exec or function leader with a friendly, high-energy, "Hey, I need your sign-off on this so we can keep moving."

- You love fixing broken things: You don't just follow a process; you look at it, spot the friction, and say, "We can make this so much faster." You'll love playing process architect alongside our Omnea partners to build a world-class procurement engine.

- You take pride in seeing things through to the finish line: From the very first ticket request all the way down to final vendor due diligence, contract execution, and the ink drying on the signature, you own it end-to-end.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You just want to be a grand-strategist negotiator: If your dream day is spending 8 hours negotiating million-dollar deals while handing off all the operational groundwork, ticket management, and contract admin to an assistant, you'll be bored here.

- You like rigid, set-in-stone playbooks: We're actively building and refining how we buy. If you need a 200-page manual on day one to tell you exactly how to breathe, this fast-paced environment might feel too fluid.

- Jugglings lots of balls makes you sweat: If tracking 20 active purchase requests at once feels overwhelming instead of an exciting puzzle, this isn't the right fit.

HOW YOU’LL DEVELOP IN THIS ROLE

In your first months at Pleo, you'll:

- Take ownership of our renewals calendar and deliver your first round of negotiated savings

- Ship the first version of procurement reporting so the business can see spend and savings in one place

- Work with Finance and Legal to tighten our procurement policy and roll it out to the teams who buy

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on bigger categories, stepping into leadership as the function grows, or deepening your expertise in vendor and contract strategy.

THE LOCATION

This role is hybrid and we're expecting the person to be in either our Lisbon or Madrid office 3 times a week.

SHOW ME THE BENEFITS!

💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring Manager Interview: 1 hour with the hiring manager talking through the expectations of the role and how you can deliver in a complex and demanding environment.

- The Pleo Challenge: A live work scenario with will show us how you manage multiple priorities and work with key stakeholders.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired a Procurement Ops Specialist, we received an incredibly high total of applications but can only interview a finite number. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI (it’s a big focus for us internally too) but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

ABOUT YOUR APPLICATION

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.

- Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here https://www.pleo.io/en/legal.

- Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

- Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Engineering Location: Menlo Park

About the Team

The Capacity, Performance & Efficiency team sits at the intersection of cloud hardware, workload behavior, performance measurement, and business economics. We drive Snowflake’s cloud hardware adoption and evolution strategy, price/performance decisions, platform footprint expansion amidst capacity constraints, and strategic alignment with cloud service provider (CSP) technical roadmaps.

We're looking for a Principal Performance Engineer to drive Snowflake's cloud infrastructure performance strategy. This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role for someone who can go deep on hardware internals (CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O behavior) while also translating that technical depth into pricing, capacity, and roadmap decisions across Snowflake.

You will drive the evaluation of new hardware generations across all major cloud providers, build the benchmarking and modeling infrastructure that turns raw performance data into pricing and rollout decisions, and represent Snowflake in technical discussions with CSPs and silicon partners. You'll help grow performance engineering as a discipline across the company — mentoring engineers, building benchmark capability, and championing a culture of rigorous, data-driven performance work.

What You'll Do

- Own new hardware evaluation and enablement. Lead evaluation of new AWS, Azure, and GCP instance types (e.g., Graviton, AMD Turin, Azure ARM/Cobalt, GCP Axion) by building representative benchmark and evaluation solutions.

- Set performance strategy and architecture. Shape the team's technical roadmap, set direction on measurement methodology, and translate benchmark results into concrete rollout and adoption recommendations.

- Lead cross-functional and CSP partnerships. Work across engineering (i.e. Warehouse, Capacity, and other core platform teams) and Finance along with AWS, Azure, GCP to qualify new hardware and influence future cloud-instance designs.

- Characterize hardware performance at a deep level. Analyze CPU microarchitecture (e.g., memory bandwidth, PMU counters, I/O behavior) to identify workload-specific bottlenecks and drive resolution.

- Develop price/performance model to support new hardware transitions.

- Automate day-zero hardware readiness. Build automated performance-validation workflows and per-provider/per-instance scorecards so Snowflake can qualify and price new silicon at or near cloud-provider GA.

- Grow the performance engineering discipline. Mentor engineers, build out benchmarking capability, and drive company-wide performance education (e.g., a recurring Performance Tech Talk series).

Our ideal candidate will have:

- 12+ years of experience in performance engineering, systems engineering, or infrastructure engineering, with a track record of principal-level technical leadership.

- Deep expertise in cloud infrastructure performance across at least one major CSP (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including instance types, pricing models, and capacity constraints.

- Strong grounding in hardware/systems fundamentals: CPU microarchitecture, memory bandwidth, I/O subsystems, and use of profiling tools (PMU counters, etc.) to root-cause performance bottlenecks.

- Experience building or operating large-scale benchmarking systems (e.g., TPC-DS-style workloads) and turning benchmark output into actionable pricing/rollout decisions.

- Ability to build quantitative models connecting technical performance metrics to business outcomes (pricing multipliers, cost-per-query).

- A track record of leading cross-functional, cross-company initiatives — comfortable being the primary technical point of contact with external hardware and cloud partners (CSPs, silicon vendors).

- Bias toward automation: builds scorecards, dashboards, and validation pipelines rather than relying on one-off analysis.

- Experience with data warehouse / distributed database performance characteristics.

- Direct experience partnering with cloud providers or silicon vendors on early-access hardware programs.

- Experience building hardware-emulation systems.

As Strategic Events Specialist, EMEA, you'll own complete across some of Snowflake's most visible moments in the region.

You will work across two connected portfolios:

- Snowflake-hosted events, ranging from flagship Snowflake World Tour stops to executive roundtables, customer hospitality, developer events, and partner experiences.

The role is well suited to someone who is highly organized, proactive, comfortable working at pace, and excited by the challenge of delivering complex events with measurable business impact.

This role is based in our London office, with a minimum of three days per week onsite. The nature of event work also means periodic travel across EMEA and occasional evening or weekend commitments around key events. The role reports to the Sr. Event Manager, EMEA.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

SNOWFLAKE-HOSTED EVENTS

You'll own workstreams within Snowflake-owned experiences including Snowflake World Tour, Snowflake Summit activations, developer events, executive workshops and roundtables, customer dinners, and partner events.

- Run your logistics workstreams end-to-end, from planning through onsite delivery and wrap-up.

- Build and manage registration, track RSVPs against target, and report attendance clearly to event stakeholders.

- Coordinate agendas, speakers, content, briefings, rehearsals, and session logistics.

- Manage venue, catering, signage, production, branding, and swag requirements.

- Deliver customer and executive hospitality, including VIP guests, dinners, and 1:1 meetings, in partnership with Field Marketing and Sales.

- Work with Sales and Field Marketing to make sure priority customers and target accounts are engaged and attending

- Ensure a seamless experience for attendees, speakers, and internal stakeholders while onsite.

THIRD-PARTY CONFERENCES

You’ll deliver Snowflake’s presence at major industry events such as Hannover Messe, Davos, Web Summit, and Gartner conferences.

Your work will include:

- Own assigned sponsorship deliverables with event organizers — booth space, branding, speaking slots, passes, entitlements — and ensure we make the most of every opportunity.

- Track organizer deadlines and requirements across the internal teams you depend on, flagging slippage early rather than late.

- Manage booth build and exhibitor logistics with agencies and production partners across creative, AV, furniture, signage, and shipping.

- Coordinate speaker and session requirements, including materials, rehearsals, deadlines, and onsite logistics.

- Own lead capture end to end — scanning setup, staffing, data quality, reconciliation, and clean handoff to Sales and marketing ops

- Document post-event results, observations, and recommendations that shape future planning.

- Ensure Snowflake’s presence is consistent, engaging, and aligned with event objectives.

DATA, BUDGET, AND PERFORMANCE

Snowflake is a data company, and we hold our own events to the same standard. We expect events to earn their budget, and we expect everyone delivering them to understand how theirs contributes.

- Own the budget lines for your workstreams, such as catering, signage, or production. Track spend against plan, prevent overages, and escalate variances before they become problems.

- Manage purchase orders, invoices, and supplier paperwork accurately and on time.

- Track the metrics for your areas: attendance, registration conversion, lead volume and quality, spend against forecast.

- Protect data integrity so post-event reporting holds up — clean lists, accurate scans, sensible follow-up categorization.

- Contribute to post-event recaps and debriefs with evidence and bring forward changes and optimizations worth making next time.

- Maintain and contribute improvements to the trackers, templates, and documentation the team relies on, and leave things clearer than you found them.

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

You'll work closely with Strategic Events, Field Marketing, Sales, Partner Marketing, Product Marketing, Communications and PR, Creative and Brand, and external agencies, venues, and production partners.

You'll lead reviews on your own workstreams, adapt how you communicate depending on who's in the room, and use detail and data to bring people with you.

WHAT YOU BRING

We’re looking for someone who brings:

- 3–5 years of experience or equivalent depth in fewer years at a high-growth company in events, field marketing, or a closely related environment; agency experience is also welcome.

- Proven experience owning event workstreams independently, including onsite delivery.

- Experience with B2B trade shows, conferences, or owned events, ideally in technology or another fast-moving industry.

- Strong organizational and project-management skills, with clear prioritization when several things are urgent at once.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You can pick up a workstream without a fully written brief, ask the right questions, and make sensible calls on the routine decisions while knowing when something needs your manager.

- Genuine independence paired with genuine teamwork — you'll own your areas, and you'll also drop what you're doing to help a colleague get theirs over the line.

- A data-driven view of event performance. You track the numbers on your own workstreams, you're honest about what didn't work, and you can make a point with evidence.

- Confidence working with vendors and agencies day to day, including resolving issues without escalating everything.

- Solid commercial fundamentals: budget lines, POs, invoices, and spend tracking.

- Clear, structured written and verbal communication, including proactive status updates and early escalation.

- Sound judgment about when to act independently and when to escalate — you make routine calls confidently and flag the non-routine ones early.

- Proficiency with Google Workspace. Familiarity with Salesforce, Marketo, Canva, and a project management tool such as Wrike or Asana is an advantage.

- Willingness to travel across EMEA for onsite delivery, including occasional evening and weekend work around key events.

HOW YOU WORK

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy bringing structure to complexity, stay composed when a plan changes on the day, and would rather solve something than pass it along.

You notice details other people miss. You anticipate the next thing before someone asks for it. And you're willing to do the unglamorous work — the spreadsheet reconciliation, unpacking boxes, the fourth revision of a floor plan — because you know that's what separates an event that looks good from one that works.

Most importantly, you’ll be excited to build memorable, high-impact experiences for Snowflake customers and partners. Snowflake is growing, EMEA is a priority region, and there's real room here to grow a career and take on more as you go.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Senior Director, Applications Engineering
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is building the data and AI platform for the agentic enterprise. Enterprise Apps & Agentic Systems is applying that same standard internally by redesigning business domains from first principles and turning high-value workflows into software-defined, AI-native products.

We are hiring a Sr. Director to make Finance, OTC, Revenue, People, and Legal domains more agentic. This leader will own the product and engineering strategy across the portfolio, moving beyond application management to deliver intelligent products that understand context, act across systems, operate within guardrails, and involve people when judgment is required.

This leader will work directly with business executives to identify the work that should be eliminated, redesigned, or delegated to software. They will build the teams, product model, technical foundations, and operating mechanisms needed to move quickly from opportunity to production and deliver measurable business impact

CORE MISSION:

- Transform enterprise operations across Finance, People, and Legal by redesigning end-to-end workflows into AI-native products rather than adding incremental features to legacy apps.

- Combine domain expertise, enterprise data, workflow automation, autonomous agents, and controls into a coherent operating experience.

- Establish a product-led model where cross-functional teams co-own strategy, adoption, reliability, and business impact.

- Build a scalable AI product lifecycle to rapidly prototype, evaluate, deploy, and scale intelligent agents across the organization.

AS A SR. DIRECTOR, APPLICATIONS ENGINEERING AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

- Define and execute the multi-year product and engineering roadmap across Finance, HR, and Legal domains, aligning investments with high-value business outcomes.

- Partner with C-level and executive leaders (CFO, HR, Legal) to challenge existing processes and redesign future-state operating models.

- Deliver production-grade agents and AI-native workflows that use trusted context and enterprise tools to complete multi-step work, manage exceptions, and escalate with clear explanations and auditability.

- Establish a product-led operating model in which business and technology co-own the problem, product strategy, adoption, reliability, controls, and value realized.

- Establish software architecture and engineering standards for AI products, covering orchestration, context retrieval, tool integration, safety, compliance, latency, and cost.

- Build reusable AI patterns and modular platforms to enable fast deployment of agentic capabilities without building bespoke platforms for every use case.

- Lead cross-functional product pods accountable for adoption, workflow completion, and measurable value realization.

- Ensure AI implementations maintain rigorous governance, auditability, SOX controls, data privacy, and security standards.

- Define operational metrics to track agentic transformation, including automation rates, cycle-time reductions, exception management, and ROI.

- Hire, mentor, and scale a world-class product and engineering team with strong AI fluency, business empathy, and operational excellence.

- Manage portfolio budgets, vendor strategies, and technology partnerships to accelerate business outcomes.

OUR IDEAL SR. DIRECTOR, APPLICATIONS ENGINEERING WILL HAVE:

- 15+ years of experience in enterprise technology, product management, or software engineering, with 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary organizations at the Director level or above.

- A demonstrated record of building and scaling software-defined products and AI-native or intelligent workflows in production, with measurable business impact.

- Strong technical grounding in modern AI architectures (LLM/agent patterns, orchestration, tools, evaluation) and cloud data platforms like Snowflake.

- First-principles product mindset focused on simplifying workflows, rapid prototyping, outcome ownership, and user-centric design.

- Experience building product-led organizations with empowered teams, managing managers, and setting a high talent bar across product, program, engineering, and domain leadership.

- Experience moving quickly from ambiguity to a working product, learning from usage, simplifying fragmented landscapes, and making hard prioritization decisions based on business value.

- Demonstrated executive presence and ability to collaborate effectively with C-suite stakeholders as a strategic partner.

- Deep knowledge of compliance, audit, SOX controls, data governance, and responsible AI practices.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent practical experience.

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

title: Customer Value Manager
description:
ABOUT TEKION:

Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.

JOB INTRODUCTION:

The Customer Value Manager is the primary owner of the customer relationship and long-term success of assigned dealership accounts within Tekion’s Customer Value Services organization. This is not a support role with a retention overlay. It is a strategic value leadership role responsible for understanding each dealer’s business goals, connecting those goals to measurable outcomes within the Tekion platform, and ensuring value is visible, documented, and expanding over time. The Customer Value Manager serves as the strategic quarterback for every account in the portfolio. This role leads the ongoing customer relationship across operational and executive stakeholders, owns the Customer Value Plan (CVP) for each account, drives outcome-focused Value Reviews, maintains visibility into portfolio health and risk, and helps ensure renewals and expansion opportunities are supported by a clear, data-backed value narrative. The Customer Value Manager partners closely with Customer Value Architects, who provide product expertise and maturity diagnostics, and with Virtual Value Managers, who help support account activity between strategic touchpoints. Together, these roles help close the gap between what a dealer purchased and the value they are actually realizing.

KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the customer relationship across assigned dealership accounts, building and maintaining trusted relationships with operational contacts, general managers, dealer principals, and other key stakeholders

- Develop, maintain, and execute a Customer Value Plan for every account in the portfolio, ensuring plans remain current, actionable, and aligned to dealer priorities and business outcomes

- Lead regular Value Reviews that replace traditional QBRs with structured, outcome-focused conversations grounded in dealer performance, platform adoption, operational progress, and realized value

- Partner with Customer Value Architects (CVAs) to interpret Dealer Maturity Model (DMM) positioning, product adoption data, workflow maturity, and module utilization in order to shape account strategy and identify value gaps

- Translate platform usage, operational performance, and maturity progress into a compelling value narrative that helps customers understand where they are realizing value and where additional opportunity exists

- Maintain visibility into portfolio health through active management of account health indicators, maturity assessments, customer risks, renewal status, and expansion potential

- Forecast renewal readiness across the portfolio, ensuring each renewal is anticipated, supported by documented evidence of realized value, and aligned with Sales-led execution

- Identify and surface expansion opportunities in partnership with Sales by understanding customer needs, value realization progress, operational gaps, and growth potential across accounts

- Represent the voice of the customer internally by escalating risks, highlighting friction points, advocating for improvements, and informing internal priorities that improve customer outcomes

- Partner with Virtual Value Managers (VVMs) to ensure account documentation, operational support activity, weekly account digests, and proactive dealer touchpoints help reinforce broader customer strategy

- Ensure Customer Value Plan documentation, account records, and customer interaction history remain current, accurate, and useful for internal alignment and execution

- Monitor customer progress against agreed goals and maturity milestones, helping dealers move forward in a structured way across the Tekion Dealer Maturity Model

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, Implementations, and other internal teams as needed to remove blockers, align account strategy, and improve customer outcomes

- Operate effectively in a high-growth environment where portfolio size, segment design, account structures, and team configurations may evolve over time

- Travel to dealership sites and customer engagement events as needed to strengthen relationships, support value conversations, and improve understanding of dealer operations

- Support broader Customer Value Services goals by improving retention readiness, expansion visibility, customer trust, and measurable value realization across the portfolio

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Automotive Management, Communications, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience accepted in lieu of degree

- 3–5 years of experience in customer value, account management, client-facing consulting, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS environment

- Demonstrated ability to manage executive relationships and lead value-focused conversations with dealer principals, general managers, or comparable senior customer stakeholders

- Strong analytical instincts, including the ability to review performance data, adoption trends, and operational signals and translate them into a compelling customer value narrative

- Experience developing account plans, success plans, value plans, or comparable structured customer engagement strategies preferred

- Experience forecasting account health, renewal risk, or expansion opportunity across a portfolio preferred

- Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, Enablement, or similar internal teams to improve customer outcomes

- Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce preferred

- Familiarity with business intelligence and reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI preferred

- Automotive industry experience or familiarity with dealership operations strongly preferred

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 50% for dealership visits, onsite engagement, and customer events

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to lead executive conversations and prepare clear internal account context

- Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with shifting priorities, portfolio needs, and organizational structures

PERKS & BENEFITS

- Competitive compensation and generous stock options

- 100% employer-paid top-of-the-line medical, dental and vision coverage

- Work on the latest and coolest technologies – everything is home-grown and built ground-up

title: Sr. Technical Account Manager
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

Job posted: 8/28/2026

Level: IC4

Location: Remote Central & South America- Pacific Time (PST) working hours required

Hi there!

Zapier’s mission is to make automation work for everyone, helping people eliminate repetitive work and focus on what matters most.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Account Manager to support our Enterprise customers on the post-sale team. You’ll serve as a named senior technical partner to builders, technical leaders, and executives, helping them turn important business problems into reliable, well-designed automations.

You’ll join a growing team of four Sr TAMs reporting to a Senior Manager. Customer portfolios vary by program, account size, technical complexity, and level of engagement. Customers typically receive an average allocation of approximately six dedicated TAM hours, which you’ll use for architecture, hands-on building, technical enablement, and proactive account planning.

You’ll design architectures, build and improve workflows, solve complex technical problems, and strengthen the resilience of customers’ automation systems. In partnership with Customer Success, you’ll connect this work to adoption, customer value, retention, and growth. You’ll also represent the customer internally, giving Product and Engineering clear insight into product gaps, critical bugs, and opportunities to improve the Enterprise experience.

- Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

- Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

- Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

- Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

- Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

THINGS YOU’LL DO

Design, build, and improve customer automations

- Use customers’ dedicated TAM hours to design, build, and improve automations tied to meaningful business outcomes.

- Translate complex processes into practical workflow architectures covering data movement, business logic, exception paths, and operational controls.

- Build alongside customer teams to move high-value use cases from concept to reliable production operation.

- Review existing automations for reliability, efficiency, maintainability, and effective use of Zapier.

- Troubleshoot issues across Zapier, APIs, authentication, data formats, and connected applications.

- Identify recurring failures and improve error handling, monitoring, alerts, fallback behavior, and recovery processes.

Lead proactive technical partnerships

- Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s priorities, systems, technical constraints, governance needs, and automation maturity.

- Create technical account plans that identify valuable use cases, architectural recommendations, risks, and next steps.

- Lead working sessions, architecture reviews, implementation discussions, and executive conversations.

- Use sound judgment to determine when to solve directly, teach the customer, recommend another approach, or involve additional Zapier teams.

Drive customer and team outcomes through internal partnership

- Partner closely with Customer Success to connect technical priorities to adoption, realized value, retention, and growth.

- Bring technical evidence into account planning, business reviews, renewal preparation, and expansion conversations.

- Surface blockers, adoption gaps, and architectural risks early, and take ownership of moving the right people toward a solution.

- Proactively identify and lead team or cross-functional initiatives, turning recurring needs into scalable solutions, reusable practices, and better experiences for customers and the team.

Represent the customer inside Zapier

- Give Product and Engineering technically grounded feedback that explains the customer’s use case, business impact, urgency, and available workarounds.

- Use evidence and patterns across your portfolio to advocate for fixes and features that materially affect Enterprise customers.

- Coordinate complex escalations, keep customers informed, and set clear expectations.

- Share recurring insights that improve the product, documentation, supportability, and broader Enterprise experience.

Help customers make sound AI decisions

AI is changing how customers design and operate automations. You’ll help them move beyond surface-level terminology and make responsible implementation choices.

- Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini in your own work, applying appropriate review, verification, and judgment.

- Understand meaningful differences among AI models and discuss their capabilities, limitations, and selection criteria credibly with customers.

- Explain the difference between deterministic automation, AI-assisted workflows, and agentic systems, and help customers decide when and how to use each.

- Guide practical conversations about accuracy, reliability, evaluation, fallback behavior, human oversight, security, and governance.

- Understand emerging AI integration patterns, including the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and how models, tools, data, and automation platforms can work together.

What We’re Looking For

- Significant experience (7+ years) in technical account management, solutions architecture, customer engineering, sales engineering, implementation consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.

- A track record of measurably improving customer outcomes across an Enterprise portfolio, for example, reducing churn risk, strengthening renewals, expanding adoption, or creating upsell and cross-sell opportunities through technical enablement.

- Demonstrated experience building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them.

- Hands-on familiarity with Zapier or comparable automation and integration platforms.

- Experience owning complex technical relationships with Enterprise customers and communicating effectively with both builders and executives.

- A track record of building integrations, automations, or API-based solutions, not only recommending them.

- Strong working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, authentication, structured data, application integrations, and conditional workflow logic.

- The ability to diagnose ambiguous, multi-system problems and design for production reliability, monitoring, recovery, and maintainability.

- Strong customer judgment, balancing immediate needs with technical feasibility, risk, scale, and long-term value.

- The ability to operate autonomously in an ambiguous environment: proactively identifying high-impact work, driving customer and team initiatives to completion across multiple internal teams.

- Hands-on experience with AI tools and a practical understanding of AI-assisted workflows, agentic systems, evaluation, oversight, and governance.

HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.

APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

- Experience taking products from concept to mass production.

title: Junior Product Owner
description:
---------------------------------------------------------------
Join Our Team as a Junior Product Owner at Hawk-Eye Innovations
---------------------------------------------------------------

Hi, I’m Alison Marr, Product Lead for the Tracking and Auto Officiating Value Stream at Hawk-Eye Innovations. Are you interested in working with the latest technologies in a fast-paced environment, with exciting career opportunities in a growing business?

At Hawk-Eye, we build technology that powers some of the most exciting and critical moments in sport, from instant replays and broadcast augmentation to officiating systems trusted by leagues, federations, broadcasters, and millions of fans worldwide.

Our Value Stream delivers the tracking and automatic officiating services that have revolutionised global sport. From our world-renowned ball and object tracking systems to *SkeleTRACK* , our real-time skeletal tracking services, we turn live athletic movement into precise, high-stakes decisions and elite data insights.

We are looking for a *Junior Product Owner* to help drive our tracking and automated officiating products forward. In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and operational excellence. You will keep the technical depth and operational focus of an engineer while taking structured ownership of backlog definition, prioritisation, and delivery outcomes. Working across complex, real-time software-hardware integrated systems in live stadium and broadcast environments, you will directly impact how our world-leading tracking platforms perform on the global stage.

*What You'll Be Doing*

*

*Product Definition & Backlog Ownership:* Act as the voice of users, operators, and the business. Translate needs into epics, features, and user stories for small-to-medium changes, and maintain a prioritised backlog using data, value, and risk.

*

*Quality & Testing Coordination:* Define and coordinate QC activities (functional, integration, regression, and UAT). Lead defect detection, triage, validation, and root cause investigations to ensure our tracking systems remain incredibly accurate and reliable.

*

*Cross-Functional Delivery:* Work day-to-day with Engineering, QA, TechOps, and UX teams to align on scope. Participate fully in Agile ceremonies, monitor support channels, and coordinate third-line support within your scope.

*

*Deployment & Early-Life Support:* Create and maintain documentation, runbooks, and training materials. Support pilots, staged roll-outs, and early-life support until tracking products are smoothly embedded in live, real-time match operations.

*

*Growth Toward Level 4:* Build your capabilities across the full product lifecycle. With coaching from senior POs and Product Managers, you will begin shaping short-range roadmaps, defining OKRs, and handling increasing ambiguity.

*What We're Looking For*

*

*1–3 years of experience* in a product-related role (e.g., Associate Product Owner, Business Analyst, QA, Operator, or similar) working on technically complex products.

*

*Strong technical grounding* with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, QA, and operators across software-hardware integrated systems.

*

*Proven experience* coordinating QC/regression testing and managing defect resolution.

*

*Data & Cloud Comfort:* Experience working with cloud-based and data-oriented products, with the ability to interpret basic product analytics and operational telemetry.

*

*Excellent communication skills* and a proactive mindset to plan your own work, handle ambiguity, and escalate risks appropriately.

*Bonus Points For*

*

Experience supporting product launches and creating documentation or tutorial content.

*

Exposure to stakeholder engagement, prioritisation frameworks, and roadmap contribution.

*

Experience working with products that combine software, high-performance cameras, and hardware in high-pressure, live broadcast, or real-time sports environments.

*Benefits & Perks*

*

Annual leave per local labour law

*

Hybrid working (2 days/week in office)

*

Sony Group perks – discounted tickets and events

*

Cafeteria options (SZÉP Card, nursery/kindergarten support, MOL Bubi Pass)

*

Private medical, life & accident insurance, dental discounts

*

Seniority awards, Employee Assistance Program

*

“All You Can Move” Pass option

Equal Opportunity Employer
--------------------------

We’re committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace. Everyone is treated fairly, regardless of gender, race, religion, age, disability, or background. We want you to be your best and truest self here.

Apply Today
-----------

If you’re excited by the idea of solving real-world problems at scale and want to help shape the future of sports tracking technology, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Junior IT Administrator, EMEA
description:
*About Dash0*
-------------

Join Dash0 and help us define the future of observability. We are OpenTelemetry-native, building a delightful, simple, and AI-centric platform that eliminates vendor lock-in and meaningless toil. Shape a product that developers love—all with transparent pricing and cost-control built in.

Dash0 is an OpenTelemetry-native observability platform growing fast, and the infrastructure that keeps our team operational needs to be as reliable as the product we build. As our Junior IT Administrator, you'll own the full device and access lifecycle — from a new hire's first laptop to an employee's final offboarding — and build the systems that make it repeatable at scale.

This role exists because we've outgrown ad-hoc IT. We need someone who takes genuine ownership: provisioning accounts, enforcing endpoint security, maintaining audit-ready records, and keeping our SaaS stack under control. You'll work closely with our Head of Security and People Ops team, but the systems work is yours to run.

It's a foundational role with real scope. The processes you put in place today will scale with the company for years.

----------------
*What You'll Do*
----------------

*

Provision and de-provision accounts across our SaaS stack for every new hire and departure, keeping onboarding repeatable and offboarding complete.

*

Manage the full device lifecycle: hardware ordering, MDM enrollment, international logistics, maintenance, and responsible recycling at end-of-life.

*

Enforce endpoint security policies, including disk encryption, activation lock, and device compliance checks, coordinating with our Head of Security to keep standards current.

*

Maintain accurate, audit-ready records of who has access to what — catching and resolving discrepancies in serial numbers, license counts, and access logs before they become compliance issues.

*

Execute end-to-end offboarding by revoking access across all systems, coordinating hardware retrieval, and ensuring nothing slips through.

*

Manage vendor relationships and contracts for IT services and hardware insurance, including invoice auditing and service forecasting.

*

Support employees across time zones with clear, prompt communication on IT issues, hardware needs, and access requests.

----------------
*What You Bring*
----------------

*

0–2 years of experience in IT support, IT operations, systems administration, or a technical helpdesk role.

*

Hands-on comfort with device management tools and the Google Workspace admin console, including user and group management.

*

A working understanding of endpoint security concepts — disk encryption, activation lock, device compliance policies, and why they matter in a security-conscious environment.

*

Strong attention to detail: you notice when a serial number, license count, or access log doesn't add up, and you follow through until it does.

*

Clear written English and ease coordinating across time zones with employees, vendors, and internal teams.

*

The ability to manage many concurrent tickets and threads without losing track of any of them — you're organized and self-directed.

--------------
*Nice to Have*
--------------

*

Hands-on experience with a specific MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji, Fleet, or Intune.

*

Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001-style access review and audit processes.

*

Basic scripting skills for automating repetitive provisioning or reporting tasks.

*

Experience in a high-growth startup environment.

*Why Dash0*

This is a unique opportunity to help build a generational company. Dash0 is backed by top-tier investors including Balderton Capital, Accel and Cherry Ventures and led by a founding team with decades of experience in observability. We're in the middle of a massive growth phase after our Series B — and we're just getting started.

If you're looking for a place where a great product meets great people, where momentum is real and your impact is visible from day one — this is it.

*What we offer:*

*

Competitive salary & meaningful equity participation — you'll own part of what you're building

*

Flexible, remote-first work environment with offices in New York, Amsterdam, and Munich

*

€60/month phone & internet allowance

*

Location-specific benefits

*

Collaborative, fast-moving team culture with a builder mindset

*

Clear path for career growth and development

*

Direct access to founders and leadership

Promote experimentation and iterative development to accelerate innovation across business and technology stakeholders.
Stay attuned to evolving customer needs, industry trends, and opportunities for business and technical transformation.
Proactively propose innovative solutions based on deep understanding of business operations, user journeys, and technology capabilities.

Technical & Cross-Functional Leadership

Maintain a high-level understanding of IT architecture to assess implications of product decisions.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into actionable specifications and user stories.
Mentor junior product team members and support onboarding and capability-building initiatives.
Ensure team alignment with organizational policies, standards, and development frameworks.

5-7 years of relevant work experience

Proficiency in Office 365, MS Azure, and Agile Collaboration tools.

Experience mentoring junior team members.

title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
*TL;DR:* If you:

*

are insatiably curious about industrial customer engineering use cases;

*

enjoy acting as the conduit between customer use case discovery and rapid product feature building;

*

have owned complex AI deployments for enterprise customers;

*

are technically fluent, commercially minded, and know how to grow customer accounts…

… you should apply for this role!

*About P-1 AI:*

At P-1 AI, we are building an AI engineer agent for the physical world named Archie. We maximize Archie’s anthropomorphism so that he fits seamlessly into existing engineering teams and workflows in the form factor of a human engineer. Archie today is at the level of a junior mechanical and electrical engineer, with quantitative intuition over the product design space and the ability to use complex engineering tools—the same tools his human teammates use. Archie's tech stack includes a custom agentic harness, structured design representation, continual skills learning, and small custom post-trained models (SFT and RLVR) using proprietary semi-synthetic training datasets and environments that create a deep competitive moat. Our ultimate aim is to build engineering ASI. We recently announced a $50 million Series A financing led by NEA, which added former General Electric CEO Jeff Immelt to our board. The round also included several AI luminaries from Anthropic and Nominal alongside our existing angel investors from Google and OpenAI.

*About the opportunity:*

As a AI Deployment Manager, you will own the discovery, success, and growth of P-1 AI’s customer relationships.

Our industrial customers are introducing an entirely new kind of worker into their engineering organizations: an AI engineer. There is no playbook for this yet and we want you to help build it.

You'll work with customers to find where Archie can have the most impact, then work alongside our FDEs to make those deployments successful.

*About the role:*

*

Own the day-to-day success of deployments, working with customers and FDEs to unblock issues, manage priorities, and make sure Archie is delivering peak value.

*

Capture customer feedback and emergent use cases in formal specifications to directly drive feature implementation and product development.

*

Serve as a voice of the customer in internal product roadmapping and prioritization discussions.

*

Drive customer expansion by finding the next teams and use cases for Archie within existing accounts and across industry.

*

Spend considerable time on-site with customers and key stakeholders.

*About you:*

*

Experience in customer-facing roles with direct responsibility for AI deployments to enterprise customers.

*

Equally comfortable diving into the technical details of a customer use case or engineering tool use pattern, and how it translates into commercial value for a customer.

*

Thrive in a face paced environment, preferably with experience at a fast-growing startup.

*

Willingness to spend approximately 25% of time at customer sites, increasing to 50-60% during discovery, deployment, and other critical phases.

*

Direct experience and domain knowledge in data center engineering, automotive, or aerospace and defense is a plus.

*Location:*

Remote (US/Canada) or in-office in San Mateo, CA. Remote employees spend one week out of six working together in our San Mateo office. Relocation support available.

*Compensation & Benefits:*

Competitive base salary, material performance based variable bonus, meaningful equity ownership, healthcare, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and unlimited PTO.

*Interview process:*

*

Introductory call (30 mins)

*

Biographical/behavioural interview (45 mins)

*

Case study interview (60 mins)

*

CEO interview (30 mins)

title: Senior Software Engineer (Azure & Internal Business Applications)
location: Remote, San José, San José Province, cr
description:
The Senior Software Engineer – Azure & Internal Business Applications is a hands-on senior engineering role responsible for designing, building, modernizing, and supporting internal business applications on the Microsoft Azure platform. This role partners closely with business teams, analysts, junior developers, and fusion development partners to turn business needs, prototypes, and early-stage tools into scalable, secure, maintainable enterprise-grade applications.

This person must be able to move from ideation and requirements clarification through solution architecture, front-end and back-end development, deployment, support transition, and ongoing product improvement. The role requires strong full-stack engineering capability, practical Azure cloud development experience, disciplined source control and release practices, and the ability to maintain coding standards across internal and external contributors.

In addition to writing production-quality code, this role provides technical leadership, code review, architecture guidance, and day-to-day mentoring for junior developers, analysts, and fusion development partners. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a business-facing environment where internal software development, workflow redesign, automation, AI enablement, and enterprise supportability all need to come together.

Key Responsibilities Include

* Design, develop, and maintain internal business applications using Microsoft Azure services and modern full-stack engineering practices.
* Own solution design from concept through implementation, including application architecture, data flow, integration patterns, security considerations, deployment approach, and long-term supportability.
* Build modern front-end experiences using React, TypeScript/JavaScript, reusable components, and API-driven application patterns.
* Develop and maintain back-end services, REST APIs, serverless functions, integrations, and cloud-native application components using Azure-native services and modern development frameworks.
* Partner with business teams, analysts, and citizen/fusion developers to evaluate early-stage tools, prototypes, and business-created applications, then refactor, harden, and scale them into reliable enterprise-grade solutions.
* Provide technical leadership, code review, architecture guidance, and day-to-day mentoring for junior developers, analysts, and fusion development partners.
* Establish, document, and reinforce coding standards, engineering practices, branching strategies, pull request expectations, and quality controls across assigned applications and contributors.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business problems, workflow gaps, and operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Integrate applications with enterprise systems, including ERP, CRM, data services, authentication platforms, reporting tools, document processing services, and other internal or external APIs.
* Apply secure coding practices and ensure applications are designed with appropriate identity, access control, data protection, privacy, and governance considerations.
* Use Git-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, work item tracking, and release management practices to support repeatable, controlled software delivery.
* Contribute to GitHub repository structure, access control, branch protections, pull request workflows, GitHub Actions, and platform governance practices where applicable.
* Support application monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support readiness using tools such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights, dashboards, alerts, and runbooks.
* Evaluate and apply practical AI/ML-enabled capabilities where appropriate, including prompt engineering, LLM integration patterns, document processing, classification, summarization, and AI-assisted development workflows.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture notes, deployment instructions, support runbooks, and knowledge transfer materials for applications under ownership.
* Continuously improve internal development practices by identifying reusable patterns, shared components, automation opportunities, and standards that improve quality, scalability, and delivery speed.

*Required Qualifications*

* 5+ years of professional software development experience (hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and support of production applications)
* 2+ years of experience building cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud platforms.
* Experience with React, TypeScript/JavaScript, REST APIs, and cloud-native back-end services.
* Experience designing and building scalable application architectures from business requirements, prototypes, or loosely defined problem statements.
* Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including clean code, modular design, error handling, logging, testing, maintainability, and performance considerations.
* Experience with Git-based source control, including branching, merging, pull requests, code reviews, and release coordination.
* Experience integrating applications with enterprise systems using REST APIs, event-driven patterns, messaging, data services, or other integration approaches. (CRM, ERP, Databases)
* Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Ability to communicate clearly with business stakeholders, analysts, developers, technical partners, and leadership.
* Experience with AI/ML-enabled application patterns, including prompt engineering, LLM integration, document processing, semantic search, classification, summarization, or AI-assisted software development.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Strong experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks preferred; experience with .NET/C# or comparable back-end frameworks is also helpful.
* Preferred experience with Python for AI/ML, automation, API development, or Azure-based services.
* Experience leading technical delivery for internal tools, business applications, workflow applications, automation platforms, or enterprise operational systems.
* Experience modernizing or hardening business-created applications, prototypes, low-code solutions, or lightly governed internal tools into scalable, supportable applications.
* Experience with Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, document intelligence, cognitive services, or related AI application capabilities.
* Experience working in a fusion development model with business analysts, citizen developers, process owners, and professional software engineers.
* Experience with application security, identity platforms, role-based access control, secrets management, and secure enterprise development practices.
* Experience in manufacturing, operations, resource scheduling, order management, finance, customer service, engineering, or other internal business process domains.
* GitHub platform management or administration experience, including repository governance, permissions, branch protections, GitHub Actions, pull request controls, and organization-level standards.

*Core Competencies*

* *Technical Ownership:* Takes ownership of solution quality from architecture through support, not just assigned development tasks.
* *Full-Stack Engineering Judgment:* Can evaluate front-end, back-end, data, integration, security, and deployment tradeoffs and make practical engineering decisions.
* *Architecture from Ambiguity:* Can turn loosely defined business needs, prototypes, or workflow problems into a coherent technical design and delivery approach.
* *Code Quality & Standards:* Writes clean, maintainable code and reinforces consistent engineering practices through review, coaching, documentation, and example.
* *Mentorship & Technical Leadership:* Guides junior developers, analysts, and fusion development partners in ways that improve both immediate delivery and long-term capability.
* *Business Orientation:* Understands internal business processes and builds solutions that improve how work is executed, measured, supported, and scaled.
* *Collaboration & Communication:* Works effectively across business, IT, engineering, operations, and external partner teams; explains technical concepts in practical business language.
* *AI-Enabled Delivery Mindset:* Understands how AI, automation, and application development can be combined to redesign workflows and improve productivity, quality, and speed.

*Working Conditions & Additional Information*

* This role is based in Costa Rica and supports internal stakeholders across multiple business functions and geographies.
* Some collaboration with global teams may require flexibility in working hours.
* This role is expected to work closely with internal IT teams, business process owners, analysts, external development partners, and enterprise platform teams.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.
* This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. The organization reserves the right to revise or change job duties and responsibilities as needed to support evolving business priorities, technology platforms, and operating models.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
