title: Junior Penetration Tester Internship
description:
This is a remote position.
--------------------------

The *Junior Penetration Tester Internship Program* at EncryptEdge Labs provides aspiring penetration testers with a structured, hands-on experience that covers various aspects of ethical hacking and vulnerability assessment. Over eight weeks, interns will complete projects designed to build a solid foundation in penetration testing techniques. The curriculum spans topics such as reconnaissance, system hacking, web application security, network-level attacks, and advanced exploitation techniques.

Participants will also learn post-exploitation strategies, reporting, and remediation, culminating in a Capture The Flag (CTF) challenge that tests their acquired skills. This program is ideal for those looking to kickstart a career in offensive security.

Key Responsibilities:
---------------------

* Learn and perform penetration testing techniques and methodologies.
* Set up and configure penetration testing labs and environments.
* Conduct information gathering, vulnerability scanning, and network penetration testing.
* Execute web application security testing and system hacking techniques.
* Engage in post-exploitation tasks, report writing, and remediation strategies.
* Participate in a Capture The Flag (CTF) challenge to demonstrate acquired skills.

Requirements
------------

*Core Qualities:*

* A strong passion for *offensive security* and ethical hacking.
* Ability to adhere to timelines and consistently deliver quality results.
* Exceptional *documentation skills* , capable of presenting findings clearly and professionally.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration.

*Educational and Learning Background:*

* A degree in *Computer Science* , *Information Security* , or related disciplines is preferred but not mandatory.
* Evidence of self-learning through certifications, projects, or challenges in cybersecurity.

*Foundational Knowledge:*

* Basic understanding of *network protocols* (e.g., TCP/IP, HTTP) and *operating system fundamentals* (Windows/Linux).
* Familiarity with *Linux command-line tools* and basic cybersecurity concepts is advantageous but not required.

*Certifications (Desirable):*

* *TryHackMe Jr Penetration Tester Certificate*.
* *eLearnSecurity Junior Penetration Tester (eJPT)*.
* *CompTIA Pentest+* (optional for entry-level candidates).

*Recommended Courses:*

* *Beginner’s Guide to Penetration Testing* (TryHackMe or HackTheBox).
* *Practical Ethical Hacking* by The Cyber Mentor.
* *Introduction to Web Application Security* (Udemy or Pluralsight).

*Key Skillset:*

* Proficiency in foundational *ethical hacking techniques* : reconnaissance, scanning, and exploitation.
* Basic understanding of *vulnerability scanning* and writing clear, actionable reports.
* Knowledge of *legal and ethical standards* in penetration testing.

*Technical Tool Familiarity:*

* Hands-on experience with tools like:

* *Kali Linux* , *Metasploit* , *Nmap* , and *Nikto*.
* Web security platforms such as *Burp Suite* and *OWASP ZAP*.

* Basic scripting knowledge in *Python* , *Bash* , or a similar language.

*Logistics and Preparedness:*

* Access to a *dedicated computer* and a *stable internet connection*.
* Ability to set up a secure and isolated work environment (training and support will be provided).

*Preferred Experience:*

* Practical exposure to penetration testing labs, online challenges, or project-based learning.
* Previous coursework or personal projects in ethical hacking or cybersecurity-related domains.

Benefits
--------

* *Hands-on Experience:* Gain practical knowledge and skills in network security, including traffic monitoring, intrusion detection, firewall configuration, and advanced cybersecurity practices.
* *Professional Development:* Receive guidance on career development and opportunities to build a portfolio through real-world challenges and presentations.
* *Global Exposure:* Participate in a global internship program, connecting with cybersecurity professionals from worldwide.
* *Certificate of Completion:* Earn a certificate of completion at the end of the internship, demonstrating your proficiency in network security engineering.
* *Letter of Experience:* Interns who successfully complete the program will also receive a letter of experience, outlining the skills and competencies developed during the internship.
* *Letter of Recommendation:* Outstanding interns will receive personalized letters of recommendation from EncryptEdge Labs.
* *Remote Learning:* Enjoy the flexibility of a remote internship that allows you to work from anywhere.
* *Mentorship:* Access support from experienced mentors and cybersecurity experts throughout the internship.
* *Job Opportunities:* Top-performing interns may be recommended for job placements through our network of partners and clients, helping you advance your career in network security.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
*Who We Are:*

We build infrastructure that delivers massive amounts of web data to the companies training the world’s most powerful AI models.

We're the team that helps to power and support Grass, a bandwidth-sharing network that lets us operate a massive distributed crawler, giving us unique access to high-quality public web data at global scale. On top of that, we’ve built pipelines for ingesting, segmenting, and annotating billions of videos, transcripts, and audio files, powering dataset creation for frontier labs.

We’re lean, technical, and move fast. No red tape, no slow decision-making; just a team of builders pushing to expand what’s possible for open web data and AI.

*The Role:*

We're looking for an early-career software engineer to help review our applications and ensure they meet compliance requirements before release. You'll be trusted to investigate application behavior independently, exercise sound judgment when identifying potential compliance issues, and take ownership of problems from discovery through resolution.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, quality assurance, and compliance validation. You'll review product changes, investigate application behavior, identify potential compliance issues, document findings clearly, and work closely with engineering and operations teams to drive issues through resolution and verify that they’ve been properly addressed before deployment.

*Please Note: This role requires a work schedule that overlaps sufficiently with EST business hours (online until 3:00 p.m. EST) to collaborate effectively with the team.*

*Who You Are:*

*

You have hands-on programming experience with Rust and/or Java — even if limited.

*

You're a fast learner who can pick up unfamiliar systems, applications, and requirements quickly.

*

You have strong analytical instincts — you naturally notice inconsistencies and dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does.

*

You communicate findings clearly and professionally, both in writing and in conversation.

*

You take ownership: once you're given a problem, you see it through rather than waiting for direction at every step.

*

You're comfortable with ambiguity and change — you don't need a fixed checklist to know what to investigate next.

*

You enjoy working closely with engineering, product, and operations, and you don't need a narrowly defined lane to be effective.

*What You'll Be Doing:*

*

Review applications before release to ensure they meet defined requirements and identify potential compliance issues.

*

Understand and investigate application behavior in order to identify technical or compliance-related problems.

*

Validate application changes and document findings clearly.

*

Provide actionable feedback and communicate issues effectively to engineering and operations teams.

*

Work with engineers to understand and resolve identified issues.

*

Verify that issues have been properly addressed before release.

*

Maintain review documentation and contribute to improving internal review processes.

*

Help improve and, where appropriate, automate validation and QA workflows.

*What We Are Looking For:*

*

Develop a deeper understanding of our applications and systems over time and take increasing ownership of the review process.

*

Help ensure a consistent, high-quality release process across products.

*

Programming experience in Rust and/or Java (early-career level is fine — we care more about how quickly you learn and think through problems).

*

Experience in a startup or small engineering team, particularly where you had broad responsibilities.

*

Exposure to QA, testing, product validation, compliance, or security.

*

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

*

Ability to manage multiple reviews or tasks in parallel without losing track of details.

*Why Work With Us:*

*

Opportunity. We are at the forefront of developing a web-scale crawler and knowledge graph that improves access to public web data and extends the value of AI to the people.

*

Culture. We're a lean team with a high bar. We come to work not to be comfortable, but to find out what we're capable of and to do work that matters. We're not calling for people who keep things moving. We're calling for people who make everyone around them better.
We prioritize low ego and high output. This is a fully remote team.

*

Compensation. You’ll receive a competitive salary, benefits and equity package.

title: Junior Software Engineer (Integrations)
description:
Junior Integrations Engineer 🌱
------------------------------

*Live Platform Maintenance · Deep System Learning · Pragmatic Development*

At CO3, we are standing up a new engineering team to take technical ownership of an active, production-grade logistics platform. We are looking for a Junior Integrations Engineer whose primary focus will be keeping our live integration pipelines healthy and operational—troubleshooting issues, maintaining data feeds, and supporting production—while progressively taking on new development tasks as domain knowledge grows.

🚀 Why this role?
----------------

* *Learn by Maintaining Real Systems:* There is no better teacher than production code. By handling maintenance, monitoring, and bug fixes first, you'll gain a deep, practical understanding of how complex, distributed systems actually behave.
* *Support as a Launchpad:* Operational support is your primary responsibility day-to-day, serving as the foundation for your transition into designing and writing new integration features over time.
* *Direct Mentorship:* You won't be thrown into the deep end alone. Senior Engineers and a Tech Lead will back you up on difficult operational issues and guide your technical growth.

🎯 Your mission
--------------

* *Deconstruct & Maintain:* Deeply analyze existing integration pipelines and telematics feeds, keeping them stable, reliable, and performant in production.
* *Tackle Multiple Integrations:* Work across diverse integration styles (REST, streaming/Kafka, webhooks, batch, message queues, vendor protocols) and keep high data quality.
* *Build Tooling & Frameworks:* Design reusable frameworks and internal developer tooling so the team can scale to thousands of feeds without increasing operational overhead.
* *Design for Scale & Resilience:* Build for high throughput, back-pressure handling, retries, and data integrity across distributed data streams.
* *Modernize & Unify:* Step-by-step refactor and transition legacy integration flows into CO3's unified, event-driven platform architecture.
* *Work AI-Native:* Utilize modern AI tooling to rapidly navigate existing integration codebases, streamline refactoring, and raise development velocity.
* *Primary Focus:* Support & Maintenance - Monitor live integration feeds, investigate data flow failures, debug broken connections, and resolve production support tickets to keep platform data reliable.
* *Secondary Focus:* Development & Refactoring -As you master system behaviour, write bug fixes, refactor legacy integrations, and build new endpoints or automation scripts.
* *Troubleshoot Diverse Integration Styles:* Dig into REST APIs, Webhooks, ETL pipelines, batch/file transfers (CSV, XML, JSON), and event streams (Kafka) to identify where data gets stuck.
* *Improve Runbooks & Tooling:* Document failure modes, write diagnostic scripts, and help refine internal developer tools to make future support easier.
* *Work AI-Native:* Utilize AI tools to rapidly navigate legacy code, parse log outputs, and trace complex domain logic during troubleshooting.

🎁 What's in it for you
----------------------

*

* *Clear Growth Path:* Transition progressively from operational support and maintenance to active integration feature engineering.
* *Real Mentorship:* A supportive and experienced team that equips you with the tools, context, and guidance needed to solve live production problems.
* *True Product Environment:* One evolving, real-world logistics platform—no body-leasing, no software house routine, and a candid, "No-BS" engineering culture.
* *Flexibility:* Remote-first across Poland with an optional Wrocław office setup (Powstańców Śląskich).

*We're looking for you if:*
---------------------------

* *You have solid coding fundamentals:* Strong basics in at least one modern language (preferably Java) — we care about how you think and solve problems rather than syntax memorization.
* *Investigative & Problem-Solving Mindset:* You enjoy digging into logs, chasing down edge-case bugs, and figuring out why a data feed isn't behaving as expected.
* *Comfortable with Support First:* You view production maintenance and live bug-fixing not as a chore, but as the fastest way to learn a real-world system.
* *Curious About Data Flows:* Eager to learn APIs, ETLs, batch processing, file protocols, and how data moves across distributed networks.
* *Clear & Transparent Communicator:* You raise flags early when stuck, ask structured questions, and keep team members updated during incident resolution.

*Bonus points*

* Basic familiarity with SQL, log monitoring tools, Kafka, or cloud platforms (AWS/GCP).
* Prior experience in IT support, application maintenance, or customer-facing technical support.
* Side projects or academic work involving data parsing, APIs, or data pipelines.

title: Junior Application Security Engineer Internship

title: Junior Research Scientist (Risk Team)
description:
We are looking for a *Junior Research Scientist* to work on foundation models for financial data. Several of them already run in production on bureau, transactional and graph data; your work is to extend that line to new data domains and new downstream tasks — credit risk, acquisition, anti-fraud, LTV forecasting.

We work with Python, PyTorch, MLFlow, AWS, Snowflake and modern AI coding tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex and Cursor.

This is a great opportunity for someone at the *beginning of their career* and who wants to work on large-scale, technically challenging projects.

-------------------------
Challenges that await you
-------------------------

* Train self-supervised models on discrete sequences to beat the SOTA and achieve business impact in downstream tasks across Plata, such as: credit risk, transaction anti-fraud, acquisition and LTV forecasting.
* Stay on top of SOTA research, applying the latest NLP and DL techniques to fintech models.
* Work with large multimodal datasets: tabular, behavioral, transactional, device and network, text, time series, graphs.
* Optimize the utilization of compute resources for both training and inference.
* Own and develop solutions end-to-end, from idea to data collection to experiments to training runs to inference optimization to evaluating impact.
* Perform rigorous evaluations.
* Write articles and speak at industry conferences.

--------------------------
What makes you a great fit
--------------------------

* Education: mathematics, engineering, computer science, artificial intelligence or another strong quantitative field.
* Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, with hands-on experience building and experimenting with models using PyTorch and LLMs.
* Understanding of dataset design and data mixing for deep learning training.
* Demonstrated understanding of how to maximize the utilization of compute resources and efficiently perform experiments to validate research ideas.
* Solid communication skills.
* High autonomy and ownership.

-----------------
Your bonus skills
-----------------

* Published research in machine learning or deep learning.
* Personal projects or startup experience in AI, machine learning or deep learning.
* Internship experience in research, ML or DL teams.
* B1 or higher English level for effective communication with an international team.

-------------------
Our ways of working
-------------------

* *Innovative Spirit:* A commitment to creativity and groundbreaking solutions.
* *Honest Feedback:* valuing open, transparent communication.
* *Supportive Team:* a strong, collaborative community.

Our benefits

title: Junior Software Engineer | Payment (m/w/d)
description:
*Deine Mission*

Wir suchen dich als *Junior Software Engineer (m/w/d)* zur Verstärkung unseres schlagkräftigen Payment-Teams – in Hamburg oder zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands.

Du hast Lust, deine Software-Engineering-Skills in der Praxis einzusetzen, Neues zu lernen und dabei Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Bei instellix arbeitest du an echten Produkt- und Kundenanforderungen mit. Dabei lassen wir dich nicht allein: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Kollegen und Kolleginnen zusammen, kannst Fragen stellen, Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit deinem Team gute Lösungen entwickeln.

In unserem Payment-Development-Team dreht sich alles um die Abwicklung und Verarbeitung von Zahlungsflüssen. Dazu gehören unter anderem die Integration von Payment Service Providern, die Verarbeitung von Settlements, das Management offener Posten sowie das Mahnwesen und Inkasso. Dabei erwarten dich abwechslungsreiche fachliche Herausforderungen und ein technologisch anspruchsvolles Umfeld.

*Was gehört dazu?*

*

Du implementierst und betreust die Microservices der Payment-Domäne bei instellix unter Verwendung von Java, Spring Boot, Gradle und Kubernetes.

*

Du arbeitest im Backend mit relationalen und NoSQL-Datenbanken und im Frontend mit React, TypeScript und Material UI, um komplexe Zahlungsprozesse effizient und sicher bearbeiten zu lassen.

*

Du folgst den Clean Code Prinzipien für die Erweiterbarkeit und Lesbarkeit unseres Quellcodes – besonders dort, wo Geldflüsse und Zustandswechsel keinen Interpretationsspielraum erlauben.

*

Durch Tracking, Alerts und Monitoring findest du technische Probleme, bevor sie beim Kunden sichtbar werden – etwa wenn die Verarbeitung von Zahlungsanweisungen, eingehenden Settlements oder Webhook-Calls fehlschlägt.

*

Du unterstützt unsere Nutzenden und dem Customer Support bei technischen Problemen und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen schnell und pragmatisch eine Lösung.

*

Du hast ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und sorgst mit automatisierten Tests auf den relevanten Teststufen für eine nachhaltige Weiterentwicklung unseres Produkts.

*

Du beschäftigst dich mit dem Betrieb unserer Plattform-Services in den Clouds von Microsoft Azure und Amazon AWS – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren DevOps.

*Das bringst du mit*

Du hast Spaß daran, Software zu entwickeln, möchtest dein Wissen in der Praxis einsetzen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterentwickeln. Du interessierst dich für digitale Zahlungs- und Finanzprozesse und hast Lust, dich in neue fachliche Themen einzuarbeiten. Dabei musst du kein Finanz- oder Buchhaltungsexperte sein. Entscheidend sind deine Neugier, Lernbereitschaft und Freude daran, gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lösungen zu entwickeln. Schritt für Schritt baust du dabei dein Wissen aus und übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung.

*

Du hast erste berufliche Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie mindestens solide Java-Kenntnisse. Vielleicht hast du bereits mit Spring Boot und weiteren Technologien aus unserem Tech-Stack gearbeitet.

*

Erste Berührungspunkte im Payment-, Fintech- oder Integrationsumfeld erleichtern deinen Einstieg. Wenn du bereits mit Zahlungsdienstleistern wie Adyen, Stripe oder anderen gearbeitet hast, ist das hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung.

*

Du interessierst dich für saubere Systemarchitekturen und hast Interesse dich in Domain-Driven Design, Microservices und hexagonaler Architektur einzuarbeiten – idealerweise bringst du bereits praktische Erfahrung damit mit.

*

Du bist wissbegierig und hinterfragst bestehenden Code, um langfristig wartbare Lösungen zu schaffen, und möchtest dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

*

Wir stellen dir moderne KI-Tools als Sparringspartner in deinem Entwicklungsalltag zur Verfügung. Du probierst gerne neue KI-gestützte Ansätze aus und nutzt sie, um effizienter zu arbeiten und bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln. Die Verantwortung für das Ergebnis bleibt dabei bei stets dir.

*

Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (min. B2) und gutes Englisch.

*Was wir zu bieten haben*

*

*Work-Life-Balance* – Mit 100 % Remote-Arbeit innerhalb Deutschlands, der Möglichkeit zu Workation im EU Ausland und sehr flexiblen Arbeitszeiten ohne Kernzeiten kannst du Privatleben und Beruf optimal miteinander vereinbaren.

*

*Modernes Equipment* – Wir bieten dir leistungsstarke Laptops mit deinem Lieblingsbetriebssystem sowie eine hochwertige Ausstattung für dein Mobile Office, damit du von überall aus produktiv arbeiten kannst.

*

*Weiterbildung* – Deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung ist uns wichtig. Deshalb unterstützen wir dich mit einem individuellen Budget für Weiterbildungen, Konferenzen, Trainings oder Fachliteratur.

*

*Firmen-Fitness* – Mit unserem Zuschuss zu Sport- und Fitnessangeboten unterstützen wir dich dabei, aktiv zu bleiben und einen gesunden Ausgleich zum Arbeitsalltag zu schaffen.

*

*Monatliche Pauschale* - Fürs mobile Arbeiten von zu Hause beteiligen wir uns an deinen laufenden Kosten (Strom & Internet).

*

*Betriebliche Altersvorsorge* – Wir unterstützen dich bei deiner Altersvorsorge, damit du schon heute entspannt an morgen denken kannst.

*

*Mitarbeiter-werben-Mitarbeiter-Programm* – Wenn du Menschen kennst, die gut zu uns passen, freuen wir uns über deine Empfehlung und belohnen erfolgreiche Vermittlungen mit einer attraktiven Prämie.

*

*Freiraum* – Gemeinsam mit deinem Team erhältst du den Raum, deine Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.

*

*Teamevents* – Auch wenn wir über ganz Deutschland verteilt sind, kommen wir bei regelmäßigen Teamevents zusammen.

*

*Weitere Infos* zum Arbeiten bei uns findest du hier.

*Deine Ansprechpartner*

Lina, Nils & Thorsten

[email protected]

title: Junior Technical Integration Manager
description:
The company
-----------

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

*We’re looking for a Junior Technical Integration Manager in our Partnerships team (Hybrid in London, UK).*

Partners send us thousands of small businesses each month looking for finance, using our Lending API embedded in the apps those businesses already use. You’ll be the person who makes those integrations work: guiding partners’ developers through the build, fixing what breaks, and turning what partners need — and what we learn from them — into what we build next. You don’t need to arrive with extensive experience of debugging API’s, but you do need to be curious and open to learning whatever it takes to help partners.

The team
--------

The Partnerships team puts iwoca’s lending inside the platforms small businesses already use — banking apps, accounting software, payment providers and comparison sites— through our Lending API. Partners range from recognisable global names to one-person businesses, and each one needs its integration to work differently. The team’s job is to grow those partnerships and to keep the journey from a partner’s app to a funded loan as short as it can be. You will also work very closely with our Partner Flow team, who build and maintain the Lending API and any features partners need.

The role
--------

You’ll be the main contact for partners’ developers, helping them with all things API. You’ll need to be curious, meticulous, and happy working under your own steam.

*Mastery: become the person who knows the Lending API best*

*

Learn the Lending API end to end — every endpoint, webhook and failure mode.

*

Guide a partner’s engineers from sandbox, to live and any ongoing optimisations. Shaping the integration they build along the way.

*

Review partner customer journeys and tell them what to change to get more businesses funded.

*

Triage live integration issues, trace them through the logs and code, and work with Partner Flow engineers on the fix.

*Influence: turn what partners tell you into what we build*

*

Own the technical relationship with each partner, from their engineers to their commercial leads.

*

Pitch new API features to partners alongside our commercial team, and make the case for why they’d move the numbers.

*

Be the partners’ voice inside iwoca — collect what they need and push it onto the roadmap.

*Ownership: run the systems the whole partner channel depends on*

*

Build the monitoring that tells us an integration is degrading before a partner has to tell us, then analyse and investigate what’s going wrong.

*

Dig into integration performance data to find the problems nobody has reported yet.

*

Own our public API documentation and make it the reason partners choose to build with us.

The requirements
----------------

Essential:
----------

*

A degree in a technical or scientific subject — computer science, engineering, maths, physics or similar

*

An understanding and interest in how APIs work — enough to follow the logic in a partner’s integration.

*

Clear, concise communication with technical and non-technical audiences alike, and the credibility to manage a partner’s expectations.

*

An analytical approach that gets to the root of a problem, not just the symptom.

*

Commercial sense to judge which problems, and which partners, are worth your time first.

*

Comfortable using AI tools to investigate, analyse and get to answers faster.

Bonus:
------

*

Experience in a partner-facing or customer-facing technical role.

*

Experience reading API documentation or debugging an integration yourself, even on a side project.

*

Basic coding experience.
------------------------

The salary
----------

We expect to pay £32,500 - £37,500 (+20% quarterly OTE bonus) for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture
-----------

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices
-----------

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

*

Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

*

Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits
------------

*

Flexible working hours.
-----------------------

*

Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

*

A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

*

A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

*

25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

*

A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

*

Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

*

3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

*

An employee equity incentive scheme.
------------------------------------

*

Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

*

Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

*

Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

*

A learning and development budget for everyone.

*

Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

*

Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Junior Generative AI Engineer
description:
--------
Overview
--------

Cleary Gottlieb is a pioneer in globalizing the legal profession. We have 14 offices in major financial centers around the world, but we operate as a single, integrated global partnership and not as a U.S. firm with a network of overseas locations. The firm employs approximately 1,100 lawyers from more than 50 countries.

Since 1946 our lawyers and staff have worked across practices, industries, jurisdictions, and continents to provide clients with simple, actionable approaches to their most complex legal and business challenges, whether domestic or international. We support every client relationship with intellectual agility, commercial acumen, and a human touch.

We're an internal team at Cleary Gottlieb building bespoke AI solutions for legal work, drawing on software engineering, data science, and deep domain expertise. We work at the boundary of enterprise-grade software, and we are regularly building services and applications nobody here has built before. That makes for a dynamic learning environment — and one where a junior engineer will gain exposure to real-world AI systems from day one.

We are a tight-knit, remote-first team that values growth, honesty, and curiosity. We work collaboratively across multiple disciplines — engineering, data science, legal domain experts, and product — to deliver meaningful impact. Junior engineers are paired with experienced mentors and participate in structured code reviews, pair-programming sessions, and weekly knowledge-sharing stand-ups.

You'll join the AI Acceleration Team as a Junior Generative AI Engineer, reporting to the Data Science Manager and working day to day with our engineers, data scientists, and legal domain experts. Nobody arrives knowing legal workflows or our exact stack — curiosity and an appetite for increasing responsibility count for more here than the length of a CV.

----------------
Responsibilities
----------------

*The Role:*

Under the guidance of senior engineers, you'll help prototype, build, test, and deploy LLM-powered products that extract intelligence from complex legal documents and deliver measurable accuracy improvements. Bring a solid foundation in software engineering and genuine enthusiasm for AI — we'll ask about projects you've worked on (personal, academic, or professional) where you used AI or ML tools: what you built, what you learned, and what you'd do differently.

*What you’ll be doing:*

* *Contribute to production AI systems* : Under the guidance of senior engineers, help build, test, and improve LLM-powered document analysis features (extraction, classification, risk flagging) that serve lawyers daily
* *Data Preparation & Engineering:* Help clean, structure, and label legal data to power our AI systems — building the data pipelines that make models work well in practice
* *Build features within agent workflows* : Implement bounded components of multi-step AI workflows for legal tasks (e.g. due diligence, contract review) — writing tool integrations, prompt chains, and retrieval logic under the supervision of senior engineers
* *Support evaluation, quality, and performance:* Write test cases, contribute to automated eval pipelines, and help maintain regression suites. Gain exposure to model selection, token budgets, caching strategies, and the guardrails (output filters, PII redaction) that keep production AI systems reliable
* *Collaborate with lawyers, engineers, and product:* Participate in cross-functional sessions to understand legal workflows, contribute to acceptance criteria, and iterate based on user feedback and evaluation results

*How We'll Support You:*

We believe in building engineers, not just hiring them. As a junior member of the team, you'll receive:

* *Dedicated mentor:* A senior engineer assigned as your day-to-day mentor for at least your first six months — available for architecture discussions, code review, and career guidance
* *Structured onboarding:* A 90-day onboarding plan covering our stack, legal domain fundamentals, and AI evaluation practices so you're never left guessing what to learn next
* *Pair programming:* Regular pair-programming sessions with senior engineers on production features — the fastest way to absorb patterns, tooling, and judgement
* *Code review as learning:* Every pull request receives a thorough, constructive review. You'll also review others' code early on, reading good code is one of the best ways to write it
* *AI safety and bias training:* Guided training on identifying non-deterministic failure modes, prompt injection risks, bias in LLM outputs, and the responsible-AI practices that govern our systems
* *Growth path:* A clear progression framework from Junior to Mid-Level to Senior, with regular check-ins, stretch goals, and the opportunity to take on increasing ownership as your skills develop

--------------
Qualifications
--------------

*What We Need You To Have:*

* Some software development experience (internships, co-ops, or substantial academic/personal projects count), including hands-on exposure to LLM/GenAI tools or APIs and some experience working with text data (parsing PDFs or HTML, basic text processing, or using an LLM for extraction or classification)
* Solid Python skills and comfort with basic SQL. Conceptual understanding of how RAG pipelines work, with ideally some hands-on experience. Familiarity with at least one LLM API (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar). Exposure to an orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or a vector database is a plus
* Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) and an understanding of how to evaluate generative AI outputs (accuracy, faithfulness, hallucination). You don't need deep expertise in either area, but you should understand the fundamentals and be willing to learn
* Strong communication skills: ability to explain what you've built, ask good questions, and clearly describe problems and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical teammates

**

*Nice to Have:*

* Experience in a hackathon, open-source project, or fast-paced team environment where you shipped working software quickly
* A degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Computational Linguistics, or a related quantitative field
* Hands-on experience with a vector database or retrieval system (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, FAISS)
* Curiosity about model-serving infrastructure (vLLM, TGI) or how open-source models are deployed — you don't need production experience, but interest matters
* Any exposure to legal tech, compliance tech, or other regulated industries where accuracy and auditability are critical
* A personal blog, portfolio project, or open-source contribution demonstrating your interest in NLP, information retrieval, or generative AI
* Interest in or coursework on knowledge graphs, ontologies, or semantic reasoning
* Any experience with Spark, Databricks, or data pipeline tooling

title: UI\UX Designer
description:
Ми у пошуках ініціативного дизайнера з гострим оком на деталі, який не чекає вказівок, а сам бачить, де можна зробити краще. Якщо вас захоплює складна анімація, сильний візуал і креативний підхід до UI — ми чекаємо на ваше портфоліо.

Кого ми шукаємо

Нам потрібна людина із сильним візуальним чуттям та креативним підходом до UI: вміння створювати дизайн зі складними анімаціями і розуміння того, як їх реалізувати на практиці. Окремо цінуємо досвід або щирий інтерес до UX/UI дизайну ігор.

Що потрібно вміти

Вільне володіння Figma — це базова вимога.
Готовність підхопити вже існуючі проєкти, вникнути в контекст і самостійно покращувати їх.
Вміння будувати дизайн-системи з нуля або розвивати наявні.
Активне використання AI-інструментів та вайбкодінгу у щоденній роботі — не просто цікавість, а вже вбудований у процеси робочий інструмент.
Вміння створювати прототипи, візуалізації та продумані користувацькі сценарії.
Навички роботи з анімацією в дизайні.

Що пропонуємо
Можливість розвиватися в різних напрямках дизайну: мобільні додатки, великі продукти, крипто-проєкти, ігри, креативні лендінги зі складними анімаціями.
Конкурентоспроможну заробітну плату, що виплачується своєчасно.
Перегляд зарплати залежно від результатів роботи.
Гнучкий робочий графік.
Сучасне обладнання для ефективної роботи.
Корпоративну культуру з регулярними корпоративними заходами.

title: Visual Designer, Marketing
description:
*OUR MISSION*

We exist to create a more connected, compassionate, and confident experience for people with cancer and those who care for them. We make it easier to get answers, access high-quality care quickly, and feel supported throughout treatment and beyond.

Today, Thyme Care is a market-leading value-based oncology care enabler, partnering with national and regional health plans, providers, and employers to deliver better outcomes and lower costs for thousands of people across the country. Our model combines high-touch human support with powerful technology and AI to bring together everyone involved in a person’s cancer journey: caregivers, oncologists, health plans, and employers.

As a tech-native organization, we believe technology should strengthen the human connection at the center of care. Through data science, automation, and AI, we simplify complexity, improve collaboration, and help care teams focus on what matters most: supporting people through cancer.

Looking ahead, our vision is bold: to become a household name in cancer care, where every person diagnosed asks for Thyme Care by name. If you’re inspired to make cancer care more human and to help reimagine what’s possible, we’d love to meet you. Together, we can build a future where every person with cancer feels truly cared for, in every moment that matters.

*WHAT YOU’LL DO*

Thyme Care’s brand is growing quickly—and so is our need for thoughtful, effective creativity that brings greater clarity and humanity to cancer care. As a Visual Designer on the Marketing team, you’ll help shape how our brand shows up across campaigns, channels, and experiences. Your work will help people understand who we are, what we offer, and how Thyme Care can make a meaningful difference in their lives.

You’ll translate ideas, creative briefs, and strategic direction into clear, engaging visual experiences for diverse audiences. Working closely with Marketing, Communications, and cross-functional partners, you’ll create campaigns, digital experiences, and meaningful brand moments. This is a hands-on role for a thoughtful designer with strong visual craft, sound judgment, and the ability to independently manage defined projects within an established brand system.

*Design and Creative Execution*
-------------------------------

*

Own the design and production of marketing campaigns, digital assets, social content, presentations, and experiential materials.

*

Translate creative briefs, marketing strategies, and established direction into thoughtful, effective deliverables.

*

Apply Thyme Care’s visual system consistently across digital and print materials while identifying opportunities to strengthen the work.

*

Collaborate with writers, marketers, and communications partners to align visual design and messaging.

*

Manage projects from initial concept through final production, seeking guidance when work involves greater complexity or ambiguity.

*Brand Stewardship*
-------------------

*

Apply Thyme Care’s visual identity consistently across channels, audiences, and formats.

*

Partner with senior creative team members to extend the design system as new needs, programs, and campaigns emerge.

*

Maintain a high standard of craft across typography, layout, imagery, and production.

*

Identify and help resolve inconsistencies in how the brand is expressed.

*Campaign and Channel Design*
-----------------------------

*

Create assets for paid media, email, web, social, and other marketing channels that balance creativity, clarity, accessibility, and performance.

*

Support key internal and external moments, including company events, conferences, and executive presentations.

*

Turn data, care experiences, and impact stories into visuals that make complex information easier to understand.

*

Adapt creative concepts across formats while maintaining the integrity of the original idea.

*Collaboration and Process*
---------------------------

*

Work closely with partners across Marketing and Communications, including Growth, Enrollment, Engagement, and Product Marketing.

*

Participate actively in creative reviews, incorporating feedback thoughtfully and explaining design decisions clearly.

*

Balance multiple projects and deadlines while communicating progress, risks, and dependencies.

*

Contribute to templates, documentation, and workflows that help the team work more efficiently and consistently.

*

Share knowledge and constructive feedback that strengthen the work of the broader creative team.

*WHAT YOU’VE DONE*

*

You have 4+ years of professional design experience, ideally within a brand, marketing, or communications team.

*

Your portfolio demonstrates strong visual storytelling, typography, layout, and multi-channel brand design.

*

You have created digital materials—including web, social, email, and presentations—as well as print or physical collateral.

*

You have a strong working knowledge of brand systems and can create varied, engaging work within established guidelines.

*

You can independently own well-defined projects from concept through final production.

*

You demonstrate sound design judgment and are open to feedback, collaboration, and continued growth.

*

You are highly organized and able to balance multiple priorities and timelines.

*

You have experience partnering with marketers, writers, and other stakeholders to translate goals and creative direction into effective design.

*

You are proficient in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Google Workspace, and collaboration tools such as Asana and Slack.

*

Experience in healthcare, digital health, or another mission-driven organization is a plus.

*WHAT LEADS TO SUCCESS*

*Act with our members in mind.* You approach design with empathy and care, recognizing that the work may reach people navigating one of the most difficult periods of their lives. You create experiences that feel clear, accessible, inclusive, and human.

*Strong visual craft.* You bring a strong foundation in typography, layout, imagery, hierarchy, and visual storytelling. You care about the details and consistently produce polished, thoughtful work across digital and physical formats.

*Brand fluency.* You understand how to work creatively within an established brand system. You can maintain consistency while thoughtfully adapting and extending the system as new audiences, channels, and needs emerge.

*Move with purpose.* You can prioritize effectively, move projects forward, and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment. You communicate early when priorities, timelines, or dependencies need to be clarified.

*Seek diverse perspectives.* You actively invite input from partners with different experiences and areas of expertise. You incorporate feedback thoughtfully and understand that stronger creative work comes from collaboration.

*Clear communication and ownership.* You can explain the thinking behind your design decisions, ask thoughtful questions, and translate feedback into action. You take responsibility for your work from concept through final production while knowing when to seek additional guidance.

*Comfort with iteration and ambiguity.* You are comfortable working through evolving briefs, shifting priorities, and imperfect information. You remain flexible, curious, and focused on finding the strongest path forward.

*OUR VALUES*

At Thyme Care, our core values guide us in everything we do: Act with our members in mind, Move with purpose, and Seek diverse perspectives. They anchor our business decisions, including how we grow, the products we make, and the paths we choose—or don’t choose.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of the total compensation package that also includes equity, benefits, and other opportunities at Thyme Care. Individual pay decisions are based on several factors, including qualifications, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to other Thyme Care employees. The base salary for this role is $110,500 - $130,000. The salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired at another level.

We recognize a history of inequality in healthcare. We’re here to challenge the status quo and create a culture of inclusion through the care we give and the company we build. We embrace and celebrate a diversity of perspectives in reflection of our members and the members we serve. We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Be cautious of recruitment fraud , and always confirm that communications are coming from an official Thyme Care email.

title: Senior UI Designer I
description:
------------
Role Summary
------------

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As a Senior UI Designer I on the Digital Design team, you’ll shape the visual direction of major digital experiences, turning complex problems into clear, expressive, and accessible interfaces. You’ll move between concept and craft, from establishing visual direction to refining high-fidelity interactions and evolving reusable design systems. You’ll also explore AI-assisted design and creative tools to accelerate the work while keeping strong design judgment, user needs, accessibility, and brand principles at the center.

--------------
What You’ll Do

* Lead visual design direction for major Marketing projects and digital experiences from early concepts through implementation and launch.

* Develop reusable design systems, component patterns, and UI standards that improve consistency, accessibility, and team efficiency.
* Create high-fidelity prototypes that clearly communicate complex flows, responsive behaviors, transitions, and interaction intent.

description:
*Make your mark as a Graphic Designer in the fast-moving world of science and technology communications.*

Where bold aesthetics meet complex ideas, the most compelling brands are built by designers who think as well as they draw. This is a remote Graphic Designer (Brand & Digital) role for someone ready to own their craft within a small, international agency shaping how frontier industries present themselves to the world.

*About the Agency*

This is a marketing and communications agency working at the intersection of science, technology and commercial storytelling. The team partners with startups and scale-ups in deep tech and emerging industries translating highly technical concepts into visual identities and brand communications that attract investors and customers alike. Remote-first with a genuinely international outlook, the culture prizes curiosity, aesthetic sharpness and creative initiative over hierarchy or micromanagement.

*The Graphic Designer Role*

The Graphic Designer (Brand & Digital) sits at the heart of how this agency delivers for its clients. From brand identity builds through to digital touchpoints, presentations and web assets, you will contribute across the full range of visual work, bringing both craft and ideas to every project. This is a role with real variety and real ownership, suited to someone who wants more than a production seat.

*Here's what you'll be doing:*

* Developing brand identities and visual systems from initial concept through to full rollout
* Producing polished assets across web, social, presentations and print for a portfolio of frontier-industry clients
* Supporting website design and contributing to builds in Webflow, Squarespace or similar platforms
* Structuring brand guidelines and scalable design systems that clients can grow with
* Integrating AI-assisted tools into your workflow to improve speed and output quality
* Bringing proactive creative input to fast-paced client projects, not just executing briefs

*Here are the skills you'll need:*

* 3 to 5 years of graphic design experience, gained within an agency or studio environment
* A strong portfolio that demonstrates considered branding work and visual design sensibility
* Confident working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite — Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop
* Practical experience with Figma and Canva, alongside familiarity with Webflow, Squarespace or Relume
* A genuine interest in web and digital design, including UX principles and responsive layouts
* Comfortable managing your own time in a fully remote setup and navigating evolving project requirements
* An open and experimental mindset towards emerging AI design tools

*Work Permissions*

You must have the right to work in the United Kingdom. Visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

*Key perks and benefits:*

* Fully remote working with flexibility to structure your day
* Regular team meetups in London with travel and accommodation covered
* One international team trip per year
* High autonomy and genuine ownership from day one
* The opportunity to build your portfolio across genuinely novel and complex industries

*Why Build a Career in Brand and Digital Design?*

Demand for skilled Graphic Designers who can operate across brand strategy and digital execution continues to grow, particularly within the technology and innovation sectors. As companies in deep tech and frontier industries scale, the need for designers who can visualise complex ideas clearly and compellingly has never been greater. Remote-first design roles like this one are also opening access to world-class projects regardless of geography — making now an excellent time to develop your skills across both brand and digital disciplines. The Opportunity Hub UK is proud to connect ambitious creative professionals with roles that genuinely advance their careers.

description:
Unleash Your Talents with Us!

Hi there, our future *Graphic Designer!* Happy to see *YOU* here.

Here at Integrated OS, you'll be part of a team of passionate individuals who are committed to delivering exceptional offshoring services. This position suits a practical designer who enjoys variety, works quickly without losing attention to detail and is comfortable managing multiple priorities. You will be expected to take clear or incomplete briefs, ask the right questions, apply the brand consistently and deliver accurate, production-ready files.

Key responsibilities for this role include:

Print, catalogue and sales collateral

Conversion-Focused Iteration: Use listing performance data and stakeholder feedback to iterate on imagery that isn't converting.

Brand Consistency: Keep listing imagery consistent with Rosabella's brand guidelines while adapting to each retailer's format and content rules.

Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with marketplace and creative stakeholders to source product photography, claims, and messaging for use in listing images.

Asset Organization: Maintain organized, well-labeled Figma files and exported assets so images can be found and reused quickly.

----------------

description:
Job Title: Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator

Type: Independent Contractor | Part-Time/Full-Time

Location: Remote | Taiwan, China, Philippines

About Us

The Law Offices of Sabrina Li, P.C. is a leading, full-service U.S. immigration law firm with offices in Los Angeles, Pasadena, Santa Ana, and Dallas, as well as international operations across Asia, Africa, and Central and South America. We are dedicated to helping individuals, families, and businesses navigate complex legal challenges with skill, compassion, and integrity.

We are proud to be recognized as a 2025 Inc. Best Workplaces honoree, a distinction that reflects our intentional investment in our people and workplace culture. Our firm prioritizes professional development, clear career pathways, and a culture of accountability and respect—creating a workplace where high performers can build meaningful, long-term careers.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and highly organized Graphic Designer & Social Media Coordinator to develop polished visual content and help manage the firm's social media presence. This role combines hands-on design with content planning, coordination, scheduling, and quality control across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and other digital channels.

The ideal candidate has strong aesthetic judgment and can independently create professional, cohesive materials that reflect the credibility of a U.S. law firm. You will build monthly content calendars, produce and adapt graphics for multiple platforms, coordinate internal reviews and approvals, schedule content, and confirm that posts are published accurately and on time.

If you combine excellent design execution with reliable project management and thoughtful use of AI and professional design tools, you will thrive in this role.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Management

* Create professional, clean, sophisticated, and visually cohesive designs that consistently reflect the firm's brand standards.
* Design social media graphics, website banners, blog featured images, client success story graphics, Google Ads creatives, thumbnails, email marketing graphics, brochures, flyers, posters, infographics, presentations, event materials, business cards, templates, logos, and other brand assets.
* Apply strong principles of typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, color coordination, composition, and brand consistency across all deliverables.
* Adapt designs to the dimensions, formats, audiences, and presentation styles required by different digital and social media platforms.
* Create and maintain editable templates and well-organized design files and brand assets for efficient reuse and collaboration.
* Complete basic photo editing and image retouching and, where applicable, create short-form videos, Reels, captions, subtitles, and thumbnails.

Social Media Planning & Coordination

* Develop balanced monthly social media content calendars based on the firm's priorities, campaigns, legal topics, and audience needs.
* Schedule and publish content on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn using Meta Business Suite or comparable social media management tools.
* Coordinate captions, graphics, videos, deadlines, internal review, approval status, and publication dates to keep content production on schedule.
* Adapt the same core topic for each platform while maintaining consistent branding and tailoring the format and presentation to the relevant audience.
* Review spelling, formatting, images, links, dimensions, and brand consistency before publication, and confirm that scheduled content is published correctly and on time.
* Monitor basic social media performance metrics and use findings to support improvements to future content.

AI, Production & Workflow Management

* Use AI-assisted design, image-generation, and content-development tools responsibly to support ideation, production, and workflow efficiency.
* Review, edit, and refine AI-generated materials to correct inaccuracies, visual defects, inconsistent branding, and other quality concerns before submission.
* Protect confidential company and client information by following firm guidelines when using AI and other third-party platforms.
* Manage multiple assignments and deadlines, communicate progress regularly, raise potential delays in advance, and complete revisions accurately and promptly.
* Collaborate with the U.S.-based team, respond professionally to feedback, and maintain reliable communication throughout each project.

Qualifications

* At least 2 years of experience in graphic design, social media coordination, digital marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* A strong professional portfolio demonstrating excellent visual judgment, original design ability, and experience creating materials for digital and social media channels is required.
* Proficiency in Canva and Adobe Photoshop, including the ability to create and maintain editable templates, is required.
* Strong understanding of typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, color, composition, and brand consistency.
* Demonstrated experience creating monthly social media content calendars and scheduling or publishing content on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.
* Experience with Meta Business Suite or another social media scheduling platform.
* Proficiency with AI-assisted design and image-generation tools, together with the ability to independently review and refine AI-generated work.
* Basic PowerPoint design, photo-editing, and image-retouching skills; short-form video-editing skills are preferred.
* Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, or comparable professional design software is preferred.
* A degree in graphic design, visual communication, marketing, or a related field is preferred but not required for candidates with a strong portfolio and relevant practical experience.
* Experience supporting a law firm, professional-services business, healthcare organization, or another regulated industry is preferred.
* Professional working proficiency in English is required. Mandarin Chinese is strongly preferred for candidates based in Taiwan or Mainland China; Spanish is helpful but not required.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, organization, communication, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Reliable computer, internet connection, and access to the design software required to perform the role.

Why Join Our Team?

* Stable, remote opportunity to work with a well-established U.S.-based law firm that values quality, creativity, accountability, and innovation.
* Opportunity to shape and strengthen the visual identity and social media presence of a growing international firm.
* Part-time or full-time arrangement based on experience, capabilities, availability, and business needs.
* Competitive compensation based on experience, portfolio quality, schedule, and scope of responsibilities.
* Fully remote role within a diverse global team.
* Structured onboarding, clear expectations, and collaborative feedback.
* Stable, long-term opportunity with room to expand responsibilities based on performance.
* Supportive work environment built on accountability, continuous improvement, and professional development.
* Thoughtful company culture, including birthday recognitions and team appreciation initiatives.

Working Hours

This role may be offered on a part-time or full-time basis with U.S. time overlap. The final schedule will depend on the successful candidate's availability, capabilities, and scope of responsibilities and may be discussed during the final stages of the hiring process.

Application Process

Candidates may be asked to complete the following during the recruitment process:

* Resume/CV.
* A relevant professional design portfolio submitted before the first interview. Candidates should be prepared to identify the work they personally completed and explain their role in developing selected projects.
* Portfolio review and interview focused on design judgment, social media experience, AI-assisted workflows, communication, and reliability.
* A short, paid practical design assessment using the firm's branding guidelines and sample content.
* Proof of qualifications and professional references. To ensure fairness and accuracy, compensation verification may be conducted for shortlisted candidates.

Additional Information

* This is a fully remote, Asia-based role, with preference for candidates located in Taiwan, Mainland China, or the Philippines.
* Engagement is as an independent contractor; tax compliance is the contractor's responsibility.
* A 3-month probationary period will apply to support onboarding and performance alignment.
* We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, contacting our offices by phone, email, or social media regarding this position is strictly prohibited. Any inquiries about application status through these channels will result in automatic disqualification from the hiring process. Our hiring team carefully reviews every submission and will contact qualified candidates directly.

This consulting role offers the opportunity to shape digital transformation initiatives through rigorous, human-centered research and evidence-based design.
You will investigate the needs, behaviours, motivations, and experiences of staff, members, and other stakeholders across a range of digital products and services.
The role combines qualitative and quantitative research with practical collaboration across product, design, development, and transformation teams.
Your findings will directly influence product strategy, service design, usability, accessibility, and digital engagement initiatives.
You will contribute to projects spanning website experiences, member and conference participant journeys, and document management systems.
The position also provides an opportunity to establish scalable UX research practices, toolkits, and guidelines within a complex international environment.
This six-month consulting engagement is well suited to an experienced UX researcher who can independently lead studies while translating research evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.

Accountabilities
----------------

* Plan and conduct UX research using interviews, surveys, usability testing, ethnographic studies, and other appropriate qualitative and quantitative methods.
* Analyze user behaviours, needs, motivations, and experiences to identify meaningful patterns and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate research findings into actionable, evidence-based recommendations for product managers, designers, developers, and other stakeholders.
* Develop personas, user journey maps, user stories, and other research artifacts that inform digital product and service design.
* Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to ensure user insights are incorporated throughout product development and delivery.
* Facilitate participatory design activities, co-creation sessions, and workshops with staff, members, and relevant stakeholders.
* Evaluate digital experiences against usability, accessibility, and inclusive design principles and recommend improvements.
* Produce structured research plans, reports, findings, and supporting documentation from interviews, surveys, usability studies, and other research activities.
* Contribute research insights and recommendations to website redesign, member experience, conference participant experience, and document management initiatives.
* Develop and document UX research toolkits, processes, standards, and guidelines to help institutionalize user research practices across relevant teams.

*Requirements*

* At least five years of professional experience conducting UX research and applying human-centered design principles to digital product development.
* Advanced knowledge of UX research methodologies, human-centered design, and user-centered product development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and conducting usability testing, user interviews, surveys, ethnographic research, and other qualitative or quantitative studies.
* Strong ability to analyze and synthesize user data and translate findings into practical, actionable product and design recommendations.
* Proven experience developing personas, journey maps, user stories, research reports, and other UX research deliverables.
* Familiarity with accessibility standards, inclusive design, and designing digital experiences for diverse user groups.
* Excellent facilitation, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with product managers, designers, developers, transformation teams, and other multidisciplinary stakeholders.
* Experience working in international, institutional, or multi-stakeholder environments is highly desirable.
* Advanced proficiency in English, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of French is an advantage.
* Advanced university degree in Human-Computer Interaction, User Experience, Psychology, Social Sciences, or a related field, or an equivalent advanced qualification.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple research activities, and deliver high-quality outputs within defined timelines.

*Benefits*

* Consulting engagement with an initial duration of six months.
* Compensation ranging from USD 280 to USD 650 per working day, depending on professional experience.
* Home-based working arrangement.
* Opportunity to contribute to high-impact digital transformation and user experience initiatives.
* Exposure to complex international and multi-stakeholder projects.
* Opportunity to influence product strategy, service design, usability, accessibility, and digital engagement.
* Scope to establish and improve UX research practices, tools, and institutional guidelines.
* Collaboration with multidisciplinary product, design, technology, and transformation professionals.
* Potential opportunities to contribute to projects with broad organizational and stakeholder impact.

title: Senior Product Designer - Cloud Update Service
description:
--------
Overview
--------

***************************************
Senior Product Designer – Content Cloud
***************************************

*Location:* Remote – India *Work Model:* Remote – Core hours 12 PM to 8 PM IST to support collaboration with European and India

--------------
About the Role
--------------

As a Senior Product Designer on Hyland's Content Cloud team, you'll shape how customers access, organize, and manage their content across the Hyland Content Innovation Cloud (CIC) platform. You'll influence content federation across multiple repositories, along with the search and browse experiences that bring it all together — helping customers surface and act on their content with AI wherever it lives.

We're looking for a designer who thrives in complex environments, proactively identifies opportunities for greater cohesion, and takes initiative to drive meaningful impact. You'll bring a thoughtful, solutions-oriented mindset that bridges user needs with business outcomes. You'll have a strong voice in the work, and the chance to create patterns and systems that scale across teams and products. You will partner with a friendly, sharp group of designers, product managers, and engineers who are creative, thoughtful, and deeply knowledgeable in their craft.

We're a diverse, global team that values constructive debate, kindness, and inclusive collaboration. We do our best work when people bring curiosity, humility, and genuine care for one another. Some travel to Cleveland or Europe may be required.

--------------------------------------------------
Your Role Responsibilities — Here's What You'll Do
--------------------------------------------------

* Work closely with product and engineering to build alignment, translate ambiguity into clear direction, and make smart tradeoffs that address user needs and total cost of ownership.
* Partner with researchers to translate user insights and customer needs into journey maps, stories, flows, concepts, and interactive prototypes.
* Design scalable systems — creating patterns, workflows, and interaction models that hold up across teams, products, roles, and edge cases.
* Design for AI-assisted experiences, shaping how customers discover, understand, and act on their content through AI-powered search, recommendations, and content understanding — with close attention to transparency, control, and trust.
* Drive accessibility as a first-class requirement, ensuring experiences meet WCAG 2.2 AA standards by partnering with accessibility experts and engineering teams.
* Provide annotated design specifications and documentation that detail interaction behaviors and acceptance criteria, enabling efficient and accurate developer implementation.

----------------
Technology Tools
----------------

* Product Design, Figma, Material Design 3, Angular Material

--------------------------------
Role Essentials — What You Bring
--------------------------------

* *8+ years of product design experience* delivering complex enterprise software with consumer-grade usability and polish, backed by strong examples of shipped work and measurable impact.
* Proven accessibility expertise, including delivery of products meeting WCAG 2.2 AA success criteria, with experience in responsive reflow considerations and collaboration with accessibility specialists.
* Design system fluency, with experience applying and extending a component system with strong judgment around component use, consistency, and scalability.
* Proficiency with Figma, with a track record of producing interactive prototypes and clear specs that enable testing, buy-in, and ease of implementation within Agile product delivery teams.
* Strong product judgment with a proven ability to navigate tradeoffs and deliver experiences that are scalable, supportable, and efficient to build.

---------------------
What We'd Like to See
---------------------

* Experience designing AI-enabled products or model-driven experiences, with an understanding of key considerations including transparency, control, safety, bias, and quality.
* Deep expertise in Material Design 3 and/or Angular Material, with strong experience in responsive and adaptive layout design within Material Design-based ecosystems.
* High craft in UI and content, including strong visual design, interaction design, and microcopy writing that make complex workflows feel clear, approachable, and simple.
* Research-informed practice, with skill in translating qualitative and quantitative insights into flows, prototypes, and iterative product improvements.
* A pragmatic, steady approach with strong judgment, prioritization, and ownership — able to bring order to ambiguous and complex challenges.

------------
About Hyland
------------

Hyland is the pioneer of the Content Innovation Cloud™, delivering ubiquitous enterprise intelligence to organizations with solutions that unlock actionable insights and drive automation. © Hyland. All rights reserved. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, including many of the Fortune 100, Hyland's solutions create the foundation for a connected, agentic enterprise, where teams harness the power of AI to redefine how they operate and engage with those they serve. For additional information on Hyland's platform and services, please visit Hyland.com.

title: Senior eClinical Business Lead, IRT & DHT Design Consultant
description:
*About Parexel*

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

*About the Role*

We are seeking a Senior eClinical Business Lead (IRT and DHT Design Consultant). As a Senior eClinical Business Lead, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in RTSM and DHT study design, requirements analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and clinical trial optimization. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout. Responsibilities include providing expert consultation on digital health technology implementation, translating complex requirements into actionable solutions, and ensuring seamless integration across clinical trial systems.

You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through advancing clinical trial technology, improving study efficiency, and enhancing patient engagement. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior eClinical Business Lead can explore career paths and expand expertise across clinical research and digital health innovation.

*Key Responsibilities*

*

Provide expert consultation to project leaders and study teams on RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, and system configuration

*

Analyze protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements that align with study design objectives and regulatory standards

*

Identify, assess, and mitigate risks related to RTSM and DHT implementation, ensuring compliance with clinical trial processes and data integrity standards

*

Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable guidance for study teams and system users to facilitate informed decision-making

*

Evaluate system integrations and proactively identify potential issues with third-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to ensure seamless functionality

*

Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing protocols, ensuring systems meet defined requirements and business objectives

*

Stay current on emerging RTSM and DHT technologies, industry best practices, and regulatory developments to drive continuous improvement and innovation

*

Manage quality assurance and timely delivery of project deliverables while implementing corrective actions to maintain excellence

*

Interact with external clients to discuss RTSM and DHT design considerations, protocol requirements, and implementation strategies

*

Demonstrate proactive problem-solving and deliver timely, effective solutions to client challenges and technical issues

*Candidate Profile*

*You'll thrive in this role if you bring:*

*

Deep expertise in RTSM and DHT systems, clinical trial design, and requirements management

*

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with the capacity to work independently and escalate appropriately

*

Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment

*

Exceptional ability to collaborate across teams and communicate complex concepts clearly to diverse audiences

*

Patient-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity

*

Comfort working with RTSM platforms, digital health technology (DHT) solutions, and clinical trial management systems (CTMS)

*Required Qualifications*

*

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

*

5+ years of experience in building RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, developing user requirements, and managing requirements gathering, configuration, design, and user acceptance testing

*

Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes

*

Excellent technical and data standards knowledge with proven experience applying data standards in clinical trial environments

*

Demonstrated ability to create and explain business processes and train others on implementation

*

Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

*Preferred Qualifications*

*

Knowledge of industry standards such as CDISC SDTM and other data standards relevant to clinical trials

*

Experience with eCOA or ePRO systems and digital health technology platforms

*

Proven track record of conducting root cause analysis and driving process improvement initiatives

*

Demonstrated client-focused approach with ability to build and maintain strong client relationships

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
