title: GBS Healthcare Training & Development Design Specialist
description:
*Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.*

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

*Job Description:*

*Job Summary*

Find your next opportunity, work with talented teams, and grow in new ways through our energetic culture that helps you become better every day. Envision innovative possibilities to hone your skills. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill and passion.

We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and highly skilled Enablement Content Developer Specialist to join the GBS Healthcare team. This will be a remote role responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and deploying high-quality learning solutions that support employee performance, onboarding, process adoption, and business readiness initiatives. The ideal candidate is a strong eLearning developer with a solid foundation in instructional design, adult learning principles, Bloom’s Taxonomy, visual design, and AI-powered content development. This position reports directly to the Learning Strategy Supervisor.

*Key Responsibilities*

* Design and develop engaging learning solutions including eLearning modules, Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT), Web-Based Learning (WBL), process documents, job aids, quick reference guides, assessments, and multimedia learning assets.
* Build end-to-end Storyline 360 and Rise 360 learning experiences from concept through deployment.
* Develop interactive simulations, branching scenarios, software demonstrations, and knowledge checks.
* Create AI-enabled learning assets using tools such as Colossyan AI and other emerging content development technologies.
* Produce and edit instructional videos using related multimedia tools.
* Create visually engaging graphics, infographics, and learning assets using Canva while following branding standards.
* Apply instructional design theories, adult learning principles, Bloom’s Taxonomy, and learning design models to create effective learning experiences.
* Perform quality assurance reviews to ensure accuracy, consistency, functionality, accessibility, and learner engagement.
* Maintain and update existing learning content to reflect business, system, or process changes.
* Support curriculum and learning content maintenance within learning management systems.
* Manage multiple development projects simultaneously while meeting delivery timelines and quality expectations.

*Required Qualifications*

* Bachelor’s degree in instructional design, education, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of professional experience in eLearning Development, Instructional Design, Learning Content Development, or a related field.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Demonstrated knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design frameworks, and Bloom’s Taxonomy.
* Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

*Required Technical Skills*

* Articulate Storyline 360
* Articulate Rise 360
* Colossyan AI
* Canva
* Camtasia
* Whatfix
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Storyboarding and Prototyping
* Assessment and knowledge-check development
* Simulation development and multimedia production

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience developing training for Customer Service or Contact Center environments.
* Knowledge of Healthcare industry operations and processes.
* Portfolio demonstrating eLearning, multimedia, simulations, videos, and learning asset development.
* Relevant certifications in Instructional Design, Articulate 360, eLearning Development, or Learning Experience Design.

*Ideal Candidate Profile*

The ideal candidate is a creative learning content developer who enjoys transforming complex information into engaging, learner-centered experiences. This individual combines strong development expertise with sound instructional design knowledge, exceptional English communication skills, a passion for visual design, and the ability to leverage modern learning technologies and AI-powered tools to create impactful learning solutions for the UPS Healthcare business.

*Why Join Us?*

In this high-impact role, you’ll have the opportunity to influence the training landscape for UPS Global Healthcare, driving skill development and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. If you’re ready to create meaningful training solutions that make a difference, we encourage you to apply and become part of our innovative team.

UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

*Employee Type:*

Permanent

title: Software Engineer
description:
FirstWork is building the next generation of agentic AI products for frontline hiring, the work that gets roughly 80% of the world's workforce hired, verified, and paid.

We're looking for a Backend Engineer to design and build the AI-powered product features that carry a worker from application to their first day on the job.

In this role, you'll build and own AI agents running in production: document, browsing, voice, and conversational; collaborating closely with product managers, designers, and the engineers building our AI infrastructure. This is a true product engineering role: you'll own features end to end, ship every week, and see your work meet real enterprise volume the day it merges. Production code, real users, real scale.

---------------------
*The scale we run at*
---------------------

*

~50,000 workers a week move through our hiring and onboarding flows.

*

2.5 million API requests a day across the platform.

*

Millions of document pages a year processed by AI agents, across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages.

*

Global staffing, logistics, healthcare, marketplace, and employment platforms across the US, UK, EU, LATAM, and India.

*

Billing on work performed, per document validated and per agent action executed, which makes product design, cost per unit, and gross margin one conversation.

----------------
*What you'll do*
----------------

*

Build and ship AI-powered product features using LLMs, document agents, and agentic workflows.

*

Develop backend services and APIs that support model inference, orchestration, and tool execution.

*

Implement document extraction and validation pipelines that read real-world documents and auto-fill product data.

*

Build AI browsing agents that drive government and third-party portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI.

*

Ship conversational and voice agents that screen and follow up with candidates over phone, SMS, and WhatsApp.

*

Write and debug durable async workflows in Temporal for automations, AI jobs, and bulk actions.

*

Design and evolve the REST APIs and webhooks that customer ATS, HR, and payroll integrations run on.

*

Handle the production realities of AI: prompt design, structured output, retries, evaluation, and cost control.

*

Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and take part in code and design review.

*

Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability using production data.

--------------
*What we need*
--------------

*

3–5 years of professional backend engineering experience.

*

Strong Python, with meaningful time in Django and Django REST Framework or a close equivalent.

*

Hands-on experience integrating LLMs or ML-powered features into a live product.

*

Real SQL fluency and sound relational data modelling instincts.

*

Familiarity with APIs, async processing, queues, and distributed systems.

*

Understanding of prompting, structured output, and model inference.

*

Solid fundamentals in testing, debugging, and system design.

*

Care for correctness in multi-tenant systems, where every query stays scoped to a single customer.

*

Clear written communication and a product mindset focused on real-world impact.

--------------
*Nice to have*
--------------

*

Experience with agentic systems, workflows, or orchestration frameworks.

*

Browser automation at scale with Playwright or similar.

*

Temporal, Celery, Airflow, or another durable execution engine.

*

PostgreSQL beyond CRUD, and AWS in production.

*

Regulated domains such as identity, payroll, healthcare, fintech, or compliance.

*

HR tech, marketplaces, or other high-volume operational products.

*

Experience in an AI-first, fast-moving product environment.

*

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude.

-----------------
*About FirstWork*
-----------------

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the HR operations platform behind frontline hiring, the largest, least automated, and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One system carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training, and payroll.

We are AI-native. Our document agents read and validate credentials against policy. Our browsing agents drive government portals through the browser, where the only interface is the UI. Our voice and conversational agents screen and follow up with candidates. Our rule engines adjudicate compliance decisions and produce the audit trail behind them. Our agents are doing regulated work in production today.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

This is a hands-on architecture role: you'll still write code, and you'll see your decisions tested against live enterprise volume. *

~50,000 workers a week move through our hiring and onboarding flows.

*

2.5 million API requests a day across the platform.

Global staffing, logistics, healthcare, marketplace, and employment platforms across the US, UK, EU, LATAM, and India.

Billing on work performed, per document validated and per agent action executed, which makes product design, cost per unit, and gross margin one conversation.

Take end-to-end ownership of core domain: the agent runtime, the compliance and rules engine, the worker data model, or integrations.

Push LLMs and agentic AI deeper into the product, and draw the line between what belongs in inference and what belongs in deterministic, auditable rules.

*

Design the safety properties of agents that act in external systems, including idempotency, retries, isolation, and human escalation.

*

Build the evaluation and accuracy infrastructure that makes AI decisions defensible in a regulated context.

Keep inference viable at scale through model routing, caching, and batching, with cost per transaction as a tracked metric.

Design data models with long-lived constraints, including audit logs, compliance clocks, and credential lifecycles.

*

Drive the data architecture roadmap: read replicas, logical sharding, CDC-fed projections, and a search tier.

*

Enforce multi-tenancy, permissions, and audit trails as invariants guaranteed by design and by test.

*

Act as a technical lead through design review, incident command, and mentoring senior engineers.

*

Work directly with product and customers to turn bespoke requests into platform capabilities.

*What we need*
--------------

*

8+ years of professional backend engineering experience.

*

Experience at a company that outgrew its first architecture, and a hand in scaling it incrementally.

*

Deep relational database expertise, including diagnosing saturation in production.

*

Production experience with LLM or vision-model systems: evaluation, accuracy, cost control, and fallback design.

*

Strong distributed systems judgement across idempotency, retries, queue lag, and partial failure.

*

Experience with multi-tenant, configurable products.

*

A measurement-first approach: profiles and traces before opinions.

*

Influence through clear writing and demonstrated results.

--------------
*Nice to have*
--------------

*

Built agentic systems where an agent takes real action in an external system.

*

Temporal or another durable execution engine at production scale.

*

Event-driven architecture and CDC pipelines feeding read stores.

*

Rules engines, policy-as-code, or workflow orchestration.

*

Compliance, identity, payroll, or financial infrastructure background.

*

Experience platformizing a single-vertical product for additional verticals.

*

Experience in an AI-first, fast-moving product environment.

*

Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude.

-----------------

FirstWork is an applied AI company building the HR operations platform behind frontline hiring, the largest, least automated, and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One system carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training, and payroll, for hundreds of enterprise customers.

title: Product Manager
description:
FirstWork is a forward-deployed applied-AI company for frontline hiring, the largest and most heavily regulated labour market in the world. One platform carries a worker from application through onboarding, compliance verification, training and payroll, for enterprise customers across 40+ countries and a dozen-plus languages. Our AI agents run that work rather than assisting someone who still does it: document agents validate credentials against policy, browsing agents operate government portals that have no API, and voice agents screen and follow up with candidates.

The scale is live, at roughly 50,000 new applicants a week and 2.5 million API requests a day. We bill on usage, per document validated and per agent action executed.

We are looking for a Product Manager to own a core product surface and the AI capabilities within it.

----------------
*What you'll do*
----------------

*

Own the strategy, roadmap and outcomes for a core product surface.

*

Build and ship AI-powered product features using LLMs and agent-based workflows.

*

Innovate and enhance product capabilities, from new feature development to improving the maturity, accuracy and performance of existing features.

*

Define where an AI agent acts autonomously, where it hands off to a human, and what the audit trail records.

*

Specify decision logic, including decision trees, approval thresholds, exception routing and reason codes.

*

Define evaluation criteria for AI features: accuracy targets, evaluation datasets, regression detection and release readiness.

*

Decide what becomes a shared platform capability and what becomes customer configuration.

*

Design configuration so customer-specific requirements land as settings, rules and policy objects rather than code.

*

Own funnel, adoption and quality metrics, along with the instrumentation behind them.

*

Track unit economics for the features you own, including model cost and latency.

*

Run discovery with customers and translate their workflows into product requirements.

*

Work closely with engineering and design to ship in short cycles against live volume.

------------------
*What we look for*
------------------

*

4+ years of product management experience on B2B SaaS, workflow, operations or platform products.

*

Ownership of a complex platform or workflow product, such as a configurable multi-tenant system, a rules or policy engine, a workflow automation engine or an integration platform.

*

Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features to production, including prompt design, structured output, tool calling, fallback handling and evaluation.

*

Strong technical depth across data models, state machines, decision trees, and API and webhook behaviour.

*

Ability to work directly with engineers on design. This is not a functional product role.

*

Comfort pulling and interrogating your own data.

*

Clear written communication, with specifications precise enough to build from.

*

Customer-facing confidence in both discovery and escalation conversations.

-------
*Bonus*
-------

*

Experience with agentic systems, orchestration frameworks or tool-calling architectures.

*

Document AI, OCR, extraction or classification pipelines.

*

Voice or conversational products.

*

HR tech, ATS, staffing, workforce management or high-volume hiring.

*

Compliance, verification, identity or payroll products.

*

Usage-based or consumption pricing models.

*

SQL proficiency.

*

Experience working in AI-first or fast-moving product teams.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
**ABOUT US**

Calibrate is on a mission to change the way the world treats weight by redefining obesity care as a matter of biology, not willpower. Designed by world leaders in metabolic health, our program combines clinical research, personalized coaching, and lifestyle intervention to deliver lasting weight loss and improved metabolic outcomes. With obesity as America’s largest chronic condition, impacting 175mm adults in a $600B market, we’re closing the care gap by offering the first value-based model in obesity treatment.

Since launching Direct-to-Consumer in 2020, we’ve expanded into Enterprise channels to improve access, and our app-based experience supports members with coaching, tailored education, daily tracking, and community engagement across the four pillars of metabolic health: food, sleep, exercise, and emotional wellbeing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Junior Data Analyst to join our data team and support us in the use of analytics in both running our business and providing scorecards and insights to our clients and partners. In this role, you will help analyze operational and business data; create and maintain dashboards and scorecards for both running the company and for clients; and ensure our teams have access to timely insights.

You will partner with teams across clinical, coaching, engineering, product, operations, and finance to answer questions, monitor performance, and support data-driven decision-making. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their data career who is eager to build strong SQL and analytics skills, gain hands-on experience with healthcare and operational data, and grow into a fully independent Data Analyst over time.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support regular and ad hoc analyses to help answer key business and operational questions
* Assist in tracking KPIs that we use to run the business, and help maintain and improve recurring reports for operating and performance metrics
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards, ensuring teams have access to timely and reliable data for decision-making
* Partner with cross-functional teams (including clinical, coaching, operations, member care, engineering and product) to help identify trends, answer questions, and surface insights
* Assist in monitoring data quality and flagging inconsistencies, anomalies, or potential issues
* Collaborate with the Data Engineering team and senior analysts to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and usability
* Document queries, reports, and data definitions to support transparency and reproducibility

**BACKGROUND & EXPERIENCE**

* 0–2 years of experience in a data analyst role, internship, academic research, or similar analytical experience
* Working knowledge of SQL and ability to write basic queries to extract and analyze data
* Experience using Excel and/or Google Sheets for data analysis and manipulation
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
* Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Eagerness to learn and grow in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

**Preferred**

* Exposure to Business Intelligence tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Tableau, or similar)
* Experience with clinical data a plus, but not required
* Basic familiarity with Python or R
* Experience with and/or passion for working in the healthcare industry
* Familiarity with Git or version control tools
* Basic understanding of data warehousing or data engineering concepts

title: Junior Cybersecurity GRC Analyst
description:

-----------

Dragonfli Group is seeking a Junior Cyber Governance and Compliance Analyst to support a multi-year cybersecurity program for a large federal agency. This is an early-career governance role for someone who wants to learn the Risk Management Framework by working it. You will support and contribute to the execution of RMF to authorize IT systems, help the organization understand whether its systems are operating at an acceptable level of risk, and support authorization decisions by performing risk trade-off analyses and contributing to risk mitigation strategies. You will support technical analysis across categorization, control selection, control implementation, and comprehensive assessments of risk posture. You will also support presentations and, at times, present directly to clients and other decision makers. It suits a versatile early-career analyst with strong communication skills and some exposure to assessment and authorization work.

This is a multi-year contract position involving a large US federal agency. Candidates with previous federal contracting experience are preferred. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. If hired, all work related to this role must be performed within the continental U.S.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Support and contribute to the execution of the Risk Management Framework to authorize IT systems
* Provide information on whether information systems are operating at an acceptable level of risk to the organization
* Support information system authorization decisions by performing risk trade-off analyses
* Contribute to the development of risk mitigation strategies and solutions
* Support technical analysis across cybersecurity risk management activities: categorizing a system, proposing security control selections, implementing security controls, and providing comprehensive assessments of risk posture
* Support security control assessment activities in accordance with NIST SP 800-37 and NIST SP 800-53A
* Support presentations and, at times, present to clients and other decision makers across technical and non-technical audiences
* Support advice to clients on technical designs, implementations, and solutions that protect against cybersecurity attacks
* Support POA&M tracking, cyber risk register upkeep, and tracking of cybersecurity regulations, guidance, and data calls
* Support cybersecurity dashboard development and the automation of routine risk reporting and compliance tracking

Requirements
------------

Must-Have
---------

* Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field
* Exposure to Assessment and Authorization (RMF) work, including testing or assessing cybersecurity solutions, through coursework, internship, or professional experience
* Working understanding of the Risk Management Framework and the federal authorization process
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including comfort supporting or delivering presentations
* Ability to work independently and as a member of a team
* U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency, with all work performed within the continental U.S.
* Ability to pass a federal agency suitability or background investigation

Preferred / Nice-to-Have
------------------------

* Internship, co-op, or 1 to 2 years of professional experience in a GRC, audit, or compliance role
* Familiarity with NIST SP 800-53 control families and evidence expectations
* Exposure to a GRC platform such as Xacta, eMASS, CSAM, Archer, or ServiceNow IRM
* Exposure to FISMA reporting, SCRM, or TPRM concepts
* Interest in or exposure to automation and AI-assisted compliance tooling
* Security+ or CGRC (formerly CAP) certification, or active pursuit of one

Skill(s)
--------

Technical Skills
----------------

* Risk Management Framework fundamentals under NIST SP 800-37
* Security control familiarity under NIST SP 800-53 and assessment basics under 800-53A
* Risk trade-off analysis and mitigation strategy support
* POA&M tracking and evidence collection
* Security documentation and authorization artifact support
* Cyber risk register and regulatory tracking support
* Dashboard, reporting, and spreadsheet analysis skills
* Exposure to automation and AI-assisted compliance tooling

Soft Skills
-----------

* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to work independently and as a contributing member of a distributed team
* Comfort operating in a fully remote setting with a camera-on meeting culture
* Sound judgment about when to decide and when to escalate
* Collaborative posture with system owners, business owners, developers, and assessors
* Attention to documentation quality and follow-through on commitments

Benefits
--------

Dragonfli Group offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Medical: Multiple POS health plan options including an HSA-compatible plan
* Dental: PPO coverage for preventive, basic, and major services
* Vision: Annual exam, frames, lenses, and contact lens allowance
* 401(k): Employer match up to 5% of eligible compensation
* Long-Term Disability: 100% employer-paid coverage at 50% of pre-disability earnings
* Life Insurance & AD&D: 100% employer-paid coverage valued at $10,000 each

title: Senior eCommerce UX/UI Designer
location: Remote, Medellín, Antioquia, Colombia, South America
description:
*About WON*

WON is building the next generation of AI transformation for enterprise organizations. We are not another AI tools vendor. We build AI-native systems, combined with deep human judgment and category expertise, that fundamentally change how our clients operate, make decisions, and serve their customers.

Within that, our design practice works with premium DTC and ecommerce brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue: brands with strong products and strong followings that are still leaving growth on the table. We are not a “make it pretty” agency, and we are not another CRO shop running button tests. We combine deep behavioral insight with quantitative truth, then ship exceptional work fast, and we are building the AI-native systems that let us do it at a pace and scale traditional design teams cannot match.

AI powers our systems. Taste powers our design. The two compound each other: automation gives you the speed, and your judgment decides what is actually good.

This role reports to the VP of Design and works within the design roadmap they set.

*What You’ll Own*

*

End-to-end execution of high-conversion experiences, full customer journey redesigns, and high-performance growth creative, scoped by the design roadmap and delivered in close collaboration with the VP of Design

*

The WON design standard: clean, premium, behavior-driven, detail-obsessed, and fast to ship

*

Adoption of WON's AI-native design systems, including Claude Design and Figma MCP, to move from concept to shippable work faster

*

Automated asset creation built on our Figma component libraries, so variations and scale stop being manual work

*

Contributing to the expansion of WON’s design agents and workflows, flagging what should be automated next

-------------------------
*How Success Is Measured*
-------------------------

*

Conversion and AOV move measurably on the experiences you touch

*

Customers move further through the funnel because of design decisions you made

*

High-quality design ships fast, with less time lost between concept and production

*

Component libraries and AI-assisted workflows reduce manual design work over time, not just for you but for the whole team

*

Your work becomes the most reliable design output at WON, the standard new hires are measured against

----------------------
*Key Responsibilities*
----------------------

*

Design high-conversion sites and landing pages that still feel premium, the kind that belong in the top 1%

*

Design the full customer journey: acquisition landing flows, onboarding, collection architecture, PDP storytelling, cart and checkout, retention and member UX

*

Design growth creative: paid social landing pages, advertorials, quiz flows, product education, bundles and upsell, offer frameworks that feel intentional, not desperate

*

Build and maintain component libraries and design systems that scale across brands and campaigns

*

Use Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated asset generation to reduce production time without reducing quality

*

Continuously evaluate your own workflow and flag what should be turned into a repeatable system or agent

*

Present work with conviction, backed by session replays, cohort behavior, and voice of customer

------------
*Must-Have:*
------------

*

5+ years in digital design, agency or in-house

*

Strong ecommerce / DTC experience

*

A portfolio of modern, premium work, not template-driven

*

Mastery in Figma

*

Strong typography instincts, real ones

*

Taste that holds up under scrutiny: you can articulate why a design decision is right, not just that it feels right

*

Comfortable being measured by impact, not just output

*

Familiarity with AI design tools such as Claude Design or Figma MCP, or genuine interest in building them into your workflow

---------------
*Nice-to-Have:*
---------------

*

Designed for high-end brands (beauty, apparel, wellness, premium food)

*

Experience working within Shopify ecosystems

*

Built component libraries and design systems from scratch

*

Contributed to CRO programs that produced measurable performance gains

*Portfolio / Proof of Work Expectation*

*We Value*

*

Modern, premium design work, not template-driven

*

Evidence your design decisions moved a real metric: conversion, AOV, or funnel progression

*

Systems thinking: component libraries and reusable frameworks, not just one-off screens

*

Comfort presenting and defending design decisions with data

*How We Work / Culture*

*

Design is treated as a growth system, not a decoration function

*

Insights come first: every decision is grounded in customer behavior and tied to KPIs

*

AI and automation are used to eliminate manual production work, not to replace judgment

*

High clarity, ownership, and craft are core values: work ships fast instead of dying in Figma

*Why Join WON*

*

Build design systems that move revenue for brands doing $50M to $500M+ in revenue

*

Work at the intersection of design, behavioral insight, and AI-native workflows

*

High ownership over execution, with a clear roadmap and a VP of Design invested in your growth

*

Collaborate with a founder-led team with taste and urgency, and full access to the truth: session replays, cohort data, voice of customer

*

Help build the AI design systems, including Claude Design, Figma MCP, and automated component workflows, that define how WON designs at scale

*If you want to be a career designer, this probably isn’t for you. If you want to become an elite operator-designer who builds work that changes brands and makes numbers move, we’d love to meet you.*

title: Middle +/Senior UI/UX Designer (iGaming)
description:
Про проєкт
Ми будуємо два real-money iGaming продукти: слотовий досвід і live беттинг продукт, з real-time взаємодією в основі.
Ти проєктуватимеш mobile-first інтерфейси, де користувачі роблять ставки, кешаутяться в один тап і в реальному часі спостерігають за раундами та множниками. Робота охоплює ігровий UX, платформенні флоу та спільну дизайн-систему, з сильним фокусом на сценарії та метрики, а не лише на «красиві екрани».

Обов'язки
Проєктувати користувацькі сценарії, вайрфрейми та інтерактивні прототипи (Figma) під обидва продукти.
Робити mobile-first інтерфейси: вертикальний екран, live плеєр над кнопками, ставка/cash-out в один тап, відображення раундів і множників.
Проєктувати ігровий UX слотів: механіки раундів, автоплей, бонуси, стани персонажа, екрани виграшу/програшу.
Будувати та підтримувати дизайн-систему (компоненти, дизайн-токени) у зв'язці з фронтендом (Tailwind/Framer Motion) і передавати акуратні хендоффи.
Проєктувати платформенні флоу: онбординг, KYC, гаманець (депозити/виводи), VIP, центр сповіщень, сторінка верифікації Provably Fair.
Покращувати метрики через дизайн: працювати з продуктовою аналітикою (PostHog), брати участь в A/B тестах і гіпотезах разом із CRM/Retention.

Вимоги (must-have)
Обов'язковий досвід саме в iGaming/гемблінгу (казино/слоти/беттинг).
Знання ігрових і беттинг механік (раунди, множники, автоплей, бонуси, cash-out, Provably Fair).
3+ роки в продуктовому UI/UX (веб/мобайл), сильне портфоліо саме з iGaming продуктами.
Експерт у Figma (auto-layout, компоненти, варіативність, прототипування), досвід проєктування дизайн-систем.
Впевнений mobile-first і розуміння відгукливості/продуктивності інтерфейсу.
Уміння мислити сценаріями та метриками, а не лише «красивими екранами»; акуратний хендофф розробці.
Англійська на робочому рівні.

Буде плюсом
Motion/мікроанімації (принципи, специфікації під Framer Motion), UX дослідження.
Розуміння HTML/CSS на рівні «говорю з розробниками однією мовою», знайомство з гейміфікацією (місії, турніри, VIP).

Червоні прапорці
Робота тільки через AI (невміння працювати головою), спроби обману, зверхність, невміння працювати в команді.

title: Mobile UI/Visual Designer/Designer
description:
Mobile UI/Visual Designer

Black Horse IT — продуктова IT-компанія, яка створює та розвиває мобільні застосунки у різних нішах.

Шукаємо сильного Mobile UI/Visual Designer для проєктної віддаленої роботи.

Нам потрібен дизайнер, який вміє не просто працювати у Figma, а розуміє, як має виглядати сучасний комерційний мобільний продукт, самостійно бачить, що потрібно покращити, та може довести дизайн до якісного результату.

Що потрібно робити
Дизайн мобільних застосунків для iOS та Android.
Створення сучасного та привабливого UI для різних ніш.
Розробка App Store Screenshots та візуалів для сторінки застосунку.
Дизайн onboarding, paywall, subscription screens та ключових екранів продукту.
Створення візуальної концепції продукту та пошук відповідного visual direction.
Покращення існуючих інтерфейсів та їхньої візуальної подачі.
Робота з референсами та конкурентами.
Підготовка дизайну, який добре виглядає не лише у Figma, а й у реальному App Store та на мобільному пристрої.

Що для нас важливо
Сильний візуальний смак та хороша дизайн-насмотреність.
Портфоліо з реальними мобільними застосунками.
Впевнене володіння Figma.
Розуміння iOS UI/UX та сучасних mobile design patterns.
Вміння створювати App Store Screenshots, paywalls та onboarding, які виглядають як у якісних комерційних продуктів.
Вміння самостійно приймати дизайнерські рішення.
Здатність працювати за коротким брифом: зрозуміти задачу, знайти референси, запропонувати концепцію та реалізувати її.
Увага до типографіки, композиції, кольору, spacing та візуальної ієрархії.

Буде перевагою
Досвід роботи із subscription apps.
Досвід створення App Store / Google Play Screenshots.
Розуміння conversion-oriented design.
Досвід роботи з AI apps, utilities, productivity та іншими consumer mobile products.
Вміння використовувати AI-інструменти для створення візуалів та концептів.

Формат роботи
Проєктна робота.
100% віддалено.
Різні мобільні продукти та ніші.
Можливість довгострокової співпраці після успішних проєктів.
Оплата обговорюється індивідуально.

Відбір
У процесі відбору буде невелике тестове завдання.
Ми оцінюємо не лише знання Figma, а насамперед смак, насмотреність, самостійність та якість фінального візуального результату.

Якщо ви дивитесь на екран і одразу розумієте, як зробити його сучаснішим, красивішим та більш переконливим для користувача, — будемо раді познайомитися.

Для відгуку: надішліть портфоліо та коротко розкажіть про свій досвід роботи з мобільними застосунками.

title: Freelance Presentation Designer

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

*Additional requirements*

* Hands-on experience creating high-end, premium corporate-meets-creative style layouts.

title: Lead UX Designer
description:
UX Design Lead
--------------

Location:Remote/Hybrid/In-Office Options
----------------------------------------

*About the Role*
TechnoMile is seeking a Lead UX/UI Designer to lead the design and development of advanced user experiences for our SaaS platform tailored to the Government Contracting (GovCon) industry. This role combines strategic UX leadership with hands-on design, with a strong focus on agentic AI experiences where users collaborate with autonomous systems.

You will define how users interact with AI agents, ensuring clarity, control, and confidence while navigating complex workflows and data-rich environments.

What You’ll Do
--------------

Agentic Experience (AX) Design
------------------------------

* Define and lead how users interact with autonomous AI agents
* Design human-in-the-loop systems that provide visibility into AI reasoning and decision-making
* Create interfaces for monitoring long-running agent tasks, including status tracking, alerts, and intervention points
* Establish clear hand-offs between users and AI systems to maintain trust and control

AI Workflow & Platform Design
-----------------------------

* Design seamless AI-driven workflows across React-based applications, Salesforce, and Microsoft Power Platform (including Teams)
* Create unified experiences across multiple enterprise ecosystems

Complex Data & Content Systems
------------------------------

* Architect dashboards and workflows for content-heavy, data-rich environments
* Design systems that enable AI agents to aggregate, connect, and contextualize disparate data (e.g., linking subcontract records to prime contracts)
* Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable insights

Advanced AI Interaction Design
------------------------------

* Move beyond chat interfaces to design canvas/workbench-style experiences
* Enable real-time collaboration between users and AI agents for document editing, data analysis, and multi-step workflows

Design Systems & Consistency
----------------------------

* Extend and maintain our design system (based on UntitledUI)
* Define standardized UI components for:

* AI status indicators
* Confidence levels and explainability
* Approval, undo, and intervention actions

Prototyping & Validation
------------------------

* Develop high-fidelity prototypes in tools such as Figma or Bolt to simulate AI-driven interactions
* Conduct usability testing focused on user trust, clarity, and control over AI systems
* Iterate based on user feedback and behavioral insights

Strategic & Collaborative Design
--------------------------------

* Define and drive UX vision aligned with business and product strategy
* Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technically feasible solutions
* Translate complex requirements into intuitive user experiences
* Present design concepts and strategies to stakeholders, leadership, and clients

Research & Optimization
-----------------------

* Conduct user research, persona development, and journey mapping
* Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions
* Continuously refine UX processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and outcomes

Qualifications:
---------------

* 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for SaaS, enterprise, or workflow-heavy products
* Proven experience designing AI/agentic user experiences beyond simple chat interfaces
* Asynchronous task monitoring
* AI transparency and explainability
* Multi-step automation workflows
* Strong experience designing for complex data visualization and content-heavy systems
* Experience working across React, Salesforce, and Microsoft ecosystems (Teams/Power Automate)
* Proficiency in prototyping tools such as Figma, Bolt, or similar
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail
* Experience conducting user research and usability testing
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Skills
----------------

* Front-end fluency and understanding of how React components integrate with AI APIs, including streaming UI states
* Experience in B2B enterprise environments, particularly GovCon or regulated industries
* Familiarity with prompt engineering concepts and LLM/agent capabilities and constraints
* Experience working with AI/ML or data science teams to translate insights into user-facing features

Who We Are:
-----------

TechnoMile provides AI-enabled cloud solutions that empower GovCon, aerospace and defense, and other government-focused companies to modernize operations. Our SaaS products help clients:

* Optimize business development and sales processes.
* Streamline and de-risk contract management.
* Unlock the value of public and private data for a competitive advantage.

Today, more than 200 companies rely on TechnoMile, including over half of the top 10 federal defense contractors and the top 10 IT government contractors.

Our Culture
-----------

* Hungry, Humble, and Smart.We foster continuous learning and career growth, offering tuition reimbursement and ongoing development opportunities.
* Innovative.We embrace challenges and develop solutions others cannot.
* Flexible.Remote, hybrid, and in-office options support your best work.
* Global.With teams across the U.S. and India, we collaborate worldwide with one mission.

title: Principal Product Manager, Core Network
description:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at .

*What you’ll be part of:*

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values : High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

----------------------------------
**What you'll be responsible for**
----------------------------------

You will own the product strategy and evolution of the CPN Payments Engine — the core infrastructure that powers payment creation, routing, settlement, and lifecycle management across the network. You’ll define the long-term vision and roadmap for the engine, identifying opportunities to expand its capabilities while improving reliability, performance, and scale. Working across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams, you’ll lead complex product decisions and investments that enable OFIs and BFIs to move money efficiently across an expanding set of corridors and rails, translating platform improvements into measurable network and business outcomes.

-----------------------
**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

*

Set the Payments Engine strategy: Own the long-term product vision and roadmap for payment creation, processing, routing, and settlement, aligning investments with CPN and Circle priorities.

*

Advance payment performance at scale: Establish the product strategy for improving success rates, latency, resilience, and processing efficiency, using data to identify systemic opportunities and prioritize investments.

*

Evolve API and protocol capabilities: Define the direction for OFI Payments APIs and BFI quoting and settlement protocols, balancing developer experience, interoperability, compliance, scalability, and network reliability.

*

Expand the capabilities of the network: Identify and lead investments that unlock new payment use cases, corridors, rails, and partner capabilities while building reusable infrastructure that scales across the network.

*

Shape observability and operational control: Define product capabilities for monitoring, alerting, exception management, and operational tooling that improve visibility into payment health and enable faster resolution of network issues.

*

Lead complex cross-functional decisions: Partner with Engineering, Compliance, Operations, BD, and other product leaders to navigate architectural and business trade-offs, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment on high-impact investments.

*

Establish product leadership for payment infrastructure: Develop frameworks, metrics, and product practices that improve decision-making across CPN, mentor other product managers, and serve as a subject matter expert on payment infrastructure across Circle.

-------------------------------
**What you'll bring to Circle**
-------------------------------

**Core requirements**
---------------------

*

10+ years of relevant experience, including significant Product Management experience building payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure products.

*

Deep experience owning platform or infrastructure products such as APIs, payment processing systems, settlement platforms, routing systems, or developer-facing capabilities.

*

Demonstrated ability to define product strategy and lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering and cross-functional teams.

*

Strong analytical and technical fluency, with the ability to use payment performance, reliability, and operational data to identify systemic issues and guide product investment decisions.

*

Track record of delivering measurable improvements to large-scale systems, including reliability, success rates, latency, scalability, operational efficiency, or customer outcomes.

*

Ability to evaluate complex technical and business trade-offs and translate them into clear product decisions, priorities, and long-term platform investments.

*

Strong cross-functional influence and communication skills, including the ability to build alignment with senior leaders and stakeholders across Engineering, Compliance, Operations, and commercial teams.

**Preferred requirements**
--------------------------

*

Deep knowledge of payment networks, cross-border payments, settlement systems, correspondent banking, stablecoins, or blockchain-based financial infrastructure.

*

Experience with enterprise API products, two-sided networks, and compliance-forward payment systems, including concepts such as SLAs, payment lifecycle events, exception handling, sanctions screening, RFIs, or the Travel Rule.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We are an *equal opportunity employer*. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. As part of our global expansion, we are launching a Global Sales Hub in Bangalore to drive revenue growth across multiple regions. This hub will play a crucial role in accelerating our SME sales efforts worldwide. We are seeking dynamic sales leaders to build and scale a world-class sales team that delivers impactful results.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Associate Account Executive / Account Executive for our AMER region, you will be responsible for driving new business by selling Airwallex’s suite of products to SME prospects in your assigned region. You will be part of our outbound sales team, owning the full sales cycle from lead sourcing and qualification to discovery, solutioning, negotiation, closing, onboarding, and activation.

You will operate within your assigned region’s time zone and collaborate closely with regional sales leadership to deliver consistent revenue growth.

Please note: This is not a support role for in-region sales teams. You will independently own and drive sales within assigned territories, taking full accountability for pipeline generation, deal execution, and revenue delivery.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the full sales cycle - consistently delivering against revenue targets and key performance metrics.

- Drive revenue growth by building and maintaining a healthy, high-converting pipeline of SME prospects.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with regional sales, marketing, operations, and product teams to scale Airwallex’s go-to-market strategy.

- Define and refine sales processes including outreach cadences, qualification workflows, CRM hygiene, and reporting to maximize productivity.

- Negotiate commercial contracts and partnership agreements, working closely with legal, finance, and strategy teams to drive deal execution.

- Establish and share best practices across the global sales organization, contributing to a high-performance sales culture and scalable playbook.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 5 years of experience in sales roles, with at least 3 years of proven success in full-cycle, high-performance B2B sales.

- Proven track record of performing in high-velocity B2B sales environments.

- Proven ability to hunt for new business opportunities.

- Relevant global selling experience.

- Experience of global selling in EMEA, ANZ or AMER.

- Experience in B2B full-cycle sales, deal negotiation, and revenue generation.

- Strong familiarity with AI-powered sales engagement tools, CRM workflows, and automation strategies.

- Self-starter, detail oriented, metrics driven, collaborative, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in or understanding of the fintech/payments industry.

All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com http://airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com http://careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s).  Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

* Strong understanding of Selenium locator strategies, including XPath and CSS, as well as handling windows/tabs, iframes, alerts, and advanced browser interactions.

title: Junior Information System Security Officer
description:
Description
-----------

Dragonfli Group is a cybersecurity and IT consulting firm providing services to federal agencies and Fortune 100 enterprises. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Dragonfli supports clients in securing mission-critical systems across on-site, hybrid, and fully remote environments.

Dragonfli Group is seeking a Junior Information System Security Officer (ISSO) to support a multi-year cybersecurity program for a large federal agency. You will develop and maintain System Security Plans and the related security documentation that carries systems through authorization, and you will support the activities that help those systems obtain and maintain an Authorization to Operate. Day to day, you will be the security point of contact for software developers, project managers, and other team members inside your ATO boundary, helping them find practical ways to meet security requirements without stalling delivery. This role suits someone with roughly 2 years of ISSO experience who wants ownership of real systems while working under the guidance of a lead or senior ISSO.\

This is a multi-year contract position involving a large US federal agency. Candidates with previous federal contracting experience are preferred. U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency is required. If hired, all work related to this role must be performed within the continental U.S.

This position is fully remote. The agency's Rules of Behavior and Telework Policy apply to all contractor personnel and require, among other things, that laptop cameras be turned on and that staff remain visible on camera during all meetings.

Responsibilities
----------------

* Develop and maintain System Security Plans (SSPs) and related security documentation
* Support the activities that help systems obtain and maintain an Authorization to Operate (ATO)
* Assist with oversight of the information systems security program for applications and systems within the ATO boundary
* Provide day-to-day security support and guidance to software developers, project managers, and other team members
* Help identify practical ways to meet security requirements with minimal impact to delivery schedules
* Escalate complex or ambiguous security issues to the lead or senior ISSO with the context needed to resolve them
* Support execution of Risk Management Framework tasks including categorization, control selection, implementation, assessment, and authorization in accordance with NIST SP 800-37
* Support continuous monitoring activities and keep authorization artifacts current
* Support System Owner system access reviews and account management compliance
* Contribute to the use of automation and AI tooling that streamlines RMF documentation and control assessment work

Requirements
------------

Must-Have
---------

* Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, information technology, or a related field
* 2 years of ISSO experience, including hands-on work developing or maintaining System Security Plans
* Working knowledge of the Risk Management Framework and the federal authorization process (ATO)
* Familiarity with NIST SP 800-37 and NIST SP 800-53 control families
* Ability to explain security requirements clearly to developers and project managers
* U.S. Citizenship or Permanent Residency, with all work performed within the continental U.S.
* Ability to pass a federal agency suitability or background investigation

Preferred / Nice-to-Have
------------------------

* Prior federal contracting experience supporting a civilian agency ATO boundary
* Experience with a GRC platform such as Xacta, eMASS, CSAM, Archer, or ServiceNow IRM
* Exposure to FedRAMP-authorized cloud services and inherited control models
* Experience supporting POA&M tracking and remediation
* Familiarity with Ongoing Authorization or continuous ATO models
* Certifications such as Security+, CGRC (formerly CAP), or CISSP Associate

Skill(s)
--------

Technical Skills
----------------

* System Security Plan (SSP) authoring and maintenance
* Risk Management Framework execution under NIST SP 800-37
* NIST SP 800-53 control selection, implementation, and evidence mapping
* Authorization package assembly and ATO lifecycle support
* POA&M tracking and remediation coordination
* Continuous monitoring and security documentation upkeep
* GRC tooling (Xacta, eMASS, CSAM, Archer, or ServiceNow IRM)
* Cloud service authorization concepts, including FedRAMP inheritance

Soft Skills
-----------

* Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
* Ability to work independently and as a contributing member of a distributed team
* Comfort operating in a fully remote setting with a camera-on meeting culture
* Sound judgment about when to decide and when to escalate
* Collaborative posture with system owners, business owners, developers, and assessors
* Attention to documentation quality and follow-through on commitments

Benefits
--------

Dragonfli Group offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

* Medical: Multiple POS health plan options including an HSA-compatible plan
* Dental: PPO coverage for preventive, basic, and major services
* Vision: Annual exam, frames, lenses, and contact lens allowance
* 401(k): Employer match up to 5% of eligible compensation
* Long-Term Disability: 100% employer-paid coverage at 50% of pre-disability earnings
* Life Insurance & AD&D: 100% employer-paid coverage valued at $10,000 each
* PTO: 15–25 days annually based on tenure
* Paid Federal Holidays: All 11 federal holidays observed

title: Junior Recruiter / Sourcing Specialist
description:
Junior Recruiter / Sourcing Specialist
--------------------------------------

*Удалённо · проектная занятость · международный IT-рекрутмент*

Ищу начинающего рекрутера или сорсера, которому интересно развиваться в международном рекрутменте в сфере tech и digital.

— Искать кандидатов в LinkedIn, на job boards, в профессиональных сообществах и других открытых источниках.
— Работать с понятным брифом по вакансии: учитывать обязательные навыки, seniority, локацию, языки, формат работы и другие критерии.
— Анализировать профили и отбирать людей, которые действительно могут подойти команде.
— При необходимости писать кандидатам первые сообщения или передавать подходящие контакты мне для дальнейшей коммуникации.
— Постепенно развивать навыки Boolean search, market mapping и международного candidate sourcing.

Кого я ищу
----------

— Начинающего рекрутера / сорсера или человека, который хочет войти в сферу международного IT-рекрутмента.
— Того, кому нравится исследовать рынок, искать информацию и замечать детали в профилях кандидатов.
— Человека с базовым пониманием LinkedIn, Boolean search и candidate sourcing — или с сильной мотивацией быстро этому научиться.

— Уверенный английский будет большим преимуществом: часть вакансий, профилей и коммуникации будет на английском.

Формат работы
-------------

— Полностью удалённо.
— Проектная занятость: вы сами выбираете, когда и сколько работать.
— Можно совмещать с учёбой, основной работой или другими проектами.
— Это не стандартная full-time вакансия с фиксированным окладом: объём задач зависит от активных проектов и результатов. Формат и компенсацию обсудим индивидуально.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
*Who We Are:*

We build infrastructure that delivers massive amounts of web data to the companies training the world’s most powerful AI models.

We're the team that helps to power and support Grass, a bandwidth-sharing network that lets us operate a massive distributed crawler, giving us unique access to high-quality public web data at global scale. On top of that, we’ve built pipelines for ingesting, segmenting, and annotating billions of videos, transcripts, and audio files, powering dataset creation for frontier labs.

We’re lean, technical, and move fast. No red tape, no slow decision-making; just a team of builders pushing to expand what’s possible for open web data and AI.

*The Role:*

We're looking for an early-career software engineer to help review our applications and ensure they meet compliance requirements before release. You'll be trusted to investigate application behavior independently, exercise sound judgment when identifying potential compliance issues, and take ownership of problems from discovery through resolution.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, quality assurance, and compliance validation. You'll review product changes, investigate application behavior, identify potential compliance issues, document findings clearly, and work closely with engineering and operations teams to drive issues through resolution and verify that they’ve been properly addressed before deployment.

*Please Note: This role requires a work schedule that overlaps sufficiently with EST business hours (online until 3:00 p.m. EST) to collaborate effectively with the team.*

*Who You Are:*

*

You have hands-on programming experience with Rust and/or Java — even if limited.

*

You're a fast learner who can pick up unfamiliar systems, applications, and requirements quickly.

*

You have strong analytical instincts — you naturally notice inconsistencies and dig until you understand why something behaves the way it does.

*

You communicate findings clearly and professionally, both in writing and in conversation.

*

You take ownership: once you're given a problem, you see it through rather than waiting for direction at every step.

*

You're comfortable with ambiguity and change — you don't need a fixed checklist to know what to investigate next.

*

You enjoy working closely with engineering, product, and operations, and you don't need a narrowly defined lane to be effective.

*What You'll Be Doing:*

*

Review applications before release to ensure they meet defined requirements and identify potential compliance issues.

*

Understand and investigate application behavior in order to identify technical or compliance-related problems.

*

Validate application changes and document findings clearly.

*

Provide actionable feedback and communicate issues effectively to engineering and operations teams.

*

Work with engineers to understand and resolve identified issues.

*

Verify that issues have been properly addressed before release.

*

Maintain review documentation and contribute to improving internal review processes.

*

Help improve and, where appropriate, automate validation and QA workflows.

*What We Are Looking For:*

*

Develop a deeper understanding of our applications and systems over time and take increasing ownership of the review process.

*

Help ensure a consistent, high-quality release process across products.

*

Programming experience in Rust and/or Java (early-career level is fine — we care more about how quickly you learn and think through problems).

*

Experience in a startup or small engineering team, particularly where you had broad responsibilities.

*

Exposure to QA, testing, product validation, compliance, or security.

*

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

*

Ability to manage multiple reviews or tasks in parallel without losing track of details.

*Why Work With Us:*

*

Opportunity. We are at the forefront of developing a web-scale crawler and knowledge graph that improves access to public web data and extends the value of AI to the people.

*

Culture. We're a lean team with a high bar. We come to work not to be comfortable, but to find out what we're capable of and to do work that matters. We're not calling for people who keep things moving. We're calling for people who make everyone around them better.
We prioritize low ego and high output. This is a fully remote team.

*

Compensation. You’ll receive a competitive salary, benefits and equity package.

---------

* Advanced English proficiency for daily collaboration with international stakeholders.

* Own product design initiatives from problem discovery and concept development through implementation and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, product requirements, and success criteria.
* Map user journeys, workflows, information architecture, and interaction models for complex digital experiences.
* Create sketches, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs to communicate and validate potential solutions.
* Design intuitive and consistent experiences across web, mobile, kiosk, and other relevant digital touchpoints.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams to evaluate technical constraints and ensure accurate design implementation.
* Apply and contribute to shared design-system components, patterns, standards, and documentation.
* Participate in research and usability-validation activities and incorporate findings into product decisions.
* Present design solutions and clearly communicate the reasoning, assumptions, and tradeoffs behind them.
* Balance customer needs, business priorities, technical feasibility, and delivery timelines.
* Work across multiple product teams while maintaining alignment throughout the broader digital ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing experiences using customer feedback, research findings, product data, and stakeholder input.
* Review implemented functionality and partner with Engineering and QA to ensure the final experience meets the intended design standards.
* Contribute to design critiques, product-planning discussions, and continuous improvement of the team’s design practices.

* 4+ years of Digital Product / UX/UI Design experience.
* Strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design case studies.
* Advanced hands-on proficiency with Figma.
* Experience owning the full product design lifecycle.
* Experience designing customer-facing web and mobile products.
* Advanced English proficiency.

About Us
--------

We Are Engineered Different.
----------------------------

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: *Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication*. These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

The environment is fast-paced and collaborative, with exposure to evolving digital health technologies and clinical research practices.
This is an opportunity to deepen your eClinical expertise while contributing to the advancement of patient-focused clinical research.

Accountabilities
----------------

* *IRT/RTSM & DHT Consulting:* Provide expert guidance to project leaders and study teams on IRT/RTSM and DHT study design, requirements gathering, configuration, and implementation.
* *Requirements Management:* Analyze clinical trial protocols and collaborate with stakeholders to develop, review, and validate user requirements aligned with study objectives and applicable regulatory standards.
* *Risk & Compliance:* Identify and mitigate risks associated with IRT/RTSM and DHT implementation while protecting data integrity and ensuring adherence to clinical trial processes.
* *Solution Translation:* Convert complex technical and business requirements into clear, actionable recommendations that enable study teams and system users to make informed decisions.
* *Systems & Integrations:* Evaluate system integrations, third-party interfaces, data flows, and user requirements to proactively identify and resolve potential functionality or implementation issues.
* *Testing & Validation:* Partner with UAT leads to design, execute, and validate testing activities, ensuring solutions meet documented requirements and business objectives.
* *Client Engagement:* Work directly with external clients to discuss study design considerations, protocol requirements, implementation strategies, technical challenges, and potential solutions.
* *Quality & Delivery:* Maintain high standards for quality and timely delivery of project outputs, implementing corrective actions and resolving issues proactively.
* *Innovation & Continuous Improvement:* Monitor emerging IRT/RTSM and DHT technologies, industry practices, and regulatory developments to identify opportunities for improved clinical trial delivery.
* *Training & Knowledge Sharing:* Develop and explain business processes and support training for users and stakeholders involved in system implementation and clinical trial operations.

------------
Requirements
------------

* *Education:* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* *Clinical Systems Experience:* At least 5 years of experience building IRT/RTSM and/or DHT clinical trial systems, including requirements gathering, system configuration, design, and User Acceptance Testing.
* *Domain Expertise:* Strong understanding of clinical trial design, requirements management, clinical research processes, and regulated healthcare environments.
* *Regulatory Knowledge:* Working knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, data integrity principles, and clinical trial standards.
* *Data Standards:* Strong technical and data standards knowledge, with demonstrated ability to apply relevant standards within clinical trial environments.
* *IRT/RTSM & DHT Platforms:* Comfortable working with RTSM platforms, Digital Health Technology solutions, Clinical Trial Management Systems, and related clinical technologies.
* *Additional Experience:* Knowledge of CDISC SDTM and other clinical data standards, as well as experience with eCOA, ePRO, or similar digital health platforms, is preferred.
* *Analytical Skills:* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work independently and escalate issues appropriately.
* *Communication:* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical and business concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* *Client Management:* Demonstrated ability to establish and maintain trusted client relationships and deliver a consistently client-focused experience.
* *Organization & Ownership:* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, proactive decision-making, and commitment to quality and data integrity.
* *Continuous Improvement:* Proven ability to identify opportunities for process improvement and implement practical solutions that enhance efficiency and outcomes.
* *Patient Focus:* A strong commitment to patient-centered clinical research and the role technology can play in improving trial experiences and accelerating access to new treatments.

--------
Benefits
--------

* Flexible working environment designed to support strong performance and work-life balance.
* Remote working opportunity based in India.
* Opportunities for continuous learning and professional development across clinical research and digital health.
* Exposure to innovative IRT/RTSM, DHT, and eClinical technologies.
* Opportunity to collaborate with diverse, cross-functional teams and international clients.
* Career development opportunities within a global clinical research and consulting environment.
* Meaningful opportunity to contribute to clinical trials and technologies that can improve patient outcomes.
* Inclusive, collaborative workplace that values diverse perspectives and encourages professional growth.

title: Product Manager 1
description:
-------------------
*About AlphaSense:*
-------------------

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:
---------------

The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating, licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured data that is both self-sourced and from third party content providers. The Content teams report to the Chief Content Officer and have strategy, product management, content operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing a rapid growth cycle across all content sets, including the Broker Research team. We value and uphold transparency, trust and accountability in our relationships within the team and with external and internal stakeholders.

About the Role:
---------------

We are seeking a Product Manager I to join the Broker Research team. The PM I must have working knowledge of investment research, including the business models and client use cases for research content and associated data. The focus of this role will be the integration and maintenance of third-party content in AlphaSense. Additional responsibilities will include the need to continuously analyze and enhance processes by working with our agile teams. The candidate must also be capable of articulating and delivering a vision for research and data on AlphaSense.

Who You Are:
------------

*

3-5 years’ experience in financial services with a specific focus on broker research.

*

A strong knowledge of broker data, content, and metadata.

*

Content delivery experience using iterative / agile development methodologies.

*

A proven track record of delivering content from initial engagement to release.

*

A superior ability to set priorities, stay focused and meet deadlines.

*

Experience working with distributed teams.

*

Existing relationships with broker research departments and key third-party distribution vendors.

*

Strong analytical skills and outstanding attention to detail.

*

B2B SaaS and/or enterprise software application company experience.

*

Solid experience with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace products (Excel, Word, Sheets, etc)

What You’ll Do:
---------------

*

Responsible for the end-to-end integration of third-party content and data feeds.

*

Work with external and internal stakeholders to create detailed requirements for broker data and content.

*

Collect product & workflow enhancement requests from brokers & internal stakeholders.

*

Applying agile development methodology and working iteratively with engineers and various stakeholders to define scope and deliver features and improvements rapidly, while iterating to make improvements.

*

Work with other members of the broker research team, continuously analyze our processes and tools to identify gaps and areas of improvement.

*

Manage and maintain strong broker and independent research relationships with key decision makers; including product, business, technology, and operations teams.

*

Project manage partnership initiatives with research providers.

*

Create and manage a project roadmap by working with development teams to understand and optimize costs, benefits, and timelines for all aspects of implementation.

*

Contributing to the successful launch of content into the market, including the creation of announcements, marketing collateral, documentation, user training and internal training.

*

Track industry trends and deliver competitive intelligence to better evolve product vision.

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor.
